                                      derivedCloudRes > 0 -> derivedCloudRes
                                      else -> slot.resonance.coerceAtLeast(0)
                                    }
                                  val resolvedActivity =
                                    when {
                                      liveMatch == null -> "OFFLINE"
                                      liveMatch.sectorId.equals("NEXUS_LOBBY", ignoreCase = true) ||
                                        liveMatch.sectorId.equals("RIFT_LOBBY", ignoreCase = true) ->
                                        "ONLINE • RIFT HUB"
                                      else -> "IN COMBAT • ${liveMatch.sectorId}"
                                    }
                                  slot.copy(
                                    shipId = liveMatch?.shipId?.toInt()?.coerceIn(1, 10) ?: slot.shipId,
                                    resonance = resolvedRes,
                                    isOnline = liveMatch != null,
                                    activityLabel = resolvedActivity,
                                  )
                                }
                              }
                            }

                          ArmadaFleetModal(
                            currentSyndicateTag = syndicateTag,
                            activeArmadaName = engine.activeArmadaName,
                            armadaTierLabel = engine.getCurrentArmadaTierLabel(),
                            armadaSlots = enrichedArmadaSlots,
                            friendsList = enrichedFriendsList,
                            blockedPilotUids = blockedPilotUids,
                            statusBannerMessage = armadaStatusBanner,
                            onCreateOrRenameArmada = { newArmadaName ->
                              val trimmedWing =
                                newArmadaName
                                  .trim()
                                  .uppercase(Locale.US)
                                  .replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_-]"), "")
                                  .take(14)
                              if (trimmedWing.isEmpty() || UgcModeration.containsProfanity(trimmedWing)) {
                                armadaStatusBanner = "SQUADRON TAG REJECTED BY SAFETY FILTER."
                              } else {
                                engine.formOrJoinArmada(
                                  trimmedWing,
                                  if (engine.activeArmadaSlots.size <= 1) enrichedFriendsList.take(1)
                                  else emptyList(),
                                )
                                armadaStatusBanner =
                                  "SQUADRON [${engine.activeArmadaName}] DEPLOYED (${engine.getCurrentArmadaSize()}/5 PILOTS)"
                                friendsRefreshKey++
                              }
                            },
                            onInviteFriendToArmada = { friend ->
                              val added = engine.addMemberToArmada(friend)
                              if (added) {
                                armadaStatusBanner =
                                  "${friend.callsign} JOINED SQUADRON [${engine.activeArmadaName}] (${engine.getCurrentArmadaSize()}/5)"
                              }
                              friendsRefreshKey++
                            },
                            onRequestJoinFriendArmada = { friend ->
                              val targetArmada =
                                friend.currentArmadaName
                                  .ifEmpty { "${friend.syndicateTag}_SQD" }
                                  .take(14)
                              engine.formOrJoinArmada(targetArmada, listOf(friend))
                              armadaStatusBanner =
                                "JOINED SQUADRON [$targetArmada] WITH ${friend.callsign} (${engine.getCurrentArmadaSize()}/5)."
                              friendsRefreshKey++
                            },
                            onRemoveArmadaMember = { callsignToDrop ->
                              engine.removeMemberFromArmada(callsignToDrop)
                              armadaStatusBanner =
                                "ROSTER UPDATED -> NOW IN ${engine.getCurrentArmadaTierLabel()} TIER."
                              friendsRefreshKey++
                            },
                            onLeaveArmadaToSolo = {
                              engine.leaveArmadaToSolo()
                              armadaStatusBanner = "LEFT SQUADRON -> OPERATING INDEPENDENTLY."
                              friendsRefreshKey++
                            },
                            onAddFriendByCallsign = { rawCallsign ->
                              viewModel.lookupAndAddRealFriendByCallsign(
                                rawCallsign = rawCallsign,
                                localPrefs = localPrefs,
                              ) { _, statusMsg ->
                                armadaStatusBanner = statusMsg
                                toastMessage = statusMsg
                                toastVersion++
                                friendsRefreshKey++
                              }
                            },
                            onBlockPilot = { pilotUid, pilotCallsign ->
                              localPrefs.blockPilot(pilotUid)
                              blockedPilotUids = localPrefs.getBlockedPilotUids()
                              armadaStatusBanner = "BLOCKED PILOT $pilotCallsign."
                            },
                            onReportPilot = { pilotUid, pilotCallsign ->
                              localPrefs.reportPilot(pilotUid, pilotCallsign, "Squadron Roster Report")
                              armadaStatusBanner = "REPORT SUBMITTED FOR $pilotCallsign."
                            },
                            onCloseModal = closeEmbeddedModal,
                          )
                        } else {
                          val directoryList =
                            remember(syndicateTag, frameTick, cloudSyndicatesState) {
                              val cloudList =
                                (cloudSyndicatesState as? UiState.Success)?.data ?: emptyList()
                              localPrefs.mergeCloudSyndicates(cloudList)
                              localPrefs.getAllSyndicates()
                            }
                          val rosterMembers =
                            remember(syndicateTag, callsign, selectedShipId, frameTick) {
                              localPrefs.getMySyndicateRoster(
                                currentUid = currentUserId,
                                callsign = callsign,
                                shipId = selectedShipId,
                                bounty = engine.localPlayer.bounty.toLong(),
                                kills = engine.allTimeKills,
                              )
                            }
                          val achievements =
                            remember(frameTick, syndicateTag) {
                              listOf(
                                PilotAchievement(
                                  id = "apex_hunter",
                                  title = "APEX HUNTER",
                                  description = "Eliminate an above-average Resonance rival (Resonance >= 250).",
                                  unlocked =
                                    engine.hvtEliminations >= 1L || engine.allTimeBountyPeak >= 250L,
                                  progressText = "${engine.hvtEliminations} TOP-RES KILLS",
                                ),
                                PilotAchievement(
                                  id = "trench_runner",
                                  title = "TRENCH RUNNER",
                                  description =
                                    "Achieve 10+ total eliminations across sector skirmishes.",
                                  unlocked = engine.allTimeKills >= 10L,
                                  progressText = "${engine.allTimeKills} / 10 KILLS",
                                ),
                                PilotAchievement(
                                  id = "first_convergence",
                                  title = "FIRST CONVERGENCE",
                                  description = "Reach 250+ Resonance in open Rift combat.",
                                  unlocked = engine.allTimeBountyPeak >= 250L,
                                  progressText = "${engine.allTimeBountyPeak} / 250 RES",
                                ),
                                PilotAchievement(
                                  id = "flux_overlord",
                                  title = "FLUX OVERLORD",
                                  description = "Collect 5+ Supply Crates in open space.",
                                  unlocked = engine.greensCollected >= 5L,
                                  progressText = "${engine.greensCollected} / 5 CRATES",
                                ),
                                PilotAchievement(
                                  id = "phase_striker",

                                        syndicateTag !in LocalPilotPrefs.NON_PLAYER_SYNDICATE_TAGS

                                    } else {
                                      "UNAFFILIATED"
                                    },

                              )
                            }

                          SyndicatesModal(

                            remainingLockFormatted = localPrefs.getRemainingSyndicateLockFormatted(),
                            directoryList = directoryList,

                            statusBannerMessage = syndicateStatusBanner,

                              if (joined) {
                                syndicateTag = localPrefs.getSyndicateTag()
                                syndicateName = localPrefs.getSyndicateName()
                                syndicateHistory = localPrefs.getSyndicateServiceHistory(currentUserId)
                                engine.localPlayer.syndicateTag = syndicateTag
                                engine.syncLocalArmadaSelfSlot()
                                syndicateStatusBanner =
                                  "JOINED [$syndicateTag] $syndicateName! 15-DAY LOCK COOLDOWN (15d 00h) ACTIVE."
                                engine.onStatsUpdated()
                              } else {
                                syndicateStatusBanner =
                                  "CANNOT SWITCH SYNDICATES YET: ${localPrefs.getRemainingSyndicateLockFormatted()} REMAINING."
                              }
                            },
                            onLeaveSyndicate = {
                              val left = localPrefs.leaveSyndicate()
                              if (left) {
                                syndicateTag = localPrefs.getSyndicateTag()
                                syndicateName = localPrefs.getSyndicateName()
                                syndicateHistory = localPrefs.getSyndicateServiceHistory(currentUserId)
                                engine.localPlayer.syndicateTag = syndicateTag
                                engine.syncLocalArmadaSelfSlot()
                                syndicateStatusBanner =
                                  "LEFT SYNDICATE -> UNAFFILIATED. 15-DAY LOCK COOLDOWN TRIGGERED."
                                engine.onStatsUpdated()
                              } else {
                                syndicateStatusBanner =
                                  "CANNOT LEAVE SYNDICATE YET: ${localPrefs.getRemainingSyndicateLockFormatted()} REMAINING."
                              }
                            },
                            onCreateCustomSyndicate = { rawTag, rawName, rawMotto ->
                              val res =
                                localPrefs.createCustomSyndicate(
                                  tag = rawTag,
                                  name = rawName,
                                  motto = rawMotto,
                                  ownerUid = currentUserId.ifBlank { "local_founder" },
                                )
                              res
                                .onSuccess { created ->
                                  syndicateTag = created.tag
                                  syndicateName = created.name
                                  syndicateHistory = localPrefs.getSyndicateServiceHistory(currentUserId)
                                  engine.localPlayer.syndicateTag = syndicateTag
                                  engine.syncLocalArmadaSelfSlot()
                                  if (isGoogleAuthenticated) {
                                    viewModel.createCloudSyndicate(created)
                                  }
                                  syndicateChannelsRefreshKey++
                                  syndicateStatusBanner =
                                    "CHARTERED [${created.tag}] ${created.name}! LOCKED FOR 15d 00h."
                                  engine.onStatsUpdated()
                                }
                                .onFailure { err ->
                                  syndicateStatusBanner = err.message ?: "INVALID SYNDICATE CHARTER."
                                }
                            },
                            onCloseModal = closeEmbeddedModal,

                              engine.hvtEliminations = 0L
                              engine.greensCollected = 0L
                              engine.xpFromBuffs = 0f
                              engine.xpFromDamage = 0f
                              engine.xpFromAccuracy = 0f
                              engine.xpFromBountyEarned = 0f
                              engine.xpFromBountyKilled = 0f
                              engine.pilotLevel = 1
                              engine.riftShards = RiftBillingManager.effectiveShardBalance(0L)

                              localPrefs.setRiftShards(engine.riftShards, currentUserId)
                              sfx.playPrize()
                              engine.onStatsUpdated()
                              true

                ) {

                syncEquippedCosmeticsToEngine(engine)
                engine.enterEphemeralPracticeRift(startTutorial = true)

                frameTick++

                }
              },

              canQueueSyndicateWars = engine.canQueueSyndicateWars(),

                suspendedActiveMatch = null

                viewModel.setActiveSector(engine.activeMatchSectorTag())

                toastMessage = "RIFT OUT // ORBITING RIFT STATION"
                toastVersion++
                frameTick++

              onOpenArmadaModal = {
                armadaStatusBanner = null
                syndicateSubDeck = SyndicateCitadelSubDeck.STRIKE_WING
                openNexusNode(NexusCoreNode.SYNDICATE_CITADEL)
              },
              onQuickFormSyndicateArmada = {
                val synMates =
                  syndicateFriends
                    .filter {
                      it.isOnline &&
                        RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(it.syndicateTag) ==
                          RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(syndicateTag)
                    }
                    .take(4)
                val prefix =
                  RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(syndicateTag).let {
                    if (it == "GUEST" || it == "RFT" || it.isEmpty()) callsign.take(6) else it
                  }
                val fleetTag = "${prefix}_SQD".take(14)
                engine.formOrJoinArmada(
                  fleetTag,
                  if (synMates.isNotEmpty()) synMates else syndicateFriends.take(2),
                )
                friendsRefreshKey++
                toastMessage =
                  "SQUADRON [$fleetTag] STAGED (${engine.getCurrentArmadaSize()}/5 PILOTS)"
                toastVersion++
              },

              },

                isForgeFullScreenStage = true

                RiftCalibrationState.isCalibrationModalOpen = false
                forgeInitialTab = NexusForgeTab.DEV_STUDIO_STAGE
                isForgeFullScreenStage = true
                openNexusNode(NexusCoreNode.STAR_FORGE)
              },

                val clamped = targetShipId.coerceIn(1, 10)
                selectedShipId = clamped
                hasExplicitHangarLock = true
                localPrefs.setPreferredShipId(clamped)
                engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(clamped, forceFromHangar = true)

                  RiftCodex.getAllNineShips()
                    .find { it.id == clamped }
                    ?.name
                    ?.replace(Regex("^[0-9]+-"), "")
                    ?.uppercase(Locale.US) ?: "RIFT FRAME"
                toastMessage = "LOCKED $shipTitle FOR SECTOR DEPLOYMENT"
                toastVersion++

                  toastMessage = "MAXIMUM 5 CHANNELS REACHED FOR [$syndicateTag]"
                  toastVersion++
                } else {
                  localPrefs.setSyndicateCustomChannels(
                    syndicateTag,

                  )
                  syndicateChannelsRefreshKey++
                  toastMessage = "CREATED SYNDICATE CHANNEL IN [$syndicateTag]"
                  toastVersion++
                }
              },
              onDeleteSyndicateChannel = { rawChannel ->
                val currentChannels = localPrefs.getSyndicateCustomChannels(syndicateTag)
                val filtered =
                  currentChannels.filterNot { it.equals(rawChannel, ignoreCase = true) }
                localPrefs.setSyndicateCustomChannels(syndicateTag, filtered)
                syndicateChannelsRefreshKey++
                toastMessage = "REMOVED CHANNEL $rawChannel"
                toastVersion++
              },
              onInviteSyndicateGuest = { guestCallsign ->
                localPrefs.inviteGuestToSyndicateChannels(syndicateTag, guestCallsign)
                syndicateChannelsRefreshKey++

                toastVersion++
              },
              onRevokeSyndicateGuest = { guestCallsign ->
                localPrefs.revokeGuestFromSyndicateChannels(syndicateTag, guestCallsign)
                syndicateChannelsRefreshKey++
                toastMessage = "REVOKED GUEST PASS FOR $guestCallsign"
                toastVersion++
              },
              lobbyMessages = chatMessages,
              onSendChannelMessage = { channelKey, messageText ->
                val safeText = UgcModeration.sanitizeUgcText(messageText)
                val cleanSyn = localPrefs.sanitizeSyndicateTag(syndicateTag)
                val posted =
                  viewModel.postStructuredChannelMessage(
                    senderCallsign = callsign,
                    senderSyndicateTag = cleanSyn,
                    channelKey = channelKey,
                    messageText = safeText,
                  )
                if (chatMessages.none { it.id == posted.id }) {
                  chatMessages.add(posted)
                }
              },
              onSubmitBugReport = { category, description ->
                val safeDesc = UgcModeration.sanitizeUgcText(description)
                val cleanSyn = localPrefs.sanitizeSyndicateTag(syndicateTag)
                localPrefs.reportPilot(
                  uid = "BUG_${category.take(10)}",
                  callsign = category,
                  reason = safeDesc,
                )
                viewModel.submitCloudBugReport(
                  reporterCallsign = callsign,
                  syndicateTag = cleanSyn,
                  category = category,
                  description = safeDesc,
                  buildVersion = CURRENT_RIFT_BUILD_VERSION,
                  activeMode = engine.activeMatchSectorTag(),
                  activeShipId = selectedShipId,
                  screenDpSummary = "${configuration.screenWidthDp}x${configuration.screenHeightDp}dp",
                )
                val bugEcho =
                  SyndicateChatMessage(
                    id = "bug_${System.currentTimeMillis()}",
                    senderUid = currentUserId,
                    senderCallsign = callsign,
                    senderSyndicateTag = cleanSyn,
                    timestampLabel = "#BUG-REPORTS",
                    messageText = "[$category] $safeDesc",
                    armadaObjective = "BUG|$category|v1.0.$CURRENT_RIFT_BUILD_VERSION",
                  )
                chatMessages.add(bugEcho)
                toastMessage = "ANOMALY LOGGED TO CLOUD TELEMETRY [$category]"
                toastVersion++
              },
              onShareActiveRiftFrameBuild = {
                val frameTitle = activeCustomSlot.customName.take(16)
                val compactRecipe =
                  "BUILD|$frameTitle|" +
                    "${activeCustomSlot.speedPts},${activeCustomSlot.thrustPts},${activeCustomSlot.turnPts},${activeCustomSlot.maxFluxPts},${activeCustomSlot.rechargePts}|" +
                    "${activeCustomSlot.primaryArchetype}|${activeCustomSlot.secondaryType}"
                val summary =
                  "[$frameTitle] ${activeCustomSlot.totalAllocatedPoints()}-PT RIFT FRAME // " +
                    "${activeCustomSlot.primaryArchetype} + ${activeCustomSlot.secondaryType} " +
                    "(SPD ${activeCustomSlot.speedPts} / THR ${activeCustomSlot.thrustPts} / TRN ${activeCustomSlot.turnPts} / FLX ${activeCustomSlot.maxFluxPts} / RCH ${activeCustomSlot.rechargePts})"
                val cleanSyn = localPrefs.sanitizeSyndicateTag(syndicateTag)
                val buildCard =
                  viewModel.postStructuredChannelMessage(
                    senderCallsign = callsign,
                    senderSyndicateTag = cleanSyn,
                    channelKey = "#shipwright-meta",
                    messageText = summary,
                    armadaName = frameTitle.take(12),
                    armadaObjective = compactRecipe.take(120),
                  )
                if (chatMessages.none { it.id == buildCard.id }) {
                  chatMessages.add(buildCard)
                }
                toastMessage = "SHARED RIFT FRAME [$frameTitle] TO #SHIPWRIGHT-META"
                toastVersion++
              },
              onLoadSharedRiftFrameBuild = { recipePayload ->
                val loadedSlot =
                  if (recipePayload.trim().startsWith("{")) {
                    CustomShipLoadoutSlot.fromJsonString(recipePayload, activeCustomSlotId)
                      .copy(slotId = activeCustomSlotId)
                  } else {
                    val stripped = recipePayload.removePrefix("BUILD|").trim()
                    val parts = stripped.split("|")
                    val namePart = parts.getOrNull(0)?.trim()?.take(18)?.ifEmpty { "Shared Frame" } ?: "Shared Frame"
                    val statNums =
                      parts.getOrNull(1)
                        ?.split(",")
                        ?.map { it.trim().toIntOrNull()?.coerceIn(0, 40) ?: 0 }
                        ?: emptyList()
                    val prim = parts.getOrNull(2)?.trim().orEmpty().ifEmpty { activeCustomSlot.primaryArchetype }
                    val sec = parts.getOrNull(3)?.trim().orEmpty().ifEmpty { activeCustomSlot.secondaryType }
                    val maxBudget = engine.getCustomizationPointsTotal()
                    val gearPts =
                      CustomShipLoadoutSlot.getPrimaryPointCost(prim) +
                        CustomShipLoadoutSlot.getSecondaryPointCost(sec)
                    var rem = (maxBudget - gearPts).coerceAtLeast(0)
                    fun takePt(v: Int): Int {
                      val c = v.coerceIn(0, rem)
                      rem -= c
                      return c
                    }
                    val sSpd = takePt(statNums.getOrElse(0) { 0 })
                    val sThr = takePt(statNums.getOrElse(1) { 0 })
                    val sTrn = takePt(statNums.getOrElse(2) { 0 })
                    val sFlx = takePt(statNums.getOrElse(3) { 0 })
                    val sRch = takePt(statNums.getOrElse(4) { 0 })
                    activeCustomSlot.copy(
                      slotId = activeCustomSlotId,
                      customName = namePart,
                      speedPts = sSpd,
                      thrustPts = sThr,
                      turnPts = sTrn,
                      maxFluxPts = sFlx,
                      rechargePts = sRch,
                      primaryArchetype = prim,
                      secondaryType = sec,
                    )
                  }
                saveCustomSlotShared(loadedSlot)
                selectedShipId = 10
                hasExplicitHangarLock = true
                localPrefs.setPreferredShipId(10)
                engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(10, forceFromHangar = true)
                engine.onStatsUpdated()
                sfx.playPrize()
                openNexusNode(NexusCoreNode.HANGAR_DECK)
                toastMessage = "LOADED [${loadedSlot.customName}] INTO $activeCustomSlotId"
                toastVersion++
              },
              onPostStrikeWingInvite = {
                val wingTag =
                  engine.activeArmadaName
                    .ifBlank { "${callsign.take(8)}_SQD" }
                    .uppercase(Locale.US)
                    .take(14)
                if (engine.activeArmadaName.isBlank()) {
                  engine.formOrJoinArmada(wingTag, emptyList())
                }
                val slotsNow = engine.getCurrentArmadaSize()
                val text =
                  "SQUADRON [$wingTag] RECRUITING PILOTS // ${engine.activeRankedMode.title.uppercase(Locale.US)}"
                val cleanSyn = localPrefs.sanitizeSyndicateTag(syndicateTag)
                val inviteMsg =
                  viewModel.postStructuredChannelMessage(
                    senderCallsign = callsign,
                    senderSyndicateTag = cleanSyn,
                    channelKey = "#strike-lfg",
                    messageText = text,
                    isArmadaRecruitBanner = true,
                    armadaName = wingTag.take(12),
                    armadaCurrentSize = slotsNow.coerceIn(1, 5),
                    armadaMaxSize = 5,
                    armadaObjective = engine.activeRankedMode.title,
                  )
                if (chatMessages.none { it.id == inviteMsg.id }) {
                  chatMessages.add(inviteMsg)
                }
                toastMessage = "POSTED SQUADRON [$wingTag] INVITE TO #SQUADRON-LFG"
                toastVersion++
              },
              onPostPrivateRoomInvite = { roomCode, modeTitle ->
                val cleanCode = roomCode.trim().uppercase(Locale.US).take(6)
                val text = "PRIVATE RIFT [$cleanCode] OPEN // $modeTitle"
                val obj = "ROOM|$cleanCode|$modeTitle".take(120)
                val cleanSyn = localPrefs.sanitizeSyndicateTag(syndicateTag)
                val roomMsg =
                  viewModel.postStructuredChannelMessage(
                    senderCallsign = callsign,
                    senderSyndicateTag = cleanSyn,
                    channelKey = "#strike-lfg",
                    messageText = text,
                    armadaName = cleanCode,
                    armadaObjective = obj,
                  )
                if (chatMessages.none { it.id == roomMsg.id }) {
                  chatMessages.add(roomMsg)
                }
                toastMessage = "SHARED PRIVATE RIFT [$cleanCode] TO #SQUADRON-LFG"
                toastVersion++
              },
              onJoinSharedStrikeWing = { msg ->
                val targetWing =
                  msg.armadaName
                    .ifBlank { "${msg.senderCallsign.take(8)}_SQD" }
                    .uppercase(Locale.US)
                    .take(14)
                val leaderFriend =
                  if (msg.senderUid.isNotBlank() && msg.senderUid != currentUserId) {
                    FriendPilotEntry(
                      uid = msg.senderUid,
                      callsign = msg.senderCallsign,
                      syndicateTag = msg.senderSyndicateTag.ifBlank { "FREE" },
                      shipId = 1,
                      statusText = "ONLINE // SQUADRON",
                      isOnline = true,
                      currentArmadaName = targetWing,
                      currentArmadaCount = msg.armadaCurrentSize.coerceIn(1, 5),
                      bounty = 100,
                    ).also { localPrefs.saveVerifiedFriendPilot(it) }
                  } else {
                    null
                  }
                engine.formOrJoinArmada(
                  targetWing,
                  if (leaderFriend != null) listOf(leaderFriend) else emptyList(),
                )
                friendsRefreshKey++
                toastMessage = "JOINED SQUADRON [$targetWing]"
                toastVersion++
              },
              onAddOnlinePilotFriend = { targetCallsign ->
                viewModel.lookupAndAddRealFriendByCallsign(
                  rawCallsign = targetCallsign,
                  localPrefs = localPrefs,
                ) { _, statusMsg ->
                  armadaStatusBanner = statusMsg
                  toastMessage = statusMsg
                  toastVersion++
                  friendsRefreshKey++
                }
              },
              onInviteOnlinePilotToWing = { livePilot ->
                val pUid = livePilot.userId.ifEmpty { livePilot.id }
                if (pUid.isNotBlank() && pUid != currentUserId) {
                  val wingTag =
                    engine.activeArmadaName
                      .ifBlank { "${callsign.take(8)}_SQD" }
                      .uppercase(Locale.US)
                      .take(14)
                  val verified =
                    FriendPilotEntry(
                      uid = pUid,
                      callsign = livePilot.callsign,
                      syndicateTag = livePilot.syndicateTag.ifBlank { "FREE" },
                      shipId = livePilot.shipId.toInt().coerceIn(1, 10),
                      statusText = "ONLINE // ${livePilot.sectorId.ifBlank { "SECTOR" }}",
                      isOnline = true,
                      currentArmadaName = wingTag,
                      currentArmadaCount = engine.getCurrentArmadaSize().coerceIn(1, 5),
                      bounty = livePilot.bounty.toInt().coerceAtLeast(100),
                    )
                  localPrefs.saveVerifiedFriendPilot(verified)
                  if (engine.activeArmadaName.isBlank()) {
                    engine.formOrJoinArmada(wingTag, listOf(verified))
                  } else {
                    engine.addMemberToArmada(verified)
                  }
                  friendsRefreshKey++
                  toastMessage = "ADDED ${livePilot.callsign} TO SQUADRON [$wingTag]"
                  toastVersion++
                }
              },
              engine = engine,
              initialLayoutMode = nexusInitialLayoutMode,
              activeModuleKey = activeModuleKey,
              activeNode = activeNexusNode,
              onSelectNode = { nextNode -> openNexusNode(nextNode) },
              syndicateSubDeck = syndicateSubDeck,
              onSelectSyndicateSubDeck = { syndicateSubDeck = it },
              archiveSubDeck = archiveSubDeck,
              onSelectArchiveSubDeck = { sub ->
                if (sub == ArchiveCodexSubDeck.TACTICAL_CODEX) {
                  archiveSubDeck = ArchiveCodexSubDeck.PILOT_DOSSIER
                  openNexusNode(NexusCoreNode.HELM_SYSTEMS, helmSubDeckOverride = 3)
                } else {
                  archiveSubDeck = ArchiveCodexSubDeck.PILOT_DOSSIER
                }
              },
              onSelectNexusLobby = { openNexusNode(NexusCoreNode.ORBITAL_HUB) },
              isCalibrationLivePeeking =
                activeNexusNode == NexusCoreNode.STAR_FORGE && RiftCalibrationState.isDraggingAnySlider,
              hideTopHeaderForFullScreenStage = isForgeFullScreenStage,
              liveResonance = engine.liveResonance,

              selectedOverwatchKey = effectiveOverwatchInstance.key,

              onSelectOverwatchKey = { nextKey ->
                if (engine.hasJoinedMatch && !engine.isEphemeralPracticeRift) {
                  sfx.playMutedClick()
                  toastMessage = "LEAVE ACTIVE MATCH FIRST TO SWITCH OVERWATCH RIFT"
                  toastVersion++
                } else {
                  userSelectedOverwatchKey = nextKey
                  overwatchZoomUi = 1.0f
                  arenaViewRef?.resetOverwatchCamera()
                  sfx.playMutedClick()
                  frameTick++
                }
              },
              onToggleFavoriteOverwatchKey = { targetKey ->
                val updatedFav = if (favoriteOverwatchKey == targetKey) "" else targetKey
                favoriteOverwatchKey = updatedFav
                localPrefs.setFavoriteOverwatchRiftKey(updatedFav)
                if (updatedFav.isNotBlank()) {
                  userSelectedOverwatchKey = updatedFav
                  toastMessage = "PINNED FAVORITE OVERWATCH // ${effectiveOverwatchInstance.riftLabel}"
                } else {
                  toastMessage = "CLEARED FAVORITE OVERWATCH PIN // AUTO HIGHEST RESONANCE"
                }
                sfx.playMutedClick()
                toastVersion++
              },
              onUpdateOverwatchViewport = { cx, cy, r ->
                arenaViewRef?.let { view ->
                  view.overwatchCenterX = cx
                  view.overwatchCenterY = cy
                  view.overwatchRadiusPx = r
                }
              },
              overwatchZoom = overwatchZoomUi,
              onOverwatchTransformGesture = { cx, cy, panDx, panDy, zoomChange ->
                val updatedZoom =
                  arenaViewRef?.applyOverwatchTransformGesture(cx, cy, panDx, panDy, zoomChange) ?: 1.0f
                overwatchZoomUi = updatedZoom
              },
              onResetOverwatchCamera = {
                arenaViewRef?.resetOverwatchCamera()
                overwatchZoomUi = 1.0f
                sfx.playMutedClick()
              },
              onQuickZoneIntoOverwatch = { inst ->
                if (
                  engine.hasJoinedMatch &&
                    !engine.isEphemeralPracticeRift &&
                    inst.key.equals(engine.activeMatchSectorTag(), ignoreCase = true)
                ) {
                  isNexusShellOpen = false
                  sfx.playPrize()
                  toastMessage = "RETURNED TO ACTIVE MATCH // ${inst.riftLabel}"
                  toastVersion++
                  frameTick++
                  return@NexusAiConsoleModal
                }
                val customCfg = inst.customConfig
                val targetMode = customCfg?.baseMode ?: inst.rankedMode
                val targetBracket =
                  customCfg?.teamSizeBracket
                    ?: when (inst.rankedMode) {
                      RankedGameMode.RIFT_SKIRMISH,
                      RankedGameMode.RIFT_CONTROL,
                      RankedGameMode.SYNDICATE_WARS -> 3
                      RankedGameMode.FLUX_CORE,
                      RankedGameMode.STASIS_BREACH -> 5
                      RankedGameMode.SECTOR_CONVERGENCE -> 20
                    }

                if (customCfg == null && inst.rankedMode == RankedGameMode.SYNDICATE_WARS) {
                  val (eligible, reason) = engine.canQueueSyndicateWars()
                  if (!eligible) {
                    sfx.playMutedClick()
                    toastMessage = reason
                    toastVersion++
                    syndicateSubDeck = SyndicateCitadelSubDeck.SYNDICATES_WARS
                    openNexusNode(NexusCoreNode.SYNDICATE_CITADEL)
                  } else {
                    deployDirectlyWithHangarShip(inst.rankedMode, targetBracket, null)
                  }
                } else {
                  val deployShipId = hangarCardShipId
                  selectedShipId = deployShipId
                  localPrefs.setPreferredShipId(deployShipId)
                  val executeDirectRiftIn: () -> Unit = {
                    pendingStagedLaunch = null
                    suspendedActiveMatch = null
                    engine.isShipLockedForMatch = false
                    engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(
                      deployShipId,
                      forceFromHangar = true,
                    )
                    syncEquippedCosmeticsToEngine(engine)
                    if (customCfg != null) {
                      if (engine.activeCustomGames.any { it.instanceId == customCfg.instanceId }) {
                        engine.joinCustomGame(customCfg.instanceId)
                      } else {
                        engine.createAndJoinCustomGame(customCfg)
                      }
                      selectedMode = customCfg.baseMode.id
                      localPrefs.setPreferredMode(customCfg.baseMode.id)
                    } else {
                      val sectorOverride =
                        if (inst.key.equals("SECTOR_CONVERGENCE_2", ignoreCase = true)) {
                          "SECTOR_CONVERGENCE_2"
                        } else {
                          null
                        }
                      selectedMode = inst.rankedMode.id
                      localPrefs.setPreferredMode(inst.rankedMode.id)
                      engine.deployToRankedMode(
                        inst.rankedMode,
                        targetBracket,
                        sectorInstanceOverride = sectorOverride,
                      )
                    }
                    syncEquippedCosmeticsToEngine(engine)
                    engine.onStatsUpdated()
                    viewModel.setActiveSector(engine.activeMatchSectorTag())
                    engine.updateRemotePilots(mergedLivePilots, currentUserId)
                    pushLivePilotHeartbeatNow()
                    isNexusShellOpen = false
                    sfx.playPrize()
                    toastMessage = "RIFTED INTO ${inst.modeTitle} // ${inst.riftLabel}"
                    toastVersion++
                    frameTick++
                  }
                  enqueueOrExecuteResonanceMatchmaking(
                    modeTitle = inst.modeTitle,
                    riftLabel = inst.riftLabel,
                    targetSectorKey = inst.key,
                    rankedMode = targetMode,
                    isCustomInstance = customCfg != null,
                    onExecuteLaunch = executeDirectRiftIn,
                  )
                }
              },
              onStageRankedModeViaHangar = { mode, bracket ->
                deployDirectlyWithHangarShip(mode, bracket, null)
              },
              onStageCustomGameViaHangar = { customCfg ->

                selectedShipId = deployShipId
                localPrefs.setPreferredShipId(deployShipId)
                pendingStagedLaunch = null
                suspendedActiveMatch = null
                engine.isShipLockedForMatch = false
                engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(deployShipId, forceFromHangar = true)
                syncEquippedCosmeticsToEngine(engine)
                selectedMode = customCfg.baseMode.id
                localPrefs.setPreferredMode(customCfg.baseMode.id)
                engine.createAndJoinCustomGame(customCfg)
                RiftCalibrationState.botsEnabled = customCfg.botsEnabled
                RiftCalibrationState.applyCalibrationChangesLive(engine, context)
                if (isGoogleAuthenticated && isDeviceOnline && currentUserId.isNotBlank()) {
                  viewModel.publishCustomGameRoom(
                    customCfg.toCloudCustomGameRoom(currentUserId)
                  )
                }
                syncEquippedCosmeticsToEngine(engine)

                engine.updateRemotePilots(mergedLivePilots, currentUserId)
                pushLivePilotHeartbeatNow()
                isNexusShellOpen = false
                sfx.playPrize()
                toastMessage = "RIFTED INTO CUSTOM RIFT [${customCfg.title.uppercase(Locale.US)}]"
                toastVersion++

              },

                pendingStagedLaunch = null

                toastVersion++
                frameTick++

                  )

                    text =

                    color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
                    fontSize = 11.sp,
                  )
                  Box(
                    modifier =
                      Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                        .height(40.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                        .background(Color(0xFF040A14))
                        .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF38BDF8), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                        .padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.CenterStart,
                  ) {
                    BasicTextField(
                      value = initialSwornCallsignDraft,

private fun CloudCustomGameRoom.toCustomGameConfig(): CustomGameConfig {
  val cleanCode =
    roomCode
      .ifBlank { id }
      .trim()
      .uppercase(java.util.Locale.US)
      .replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9]"), "")
      .take(8)
  val isPriv = privateRoom || visibility.equals("private", ignoreCase = true)
  val resolvedInstanceId =
    instanceId
      .trim()
      .replace(Regex("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]"), "")
      .take(23)
      .ifBlank { "${if (isPriv) "priv" else "pub"}_$cleanCode" }
  val resolvedMode =
    RankedGameMode.entries.firstOrNull {
      it.id.equals(baseMode, ignoreCase = true) || it.name.equals(baseMode, ignoreCase = true)
    } ?: RankedGameMode.SECTOR_CONVERGENCE
  return CustomGameConfig(
    instanceId = resolvedInstanceId,
    roomCode = cleanCode,
    privateRoom = isPriv,
    title =
      title.ifBlank {
        "${hostCallsign.uppercase(java.util.Locale.US)} ${resolvedMode.title.uppercase(java.util.Locale.US)} [$cleanCode]"
      },
    hostCallsign = hostCallsign.ifBlank { "PILOT" },
    baseMode = resolvedMode,
    teamSizeBracket = teamSizeBracket.coerceIn(2, 20),
    matchDurationMinutes = matchDurationMinutes.coerceIn(0, 60),
    allowArmadasInFfa = allowArmadasInFfa,
    botsEnabled = botsEnabled,
    bulletSizeMult = bulletSizeMult.toFloat().coerceIn(0.4f, 4.0f),
    damageMult = damageMult.toFloat().coerceIn(0.25f, 4.0f),
    speedMult = speedMult.toFloat().coerceIn(0.4f, 3.0f),
    healthMult = healthMult.toFloat().coerceIn(0.5f, 4.0f),
    rechargeMult = rechargeMult.toFloat().coerceIn(0.4f, 4.0f),
    crateSpawnMult = crateSpawnMult.toFloat().coerceIn(0.2f, 4.0f),
  )
}

private fun CustomGameConfig.toCloudCustomGameRoom(hostUid: String): CloudCustomGameRoom {
  val code = extractCustomRoomCode(this)
  val isPriv = isPrivateCustomGame(this)
  val cleanInstanceId =
    instanceId
      .trim()
      .replace(Regex("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]"), "")
      .take(23)
      .ifBlank { "${if (isPriv) "priv" else "pub"}_$code" }
  return CloudCustomGameRoom(
    id = code,
    roomCode = code,
    instanceId = cleanInstanceId,
    hostUid = hostUid,
    hostCallsign = hostCallsign.ifBlank { "PILOT" }.take(24),
    title = title.ifBlank { "CUSTOM RIFT [$code]" }.take(48),
    visibility = if (isPriv) "private" else "public",
    privateRoom = isPriv,
    baseMode = baseMode.id,
    teamSizeBracket = teamSizeBracket.coerceIn(2, 20),
    matchDurationMinutes = matchDurationMinutes.coerceIn(0, 60),
    allowArmadasInFfa = allowArmadasInFfa,
    botsEnabled = botsEnabled,
    bulletSizeMult = bulletSizeMult.toDouble(),
    damageMult = damageMult.toDouble(),
    speedMult = speedMult.toDouble(),
    healthMult = healthMult.toDouble(),
    rechargeMult = rechargeMult.toDouble(),
    crateSpawnMult = crateSpawnMult.toDouble(),
    createdAtMs = System.currentTimeMillis(),
  )
}

```
package com.example.data

import android.util.Log
import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuth
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestoreException
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject

enum class OperationType(val value: String) {
  CREATE("create"),
  UPDATE("update"),
  DELETE("delete"),
  LIST("list"),
  GET("get"),
  WRITE("write"),
}

fun handleFirestoreError(exception: Throwable, operationType: OperationType, path: String?): String {
  val causes = generateSequence(exception) { it.cause }
  val rootError =
    causes.firstOrNull { it is FirebaseFirestoreException }
      ?: causes.firstOrNull { it !is CancellationException }
      ?: exception

  val auth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance()
  val currentUser = auth.currentUser

  val providerInfoList =
    currentUser?.providerData?.map { provider ->
      JSONObject().apply {
        put("providerId", provider.providerId)
        put("email", provider.email)
      }
    } ?: emptyList()

  val authInfoJson =
    JSONObject().apply {
      put("userId", currentUser?.uid)
      put("email", currentUser?.email)
      put("emailVerified", currentUser?.isEmailVerified)
      put("tenantId", currentUser?.tenantId)
      put("providerInfo", JSONArray(providerInfoList))
    }

  val errorInfoJson =
    JSONObject().apply {
      put("error", rootError.message ?: rootError.toString())
      put("operationType", operationType.value)
      put("path", path)
      put("authInfo", authInfoJson)
    }

  val jsonString = errorInfoJson.toString()
  Log.e("FirestoreError", "Firestore Error: $jsonString")
  return jsonString
}

package com.example.data

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import java.util.Locale
import java.util.UUID
import kotlin.math.ceil
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject

class LocalPilotPrefs(context: Context) {
  private val prefs: SharedPreferences =
    context.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
  private val userSettingsPrefs: SharedPreferences =
    context.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences(USER_SETTINGS_PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

  /**
   * Returns a permanent device-bound UID stored in local storage so guest stats and leaderboard
   * identity follow the player forever across app launches without requiring Google OAuth popups.
   */
  fun getOrCreatePermanentDeviceUid(): String {
    val existing = prefs.getString(KEY_DEVICE_UID, null)
    if (!existing.isNullOrBlank()) return existing
    val generated = "dev_" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "").take(16)
    prefs.edit().putString(KEY_DEVICE_UID, generated).apply()
    return generated
  }

  fun isGuestBypassEnabled(): Boolean = prefs.getBoolean(KEY_GUEST_BYPASS, false)

  fun setGuestBypassEnabled(enabled: Boolean) {
    val editor = prefs.edit().putBoolean(KEY_GUEST_BYPASS, enabled)
    if (enabled) {
      editor.putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, "RFT")
      editor.putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, "Rift Drifters")
    } else {
      val rawTag = (prefs.getString(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, "") ?: "").trim().uppercase(Locale.US)
      if (rawTag in NON_PLAYER_SYNDICATE_TAGS) {
        editor.putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, "")
        editor.putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, "Unaffiliated")
      }
    }
    editor.apply()
  }

  fun isSwornPilot(isGoogleAuthenticated: Boolean): Boolean =
    isGoogleAuthenticated && !isGuestBypassEnabled()

  fun generateRandomDrifterCallsign(): String = DRIFTER_NAMES.random()

  fun isDrifterOrEphemeralUid(uid: String? = null): Boolean {
    val clean = uid?.trim().orEmpty()
    if (
      clean.startsWith("drifter_", ignoreCase = true) ||
        clean.startsWith("dev_", ignoreCase = true) ||
        clean.startsWith("guest_", ignoreCase = true)
    ) {
      return true
    }
    return isGuestBypassEnabled() && clean.isEmpty()
  }

  private fun canUseLegacyUnscopedFallback(uid: String?): Boolean {
    if (isDrifterOrEphemeralUid(uid)) return false
    val clean = uid?.trim().orEmpty()
    if (clean.isEmpty()) return !isGuestBypassEnabled()
    val owner = prefs.getString(KEY_PRIMARY_SWORN_UID, null)?.trim().orEmpty()
    if (owner.isEmpty()) {
      prefs.edit().putString(KEY_PRIMARY_SWORN_UID, clean).apply()
      return true
    }
    return owner == clean
  }

  /**
   * Starts a brand-new ephemeral Drifter session on launch or in-app swap:
   * assigns a fresh session UID, locks Drifter tag to [RFT], and picks a random Drifter callsign
   * WITHOUT touching any Sworn Pilot UID-scoped or unscoped progression keys.
   */
  fun startFreshDrifterSession(): String {
    val freshUid = "drifter_" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "").take(12)
    val randomCallsign = generateRandomDrifterCallsign()
    prefs
      .edit()
      .putString(KEY_DEVICE_UID, freshUid)
      .putBoolean(KEY_GUEST_BYPASS, true)
      .putString(KEY_DRIFTER_CALLSIGN, randomCallsign)
      .putString("${KEY_CALLSIGN}_$freshUid", randomCallsign)
      .putString("${KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG}_$freshUid", "RFT")
      .putString("${KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME}_$freshUid", "Rift Drifters")
      .putString("${KEY_ARMADA_NAME}_$freshUid", "")
      .putLong("${KEY_PVP_KILLS}_$freshUid", 0L)
      .putLong("${KEY_PVP_DEATHS}_$freshUid", 0L)
      .putLong("${KEY_PVP_BOUNTY_PEAK}_$freshUid", 100L)
      .putLong("${KEY_ALL_KILLS}_$freshUid", 0L)
      .putLong("${KEY_ALL_DEATHS}_$freshUid", 0L)
      .putLong("${KEY_ALL_BOUNTY_PEAK}_$freshUid", 100L)
      .putLong("${KEY_CONVERGENCES_WON}_$freshUid", 0L)
      .putLong("${KEY_HVT_ELIMINATIONS}_$freshUid", 0L)
      .putLong("${KEY_GREENS_COLLECTED}_$freshUid", 0L)
      .apply()
    return randomCallsign
  }

  fun getShortPilotTag(uid: String): String {
    val clean = uid.trim().ifEmpty { getOrCreatePermanentDeviceUid() }
    val alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    var h = clean.hashCode().toLong() and 0xFFFFFFFFL
    if (h == 0L) h = 0x5A3C91L
    val sb = StringBuilder(6)
    for (i in 0 until 6) {
      val idx = ((h xor (i * 31L)) % alphabet.length).toInt().let { if (it < 0) -it else it }
      sb.append(alphabet[idx % alphabet.length])
      h = (h * 1664525L + 1013904223L) and 0xFFFFFFFFL
    }
    return "#RFT-$sb"
  }

  /**
   * Clears unscoped callsign and initial-choice markers when switching accounts or signing out so
   * another Google account on the same tablet never inherits a previous pilot's callsign.
   */
  fun clearUnscopedCallsignOnAccountSwitch() {
    prefs
      .edit()
      .remove(KEY_CALLSIGN)
      .remove(KEY_INITIAL_CALLSIGN_CHOSEN)
      .apply()
  }

  fun getCallsign(uid: String? = null): String {
    if (isGuestBypassEnabled() || isDrifterOrEphemeralUid(uid)) {
      val drifterName =
        (if (!uid.isNullOrBlank()) prefs.getString(uidKey(KEY_CALLSIGN, uid), null) else null)
          ?: prefs.getString(KEY_DRIFTER_CALLSIGN, null)
      if (!drifterName.isNullOrBlank() && drifterName != "COMMANDER") return drifterName
      return generateRandomDrifterCallsign().also {
        val ed = prefs.edit().putString(KEY_DRIFTER_CALLSIGN, it)
        if (!uid.isNullOrBlank()) ed.putString(uidKey(KEY_CALLSIGN, uid), it)
        ed.apply()
      }
    }
    fun isChosenSwornName(s: String?): Boolean {
      if (s.isNullOrBlank()) return false
      val u = s.trim().uppercase(Locale.US)
      return u != "COMMANDER" && !u.startsWith("RFT-") && !u.startsWith("#RFT")
    }
    // Signed-in Sworn Pilot: strictly read uid-scoped callsign only (zero unscoped fallback or copy)
    if (!uid.isNullOrBlank()) {
      val perUid = prefs.getString(uidKey(KEY_CALLSIGN, uid), null)
      return perUid?.takeIf { isChosenSwornName(it) } ?: "COMMANDER"
    }
    val global = prefs.getString(KEY_CALLSIGN, null)
    return global?.takeIf { isChosenSwornName(it) } ?: "COMMANDER"
  }

  fun setCallsign(rawCallsign: String, uid: String? = null): String {
    val sanitizedRaw =
      rawCallsign
        .trim()
        .uppercase(Locale.US)
        .replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_\\-]"), "")
        .take(14)
    val cleaned =
      if (sanitizedRaw.isEmpty() || UgcModeration.containsProfanity(sanitizedRaw)) {
        if (isGuestBypassEnabled()) generateRandomDrifterCallsign() else "COMMANDER"
      } else {
        sanitizedRaw
      }
    val editor = prefs.edit()
    if (isGuestBypassEnabled() || isDrifterOrEphemeralUid(uid)) {
      editor.putString(KEY_DRIFTER_CALLSIGN, cleaned)
      if (!uid.isNullOrBlank()) {
        editor.putString(uidKey(KEY_CALLSIGN, uid), cleaned)
      }
    } else if (!uid.isNullOrBlank()) {
      editor.putString(uidKey(KEY_CALLSIGN, uid), cleaned)
      editor.remove(KEY_CALLSIGN)
    } else {
      editor.putString(KEY_CALLSIGN, cleaned)
    }
    editor.apply()
    return cleaned
  }

  fun getCallsignChangeCount(uid: String? = null): Int =
    if (!uid.isNullOrBlank()) {
      prefs.getInt(uidKey(KEY_CALLSIGN_CHANGE_COUNT, uid), 0)
    } else {
      prefs.getInt(KEY_CALLSIGN_CHANGE_COUNT, 0)
    }

  fun incrementCallsignChangeCount(uid: String? = null) {
    val next = getCallsignChangeCount(uid) + 1
    val ed = prefs.edit()
    if (!uid.isNullOrBlank()) {
      ed.putInt(uidKey(KEY_CALLSIGN_CHANGE_COUNT, uid), next)
    } else {
      ed.putInt(KEY_CALLSIGN_CHANGE_COUNT, next)
    }
    ed.apply()
  }

  fun hasChosenInitialCallsign(uid: String? = null): Boolean {
    if (isGuestBypassEnabled() || isDrifterOrEphemeralUid(uid)) return false
    val explicitChosen =
      if (!uid.isNullOrBlank()) {
        prefs.getBoolean(uidKey(KEY_INITIAL_CALLSIGN_CHOSEN, uid), false)
      } else {
        prefs.getBoolean(KEY_INITIAL_CALLSIGN_CHOSEN, false)
      }
    if (explicitChosen) return true
    val existing = getCallsign(uid)
    val upper = existing.trim().uppercase(Locale.US)
    if (upper.isNotBlank() && upper != "COMMANDER" && !upper.startsWith("RFT-") && !upper.startsWith("#RFT")) {
      setHasChosenInitialCallsign(true, uid)
      return true
    }
    return false
  }

  fun setHasChosenInitialCallsign(chosen: Boolean, uid: String? = null) {
    val editor = prefs.edit()
    if (!uid.isNullOrBlank()) {
      editor.putBoolean(uidKey(KEY_INITIAL_CALLSIGN_CHOSEN, uid), chosen)
      editor.remove(KEY_INITIAL_CALLSIGN_CHOSEN)
    } else {
      editor.putBoolean(KEY_INITIAL_CALLSIGN_CHOSEN, chosen)
    }
    editor.apply()
  }

  /**
   * Changes a Sworn Pilot's callsign:
   * - 1st change (`getCallsignChangeCount(uid) == 0`) is FREE (0 Rift Shards).
   * - Subsequent changes cost 250 Rift Shards.
   * Returns Triple(success, resultCallsignOrErrorMessage, updatedShards).
   */
  fun changeSwornPilotCallsign(
    newCallsign: String,
    currentShards: Long,
    uid: String? = null,
  ): Triple<Boolean, String, Long> {
    if (isGuestBypassEnabled()) {
      return Triple(false, "Drifters use temporary [RFT] callsigns. Sign in to claim a permanent name.", currentShards)
    }
    val sanitized =
      newCallsign
        .trim()
        .uppercase(Locale.US)
        .replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_\\-]"), "")
        .take(14)
    if (sanitized.length < 3) {
      return Triple(false, "Callsign must be 3 to 14 characters.", currentShards)
    }
    if (UgcModeration.containsProfanity(sanitized)) {
      return Triple(false, "Callsign contains blocked words.", currentShards)
    }
    val currentName = getCallsign(uid)
    if (sanitized.equals(currentName, ignoreCase = true) && hasChosenInitialCallsign(uid)) {
      return Triple(true, sanitized, currentShards)
    }
    val changeCount = getCallsignChangeCount(uid)
    val cost = if (changeCount == 0) 0L else 250L
    if (currentShards < cost) {
      return Triple(false, "Need 250 Rift Shards to change callsign.", currentShards)
    }
    val nextShards = (currentShards - cost).coerceAtLeast(0L)
    if (cost > 0L) {
      setRiftShards(nextShards, uid)
    }
    val saved = setCallsign(sanitized, uid)
    incrementCallsignChangeCount(uid)
    setHasChosenInitialCallsign(true, uid)
    return Triple(true, saved, nextShards)
  }

  fun sanitizeSyndicateTag(raw: String): String {
    val cleanedFull =
      raw
        .trim()
        .uppercase(Locale.US)
        .replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_\\-]"), "")
    if (cleanedFull.isEmpty() || cleanedFull in NON_PLAYER_SYNDICATE_TAGS) {
      return ""
    }
    val trimmed = cleanedFull.take(3)
    return if (trimmed in NON_PLAYER_SYNDICATE_TAGS) "" else trimmed
  }

  fun isGhostSyndicateName(rawName: String): Boolean {
    val clean = rawName.trim()
    if (clean.isEmpty()) return true
    return clean.equals("Rift Drifters", ignoreCase = true) ||
      clean.equals("Guest Tracking Framework", ignoreCase = true) ||
      clean.equals("GUE Syndicate", ignoreCase = true) ||
      clean.equals("GUES Syndicate", ignoreCase = true) ||
      clean.equals("NOV Syndicate", ignoreCase = true) ||
      clean.equals("NOVA VANGUARD", ignoreCase = true) ||
      clean.contains("Kestrel", ignoreCase = true) ||
      clean.contains("Aurelia", ignoreCase = true) ||
      clean.contains("Vortex", ignoreCase = true) ||
      clean.contains("Rustweld", ignoreCase = true)
  }

  fun isHumanFoundedSyndicateRecord(syn: SyndicateInfo): Boolean {
    if (!syn.isCustom) return false
    if (!syn.isRealPlayerFoundedSyndicate()) return false
    val cleanTag = sanitizeSyndicateTag(syn.tag)
    if (cleanTag.length !in 1..3 || cleanTag in NON_PLAYER_SYNDICATE_TAGS) return false
    val cleanOwner = syn.ownerId.trim()
    if (
      cleanOwner.isEmpty() ||
        cleanOwner.startsWith("dev_", ignoreCase = true) ||
        cleanOwner.startsWith("drifter_", ignoreCase = true) ||
        cleanOwner.startsWith("guest_", ignoreCase = true) ||
        cleanOwner.startsWith("bot_", ignoreCase = true)
    ) {
      return false
    }
    if (isGhostSyndicateName(syn.name)) return false
    return true
  }

  fun getSyndicateTag(uid: String? = null): String {
    if (isGuestBypassEnabled() || isDrifterOrEphemeralUid(uid)) return "RFT"
    val fallbackTag = if (canUseLegacyUnscopedFallback(uid)) (prefs.getString(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, "") ?: "") else ""
    val fallbackName = if (canUseLegacyUnscopedFallback(uid)) (prefs.getString(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, "") ?: "") else ""
    val raw = (prefs.getString(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, uid), fallbackTag) ?: "").trim().uppercase(Locale.US)
    val rawName = (prefs.getString(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, uid), fallbackName) ?: "").trim()
    val clean = sanitizeSyndicateTag(raw)
    if (clean.isEmpty() || raw in NON_PLAYER_SYNDICATE_TAGS || isGhostSyndicateName(rawName)) {
      if (raw.isNotEmpty() || (rawName.isNotEmpty() && !rawName.equals("Unaffiliated", ignoreCase = true))) {
        val ed =
          prefs
            .edit()
            .putString(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, uid), "")
            .putString(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, uid), "Unaffiliated")
        if (canUseLegacyUnscopedFallback(uid)) {
          ed.putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, "").putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, "Unaffiliated")
        }
        ed.apply()
      }
      return ""
    }
    return clean
  }

  fun getSyndicateName(uid: String? = null): String {
    if (isGuestBypassEnabled() || isDrifterOrEphemeralUid(uid)) return "Rift Drifters"
    val tag = getSyndicateTag(uid)
    if (tag.isBlank()) return "Unaffiliated"
    val fallbackName =
      if (canUseLegacyUnscopedFallback(uid)) (prefs.getString(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, "Unaffiliated") ?: "Unaffiliated")
      else "Unaffiliated"
    val raw = (prefs.getString(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, uid), fallbackName) ?: "Unaffiliated").trim()
    return if (isGhostSyndicateName(raw)) {
      val ed =
        prefs
          .edit()
          .putString(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, uid), "")
          .putString(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, uid), "Unaffiliated")
      if (canUseLegacyUnscopedFallback(uid)) {
        ed.putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, "").putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, "Unaffiliated")
      }
      ed.apply()
      "Unaffiliated"
    } else {
      raw
    }
  }

  fun getSyndicateLockUntilMs(uid: String? = null): Long {
    val fallback = if (canUseLegacyUnscopedFallback(uid)) prefs.getLong(KEY_SYNDICATE_LOCK_UNTIL_MS, 0L) else 0L
    return prefs.getLong(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_LOCK_UNTIL_MS, uid), fallback)
  }

  fun getRemainingSyndicateLockDays(nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(), uid: String? = null): Int {
    val lockUntil = getSyndicateLockUntilMs(uid)
    if (lockUntil <= nowMs) return 0
    val diffMs = lockUntil - nowMs
    return ceil(diffMs.toDouble() / (24.0 * 3600.0 * 1000.0)).toInt()
  }

  fun getRemainingSyndicateLockFormatted(nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(), uid: String? = null): String {
    val lockUntil = getSyndicateLockUntilMs(uid)
    if (lockUntil <= nowMs) return "00d 00h"
    val diffMs = lockUntil - nowMs
    val totalHours = ceil(diffMs.toDouble() / (3600.0 * 1000.0)).toInt()
    val days = totalHours / 24
    val hours = totalHours % 24
    return String.format(Locale.US, "%02dd %02dh", days, hours)
  }

  fun joinOfficialSyndicate(
    tag: String,
    name: String,
    apply15DayLock: Boolean = true,
    role: String = "Pilot",
    uid: String? = null,
  ): Boolean {
    if (isGuestBypassEnabled() || isDrifterOrEphemeralUid(uid)) return false
    val cleanTag = sanitizeSyndicateTag(tag)
    if (cleanTag.isEmpty() || isGhostSyndicateName(name)) {
      return false
    }
    if (apply15DayLock && getRemainingSyndicateLockDays(uid = uid) > 0) {
      return false
    }
    val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
    val cleanName = name.trim().take(28).ifEmpty { "$cleanTag Syndicate" }
    val lockUntil =
      if (apply15DayLock) {
        now + FIFTEEN_DAYS_MS
      } else {
        getSyndicateLockUntilMs(uid)
      }
    val ed =
      prefs
        .edit()
        .putString(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, uid), cleanTag)
        .putString(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, uid), cleanName)
        .putLong(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_LOCK_UNTIL_MS, uid), lockUntil)
    if (canUseLegacyUnscopedFallback(uid)) {
      ed
        .putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, cleanTag)
        .putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, cleanName)
        .putLong(KEY_SYNDICATE_LOCK_UNTIL_MS, lockUntil)
    }
    ed.apply()
    appendSyndicateServiceTransition(
      newTag = cleanTag,
      newName = cleanName,
      newRole = role,
      nowMs = now,
      uid = uid,
    )
    return true
  }

  fun leaveSyndicate(uid: String? = null): Boolean {
    if (getRemainingSyndicateLockDays(uid = uid) > 0) {
      return false
    }
    val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
    val lockUntil = now + FIFTEEN_DAYS_MS
    val ed =
      prefs
        .edit()
        .putString(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, uid), "")
        .putString(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, uid), "Unaffiliated")
        .putLong(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_LOCK_UNTIL_MS, uid), lockUntil)
    if (canUseLegacyUnscopedFallback(uid)) {
      ed
        .putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, "")
        .putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, "Unaffiliated")
        .putLong(KEY_SYNDICATE_LOCK_UNTIL_MS, lockUntil)
    }
    ed.apply()
    appendSyndicateServiceTransition(
      newTag = "UNAFFILIATED",
      newName = "Unaffiliated",
      newRole = "Pilot",
      nowMs = now,
      uid = uid,
    )
    return true
  }

  fun getMySyndicateRoster(
    currentUid: String,
    callsign: String,
    shipId: Int,
    bounty: Long,
    kills: Long,
  ): List<SyndicateMemberEntry> {
    if (isGuestBypassEnabled()) return emptyList()
    val tag = getSyndicateTag()
    if (tag.uppercase(Locale.US) in NON_PLAYER_SYNDICATE_TAGS) {
      return emptyList()
    }
    val localEntry =
      SyndicateMemberEntry(
        uid = currentUid,
        callsign = callsign,
        tag = tag,
        shipId = shipId,
        shipName = cleanShipNameForId(shipId),
        role = "SYNDICATE COMMANDER (YOU)",
        bountyContribution = bounty.coerceAtLeast(getAllTimeBountyPeak()),
        kills = kills,
        isOnline = true,
        isLocalPlayer = true,
      )
    val realSyndicateFriends =
      getFriendsList()
        .filter {
          it.syndicateTag.equals(tag, ignoreCase = true) &&
            !it.callsign.equals(callsign, ignoreCase = true)
        }
        .map { friend ->
          SyndicateMemberEntry(
            uid = friend.uid,
            callsign = friend.callsign,
            tag = tag,
            shipId = friend.shipId,
            shipName = cleanShipNameForId(friend.shipId),
            role = "SYNDICATE WINGMAN",
            bountyContribution = friend.bounty.toLong(),
            kills = 0L,
            isOnline = friend.isOnline,
            isLocalPlayer = false,
          )
        }
    return listOf(localEntry) + realSyndicateFriends
  }

    kills: Long,

  /**
   * Best Ship Calculator:
   * Returns the ship ID (1..10) with the highest earned per-ship Resonance,
   * tie-breaking with PvP/All-Time Peak Snapshots and fallbackShipId (1..10).
   */
  fun getBestShipId(uid: String? = null, fallbackShipId: Int = getLastShipId()): Int {
    ensureShipResonancesMigrated(uid)
    var topShipId = -1
    var topShipRes = 0
    for (id in 1..10) {
      val res = getShipResonanceRaw(id, uid)
      if (res > topShipRes) {
        topShipRes = res
        topShipId = id
      }
    }
    if (topShipId in 1..10 && topShipRes > 0) {
      return topShipId
    }
    val pvpSnap = getPvpPeakBountySnapshot(uid)
    val allSnap = getAllTimePeakBountySnapshot(uid)
    val bestSnap =
      when {
        pvpSnap != null && allSnap != null ->
          if (pvpSnap.bountyReached >= allSnap.bountyReached) pvpSnap else allSnap
        pvpSnap != null -> pvpSnap
        allSnap != null -> allSnap
        else -> null
      }
    val resolvedId = bestSnap?.shipId?.takeIf { it in 1..10 } ?: fallbackShipId.takeIf { it in 1..10 } ?: getLastShipId()
    return resolvedId.coerceIn(1, 10)
  }

  fun setAiShipDesignTokens(tokens: Int, uid: String? = null) {
    val clean = tokens.coerceAtLeast(0)
    prefs
      .edit()
      .putInt(KEY_AI_DESIGN_TOKENS, clean)
      .putInt(uidKey(KEY_AI_DESIGN_TOKENS, uid), clean)
      .apply()
  }

  // Custom Modular Ship Loadout Slots (Frame A through Frame E) with seamless legacy migration
  fun normalizeCustomSlotId(rawSlotId: String?): String =
    when (rawSlotId?.trim()?.uppercase(Locale.US)) {
      "FRAME B", "9B", "B" -> "Frame B"
      "FRAME C", "9C", "C" -> "Frame C"
      "FRAME D", "9D", "D" -> "Frame D"
      "FRAME E", "9E", "E" -> "Frame E"
      else -> "Frame A"
    }

  private fun legacySlotKeySuffix(cleanSlotId: String): String =
    when (cleanSlotId) {
      "Frame B" -> "9B"
      "Frame C" -> "9C"
      "Frame D" -> "9D"
      "Frame E" -> "9E"
      else -> "9A"
    }

  fun getActiveCustomSlotId(uid: String? = null): String {
    val raw =
      prefs.getString(
        uidKey(KEY_ACTIVE_CUSTOM_SLOT_ID, uid),
        prefs.getString(KEY_ACTIVE_CUSTOM_SLOT_ID, "Frame A"),
      ) ?: "Frame A"
    return normalizeCustomSlotId(raw)
  }

  fun setActiveCustomSlotId(slotId: String, uid: String? = null) {
    val clean = normalizeCustomSlotId(slotId)
    prefs
      .edit()
      .putString(KEY_ACTIVE_CUSTOM_SLOT_ID, clean)
      .putString(uidKey(KEY_ACTIVE_CUSTOM_SLOT_ID, uid), clean)
      .apply()
  }

  fun isCustomSlotUnlocked(slotId: String, uid: String? = null): Boolean {
    val norm = normalizeCustomSlotId(slotId)
    if (norm == "Frame A") return true
    val lvl = getPilotLevel(uid)
    val peakRes = getPeakResonance(uid)
    val gate = com.example.engine.RiftProgressionCatalog.getFrameSlotGate(norm)
    return when (norm) {
      "Frame B" ->
        prefs.getBoolean(uidKey(KEY_SLOT_B_UNLOCKED, uid), prefs.getBoolean(KEY_SLOT_B_UNLOCKED, false)) ||
          getUnlockedExtraSlots(uid) >= 1 ||
          lvl >= 35 ||
          peakRes >= gate.freeAtResonance
      "Frame C" ->
        prefs.getBoolean(uidKey(KEY_SLOT_C_UNLOCKED, uid), prefs.getBoolean(KEY_SLOT_C_UNLOCKED, false)) ||
          getUnlockedExtraSlots(uid) >= 2 ||
          lvl >= 50 ||
          peakRes >= gate.freeAtResonance
      "Frame D" ->
        prefs.getBoolean(uidKey(KEY_SLOT_D_UNLOCKED, uid), prefs.getBoolean(KEY_SLOT_D_UNLOCKED, false)) ||
          getUnlockedExtraSlots(uid) >= 3 ||
          lvl >= 75 ||
          peakRes >= gate.freeAtResonance
      "Frame E" ->
        prefs.getBoolean(uidKey(KEY_SLOT_E_UNLOCKED, uid), prefs.getBoolean(KEY_SLOT_E_UNLOCKED, false)) ||
          getUnlockedExtraSlots(uid) >= 4 ||
          lvl >= 100 ||
          peakRes >= gate.freeAtResonance
      else -> true
    }
  }

  fun setCustomSlotUnlocked(slotId: String, unlocked: Boolean, uid: String? = null) {
    val key =
      when (normalizeCustomSlotId(slotId)) {
        "Frame B" -> KEY_SLOT_B_UNLOCKED
        "Frame C" -> KEY_SLOT_C_UNLOCKED
        "Frame D" -> KEY_SLOT_D_UNLOCKED
        "Frame E" -> KEY_SLOT_E_UNLOCKED
        else -> return
      }
    prefs
      .edit()
      .putBoolean(key, unlocked)
      .putBoolean(uidKey(key, uid), unlocked)
      .apply()
  }

  fun getCustomShipSlot(slotId: String, uid: String? = null): com.example.engine.CustomShipLoadoutSlot {
    val cleanId = normalizeCustomSlotId(slotId)
    val baseKey = "${KEY_CUSTOM_SLOT_PREFIX}_$cleanId"
    val legacyBaseKey = "${KEY_CUSTOM_SLOT_PREFIX}_${legacySlotKeySuffix(cleanId)}"
    val raw =
      prefs.getString(uidKey(baseKey, uid), prefs.getString(baseKey, null))
        ?: prefs.getString(uidKey(legacyBaseKey, uid), prefs.getString(legacyBaseKey, null))
    return com.example.engine.CustomShipLoadoutSlot.fromJsonString(raw, cleanId)
  }

  fun saveCustomShipSlot(slot: com.example.engine.CustomShipLoadoutSlot, uid: String? = null) {
    val cleanId = normalizeCustomSlotId(slot.slotId)
    val normalizedSlot = slot.copy(slotId = cleanId)
    val baseKey = "${KEY_CUSTOM_SLOT_PREFIX}_$cleanId"
    val json = normalizedSlot.toJsonString()
    prefs
      .edit()
      .putString(baseKey, json)
      .putString(uidKey(baseKey, uid), json)
      .apply()
  }

  fun savePilotProgression(
    uid: String? = null,
    xpFromBuffs: Long,
    xpFromDamage: Long,
    xpFromAccuracy: Long,
    xpFromBountyEarned: Long,
    xpFromBountyKilled: Long,
    riftShards: Long,
    highestMilestoneLevelClaimed: Int,
  ) {
    val cleanShards = riftShards.coerceAtLeast(0L)
    val nextBuffs = kotlin.math.max(getXpFromBuffs(uid), xpFromBuffs)
    val nextDmg = kotlin.math.max(getXpFromDamage(uid), xpFromDamage)
    val nextAcc = kotlin.math.max(getXpFromAccuracy(uid), xpFromAccuracy)
    val nextEarned = kotlin.math.max(getXpFromBountyEarned(uid), xpFromBountyEarned)
    val nextKilled = kotlin.math.max(getXpFromBountyKilled(uid), xpFromBountyKilled)
    val nextMilestone = kotlin.math.max(getHighestMilestoneLevelClaimed(uid), highestMilestoneLevelClaimed)
    val ed =
      prefs
        .edit()
        .putLong(uidKey(KEY_XP_BUFFS, uid), nextBuffs)
        .putLong(uidKey(KEY_XP_DAMAGE, uid), nextDmg)
        .putLong(uidKey(KEY_XP_ACCURACY, uid), nextAcc)
        .putLong(uidKey(KEY_XP_BOUNTY_EARNED, uid), nextEarned)
        .putLong(uidKey(KEY_XP_BOUNTY_KILLED, uid), nextKilled)
        .putLong(uidKey(KEY_RIFT_SHARDS, uid), cleanShards)
        .putInt(uidKey(KEY_HIGHEST_MILESTONE_LVL, uid), nextMilestone)
    if (canUseLegacyUnscopedFallback(uid)) {
      ed
        .putLong(KEY_XP_BUFFS, nextBuffs)
        .putLong(KEY_XP_DAMAGE, nextDmg)
        .putLong(KEY_XP_ACCURACY, nextAcc)
        .putLong(KEY_XP_BOUNTY_EARNED, nextEarned)
        .putLong(KEY_XP_BOUNTY_KILLED, nextKilled)
        .putLong(KEY_RIFT_SHARDS, cleanShards)
        .putInt(KEY_HIGHEST_MILESTONE_LVL, nextMilestone)
    }
    ed.apply()
  }

  fun claimPendingMilestoneShards(currentLevel: Int, uid: String? = null): Long {
    val highestClaimed = getHighestMilestoneLevelClaimed(uid).coerceAtLeast(1)
    val clampedLevel = currentLevel.coerceIn(1, 100)
    val reward =
      com.example.engine.RiftProgressionCatalog.calculateUnclaimedMilestoneShards(
        highestClaimedLevel = highestClaimed,
        currentLevel = clampedLevel,
      )
    if (reward > 0L || clampedLevel > highestClaimed) {
      val nextShards = getRiftShards(uid) + reward
      val ed =
        prefs
          .edit()
          .putLong(uidKey(KEY_RIFT_SHARDS, uid), nextShards)
          .putInt(uidKey(KEY_HIGHEST_MILESTONE_LVL, uid), clampedLevel)
      if (canUseLegacyUnscopedFallback(uid)) {
        ed
          .putLong(KEY_RIFT_SHARDS, nextShards)
          .putInt(KEY_HIGHEST_MILESTONE_LVL, clampedLevel)
      }
      ed.apply()
    }
    return reward
  }

  fun isCosmeticUnlocked(
    category: String,
    itemId: Int,
    pilotLevel: Int = getPilotLevel(),
    uid: String? = null,
  ): Boolean {
    if (itemId <= 0) return true
    val cat = category.trim().uppercase(Locale.US)
    val item = com.example.engine.RiftProgressionCatalog.getCosmeticItem(cat, itemId)
    if (item != null && (pilotLevel >= item.freeAtLevel || getPeakResonance(uid) >= item.freeAtResonance)) {
      return true
    }
    val baseKey = "cosmetic_unlocked_${cat}_$itemId"
    return prefs.getBoolean(uidKey(baseKey, uid), prefs.getBoolean(baseKey, false))
  }

  fun getEquippedCosmeticId(category: String, uid: String? = null): Int {
