Ask about RIFT ships, pixel/physics stats, custom builds, Rift Conduit Resonance, Playfield Rifts, 5x Rift Station, Rift Hub Overwatch, Squadrons, Ranked Modes, buffs, or Pilot Dossier records."
3. PINPOINT NUMERICAL & PIXEL PRECISION: Cite exact live engine numbers, world-pixel dimensions, DPS, Flux costs (HP + weapon energy, floored at 1 Flux on self-drain), Rift Shards economy, Per-Ship, Live & Peak Resonance, custom frames (`Frame A-E`), Eclipse two-way `Stasis` (6.0s duration, 275px radius, 320 Flux cost, 8.5s CD), Gravity Rift 440px swept growth & >= 260px 950/s tidal implosion, Unstable Rift 10.0s convergence & outside-Safe-Zone insta-kill shockwave, 5x (180px) Rift Station, Ranked Mode telemetry, Calibration overrides, and Sworn Pilot Leaderboard records. Never use decorative emojis or literal star icons; write "Flux" for ship energy/HP and "Rift Shards" for currency.
4. ANDROID TOUCH HUD & TWIN-STICK CONTROLLER TERMINOLOGY ONLY: Support native Android Landscape Touch HUD (Left Movement Stick, Manual [BRAKE], Right Primary Fire Stick, Secondary, Special Buff, Repel, Native Multi-Shot, Collapsible Living-Teammate Spectator Box, Graphical Dual-Rift Tug-of-War Top Bar in Rift Control, and Bottom Console with 3D AGSL Plasma Flux Ring wrapping the 1:1 circular minimap) AND Bluetooth/USB Twin-Stick Controllers (including LB/RB teammate spectator cycling). Never mention PC keyboard shortcuts.
5. PURE TEXT Q&A & THEORYCRAFTING: Deliver clear, structured tactical answers and 100-point Rift Frame theorycrafting breakdowns (all 10 ships and full 100-point parity open from 0 Resonance).
"""

  fun buildLiveSystemPrompt(
    engine: RiftGameEngine,
    localPrefs: LocalPilotPrefs,
    currentUserId: String,
    callsign: String,
    syndicateTag: String,
    syndicateName: String,
    cloudLeaderboard: List<LeaderboardEntry>,
    allTimePeakSnapshot: PeakBountyRunSnapshot?,
    pvpPeakSnapshot: PeakBountyRunSnapshot?,
    syndicateHistory: List<SyndicateServiceEntry>,
  ): String =
    compileLiveSnapshot(
      engine = engine,
      localPrefs = localPrefs,
      currentUserId = currentUserId,
      callsign = callsign,
      syndicateTag = syndicateTag,
      syndicateName = syndicateName,
      cloudLeaderboard = cloudLeaderboard,
      allTimePeakSnapshot = allTimePeakSnapshot,
      pvpPeakSnapshot = pvpPeakSnapshot,
      syndicateHistory = syndicateHistory,
    )

  fun compileLiveSnapshot(
    engine: RiftGameEngine,
    localPrefs: LocalPilotPrefs,
    currentUserId: String,
    callsign: String,
    syndicateTag: String,
    syndicateName: String,
    cloudLeaderboard: List<LeaderboardEntry>,
    allTimePeakSnapshot: PeakBountyRunSnapshot?,
    pvpPeakSnapshot: PeakBountyRunSnapshot?,
    syndicateHistory: List<SyndicateServiceEntry>,
  ): String {
    val sb = StringBuilder(17_000)
    val camScale = engine.effectiveCameraScale()
    val projScale = RiftCalibrationState.projectileScale
    val shipVisScale = RiftCalibrationState.shipScale
    val crateVisScale = RiftCalibrationState.crateScale
    val anomVisScale = RiftCalibrationState.anomalyScale
    val customSpdMult = engine.currentCustomGame?.speedMult ?: 1.0f
    val customDmgMult = engine.currentCustomGame?.damageMult ?: 1.0f

    sb.appendLine("=== [LIVE RIFT GROUND-TRUTH TELEMETRY SNAPSHOT — BUILD #95] ===")

    sb.appendLine()
    sb.appendLine("[1. SCI-FI COMMAND TABLET RIFT HUB, OVERWATCH, 5X RIFT STATION SAFE HARBOR & PIXEL/SHADER SPECS]")
    sb.appendLine(
      "- RIFT Sci-Fi Command Tablet Hub: #060D1A tablet shell with 6 192x192 5-stop metallic station-styled module cards — Left Wing: HANGAR DECK (active or locked ship name below title, Best Ship or Ship #1 artwork, and BEST or LOCKED badge), STARFORGE (ships, skins & audio), SUBSPACE COMMS (live channels & RIFT AI); Right Wing: RIFT CONDUIT (Conduit Rank & Resonance crest icon), active Syndicate name & SQUADRON controls (SYNDICATE CITADEL), PILOT DOSSIER — framing a center Round Rippling Dynamic-Lit Digitized Aperture with live 1.0x..6.0x 2-finger pinch-to-zoom & 1-finger pan Orbital Overwatch (world nametags hidden below 1.55x zoom for a clean radar view), auto-selecting [FAV] or the active game with Highest Combined Pilot Resonance (Game Type • RIFT #XX) + [RIFT IN] opening the scrollable CONVERGENCE GATE mode list (SECTOR CONVERGENCE at top) to deploy directly with the ship indicated on HANGAR DECK (BEST or LOCKED)."
    )
    sb.appendLine(
      "- World Arena & Rippling Rift-Cloud Storm Wall: 8000 x 8000 world pixels (8x8 sectors A1..H8, each sector = 1000 x 1000 world px; circular perimeter radius = ${engine.arenaRadius.toInt()} world px). Outer boundary renders a seamless GPU AGSL 3D Rift-Cloud Storm Wall bleeding 260px inward with live branching proximity arc lightning striking ships within 220px of the perimeter."
    )
    sb.appendLine(
      "- Wall-Less Circular Safe-Zone Harbor & 5x Rift Station: Safe-Zone radius = ${engine.getSafeZoneRadius().toInt()} world px centered at (${engine.arenaCenterX.toInt()}, ${engine.arenaCenterY.toInt()}), anchored by a 5x ship-scale (180px world radius) Rift Station metallic sprite with a revolving cyan/gold Ops Holo-Ring and radial stabilizer beams (editable live in STAR FORGE). Active ONLY in SECTOR CONVERGENCE and FLUX CORE (live hasActiveSafeZone() = ${engine.hasActiveSafeZone()}, 15s max stay / weapon-lockout); completely disabled in RIFT CONTROL, STASIS BREACH, RIFT SKIRMISH, and SYNDICATE WARS. Open-Space Anti-AFK Flux drain is likewise restricted strictly to SECTOR CONVERGENCE and FLUX CORE."
    )
    sb.appendLine(
      String.format(
        Locale.US,
        "- Camera Scale Formula: effectiveCameraScale = 0.65 (base) * cameraZoom (%.2fx) * cameraZoomScale (%.2fx) = %.4fx live (1 world px = %.4f screen px).",
        engine.cameraZoom,
        RiftCalibrationState.cameraZoomScale,
        camScale,
        camScale,
      )
    )
    sb.appendLine(
      String.format(
        Locale.US,
        "- Ship Hull Rendering & Hitbox: Offscreen procedural 3D metallic bitmap = 128x128 px; physical collision radius = 36.0 world px (72.0 world px diameter); live world render quad = %.2f x %.2f world px (%.2f screen px at live zoom).",
        88f * shipVisScale,
        88f * shipVisScale,
        88f * shipVisScale * camScale,
      )
    )
    sb.appendLine(
      String.format(
        Locale.US,
        "- Primary Laser / Bolt Exact Pixel Formula: Shaft Vector Length = primarySpeed * 0.036 world px; Outer Colored Glow Width = %.2f world px; Inner White Core Width = %.2f world px; swept segment-vs-AABB collision prevents point-blank wall bleed.",
        6.4f * projScale,
        2.8f * projScale,
      )
    )
    sb.appendLine(
      String.format(
        Locale.US,
        "- Secondary Warhead & Ability Specs (scaled by projectileScale %.2fx, Custom speedMult %.2fx, Custom damageMult %.2fx): Viper Phase Dash = 135 world px spatial blink + %.0f px/s dodge burst (320 Flux cost, 0.65s CD, +%.0f%% next-shot rail overcharge); Siege Bomb = %.1f world px radius; Bounce & Prox Flak Bomb = %.1f world px radius (Prox Flak fuse = %.0f world px); Disruptor Cloak & 360-deg EMP = 20 Flux entry, %.0f Flux/s cloak drain (50%% cloaked afterburner drain, 4.5s CD, 150 Flux safety floor), 0 Flux manual decloak %.0f world px EMP draining %.0f%% Max Flux (capped at 850 Flux) + %.1fs recharge freeze; Proximity Mine = %.1f world px radius (max %d mines, 30s life); Fast Predictive Seeker Torpedo = %.1f world px radius (%.0f px/s cruise * speedMult, proportional intercept lead, %.1fs flight); Stackable Stasis Barrier = %.0f world px Tethered Cyan Hard-Light Forcefield (%.1fs duration, deploys within 78px stack as BARRIER xN); SWARM = 5 autonomous zig-zagging hunter drones (210 Flux dmg * damageMult each, 560 px/s * speedMult, 6.5s life); Eclipse Stasis (INTERDICTOR_DOME) = %.0f world px radius (%.0f world px diameter) two-way Stasis active for %.1fs (320 Flux cost, %.1fs CD).",
        projScale,
        customSpdMult,
        customDmgMult,
        RiftCalibrationState.phaseDashImpulse,
        RiftCalibrationState.phaseOverchargeBonusPct * 100f,
        24f * projScale,
        17f * projScale,
        RiftCalibrationState.proxFuseRadius,
        RiftCalibrationState.cloakDrainPerSec,
        RiftCalibrationState.empPulseRadius,
        RiftCalibrationState.empFluxDrainPct * 100f,
        RiftCalibrationState.empFreezeSec,
        18f * projScale,
        RiftCalibrationState.maxMinesPerShip,
        19f * projScale,
        RiftCalibrationState.seekerSpeed,
        RiftCalibrationState.seekerFlightTime,
        RiftCalibrationState.stasisBarrierLength,
        RiftCalibrationState.stasisBarrierDuration,
        RiftCalibrationState.interdictorBubbleRadius,
        RiftCalibrationState.interdictorBubbleRadius * 2f,
        RiftCalibrationState.interdictorBubbleDuration,
        RiftCalibrationState.interdictorBubbleCooldown,
      )
    )
    sb.appendLine(
      String.format(
        Locale.US,
        "- Destructible Crystal Asteroids & 10-Hit Station Defense Novas: Crystal Asteroids have 2,400 Flux integrity with an on-rock circular integrity ring; shattering one drops a guaranteed Supply Crate and schedules a 20.0s respawn (%d pending respawns). Orbital & Asteroid Stations track weapon impacts with a 10-segment charge ring and unleash a 16-bolt 360-degree Station Defense Nova every 10 hits (or when imploded by a >= 260px Gravity Rift, damaging all frequencies). Supply Crate world size = %.2f world px; 3D AGSL Plasma Flux Ring wraps the 1:1 arenaRadius Circular Minimap.",
        engine.pendingAsteroidRespawns.size,
        78.32f * crateVisScale,
      )
    )

    sb.appendLine()
    sb.appendLine("[2. RIFT CONDUIT RESONANCE, STARTING RESONANCE (100-500) & RANKED/CUSTOM MODES]")
    val liveRes = engine.liveResonance
    val peakRes = engine.peakResonance
    val conduitTier = RiftProgressionCatalog.getConduitTierForResonance(liveRes)
    val startRes = engine.getLocalStartingBounty()
    sb.appendLine(
      "- Rift Conduit Resonance: Live Resonance = $liveRes (${conduitTier.title}) | Peak Resonance = $peakRes | Effective Starting Resonance = $startRes RES (Ranked scales 100 -> 150 -> 225 -> 300 -> 400 -> 500 Max across Drift Initiate, Vanguard, Interceptor, Phantom, Rift Commander, and Apex Archon; Custom Rifts standardize starting Resonance to 100 RES)."
    )
    val directives = localPrefs.getDailyDirectives(currentUserId)
    val directivesSummary =
      directives.joinToString(" | ") { d ->
        "${d.title}: ${d.progressValue}/${d.targetValue} (${d.shardReward} Shards +${d.resonanceReward} RES, ${if (d.claimed) "CLAIMED" else if (d.isComplete) "READY" else "ACTIVE"})"
      }
    sb.appendLine("- 3 Daily Conduit Directives (up to 250 Shards/day including +100 Shards 3/3 Sweep Chest): $directivesSummary")
    sb.appendLine(
      String.format(
        Locale.US,
        "- Zero-Friction Newtonian Drift & Controls: Ships coast indefinitely when releasing the Left Stick. Left Stick >80%% ignites Afterburners (%.2fx thrust, drains %.0f Flux/s floored at 1 Flux). Braking occurs ONLY via manual [BRAKE] or mapped Gamepad Retro-Brake (damping %.2f). Live Controller Bindings: Main=%s, Buff=%s, Brake=%s, Secondary=%s, Repel=%s, Multi=%s; LB/RB cycle living allies while spectating.",
        RiftCalibrationState.afterburnerThrustMult,
        RiftCalibrationState.afterburnerDrainPerSec,
        RiftCalibrationState.retroBrakeDamping,
        RiftCalibrationState.getBindingLabel(RiftCalibrationState.bindPrimaryFire),
        RiftCalibrationState.getBindingLabel(RiftCalibrationState.bindSpecialBuff),
        RiftCalibrationState.getBindingLabel(RiftCalibrationState.bindRetroBrake),
        RiftCalibrationState.getBindingLabel(RiftCalibrationState.bindSecondaryAbility),
        RiftCalibrationState.getBindingLabel(RiftCalibrationState.bindRepel),
        RiftCalibrationState.getBindingLabel(RiftCalibrationState.bindMultiToggle),
      )
    )
    val matchRemainingSec = (engine.publicMatchCycleLimitSec - engine.publicMatchDurationSec).coerceAtLeast(0f)
    sb.appendLine(
      String.format(
        Locale.US,
        "- Public FFA Sector Convergence & Live Resonance Math: %.0f-minute cycle (%.0fs remaining). Local pilot spawns at %d Starting Resonance; High-Resonance halo above match average (Rift Leader threshold >= %d RES); killing awards +%.0f%% victim Resonance; Supply Crates +%d Resonance. Winning with >50%% presence awards +100 Rift Shards.",
        engine.publicMatchCycleLimitSec / 60f,
        matchRemainingSec,
        startRes,
        RiftCalibrationState.hvtBountyThreshold,
        RiftCalibrationState.bountyKillBonusPct * 100f,
        RiftCalibrationState.cratePickupBounty,
      )
    )
    sb.appendLine("- 6 Official Ranked Modes + Cloneable Custom Rifts (Rift Hub [RIFT IN] -> Scrollable Mode List with SECTOR CONVERGENCE at top -> Direct Rift Entry using ship on HANGAR DECK):")
    sb.appendLine("  - 1) SECTOR CONVERGENCE: 20-Pilot Ranked FFA / 1-5 Squadron | 5x Rift Station Safe Harbor ON | +100 Shards.")
    sb.appendLine("  - 2) RIFT SKIRMISH: Ranked 2v2-5v5 Best-of-3 Rounds Team Deathmatch | Safe Zone OFF | Ship Lock ON | Teammate Spectator | +75 Shards.")
    sb.appendLine(
      String.format(
        Locale.US,
        "  - 3) FLUX CORE: 20-Pilot Ranked Powerball FFA | 5x Rift Station Safe Harbor ON | Tier 1-10 Overcharge (+15 RES/s; 2x pulsing Gold radar beacon) | Ejects at %.0f px/s on death or Safe Zone entry.",
        RiftCalibrationState.fluxCoreEjectSpeed,
      )
    )
    sb.appendLine(
      String.format(
        Locale.US,
        "  - 4) STASIS BREACH: Ranked 10v10 Circular Stasis Jailbreak | Safe Zone OFF | Prisoners inside deal 100%% weapon damage to the %.0f Flux Stasis Core to detonate a radial shockwave and break everyone out | +100 Shards (Live Cores: West=%.0f Flux, East=%.0f Flux).",
        RiftCalibrationState.stasisBrigReactorMaxHp,
        engine.westBrigGeneratorHp,
        engine.eastBrigGeneratorHp,
      )
    )
    sb.appendLine("  - 5) RIFT CONTROL: Ranked Tug-of-War over Rift Alpha & Rift Omega | Safe Zone OFF | Graphical Dual-Rift Tug-of-War Top HUD Bar | +85 Shards.")
    val myWarRec = localPrefs.getSyndicateWarRecord(syndicateTag)
    sb.appendLine(
      "  - 6) SYNDICATE WARS: Ranked Direct Syndicate-vs-Syndicate Ladder | Safe Zone OFF | Ship Lock ON | Requires a Sworn Pilot Syndicate and 100% same-Syndicate Squadron | Ranked by Syndicate War Trophies (Active Syndicate [$syndicateTag] Record: ${myWarRec.warTrophies} War Trophies, ${myWarRec.warWins}W-${myWarRec.warLosses}L, Streak ${myWarRec.warStreak})."
    )
    sb.appendLine(
      "  - Active Ranked Mode Right Now: ${engine.activeRankedMode.title} (${engine.activeRankedMode.id}, Bracket=${engine.activeTeamSizeBracket}, Human Pilots in Mode=${engine.getHumanPilotCountForMode(engine.activeRankedMode)}, ShipLocked=${engine.doesModeLockShipSelection()})."
    )

    sb.appendLine()
    sb.appendLine("[3. COMPLETE 10-SHIP ROSTER — ALL 10 OPEN AT 0 RESONANCE (100-POINT PARITY)]")
    for (spec in RiftCodex.getAllTenShips()) {
      val shaftWorldPx = spec.primarySpeed * 0.036f
      val outerWidthWorldPx = 6.4f * projScale
      val totalWorldLenPx = shaftWorldPx + outerWidthWorldPx
      val shotsPerSec = if (spec.primaryCooldown > 0.001f) 1f / spec.primaryCooldown else 0f
      val volleyDmg = spec.primaryDamage * spec.primaryStreams
      val primaryDps = volleyDmg * shotsPerSec
      val fluxPerSec = spec.primaryCost * shotsPerSec

      sb.appendLine(
        String.format(
          Locale.US,
          "* %s (%s) [100-Pt Allocation: Spd %d, Thr %d, Turn %d, MaxFlux %d, Rech %d, Pri %d, Sec %d = %d Pts]:",
          spec.name,
          spec.role,
          spec.speedPts,
          spec.thrustPts,
          spec.turnPts,
          spec.maxFluxPts,
          spec.rechargePts,
          spec.primaryPts,
          spec.secondaryPts,
          spec.totalAllocatedPoints,
        )
      )
      sb.appendLine(
        String.format(
          Locale.US,
          "  - Hull: MaxFlux=%.0f Flux, Recharge=%.0f Flux/s, TopSpeed=%.0f px/s (Afterburner=%.0f px/s), Thrust=%.0f px/s^2, TurnRate=%.2f rad/s.",
          spec.maxFlux,
          spec.rechargeRate,
          spec.topSpeed,
          spec.afterburnerSpeed,
          spec.thrust,
          spec.turnRate,
        )
      )
      sb.appendLine(
        String.format(
          Locale.US,
          "  - Primary [%s]: %d stream(s), %.0f Flux/stream (%.0f Flux/volley), Cost=%.0f Flux/shot, Cooldown=%.3fs, Speed=%.0f px/s, Bounces=%d | Raw DPS=%.0f Flux/s, Drain=%.0f Flux/s | Bolt=%.2f world px.",
          spec.primaryTitle,
          spec.primaryStreams,
          spec.primaryDamage,
          volleyDmg,
          spec.primaryCost,
          spec.primaryCooldown,
          spec.primarySpeed,
          spec.primaryBounces,
          primaryDps,
          fluxPerSec,
          totalWorldLenPx,
        )
      )
      if (spec.hasBomb) {
        sb.appendLine(
          String.format(
            Locale.US,
            "  - Secondary [%s | type=%s]: Cost=%.0f Flux, Cooldown=%.2fs, Damage=%.0f Flux, WallBounces=%d.",
            spec.secondaryTitle,
            spec.bombType,
            spec.bombCost,
            spec.bombCooldown,
            spec.bombDamage,
            spec.bombBounces,
          )
        )
      }
      sb.appendLine("  - Lore & Role: ${spec.tacticalLore}")
    }

    sb.appendLine()
    sb.appendLine("[4. RIFT FRAME 100-POINT PARITY (OPEN AT 0 RESONANCE) & SAVED FRAMES A-E]")
    sb.appendLine("- All 10 ships including Rift Frame (100/100 Customization Points + Frame A) are open immediately at 0 Resonance. Peak Resonance unlocks 3D Hull Trims, Kill Finishers, Warp Signatures, Resonance Leader Halos, and extra Loadout Bays Frame B-E.")
    val activeSlotId = localPrefs.getActiveCustomSlotId(currentUserId)
    for (slotId in CustomShipLoadoutSlot.ALL_SLOT_IDS) {
      val slot = localPrefs.getCustomShipSlot(slotId, currentUserId)
      val unlocked = slotId == "Frame A" || localPrefs.isCustomSlotUnlocked(slotId, currentUserId)
      val activeMarker = if (slotId == activeSlotId) " [ACTIVE]" else ""
      sb.appendLine(
        "  - $slotId$activeMarker (${if (unlocked) "UNLOCKED" else "LOCKED"}) '${slot.customName}': ${slot.totalAllocatedPoints()} Pts (Spd=${slot.speedPts}, Thr=${slot.thrustPts}, Turn=${slot.turnPts}, Flux=${slot.maxFluxPts}, Rech=${slot.rechargePts}, Pri=${slot.primaryArchetype}, Sec=${slot.secondaryType})."
      )
    }

    sb.appendLine()
    sb.appendLine("[5. 12-BUFF SUPPLY POOL, FORGED BUFFS & PLAYFIELD RIFTS (440PX GRAVITY IMPLOSION & UNSTABLE RIFT)]")
    sb.appendLine(
      "- Supply Crate Cap: ${engine.getEffectiveBuffCap()} crates (${engine.greens.size} spawned, ${engine.swarmDrones.size} active Swarm Drones, ${engine.brickWalls.size} active Stasis Barriers). Repel Cost=${RiftCalibrationState.repelCost.toInt()} Flux, Radius=${RiftCalibrationState.repelRadius.toInt()}px."
    )
    for (entry in RiftCodex.POWERUP_CODEX) {
      sb.appendLine("  - ${entry.title} (${entry.dropRatePercent}% drop): ${entry.effectSummary}")
    }
    val customForged = RiftCodex.getCustomForgedBuffs()
    for (cb in customForged) {
      sb.appendLine(
        "  - [CUSTOM FORGED] ${cb.officialName} (${cb.shortLabel}): ${cb.chargesPerPickup} charges, effect=${cb.specialEffect.label}, dmg=${cb.damage.toInt()} Flux, radius=${cb.blastRadius.toInt()}px."
      )
    }
    val unstableCount = engine.anomalies.count { it.isUnstableMergedRift }
    sb.appendLine(
      String.format(
        Locale.US,
        "- Playfield Rifts (%.0fpx base physical core radius, %.0fs lifespan, %d active, %d Unstable Merged): 1) PLASMA RIFT (%.0f%% Max Flux burn/0.6s), 2) REPULSOR RIFT (%.0fpx deflection + inner-core 1.45x afterburner supersonic slingshot), 3) GRAVITY RIFT (%.0fpx pull; swept 0.92x visible-disc weapon absorption grows radius +18px/bolt, +40px/bomb-torpedo, +14px/drone-phantom up to 440px max; at >= 260px swollen mass drags Crystal Asteroids, Orbital/Asteroid Stations, Debris, and Stasis Barriers into the core at 950/s tidal crush -> implosion + Supply Crate + 20.0s respawn + 16-bolt 360-deg Station Overload Nova), 4) PAIRED PHASE RIFTS (Phase Rift A & B instantaneous gateway, %.2fs re-entry CD), 5) UNSTABLE RIFT (overlapping Rifts merge into a 10.0s circular convergence singularity that detonates for full-sector insta-kill outside Safe Harbor and shatters nearby Crystal Asteroids).",
        RiftCalibrationState.riftPhysicalRadius * anomVisScale,
        RiftCalibrationState.riftLifespanSec,
        engine.anomalies.size,
        unstableCount,
        RiftCalibrationState.plasmaRiftDamagePct * 100f,
        RiftCalibrationState.repulsorFieldRadius,
        RiftCalibrationState.gravityPullRadius,
        RiftCalibrationState.phaseRiftCooldownSec,
      )
    )

    sb.appendLine()
    sb.appendLine("[6. REAL-PLAYER-ONLY SWORN PILOT LEADERBOARD & DOSSIER RECORDS]")
    val realCloudLeaderboard =
      cloudLeaderboard.filter {
        val rawT = it.syndicateTag.trim().uppercase(Locale.US)
        rawT != "BOT" &&
          rawT != "RFT" &&
          !it.callsign.contains("[BOT]") &&
          !it.userId.startsWith("dev_")
      }
    val topCloudAllTime = realCloudLeaderboard.maxByOrNull { it.allTimeBounty }
    if (topCloudAllTime != null) {
      val synClean = localPrefs.sanitizeSyndicateTag(topCloudAllTime.syndicateTag)
      val synBadge = if (synClean.isNotEmpty()) "[$synClean] " else ""
      sb.appendLine(
        "- Top Cloud Sworn Pilot All-Time Record: $synBadge${topCloudAllTime.callsign} with ${topCloudAllTime.allTimeBounty} Peak Resonance (${topCloudAllTime.allTimeKills}K/${topCloudAllTime.allTimeDeaths}D)."
      )
    } else {
      sb.appendLine("- Cloud Leaderboard Status: 0 Sworn Pilot records synced yet (AI Bots and [RFT] Drifters are strictly excluded).")
    }

    val p = engine.localPlayer
    val pSpeed = hypot(p.vx, p.vy).roundToInt()
    val secX = ((p.x / 1000f).toInt()).coerceIn(0, 7)
    val secY = ((p.y / 1000f).toInt()).coerceIn(0, 7)
    val sectorStr = "${('A' + secX)}${secY + 1}"
    val perShipResSummary =
      (1..10).joinToString(", ") { id -> "${RiftCodex.getShipById(id).name}:${engine.getShipResonance(id)}" }
    val activeSynClean = localPrefs.sanitizeSyndicateTag(syndicateTag)
    val activeSynLabel = if (activeSynClean.isNotEmpty()) "[$activeSynClean] " else "[SOLO] "
    sb.appendLine(
      "- Active Pilot: $activeSynLabel$callsign (Syndicate: '$syndicateName') | Live Resonance: $liveRes (${conduitTier.title}) | Per-Ship Resonance: [$perShipResSummary] | Peak Resonance: $peakRes | Shards: ${engine.riftShards} | Live Hull: ${engine.formatShipLabel(p)} (${engine.getShipResonance(p.shipId)} RES) in Sector $sectorStr, Speed=$pSpeed px/s, Flux=${p.flux.toInt()}/${p.maxFlux.toInt()} Flux."
    )

    fun formatSnapshot(label: String, snap: PeakBountyRunSnapshot?) {
      if (snap == null) return
      sb.appendLine(
        "- $label: Peak Resonance=${snap.bountyReached} RES in ${snap.shipFlown}, Survived=${snap.formattedDuration()}, Kills=${snap.pvpKills} PVP / ${snap.botKills} Bot, Damage=${snap.damageDealt.toInt()} Flux dealt / ${snap.damageTaken.toInt()} Flux taken."
      )
    }
    formatSnapshot("All-Time Peak Resonance Run", allTimePeakSnapshot)
    formatSnapshot("PVP Peak Resonance Run", pvpPeakSnapshot)

    if (syndicateHistory.isNotEmpty()) {
      sb.appendLine(
        "- Syndicate Service History: " +
          syndicateHistory.joinToString(" ; ") { "[${it.syndicateTag}] ${it.syndicateName} (${it.totalKills}K, ${it.publicGameWins}W)" }
      )
    }

    val modifiedCalibrations =
      RiftCalibrationState.buildAllParameterDescriptors().mapNotNull { desc ->
        val cur = desc.getter()
        val def = RiftCalibrationState.DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]
        if (def != null && abs(cur - def) > 0.0005f) {
          "${desc.title}: ${desc.formatValue(def)} -> ${desc.formatValue(cur)}"
        } else {
          null
        }
      }
    if (modifiedCalibrations.isNotEmpty()) {
      sb.appendLine("- Live Calibration Overrides (${modifiedCalibrations.size}): ${modifiedCalibrations.joinToString(" | ")}")
    }

    return sb.toString()
  }
}

enum class MusicSynthArchetype(
  val id: String,
  val label: String,
  val defaultBpm: Int,
  val summary: String,
) {
  DARK_SYNTHWAVE(
    id = "DARK_SYNTHWAVE",
    label = "Dark Synthwave",
    defaultBpm = 118,
    summary = "Driving minor bassline + pulsing neon arpeggio",
  ),
  CYBER_INDUSTRIAL(
    id = "CYBER_INDUSTRIAL",
    label = "Industrial Bass",
    defaultBpm = 132,
    summary = "Aggressive Phrygian sawtooth + heavy gated percussion",
  ),
  COSMIC_AMBIENT(
    id = "COSMIC_AMBIENT",
    label = "Deep-Space Pad",
    defaultBpm = 84,
    summary = "Floating Lydian synth pads + sub-drone, no drums",
  ),
  RETRO_CHIPTUNE(
    id = "RETRO_CHIPTUNE",
    label = "Arcade Chiptune",
    defaultBpm = 142,
    summary = "Crisp pulse-wave arcade lead + rapid 16th-note arp",
  ),
  SINGULARITY_OVERDRIVE(
    id = "SINGULARITY_OVERDRIVE",
    label = "Singularity Drive",
    defaultBpm = 156,
    summary = "High-tension harmonic minor polyrhythm + punchy kick",
  );

  companion object {
    fun fromId(rawId: String?): MusicSynthArchetype =
      entries.firstOrNull { it.id.equals(rawId?.trim(), ignoreCase = true) } ?: DARK_SYNTHWAVE
  }
}

data class MusicForgeRecipe(
  val archetype: MusicSynthArchetype = MusicSynthArchetype.DARK_SYNTHWAVE,
  val bpm: Int = 118,
  val rootMidiNote: Int = 38, // D2 default
  val scaleIntervals: IntArray = intArrayOf(0, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10), // Natural Minor
  val leadWaveform: Int = 0, // 0=DetunedSaw, 1=PulseSquare, 2=WarmSinePad, 3=FmBell
  val arpPattern: Int = 0, // 0=UpDown, 1=OctaveJump, 2=TripletRoll, 3=SparseAmbient
  val drumsEnabled: Boolean = true,
  val bassDrive: Float = 0.80f,
  val brightness: Float = 0.65f,
  val customPromptSummary: String = "Dark Synthwave • 118 BPM",
) {
  fun toJson(): JSONObject =
    JSONObject().apply {
      put("archetype", archetype.id)
      put("bpm", bpm.coerceIn(60, 180))
      put("rootMidiNote", rootMidiNote.coerceIn(28, 60))
      val scaleArr = JSONArray()
      scaleIntervals.forEach { scaleArr.put(it) }
      put("scaleIntervals", scaleArr)
      put("leadWaveform", leadWaveform.coerceIn(0, 3))
      put("arpPattern", arpPattern.coerceIn(0, 3))
      put("drumsEnabled", drumsEnabled)
      put("bassDrive", ((bassDrive.coerceIn(0.2f, 1.2f) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
      put("brightness", ((brightness.coerceIn(0.2f, 1.0f) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
      put("customPromptSummary", customPromptSummary.take(120))
    }

  override fun equals(other: Any?): Boolean {
    if (this === other) return true
    if (other !is MusicForgeRecipe) return false
    return archetype == other.archetype &&
      bpm == other.bpm &&
      rootMidiNote == other.rootMidiNote &&
      scaleIntervals.contentEquals(other.scaleIntervals) &&
      leadWaveform == other.leadWaveform &&
      arpPattern == other.arpPattern &&
      drumsEnabled == other.drumsEnabled &&
      bassDrive == other.bassDrive &&
      brightness == other.brightness &&
      customPromptSummary == other.customPromptSummary
  }

  override fun hashCode(): Int {
    var result = archetype.hashCode()
    result = 31 * result + bpm
    result = 31 * result + rootMidiNote
    result = 31 * result + scaleIntervals.contentHashCode()
    result = 31 * result + leadWaveform
    result = 31 * result + arpPattern
    result = 31 * result + drumsEnabled.hashCode()
    result = 31 * result + bassDrive.hashCode()
    result = 31 * result + brightness.hashCode()
    result = 31 * result + customPromptSummary.hashCode()
    return result
  }

  companion object {
    fun fromJson(obj: JSONObject?): MusicForgeRecipe {
      if (obj == null) return RiftSoundSynthesizer.buildArchetypeRecipe(MusicSynthArchetype.DARK_SYNTHWAVE, 118)
      val arch = MusicSynthArchetype.fromId(obj.optString("archetype", "DARK_SYNTHWAVE"))
      val bpm = obj.optInt("bpm", arch.defaultBpm).coerceIn(60, 180)
      val scaleArr = obj.optJSONArray("scaleIntervals")
      val intervals =
        if (scaleArr != null && scaleArr.length() > 0) {
          IntArray(scaleArr.length()) { idx -> scaleArr.optInt(idx, 0).coerceIn(0, 11) }
        } else {
          intArrayOf(0, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10)
        }
      return MusicForgeRecipe(
        archetype = arch,
        bpm = bpm,
        rootMidiNote = obj.optInt("rootMidiNote", 38).coerceIn(28, 60),
        scaleIntervals = intervals,
        leadWaveform = obj.optInt("leadWaveform", 0).coerceIn(0, 3),
        arpPattern = obj.optInt("arpPattern", 0).coerceIn(0, 3),
        drumsEnabled = obj.optBoolean("drumsEnabled", arch != MusicSynthArchetype.COSMIC_AMBIENT),
        bassDrive = obj.optDouble("bassDrive", 0.80).toFloat().coerceIn(0.2f, 1.2f),
        brightness = obj.optDouble("brightness", 0.65).toFloat().coerceIn(0.2f, 1.0f),
        customPromptSummary =
          obj.optString("customPromptSummary", "${arch.label} • $bpm BPM")
            .ifBlank { "${arch.label} • $bpm BPM" }
            .take(120),
      )
    }
  }
}

/**
 * 100% On-Device Procedural Combat SFX Recipe for `NEXUS FORGE` (`Soundtrack & SFX Forge` bay).
 * Controls live PCM synthesis of lasers, explosions, Repel/shield ripples, and pickup chimes.
 */
data class SfxForgeRecipe(
  val laserPitchMultiplier: Float = 1.0f, // 0.55f .. 1.75f
  val laserHarmonicDrive: Float = 0.45f, // 0.10f .. 1.00f
  val explosionSubBass: Float = 0.85f, // 0.25f .. 1.40f
  val explosionDebrisCrunch: Float = 0.35f, // 0.05f .. 1.00f
  val shieldRippleResonance: Float = 0.70f, // 0.20f .. 1.35f
  val uiChimeBrightness: Float = 0.65f, // 0.20f .. 1.25f
  val promptUsed: String = "Tactical Standard SFX",
) {
  fun toJson(): JSONObject =
    JSONObject().apply {
      put("laserPitchMultiplier", ((laserPitchMultiplier.coerceIn(0.55f, 1.75f) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
      put("laserHarmonicDrive", ((laserHarmonicDrive.coerceIn(0.10f, 1.00f) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
      put("explosionSubBass", ((explosionSubBass.coerceIn(0.25f, 1.40f) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
      put("explosionDebrisCrunch", ((explosionDebrisCrunch.coerceIn(0.05f, 1.00f) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
      put("shieldRippleResonance", ((shieldRippleResonance.coerceIn(0.20f, 1.35f) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
      put("uiChimeBrightness", ((uiChimeBrightness.coerceIn(0.20f, 1.25f) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
      put("promptUsed", promptUsed.take(120))
    }

  companion object {
    fun fromJson(obj: JSONObject?): SfxForgeRecipe {
      if (obj == null) return SfxForgeRecipe()
      return SfxForgeRecipe(
        laserPitchMultiplier = obj.optDouble("laserPitchMultiplier", 1.0).toFloat().coerceIn(0.55f, 1.75f),
        laserHarmonicDrive = obj.optDouble("laserHarmonicDrive", 0.45).toFloat().coerceIn(0.10f, 1.00f),
        explosionSubBass = obj.optDouble("explosionSubBass", 0.85).toFloat().coerceIn(0.25f, 1.40f),
        explosionDebrisCrunch = obj.optDouble("explosionDebrisCrunch", 0.35).toFloat().coerceIn(0.05f, 1.00f),
        shieldRippleResonance = obj.optDouble("shieldRippleResonance", 0.70).toFloat().coerceIn(0.20f, 1.35f),
        uiChimeBrightness = obj.optDouble("uiChimeBrightness", 0.65).toFloat().coerceIn(0.20f, 1.25f),
        promptUsed = obj.optString("promptUsed", "Tactical Standard SFX").ifBlank { "Tactical Standard SFX" }.take(120),
      )
    }

    fun synthesizeFromPrompt(rawPrompt: String, variationSalt: Int = 0): SfxForgeRecipe {
      val cleaned = rawPrompt.trim()
      if (cleaned.isEmpty()) return SfxForgeRecipe()
      val lower = cleaned.lowercase(Locale.US)
      val hash = abs((lower + "#$variationSalt").hashCode())
      fun hasAny(vararg w: String): Boolean = w.any { lower.contains(it) }

      val pitch =
        when {
          hasAny("heavy", "deep", "cannon", "bass", "sub", "railgun", "thump", "low") -> 0.72f
          hasAny("chirp", "high", "needle", "crystal", "arcade", "8-bit", "8bit", "sharp", "crisp") -> 1.34f
          hasAny("stealth", "silenced", "soft", "muted", "suppressed") -> 0.86f
          else -> 0.92f + (hash % 25) * 0.01f
        }

      val drive =
        when {
          hasAny("gritty", "overdrive", "acid", "industrial", "distorted", "plasma", "heavy", "8-bit") -> 0.82f
          hasAny("clean", "pure", "glass", "crystal", "stealth", "soft") -> 0.24f
          else -> 0.48f
        }

      val subBass =
        when {
          hasAny("seismic", "sub", "bass", "boom", "heavy", "nuclear", "cinematic", "cannon") -> 1.25f
          hasAny("light", "arcade", "minimal", "stealth", "crisp") -> 0.58f
          else -> 0.88f
        }

      val crunch =
        when {
          hasAny("crunch", "debris", "shrapnel", "metallic", "industrial", "gritty") -> 0.78f
          hasAny("smooth", "clean", "sub", "pure", "soft") -> 0.18f
          else -> 0.38f
        }

      val shieldRes =
        when {
          hasAny("resonant", "quantum", "phase", "ripple", "magnetic", "sci-fi", "glass", "crystal") -> 1.15f
          hasAny("tight", "dry", "minimal", "stealth") -> 0.42f
          else -> 0.74f
        }

      val chime =
        when {
          hasAny("bright", "sparkle", "crystal", "bell", "chime", "arcade", "gold") -> 1.08f
          hasAny("dark", "warm", "deep", "stealth", "muted") -> 0.42f
          else -> 0.68f
        }

      return SfxForgeRecipe(
        laserPitchMultiplier = pitch.coerceIn(0.55f, 1.75f),
        laserHarmonicDrive = drive.coerceIn(0.10f, 1.00f),
        explosionSubBass = subBass.coerceIn(0.25f, 1.40f),
        explosionDebrisCrunch = crunch.coerceIn(0.05f, 1.00f),
        shieldRippleResonance = shieldRes.coerceIn(0.20f, 1.35f),
        uiChimeBrightness = chime.coerceIn(0.20f, 1.25f),
        promptUsed = cleaned.take(120),
      )
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Zero-Latency Procedural Space Audio Synthesizer + Real-Time 60–180 BPM Battle Soundtrack
 * with 3 persistent Track Slots (`Track A`, `Track B`, `Track C`) and live procedural SFX forging.
 */
class RiftSoundSynthesizer(
  cacheDir: File = File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir") ?: "/data/local/tmp"),
) {
  private val sfxCacheDir: File = cacheDir
  private val sampleRate = 22050
  private val soundPool: SoundPool

  @Volatile var enabled: Boolean = true
  var soundEnabled: Boolean
    get() = enabled
    set(value) {
      enabled = value
    }

  @Volatile var musicEnabled: Boolean = true
  @Volatile var sfxVolume: Float = 0.85f
  @Volatile var musicVolume: Float = 0.70f
  @Volatile var musicBpm: Int = 128
  @Volatile var dynamicEscalationTargetBpm: Float = -1f
  @Volatile var liveEffectiveMusicBpm: Float = 128f
  @Volatile
  var currentMusicRecipe: MusicForgeRecipe =
    trackSlots.getOrNull(activeTrackSlotIndex)
      ?: buildArchetypeRecipe(MusicSynthArchetype.DARK_SYNTHWAVE, 128)

  fun setDynamicEscalationTargetBpm(targetBpm: Float?) {
    dynamicEscalationTargetBpm = targetBpm?.coerceIn(60f, 180f) ?: -1f
  }

  val musicTrackSlots: SnapshotStateList<MusicForgeRecipe>
    get() = trackSlots

  var currentTrackSlot: Int
    get() = activeTrackSlotIndex
    set(value) {
      selectTrackSlot(value)
    }

  var currentSfxRecipe: SfxForgeRecipe
    get() = sharedSfxRecipe
    set(value) {
      applySfxRecipe(value)
    }

  @Volatile private var appForegroundFlag: Boolean = true
  val isAppForeground: Boolean
    get() = appForegroundFlag

  @Volatile private var activeAudioTrack: AudioTrack? = null
  @Volatile private var isReleased: Boolean = false
  private val sfxBakeLock = Any()
  private val sfxBakeExecutor =
    Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor { runnable ->
      Thread(runnable, "RiftSfxBaker").apply {
        isDaemon = true
        priority = (Thread.NORM_PRIORITY - 1).coerceAtLeast(Thread.MIN_PRIORITY)
      }
    }
  private var ambientMusicThread: Thread? = null
  private var sfxBakeGeneration: Int = 0

  @Volatile private var sfxLaser: Int = 0
  @Volatile private var sfxBomb: Int = 0
  @Volatile private var sfxExplosion: Int = 0
  @Volatile private var sfxPrize: Int = 0
  @Volatile private var sfxPortal: Int = 0
  @Volatile private var sfxRepel: Int = 0
  @Volatile private var sfxWarp: Int = 0
  @Volatile private var sfxThor: Int = 0
  @Volatile private var sfxShotgun: Int = 0
  @Volatile private var sfxMissileBeep: Int = 0
  @Volatile private var sfxMutedClick: Int = 0
  @Volatile private var sfxBounce: Int = 0

  init {
    appForegroundFlag = globalForegroundState
    val attrs =
      AudioAttributes.Builder()
        .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_GAME)
        .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
        .build()
    soundPool = SoundPool.Builder().setMaxStreams(12).setAudioAttributes(attrs).build()
    if (!appForegroundFlag) {
      runCatching { soundPool.autoPause() }
    }

    musicBpm = currentMusicRecipe.bpm.coerceIn(60, 180)
    liveEffectiveMusicBpm = musicBpm.toFloat()
    scheduleBakeAllSfxBuffers(sharedSfxRecipe)

    val superseded = activeInstance
    if (superseded != null && superseded !== this) {
      runCatching { superseded.release() }
    }
    activeInstance = this
    startAmbientMusicLoop()
  }

  fun setAppForeground(foreground: Boolean) {
    appForegroundFlag = foreground
    runCatching {
      if (!foreground) {
        soundPool.autoPause()
        activeAudioTrack?.let { tr ->
          if (tr.playState == AudioTrack.PLAYSTATE_PLAYING) {
            tr.pause()
            tr.flush()
          }
        }
      } else if (!isReleased) {
        soundPool.autoResume()
        if (musicEnabled && musicVolume > 0.001f) {
          activeAudioTrack?.let { tr ->
            if (tr.playState != AudioTrack.PLAYSTATE_PLAYING) {
              tr.play()
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private fun scheduleBakeAllSfxBuffers(recipe: SfxForgeRecipe) {
    if (isReleased) return
    runCatching {
      sfxBakeExecutor.execute {
        if (!isReleased) {
          synchronized(sfxBakeLock) {
            if (!isReleased) {
              runCatching { bakeAllSfxBuffers(recipe) }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private fun bakeAllSfxBuffers(recipe: SfxForgeRecipe) {
    if (isReleased) return
    val gen = ++sfxBakeGeneration
    val pitch = recipe.laserPitchMultiplier.coerceIn(0.55f, 1.75f).toDouble()
    val drive = recipe.laserHarmonicDrive.coerceIn(0.10f, 1.00f).toDouble()
    val subBass = recipe.explosionSubBass.coerceIn(0.25f, 1.40f).toDouble()
    val crunch = recipe.explosionDebrisCrunch.coerceIn(0.05f, 1.00f).toDouble()
    val ripple = recipe.shieldRippleResonance.coerceIn(0.20f, 1.35f).toDouble()
    val chimeBright = recipe.uiChimeBrightness.coerceIn(0.20f, 1.25f).toDouble()

    val oldIds =
      intArrayOf(
        sfxLaser,
        sfxBomb,
        sfxExplosion,
        sfxPrize,
        sfxPortal,
        sfxRepel,
        sfxWarp,
        sfxThor,
        sfxShotgun,
        sfxMissileBeep,
        sfxMutedClick,
        sfxBounce,
      )

    sfxLaser =
      loadWav(
        sfxCacheDir,
        "sfx_laser_$gen.wav",
        synthSweep(
          fStart = 980.0 * pitch,
          fEnd = 220.0 * pitch,
          durationSec = 0.085,
          amp = 0.45,

          harmonicDrive = drive,
        ),
      )
    sfxBomb =
      loadWav(

        synthSweep(

          fEnd = 62.0 / subBass.coerceIn(0.6, 1.35),
          durationSec = 0.24,
          amp = 0.78,
          addNoise = (0.20 + crunch * 0.25).coerceIn(0.05, 0.55),
          harmonicDrive = drive * 0.8,
        ),
      )
    sfxExplosion =
      loadWav(
        sfxCacheDir,
        "sfx_exp_$gen.wav",
        synthExplosionBurst(
          durationSec = 0.38,
          amp = 0.88,
          subBass = subBass,
          debrisCrunch = crunch,
        ),
      )
    sfxPrize =
      loadWav(
        sfxCacheDir,
        "sfx_prize_$gen.wav",
        synthArpeggio(
          notes =
            doubleArrayOf(
              523.25 * (0.85 + chimeBright * 0.22),
              659.25 * (0.85 + chimeBright * 0.22),
              783.99 * (0.85 + chimeBright * 0.22),
              1046.5 * (0.85 + chimeBright * 0.22),
            ),
          durationSec = 0.16,
          amp = 0.52,
          brightness = chimeBright,
        ),
      )
    sfxPortal =
      loadWav(

        synthSweep(
          fStart = 240.0 * ripple.coerceIn(0.65, 1.3),
          fEnd = 880.0 * ripple.coerceIn(0.65, 1.3),

          harmonicDrive = ripple * 0.45,
        ),
      )
    sfxRepel =
      loadWav(
        sfxCacheDir,
        "sfx_repel_$gen.wav",
        synthSweep(
          fStart = 150.0,
          fEnd = 740.0 * ripple.coerceIn(0.65, 1.35),
          durationSec = 0.25,
          amp = 0.74,
          addNoise = 0.16,
          harmonicDrive = ripple * 0.55,
        ),
      )
    sfxWarp =
      loadWav(
        sfxCacheDir,
        "sfx_warp_$gen.wav",
        synthSweep(660.0 * ripple.coerceIn(0.7, 1.25), 180.0, 0.20, 0.55),
      )
    sfxThor =
      loadWav(
        sfxCacheDir,
        "sfx_thor_$gen.wav",
        synthSweep(
          fStart = 140.0,
          fEnd = 42.0 / subBass.coerceIn(0.7, 1.3),
          durationSec = 0.34,
          amp = 0.90,
          addNoise = (0.28 + crunch * 0.30).coerceIn(0.1, 0.65),
          harmonicDrive = drive,
        ),
      )
    sfxShotgun =
      loadWav(
        sfxCacheDir,
        "sfx_shotgun_$gen.wav",
        synthSweep(
          fStart = 420.0 * pitch.coerceIn(0.75, 1.35),
          fEnd = 95.0,
          durationSec = 0.14,
          amp = 0.75,
          addNoise = (0.38 + crunch * 0.30).coerceIn(0.15, 0.72),
          harmonicDrive = drive,
        ),
      )
    sfxMissileBeep =
      loadWav(
        sfxCacheDir,
        "sfx_lock_beep_$gen.wav",
        synthArpeggio(
          notes = doubleArrayOf(1320.0 * (0.85 + chimeBright * 0.2), 1760.0 * (0.85 + chimeBright * 0.2)),
          durationSec = 0.11,
          amp = 0.55,
          brightness = chimeBright,
        ),
      )
    sfxMutedClick =
      loadWav(sfxCacheDir, "sfx_muted_click_$gen.wav", synthSweep(190.0, 110.0, 0.055, 0.38))
    sfxBounce =
      loadWav(
        sfxCacheDir,
        "sfx_bounce_$gen.wav",
        synthSweep(360.0 * ripple.coerceIn(0.75, 1.25), 580.0 * ripple.coerceIn(0.75, 1.25), 0.065, 0.48),
      )

    for (oldId in oldIds) {
      if (oldId > 0) {
        try {
          soundPool.unload(oldId)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}
      }
    }
    // Clean up older cached wav generations quietly
    if (gen > 1) {
      val prev = gen - 1
      val prefixes =
        arrayOf(
          "sfx_laser_",
          "sfx_bomb_",
          "sfx_exp_",
          "sfx_prize_",
          "sfx_portal_",
          "sfx_repel_",
          "sfx_warp_",
          "sfx_thor_",
          "sfx_shotgun_",
          "sfx_lock_beep_",
          "sfx_muted_click_",
          "sfx_bounce_",
        )
      for (p in prefixes) {
        try {
          File(sfxCacheDir, "$p$prev.wav").delete()
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}
      }
    }

  @JvmName("updateMusicEnabled")
  fun setMusicEnabled(enabledState: Boolean) {
    musicEnabled = enabledState
  }

  fun setMusicBpmLive(bpm: Int) {
    val clamped = bpm.coerceIn(60, 180)
    musicBpm = clamped
    val prev = currentMusicRecipe
    val baseTitle = prev.customPromptSummary.substringBefore("•").trim().ifEmpty { prev.archetype.label }
    val drumSuffix = if (!prev.drumsEnabled && !baseTitle.contains("Pad", ignoreCase = true)) " (No Drums)" else ""
    val updated =
      prev.copy(
        bpm = clamped,
        customPromptSummary = "$baseTitle • $clamped BPM$drumSuffix",
      )
    currentMusicRecipe = updated
    val slotIdx = activeTrackSlotIndex.coerceIn(0, 2)
    if (slotIdx in trackSlots.indices) {
      trackSlots[slotIdx] = updated
    }
  }

  fun setMusicVolumeLive(vol: Float) {
    musicVolume = vol.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
  }

  fun setSfxVolumeLive(vol: Float) {
    sfxVolume = vol.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
  }

  /**
   * Switches active playback instantaneously between Track A (`0`), Track B (`1`), and Track C (`2`).
   */
  fun selectTrackSlot(index: Int): MusicForgeRecipe {
    val clampedIdx = index.coerceIn(0, 2)
    activeTrackSlotIndex = clampedIdx
    val slotRecipe =
      trackSlots.getOrNull(clampedIdx)
        ?: buildArchetypeRecipe(MusicSynthArchetype.DARK_SYNTHWAVE, 128)
    musicBpm = slotRecipe.bpm.coerceIn(60, 180)
    currentMusicRecipe = slotRecipe
    return slotRecipe
  }

  /**
   * Saves the active procedural soundtrack recipe into `Track A` (`0`), `Track B` (`1`), or `Track C` (`2`).
   */
  fun saveCurrentMusicToSlot(
    index: Int = activeTrackSlotIndex,
    customTitle: String? = null,
  ): MusicForgeRecipe {
    val clampedIdx = index.coerceIn(0, 2)
    val slotPrefix = "Track ${'A' + clampedIdx}"
    val base = currentMusicRecipe
    val summary =
      if (!customTitle.isNullOrBlank()) {
        "$slotPrefix: ${customTitle.trim()} • ${base.bpm} BPM"
      } else if (base.customPromptSummary.startsWith("Track ")) {
        "$slotPrefix: ${base.customPromptSummary.substringAfter(":", base.customPromptSummary).trim()}"
      } else {
        "$slotPrefix: ${base.customPromptSummary}"
      }
    val saved = base.copy(customPromptSummary = summary.take(120))
    while (trackSlots.size < 3) {
      trackSlots.add(buildDefaultTrackSlots()[trackSlots.size])
    }
    trackSlots[clampedIdx] = saved
    activeTrackSlotIndex = clampedIdx
    currentMusicRecipe = saved
    return saved
  }

  fun applyMusicArchetype(
    archetype: MusicSynthArchetype,
    overrideBpm: Int? = null,
  ): MusicForgeRecipe {
    val targetBpm = (overrideBpm ?: archetype.defaultBpm).coerceIn(60, 180)
    val recipe = buildArchetypeRecipe(archetype, targetBpm)
    musicBpm = targetBpm
    currentMusicRecipe = recipe
    val slotIdx = activeTrackSlotIndex.coerceIn(0, 2)
    if (slotIdx in trackSlots.indices) {
      val slotPrefix = "Track ${'A' + slotIdx}"
      trackSlots[slotIdx] = recipe.copy(customPromptSummary = "$slotPrefix: ${recipe.customPromptSummary}")
    }
    return recipe
  }

  fun synthesizeMusicFromPrompt(
    prompt: String,
    currentBpm: Int? = null,
    saveToActiveSlot: Boolean = true,
  ): MusicForgeRecipe {
    val forged = forgeMusicFromPrompt(prompt, currentBpm)
    if (saveToActiveSlot) {
      return saveCurrentMusicToSlot(activeTrackSlotIndex)
    }
    return forged
  }

  /**
   * 100% On-Device Deterministic Prompt-to-Synth Forge (Zero External AI / Zero Network Calls).
   * Parses plain-English tempo, scale, waveform, arpeggio, root key, and percussion descriptors
   * and updates the live PCM synthesizer within <50ms.
   */
  fun forgeMusicFromPrompt(
    prompt: String,
    currentBpm: Int? = null,
  ): MusicForgeRecipe {
    val cleaned = prompt.trim()
    if (cleaned.isEmpty()) {
      return applyMusicArchetype(currentMusicRecipe.archetype, currentBpm)
    }
    val lower = cleaned.lowercase(Locale.US)
    val hashSalt = abs(lower.hashCode())

    // 1. Archetype & Scale / Mood Classification
    val isIndustrial =
      containsAnyKeyword(lower, "dark", "aggressive", "industrial", "evil", "metal", "acid", "gritty", "cyber", "cyberpunk")
    val isCosmic =
      containsAnyKeyword(lower, "dreamy", "cosmic", "ethereal", "nebula", "float", "floating", "pad", "calm", "chill", "ambient", "zero-g")
    val isRetro =
      containsAnyKeyword(lower, "retro", "8-bit", "8bit", "arcade", "chip", "chiptune", "pixel", "nes", "gameboy")
    val isHeroic =
      containsAnyKeyword(lower, "heroic", "epic", "anthem", "triumph", "glory", "uplifting", "soaring")
    val isOverdrive =
      containsAnyKeyword(lower, "hyper", "overdrive", "singularity", "boss", "polyrhythm", "bell", "quantum", "chaos")

    val resolvedArchetype =
      when {
        isRetro -> MusicSynthArchetype.RETRO_CHIPTUNE
        isCosmic && !isIndustrial && !isOverdrive -> MusicSynthArchetype.COSMIC_AMBIENT
        isOverdrive -> MusicSynthArchetype.SINGULARITY_OVERDRIVE
        isIndustrial -> MusicSynthArchetype.CYBER_INDUSTRIAL
        else -> MusicSynthArchetype.DARK_SYNTHWAVE
      }

    val scaleIntervals: IntArray
    val moodDescriptor: String
    when {
      isIndustrial -> {
        scaleIntervals = intArrayOf(0, 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10) // Phrygian
        moodDescriptor = if (lower.contains("acid")) "Phrygian Acid" else "Industrial Phrygian"
      }
      isCosmic && !isOverdrive -> {
        scaleIntervals = intArrayOf(0, 2, 4, 6, 7, 9, 11) // Lydian
        moodDescriptor = "Cosmic Lydian"
      }
      isHeroic -> {
        scaleIntervals = intArrayOf(0, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 10) // Dorian
        moodDescriptor = "Heroic Dorian"
      }
      isOverdrive -> {
        scaleIntervals = intArrayOf(0, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 11) // Harmonic Minor
        moodDescriptor = "Singularity Harmonic"
      }
      isRetro -> {
        scaleIntervals = intArrayOf(0, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 10) // Arcade Dorian Minor
        moodDescriptor = "8-Bit Arcade"
      }
      else -> {
        scaleIntervals = intArrayOf(0, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10) // Natural Minor
        moodDescriptor = "Neon Synthwave"
      }
    }

    // 2. Tempo / BPM Extraction (60..180 BPM)
    val explicitBpmMatch =
      Regex("\\b(6[0-9]|[7-9][0-9]|1[0-7][0-9]|180)\\s*(?:bpm)?\\b").find(lower)
    val explicitBpm = explicitBpmMatch?.groupValues?.getOrNull(1)?.toIntOrNull()

    val resolvedBpm =
      when {
        explicitBpm != null -> explicitBpm.coerceIn(60, 180)
        containsAnyKeyword(lower, "fast", "intense", "hyper", "overdrive", "boss", "frantic", "rave", "speed", "rapid") ->
          148 + (hashSalt % 18)
        containsAnyKeyword(lower, "slow", "calm", "chill", "ambient", "space", "float", "drift", "meditative", "downtempo", "zero-g") ->
          76 + (hashSalt % 17)
        containsAnyKeyword(lower, "mid", "steady", "groove", "cruise") ->
          110 + (hashSalt % 15)
        currentBpm != null -> currentBpm.coerceIn(60, 180)
        else -> resolvedArchetype.defaultBpm
      }

    // 3. Lead Waveform Selection (0=DetunedSaw, 1=PulseSquare, 2=WarmSinePad, 3=FmBell)
    val leadWaveform =
      when {
        containsAnyKeyword(lower, "bell", "fm", "crystal", "glass", "chime") -> 3
        isRetro || containsAnyKeyword(lower, "square", "pulse", "chip", "8-bit", "8bit") -> 1
        (isCosmic && !isIndustrial) || containsAnyKeyword(lower, "pad", "warm", "sine", "smooth", "soft") -> 2
        else -> 0
      }

    val waveLabel =
      when (leadWaveform) {
        1 -> "Pulse"
        2 -> "Pad"
        3 -> "FM Bell"
        else -> "Saw"
      }

    // 4. Arpeggio Pattern Selection (0=UpDown, 1=OctaveJump, 2=TripletRoll, 3=SparseAmbient)
    val arpPattern =
      when {
        containsAnyKeyword(lower, "sparse", "drone", "pad only", "minimal", "float") -> 3
        containsAnyKeyword(lower, "triplet", "poly", "polyrhythm", "swirl", "spiral", "boss") || isOverdrive -> 2
        containsAnyKeyword(lower, "octave", "acid", "bounce", "arcade", "8-bit", "chip") || isRetro -> 1
        else -> 0
      }

    // 5. Drums & Bass Drive Selection
    val disableDrums =
      containsAnyKeyword(lower, "no drums", "no drum", "pad only", "beatless", "drumless", "no beat", "ambient") &&
        !containsAnyKeyword(lower, "with drums", "heavy drums")
    val heavyDrums =
      containsAnyKeyword(lower, "heavy drums", "techno", "percussion", "kick", "drums", "industrial", "hard")

    val drumsEnabled =
      when {
        disableDrums -> false
        heavyDrums -> true
        resolvedArchetype == MusicSynthArchetype.COSMIC_AMBIENT -> false
        else -> true
      }

    val bassDrive =
      when {
        heavyDrums || isIndustrial || lower.contains("acid") || lower.contains("bass") -> 1.0f
        !drumsEnabled -> 0.52f
        isOverdrive -> 0.92f
        else -> 0.80f
      }

    val brightness =
      when {
        containsAnyKeyword(lower, "bright", "neon", "laser", "acid", "arcade", "bell") -> 0.88f
        containsAnyKeyword(lower, "warm", "deep", "mellow", "sub", "dark") && !lower.contains("acid") -> 0.50f
        else -> 0.68f
      }

    // 6. Musical Root Note (C2=36 .. A2=45)
    val rootMidiNote =
      when {
        Regex("\\bc#\\b|\\bdb\\b").containsMatchIn(lower) -> 37
        Regex("\\bc\\b").containsMatchIn(lower) -> 36
        Regex("\\bd#\\b|\\beb\\b").containsMatchIn(lower) -> 39
        Regex("\\be\\b").containsMatchIn(lower) -> 40
        Regex("\\bf#\\b|\\bgb\\b").containsMatchIn(lower) -> 42
        Regex("\\bf\\b").containsMatchIn(lower) -> 41
        Regex("\\bg\\b").containsMatchIn(lower) -> 43
        Regex("\\ba\\b").containsMatchIn(lower) -> 45
        else -> intArrayOf(36, 38, 40, 41, 43, 45)[hashSalt % 6]
      }

    val drumNote = if (!drumsEnabled) " (No Drums)" else ""
    val summary = "Forged: $moodDescriptor $waveLabel • $resolvedBpm BPM$drumNote"

    val recipe =
      MusicForgeRecipe(
        archetype = resolvedArchetype,
        bpm = resolvedBpm,
        rootMidiNote = rootMidiNote,
        scaleIntervals = scaleIntervals,
        leadWaveform = leadWaveform,
        arpPattern = arpPattern,
        drumsEnabled = drumsEnabled,
        bassDrive = bassDrive,
        brightness = brightness,
        customPromptSummary = summary,
      )

    musicBpm = resolvedBpm
    currentMusicRecipe = recipe
    val slotIdx = activeTrackSlotIndex.coerceIn(0, 2)
    if (slotIdx in trackSlots.indices) {
      val slotPrefix = "Track ${'A' + slotIdx}"
      trackSlots[slotIdx] = recipe.copy(customPromptSummary = "$slotPrefix: $moodDescriptor $waveLabel • $resolvedBpm BPM$drumNote")
    }
    return recipe
  }

  /**
   * Applies a `SfxForgeRecipe` and immediately re-synthesizes all procedural combat WAV buffers on-device.
   */
  fun applySfxRecipe(recipe: SfxForgeRecipe) {
    sharedSfxRecipe = recipe
    if (!isReleased) {
      scheduleBakeAllSfxBuffers(recipe)
    }
  }

  fun synthesizeSfxFromPrompt(rawPrompt: String, variationSalt: Int = 0): SfxForgeRecipe {
    val forged = SfxForgeRecipe.synthesizeFromPrompt(rawPrompt, variationSalt)
    applySfxRecipe(forged)
    return forged
  }

  fun exportAudioForgeObject(): JSONObject = exportAudioForgeJson()

  private fun startAmbientMusicLoop() {
    val musicSampleRate = 22050
    val chunkSamples = 1024
    val minBuf =
      AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(
        musicSampleRate,
        AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO,
        AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT,
      ).coerceAtLeast(chunkSamples * 4)

    ambientMusicThread =
      Thread(
        {
          var track: AudioTrack? = null
          try {
            val musicAttrs =
              AudioAttributes.Builder()
                .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_GAME)
                .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC)
                .build()
            val format =
              AudioFormat.Builder()
                .setSampleRate(musicSampleRate)
                .setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)
                .setChannelMask(AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO)
                .build()
            track =
              AudioTrack.Builder()
                .setAudioAttributes(musicAttrs)
                .setAudioFormat(format)
                .setBufferSizeInBytes(minBuf)
                .setTransferMode(AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM)
                .build()
            activeAudioTrack = track
            if (isAppForeground && musicEnabled) {
              track.play()
            }

            val progressionScaleIndices = intArrayOf(0, 5, 3, 4)
            val upDownDegrees = intArrayOf(0, 2, 4, 7, 4, 2, 0, 4)
            val octaveJumpDegrees = intArrayOf(0, 7, 2, 9, 4, 11, 2, 7)
            val tripletDegrees = intArrayOf(0, 2, 4, 6, 4, 2)
            val sparseDegrees = intArrayOf(0, 4, 7, 9)

            val pcmChunk = ShortArray(chunkSamples)
            var sampleInSixteenth = 0
            var sixteenthStepCounter = 0L
            var globalSampleCounter = 0L

            var phaseBassA = 0.0
            var phaseBassB = 0.0
            var phasePad1 = 0.0
            var phasePad2 = 0.0
            var phaseLeadA = 0.0
            var phaseLeadB = 0.0
            var phaseKick = 0.0
            var hatFilterState = 0.0
            var smoothedGain = musicVolume.toDouble()

            val twoPi = 2.0 * PI
            val invRate = 1.0 / musicSampleRate.toDouble()
            val chunkDurationNs = (chunkSamples * 1_000_000_000L) / musicSampleRate
            val maxAheadBufferNs = chunkDurationNs * 6L
            var virtualPlaybackHeadNs = System.nanoTime()

            while (!isReleased) {
              if (!isAppForeground) {
                if (track.playState == AudioTrack.PLAYSTATE_PLAYING) {
                  runCatching {
                    track.pause()
                    track.flush()
                  }
                }
                Thread.sleep(60L)
                virtualPlaybackHeadNs = System.nanoTime()
                continue
              }
              val volTarget = musicVolume.coerceIn(0f, 1f).toDouble()
              if (!musicEnabled || volTarget <= 0.001) {
                if (track.playState == AudioTrack.PLAYSTATE_PLAYING) {
                  runCatching {
                    track.pause()
                    track.flush()
                  }
                }
                Thread.sleep(50L)
                virtualPlaybackHeadNs = System.nanoTime()
                continue
              }

              val recipe = currentMusicRecipe
              val baseBpm = musicBpm.coerceIn(60, 180).toFloat()
              val desiredBpm =
                if (dynamicEscalationTargetBpm >= 60f) {
                  dynamicEscalationTargetBpm.coerceIn(60f, 180f)
                } else {
                  baseBpm
                }
              val chunkSec = (chunkSamples.toFloat() / musicSampleRate.toFloat()).coerceAtLeast(0.005f)
              val maxStepBpm = 24f * chunkSec
              val deltaBpm = desiredBpm - liveEffectiveMusicBpm
              liveEffectiveMusicBpm =
                if (kotlin.math.abs(deltaBpm) <= maxStepBpm) {
                  desiredBpm
                } else {
                  liveEffectiveMusicBpm + kotlin.math.sign(deltaBpm) * maxStepBpm
                }
              val liveBpm = liveEffectiveMusicBpm.coerceIn(60f, 180f).toDouble()
              val samplesPerSixteenth =
                (musicSampleRate * 60.0 / (liveBpm * 4.0)).toInt().coerceAtLeast(64)
              val scale =
                if (recipe.scaleIntervals.isNotEmpty()) recipe.scaleIntervals
                else intArrayOf(0, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10)
              val bassDrive = recipe.bassDrive.coerceIn(0.2f, 1.2f).toDouble()
              val bright = recipe.brightness.coerceIn(0.2f, 1.0f).toDouble()

              for (i in 0 until chunkSamples) {
                globalSampleCounter++
                smoothedGain += (volTarget - smoothedGain) * 0.004

                sampleInSixteenth++
                if (sampleInSixteenth >= samplesPerSixteenth) {
                  sampleInSixteenth = 0
                  sixteenthStepCounter++
                }
                val posIn16th =
                  (sampleInSixteenth.toDouble() / samplesPerSixteenth.toDouble()).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)

                val stepInBar = (sixteenthStepCounter % 16L).toInt()
                val chordBarIdx = ((sixteenthStepCounter / 16L) % 4L).toInt()
                val chordScaleDeg = progressionScaleIndices[chordBarIdx]

                val chordRootMidi = midiFromScaleDegree(recipe.rootMidiNote, scale, chordScaleDeg)
                val chordThirdMidi = midiFromScaleDegree(recipe.rootMidiNote + 12, scale, chordScaleDeg + 2)
                val chordFifthMidi = midiFromScaleDegree(recipe.rootMidiNote + 12, scale, chordScaleDeg + 4)

                val bassOctaveBoost =
                  if (recipe.drumsEnabled && (stepInBar % 4 == 2)) 12 else 0
                val bassHz = midiToHz(chordRootMidi + bassOctaveBoost)
                val padThirdHz = midiToHz(chordThirdMidi)
                val padFifthHz = midiToHz(chordFifthMidi)

                phaseBassA = (phaseBassA + twoPi * bassHz * invRate) % twoPi
                phaseBassB = (phaseBassB + twoPi * (bassHz * 0.5) * invRate) % twoPi
                val bassSaw = (phaseBassA / PI) - 1.0
                val bassGate =
                  if (recipe.drumsEnabled) {
                    (1.0 - posIn16th * 0.55).coerceIn(0.28, 1.0)
                  } else {
                    0.85
                  }
                val bassSample =
                  (0.58 * sin(phaseBassB) + 0.42 * sin(phaseBassA) + 0.34 * bassDrive * bassSaw) *
                    bassGate *
                    bassDrive

                val tSec = globalSampleCounter * invRate
                phasePad1 = (phasePad1 + twoPi * (padThirdHz * 1.003) * invRate) % twoPi
                phasePad2 = (phasePad2 + twoPi * (padFifthHz * 0.997) * invRate) % twoPi
                val padLfo = 0.65 + 0.35 * sin(twoPi * 0.25 * tSec)
                val padSample =
                  (0.48 * sin(phasePad1) + 0.38 * sin(phasePad2) + 0.18 * bright * sin(phasePad1 * 2.0)) *
                    padLfo

                val arpDegOffset: Int
                val arpTriggerActive: Boolean
                when (recipe.arpPattern) {
                  1 -> {
                    arpDegOffset = octaveJumpDegrees[(sixteenthStepCounter % octaveJumpDegrees.size).toInt()]
                    arpTriggerActive = true
                  }
                  2 -> {
                    arpDegOffset = tripletDegrees[(sixteenthStepCounter % tripletDegrees.size).toInt()]
                    arpTriggerActive = true
                  }
                  3 -> {
                    arpDegOffset = sparseDegrees[((sixteenthStepCounter / 4L) % sparseDegrees.size).toInt()]
                    arpTriggerActive = (stepInBar % 4 == 0)
                  }
                  else -> {
                    arpDegOffset = upDownDegrees[(sixteenthStepCounter % upDownDegrees.size).toInt()]
                    arpTriggerActive = true
                  }
                }

                val arpMidi = midiFromScaleDegree(recipe.rootMidiNote + 24, scale, chordScaleDeg + arpDegOffset)
                val arpHz = midiToHz(arpMidi)
                phaseLeadA = (phaseLeadA + twoPi * arpHz * invRate) % twoPi
                phaseLeadB = (phaseLeadB + twoPi * (arpHz * 1.007) * invRate) % twoPi

                val arpEnv =
                  if (recipe.arpPattern == 3) {
                    if (arpTriggerActive) sin(posIn16th * PI).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0) * 0.75 else 0.22
                  } else {
                    val decayShape = (1.0 - posIn16th).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
                    decayShape * (0.35 + 0.65 * decayShape)
                  }

                val rawLeadWave =
                  when (recipe.leadWaveform) {
                    1 -> {
                      val sq1 = if (phaseLeadA < PI * 0.65) 0.75 else -0.75
                      val sq2 = if (phaseLeadB < PI) 0.25 else -0.25
                      sq1 + sq2
                    }
                    2 -> {
                      0.72 * sin(phaseLeadA) + 0.28 * bright * sin(phaseLeadB * 2.0)
                    }
                    3 -> {
                      val modIndex = 1.65 * bright * arpEnv
                      sin(phaseLeadA + modIndex * sin(phaseLeadA * 2.0))
                    }
                    else -> {
                      val sawA = (phaseLeadA / PI) - 1.0
                      val sawB = (phaseLeadB / PI) - 1.0
                      0.45 * (sawA + sawB) * bright + 0.35 * sin(phaseLeadA)
                    }
                  }
                val leadSample = rawLeadWave * arpEnv

                var drumSample = 0.0
                if (recipe.drumsEnabled) {
                  val stepInBeat = stepInBar % 4
                  if (stepInBeat == 0) {
                    val kickEnv = (1.0 - posIn16th).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0).pow(2.2)
                    val kickFreq = 52.0 + 135.0 * (1.0 - posIn16th).pow(3.0)
                    phaseKick = (phaseKick + twoPi * kickFreq * invRate) % twoPi
                    drumSample += sin(phaseKick) * kickEnv * 0.95
                  } else if (stepInBeat == 2) {
                    val hatEnv = (1.0 - posIn16th).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0).pow(3.2)
                    val white = Random.nextDouble(-1.0, 1.0)
                    hatFilterState = hatFilterState * 0.35 + white * 0.65
                    val highPass = white - hatFilterState
                    drumSample += highPass * hatEnv * (0.38 + 0.22 * bright)
                  } else if (recipe.archetype == MusicSynthArchetype.SINGULARITY_OVERDRIVE && stepInBeat == 3) {
                    val ghostEnv = (1.0 - posIn16th).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0).pow(4.0)
                    val white = Random.nextDouble(-1.0, 1.0)
                    drumSample += white * ghostEnv * 0.22
                  }
                }

                val rawMix =
                  bassSample * 0.32 +
                    padSample * (if (recipe.drumsEnabled) 0.24 else 0.38) +
                    leadSample * 0.24 +
                    drumSample * 0.28
                val gained = (rawMix * 0.38 * smoothedGain).coerceIn(-0.98, 0.98)
                pcmChunk[i] = (gained * 32767.0).toInt().toShort()
              }

              if (!isAppForeground) {
                continue
              }
              if (track.playState != AudioTrack.PLAYSTATE_PLAYING) {
                runCatching { track.play() }
              }
              val written = track.write(pcmChunk, 0, chunkSamples)
              val nowNs = System.nanoTime()
              if (written <= 0) {
                Thread.sleep(45L)
                virtualPlaybackHeadNs = System.nanoTime()
              } else {
                if (virtualPlaybackHeadNs < nowNs) {
                  virtualPlaybackHeadNs = nowNs
                }
                virtualPlaybackHeadNs += chunkDurationNs
                val aheadNs = virtualPlaybackHeadNs - nowNs
                if (aheadNs > maxAheadBufferNs) {
                  val sleepMs = ((aheadNs - maxAheadBufferNs) / 1_000_000L).coerceIn(15L, 50L)
                  Thread.sleep(sleepMs)
                }
              }
            }
          } catch (_: Throwable) {
          } finally {
            if (activeAudioTrack === track) {
              activeAudioTrack = null
            }
            try {
              track?.stop()
            } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            try {
              track?.release()
            } catch (_: Throwable) {}
          }
        },
        "RiftAmbientBattleMusic",
      ).apply {
        isDaemon = true
        priority = Thread.MIN_PRIORITY + 1
        start()
      }
  }

  private fun playSfxScaled(soundId: Int, baseVol: Float, priority: Int, rate: Float = 1.0f) {
    if (!isAppForeground || isReleased) return
    val v = (baseVol * sfxVolume.coerceIn(0f, 1f)).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    if (enabled && v > 0.001f && soundId > 0) {
      soundPool.play(soundId, v, v, priority, 0, rate.coerceIn(0.5f, 2.0f))
    }
  }

  fun playLaser() {
    playSfxScaled(sfxLaser, 0.36f, 1, 1.0f + (Random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.08f)
  }

  fun playBomb() {

  fun release() {
    isReleased = true
    activeAudioTrack = null
    if (activeInstance === this) {
      activeInstance = null
    }
    try {
      sfxBakeExecutor.shutdownNow()
    } catch (_: Throwable) {}
    try {
      ambientMusicThread?.interrupt()
    } catch (_: Throwable) {}
    synchronized(sfxBakeLock) {
      runCatching { soundPool.release() }
    }
  }

  private fun synthSweep(
    fStart: Double,
    fEnd: Double,
    durationSec: Double,
    amp: Double,
    addNoise: Double = 0.0,
    harmonicDrive: Double = 0.0,
  ): ShortArray {
    val count = (sampleRate * durationSec).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
    val pcm = ShortArray(count)
    var phase = 0.0
    for (i in 0 until count) {
      val t = i.toDouble() / count
      val env = (1.0 - t).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
      val freq = (fStart + (fEnd - fStart) * t).coerceIn(28.0, 9500.0)
      phase += 2.0 * PI * freq / sampleRate
      val fundamental = sin(phase)
      val harmonic = if (harmonicDrive > 0.01) sin(phase * 2.0) * 0.38 * harmonicDrive else 0.0
      val tone = (fundamental + harmonic).coerceIn(-1.1, 1.1)
      val noise = if (addNoise > 0.0) (Random.nextDouble(-1.0, 1.0) * addNoise) else 0.0
      val sample = ((tone * (1.0 - addNoise * 0.65) + noise) * env * amp).coerceIn(-1.0, 1.0)
      pcm[i] = (sample * 32767.0).toInt().toShort()
    }
    return pcm
  }

  private fun synthExplosionBurst(
    durationSec: Double,
    amp: Double,
    subBass: Double = 0.85,
    debrisCrunch: Double = 0.35,
  ): ShortArray {
    val count = (sampleRate * durationSec).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
    val pcm = ShortArray(count)
    var lp = 0.0
    var subPhase = 0.0
    val filterAlpha = (0.20 + debrisCrunch * 0.38).coerceIn(0.12, 0.72)
    for (i in 0 until count) {
      val t = i.toDouble() / count
      val env = (1.0 - t) * (1.0 - t)
      val raw = Random.nextDouble(-1.0, 1.0)
      lp = lp * (1.0 - filterAlpha) + raw * filterAlpha
      val subFreq = 44.0 + 95.0 * (1.0 - t).pow(2.4)
      subPhase += 2.0 * PI * subFreq / sampleRate
      val subBoom = sin(subPhase) * (1.0 - t).pow(1.8) * 0.45 * subBass
      val sample = ((lp * 0.78 + subBoom) * env * amp).coerceIn(-1.0, 1.0)
      pcm[i] = (sample * 32767.0).toInt().toShort()
    }
    return pcm
  }

  private fun synthArpeggio(
    notes: DoubleArray,
    durationSec: Double,
    amp: Double,
    brightness: Double = 0.65,
  ): ShortArray {
    val count = (sampleRate * durationSec).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
    val pcm = ShortArray(count)
    var phase = 0.0
    for (i in 0 until count) {
      val t = i.toDouble() / count
      val idx = (t * notes.size).toInt().coerceIn(0, notes.lastIndex)
      val freq = notes[idx].coerceIn(80.0, 8800.0)
      val env = (1.0 - t * 0.6).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
      phase += 2.0 * PI * freq / sampleRate
      val shimmer = sin(phase * 2.0) * 0.25 * brightness.coerceIn(0.0, 1.25)
      val sample = ((sin(phase) * 0.85 + shimmer) * env * amp).coerceIn(-1.0, 1.0)
      pcm[i] = (sample * 32767.0).toInt().toShort()
    }
    return pcm
  }

  private fun loadWav(cacheDir: File, fileName: String, pcm: ShortArray): Int {
    if (!cacheDir.exists()) {
      cacheDir.mkdirs()
    }
    val file = File(cacheDir, fileName)
    val byteData = ByteBuffer.allocate(44 + pcm.size * 2).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
    val dataSize = pcm.size * 2
    byteData.put("RIFF".toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII))
    byteData.putInt(36 + dataSize)
    byteData.put("WAVE".toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII))
    byteData.put("fmt ".toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII))
    byteData.putInt(16)
    byteData.putShort(1)
    byteData.putShort(1)
    byteData.putInt(sampleRate)
    byteData.putInt(sampleRate * 2)
    byteData.putShort(2)
    byteData.putShort(16)
    byteData.put("data".toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII))
    byteData.putInt(dataSize)
    for (s in pcm) {
      byteData.putShort(s)
    }
    FileOutputStream(file).use { it.write(byteData.array()) }
    return soundPool.load(file.absolutePath, 1)
  }

  companion object {
    @Volatile var activeInstance: RiftSoundSynthesizer? = null
    @Volatile private var globalForegroundState: Boolean = true

    fun isAppCurrentlyForeground(): Boolean = globalForegroundState

    fun notifyAppForegroundState(foreground: Boolean) {
      globalForegroundState = foreground
      activeInstance?.setAppForeground(foreground)
    }

    private fun buildDefaultTrackSlots(): List<MusicForgeRecipe> =
      listOf(
        buildArchetypeRecipe(MusicSynthArchetype.DARK_SYNTHWAVE, 128)
          .copy(customPromptSummary = "Track A: Dark Cyber-Pulse • 128 BPM"),
        buildArchetypeRecipe(MusicSynthArchetype.COSMIC_AMBIENT, 96)
          .copy(customPromptSummary = "Track B: Zero-G Drift Pad • 96 BPM"),
        buildArchetypeRecipe(MusicSynthArchetype.SINGULARITY_OVERDRIVE, 148)
          .copy(customPromptSummary = "Track C: Singularity Acid • 148 BPM"),
      )

    val trackSlots: SnapshotStateList<MusicForgeRecipe> =
      mutableStateListOf<MusicForgeRecipe>().apply { addAll(buildDefaultTrackSlots()) }

    var activeTrackSlotIndex by mutableIntStateOf(0)
    var sharedSfxRecipe by mutableStateOf(SfxForgeRecipe())

    fun resetAudioForgeToDefaults() {
      val defaults = buildDefaultTrackSlots()
      trackSlots.clear()
      trackSlots.addAll(defaults)
      activeTrackSlotIndex = 0
      sharedSfxRecipe = SfxForgeRecipe()
      activeInstance?.let { inst ->
        inst.selectTrackSlot(0)
        inst.applySfxRecipe(sharedSfxRecipe)
      }
    }

    fun exportAudioForgeJson(): JSONObject {
      val slotsArr = JSONArray()
      for (i in 0 until 3) {
        val rec = trackSlots.getOrNull(i) ?: buildDefaultTrackSlots()[i]
        slotsArr.put(rec.toJson())
      }
      return JSONObject().apply {
        put("activeTrackSlotIndex", activeTrackSlotIndex.coerceIn(0, 2))
        put("trackSlots", slotsArr)
        put("sfxRecipe", sharedSfxRecipe.toJson())
      }
    }

    fun importAudioForgeJson(obj: JSONObject?) {
      if (obj == null) return
      val defaults = buildDefaultTrackSlots()
      val slotsArr = obj.optJSONArray("trackSlots")
      if (slotsArr != null && slotsArr.length() > 0) {
        val loaded =
          (0 until 3).map { idx ->
            val item = slotsArr.optJSONObject(idx)
            if (item != null) MusicForgeRecipe.fromJson(item) else defaults[idx]
          }
        trackSlots.clear()
        trackSlots.addAll(loaded)
      }
      val selIdx = obj.optInt("activeTrackSlotIndex", 0).coerceIn(0, 2)
      activeTrackSlotIndex = selIdx
      val sfxObj = obj.optJSONObject("sfxRecipe")
      val restoredSfx = SfxForgeRecipe.fromJson(sfxObj)
      sharedSfxRecipe = restoredSfx

      activeInstance?.let { inst ->
        inst.selectTrackSlot(selIdx)
        inst.applySfxRecipe(restoredSfx)
      }
    }

    private fun containsAnyKeyword(lowerText: String, vararg keywords: String): Boolean =
      keywords.any { lowerText.contains(it) }

    private fun midiToHz(midiNote: Int): Double =
      440.0 * 2.0.pow((midiNote - 69) / 12.0)

    private fun midiFromScaleDegree(baseMidi: Int, scaleIntervals: IntArray, degree: Int): Int {
      val len = scaleIntervals.size.coerceAtLeast(1)
      val octaves = Math.floorDiv(degree, len)
      val idx = Math.floorMod(degree, len)
      return (baseMidi + octaves * 12 + scaleIntervals[idx]).coerceIn(24, 96)
    }

    fun buildArchetypeRecipe(
      archetype: MusicSynthArchetype,
      bpm: Int = archetype.defaultBpm,
    ): MusicForgeRecipe {
      val clampedBpm = bpm.coerceIn(60, 180)
      return when (archetype) {
        MusicSynthArchetype.DARK_SYNTHWAVE ->
          MusicForgeRecipe(
            archetype = archetype,
            bpm = clampedBpm,
            rootMidiNote = 38, // D2
            scaleIntervals = intArrayOf(0, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10), // Natural Minor
            leadWaveform = 0, // DetunedSaw
            arpPattern = 0, // UpDown
            drumsEnabled = true,
            bassDrive = 0.80f,
            brightness = 0.68f,
            customPromptSummary = "${archetype.label} • $clampedBpm BPM",
          )

        MusicSynthArchetype.CYBER_INDUSTRIAL ->
          MusicForgeRecipe(
            archetype = archetype,
            bpm = clampedBpm,
            rootMidiNote = 40, // E2
            scaleIntervals = intArrayOf(0, 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10), // Phrygian
            leadWaveform = 0, // DetunedSaw
            arpPattern = 1, // OctaveJump
            drumsEnabled = true,
            bassDrive = 0.98f,
            brightness = 0.80f,
            customPromptSummary = "${archetype.label} • $clampedBpm BPM",
          )

        MusicSynthArchetype.COSMIC_AMBIENT ->
          MusicForgeRecipe(
            archetype = archetype,
            bpm = clampedBpm,
            rootMidiNote = 41, // F2
            scaleIntervals = intArrayOf(0, 2, 4, 6, 7, 9, 11), // Lydian
            leadWaveform = 2, // WarmSinePad
            arpPattern = 3, // SparseAmbient
            drumsEnabled = false,
            bassDrive = 0.52f,
            brightness = 0.48f,
            customPromptSummary = "${archetype.label} • $clampedBpm BPM",
          )

        MusicSynthArchetype.RETRO_CHIPTUNE ->
          MusicForgeRecipe(
            archetype = archetype,
            bpm = clampedBpm,
            rootMidiNote = 45, // A2
            scaleIntervals = intArrayOf(0, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 10), // Dorian Minor
            leadWaveform = 1, // PulseSquare
            arpPattern = 1, // OctaveJump
            drumsEnabled = true,
            bassDrive = 0.76f,
            brightness = 0.88f,
            customPromptSummary = "${archetype.label} • $clampedBpm BPM",
          )

        MusicSynthArchetype.SINGULARITY_OVERDRIVE ->
          MusicForgeRecipe(
            archetype = archetype,
            bpm = clampedBpm,
            rootMidiNote = 38, // D2
            scaleIntervals = intArrayOf(0, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 11), // Harmonic Minor
            leadWaveform = 3, // FmBell
            arpPattern = 2, // TripletRoll
            drumsEnabled = true,
            bassDrive = 0.94f,
            brightness = 0.86f,
            customPromptSummary = "${archetype.label} • $clampedBpm BPM",
          )
      }
    }
  }
}

   *    and 3 tiny orbital plasma spark nodes — 100% circular/helical energy, never a diamond.

  fun drawFluxPrismIcon(
    c: Canvas,
    cx: Float,
    cy: Float,

  ) {

    fun argbHex(baseAlpha: Int, red: Int, green: Int, blue: Int): Int =

    fun argbColor(baseAlpha: Int, colorInt: Int): Int =
      argbHex(baseAlpha, Color.red(colorInt), Color.green(colorInt), Color.blue(colorInt))

    val isDefaultRecipe = rec == null || rec.isFactoryDefault
    val scaledR = r * (rec?.pixelScale ?: 1f).coerceIn(0.65f, 1.50f)
    val glowMult = (rec?.glowIntensity ?: 1f).coerceIn(0f, 2f)
    val borderMult = (rec?.borderWeight ?: 1f).coerceIn(0.5f, 2.2f)

    val glowCol = if (isDefaultRecipe) Color.rgb(0, 245, 212) else rec!!.glowColorInt
    val skyCol = if (isDefaultRecipe) Color.rgb(56, 189, 248) else rec!!.trimColorInt
    val deepAzureCol =
      if (isDefaultRecipe) {
        Color.rgb(2, 132, 199)
      } else {
        Color.rgb(
          (Color.red(skyCol) * 0.45f + Color.red(rec!!.primaryColorInt) * 0.35f).toInt().coerceIn(0, 255),
          (Color.green(skyCol) * 0.58f + Color.green(rec.primaryColorInt) * 0.25f).toInt().coerceIn(0, 255),
          (Color.blue(skyCol) * 0.82f + Color.blue(rec.primaryColorInt) * 0.18f).toInt().coerceIn(0, 255),
        )
      }
    val containmentDiscCol =
      if (isDefaultRecipe) Color.rgb(4, 13, 26) else rec!!.primaryColorInt

    val fillPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { style = Paint.Style.FILL }
    val strokePaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
        strokeJoin = Paint.Join.ROUND
      }

    // 1. Soft outer radial plasma bloom
    if (glowMult > 0.05f) {
      val bloomR = scaledR * 1.16f
      fillPaint.shader =
        RadialGradient(
          cx,
          cy,
          bloomR.coerceAtLeast(1f),
          intArrayOf(
            argbColor((92 * glowMult).toInt().coerceIn(0, 220), glowCol),
            argbColor((42 * glowMult).toInt().coerceIn(0, 160), skyCol),
            argbColor(0, deepAzureCol),
          ),
          floatArrayOf(0f, 0.62f, 1f),
