 companion object {
  fun fromKey(rawKey: String?): ForgeElementTarget? {
   if (rawKey.isNullOrBlank()) return null
   val trimmed = rawKey.trim()
   return entries.firstOrNull { it.key.equals(trimmed, ignoreCase = true) || it.name.equals(trimmed, ignoreCase = true) }
  }
 }
}

data class VisualElementRecipe(
 val targetKey: String,
 val primaryHex: String = "#040914",
 val trimHex: String = "#38BDF8",
 val glowHex: String = "#00F5D4",
 val geometryStyle: Int = 0,
 val pixelScale: Float = 1.0f,
 val borderWeight: Float = 1.0f,
 val glowIntensity: Float = 1.0f,
 val surfaceOpacity: Float = 0.90f,
 val rimLightDepth: Float = 0.70f,
 val detailDensity: Float = 0.70f,
 val shaderTurbulence: Float = 0.75f,
 val promptUsed: String = "Factory Default",
) {
 val primaryColorInt: Int get() = parseHexColorSafe(primaryHex, 0xFF040914.toInt())
 val trimColorInt: Int get() = parseHexColorSafe(trimHex, 0xFF38BDF8.toInt())
 val glowColorInt: Int get() = parseHexColorSafe(glowHex, 0xFF00F5D4.toInt())

 val isFactoryDefault: Boolean
  get() {
   val target = ForgeElementTarget.fromKey(targetKey) ?: return false
   val def = defaultFor(target)
   return primaryHex.equals(def.primaryHex, ignoreCase = true) &&
    trimHex.equals(def.trimHex, ignoreCase = true) &&
    glowHex.equals(def.glowHex, ignoreCase = true) &&
    geometryStyle == def.geometryStyle &&
    abs(pixelScale - def.pixelScale) < 0.005f &&
    abs(borderWeight - def.borderWeight) < 0.005f &&
    abs(glowIntensity - def.glowIntensity) < 0.005f &&
    abs(surfaceOpacity - def.surfaceOpacity) < 0.005f &&
    abs(rimLightDepth - def.rimLightDepth) < 0.005f &&
    abs(detailDensity - def.detailDensity) < 0.005f &&
    abs(shaderTurbulence - def.shaderTurbulence) < 0.005f
  }

 fun toJson(): JSONObject = JSONObject().apply {
  put("targetKey", targetKey)
  put("primaryHex", normalizeHexString(primaryHex, "#040914"))
  put("trimHex", normalizeHexString(trimHex, "#38BDF8"))
  put("glowHex", normalizeHexString(glowHex, "#00F5D4"))
  put("geometryStyle", geometryStyle.coerceIn(0, 3))
  put("pixelScale", ((pixelScale.coerceIn(0.50f, 2.00f) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
  put("borderWeight", ((borderWeight.coerceIn(0.40f, 2.50f) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
  put("glowIntensity", ((glowIntensity.coerceIn(0.00f, 2.50f) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
  put("surfaceOpacity", ((surfaceOpacity.coerceIn(0.15f, 1.00f) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
  put("rimLightDepth", ((rimLightDepth.coerceIn(0.00f, 1.50f) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
  put("detailDensity", ((detailDensity.coerceIn(0.00f, 1.50f) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
  put("shaderTurbulence", ((shaderTurbulence.coerceIn(0.00f, 2.00f) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
  put("promptUsed", promptUsed.take(120))
 }

 companion object {
  fun parseHexColorSafe(hex: String?, fallback: Int): Int {
   if (hex.isNullOrBlank()) return fallback
   val cleaned = if (hex.trim().startsWith("#")) hex.trim() else "#${hex.trim()}"
   return try { Color.parseColor(cleaned) } catch (_: Exception) { fallback }
  }

  fun normalizeHexString(hex: String?, fallback: String): String {
   val parsed = parseHexColorSafe(hex, parseHexColorSafe(fallback, 0xFF38BDF8.toInt()))
   return String.format(Locale.US, "#%02X%02X%02X", Color.red(parsed), Color.green(parsed), Color.blue(parsed))
  }

  fun defaultFor(target: ForgeElementTarget): VisualElementRecipe {
   val k = target.key
   return when (target) {
    ForgeElementTarget.SAFE_ZONE_WALL -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#040914", "#38BDF8", "#00F5D4", surfaceOpacity = 0.92f, rimLightDepth = 0.75f, detailDensity = 0.70f)
    ForgeElementTarget.SAFE_ZONE_PAD -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#0F172A", "#38BDF8", "#00F5D4", surfaceOpacity = 0.96f, rimLightDepth = 0.85f, detailDensity = 0.80f)
    ForgeElementTarget.PLACED_STASIS_BARRIER -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#040914", "#38BDF8", "#00F5D4", surfaceOpacity = 0.94f, rimLightDepth = 0.80f, detailDensity = 0.75f)
    ForgeElementTarget.OBSTACLE_ORBITAL_STATION -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#040914", "#1E3A5F", "#00F5D4", surfaceOpacity = 0.98f, rimLightDepth = 0.80f, detailDensity = 0.75f)
    ForgeElementTarget.OBSTACLE_ASTEROID_STATION -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#060D1C", "#38BDF8", "#00F5D4", surfaceOpacity = 0.98f, rimLightDepth = 0.80f, detailDensity = 0.75f)
    ForgeElementTarget.OBSTACLE_SPACE_ASTEROID -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#040914", "#1E3A5F", "#00F5D4", surfaceOpacity = 0.98f, rimLightDepth = 0.82f, detailDensity = 0.75f)
    ForgeElementTarget.OBSTACLE_FLOATING_DEBRIS -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#040914", "#38BDF8", "#00F5D4", surfaceOpacity = 0.96f, rimLightDepth = 0.75f, detailDensity = 0.70f)
    ForgeElementTarget.ARENA_PERIMETER_RING -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#040914", "#38BDF8", "#00F5D4", surfaceOpacity = 0.90f, rimLightDepth = 0.70f, detailDensity = 0.70f)
    ForgeElementTarget.BACKGROUND_NEBULA -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#02050B", "#0E7490", "#312E81", surfaceOpacity = 0.88f, rimLightDepth = 0.60f, detailDensity = 0.70f)
    ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_PLASMA -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#EF4444", "#D946EF", "#FFE4E6", surfaceOpacity = 0.95f, rimLightDepth = 0.85f, detailDensity = 0.75f)
    ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_REPULSOR -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#38BDF8", "#BAE6FD", "#FFFFFF", surfaceOpacity = 0.95f, rimLightDepth = 0.85f, detailDensity = 0.75f)
    ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_GRAVITY -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#A855F7", "#6366F1", "#E9D5FF", surfaceOpacity = 0.95f, rimLightDepth = 0.85f, detailDensity = 0.75f)
    ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_PHASE_PAIR -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#2DD4BF", "#38BDF8", "#F0FDFA", surfaceOpacity = 0.95f, rimLightDepth = 0.85f, detailDensity = 0.75f)
    ForgeElementTarget.SUPPLY_CRATE -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#081120", "#10B981", "#00F5D4", surfaceOpacity = 0.94f, rimLightDepth = 0.80f, detailDensity = 0.75f)
    ForgeElementTarget.PROJECTILE_PRIMARY_BOLT -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#38BDF8", "#E0F2FE", "#00F5D4", surfaceOpacity = 0.96f, rimLightDepth = 0.75f, detailDensity = 0.70f)
    ForgeElementTarget.PROJECTILE_PROXIMITY_MINE -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#0B1324", "#F59E0B", "#EF4444", surfaceOpacity = 0.95f, rimLightDepth = 0.80f, detailDensity = 0.75f)
    ForgeElementTarget.ECLIPSE_STASIS_BUBBLE -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#3B0764", "#EC4899", "#00F5D4", surfaceOpacity = 0.78f, rimLightDepth = 0.80f, detailDensity = 0.75f)
    ForgeElementTarget.FLUX_CORE_ORB -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#F59E0B", "#FACC15", "#FEF08A", surfaceOpacity = 0.98f, rimLightDepth = 0.90f, detailDensity = 0.80f)
    ForgeElementTarget.STASIS_BRIG_JAIL -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#061020", "#38BDF8", "#EF4444", surfaceOpacity = 0.90f, rimLightDepth = 0.80f, detailDensity = 0.75f)
    ForgeElementTarget.SHIP_AURA_LABELS -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#06101E", "#38BDF8", "#00F5D4", surfaceOpacity = 0.90f, rimLightDepth = 0.70f, detailDensity = 0.70f)
    ForgeElementTarget.HUD_SECONDARY_BTN -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#0A1326", "#F59E0B", "#FBBF24", surfaceOpacity = 0.88f)
    ForgeElementTarget.HUD_SPECIAL_BUFF_BTN -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#081624", "#10B981", "#2DD4BF", surfaceOpacity = 0.88f)
    ForgeElementTarget.HUD_REPEL_BTN -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#071526", "#00F5D4", "#38BDF8", surfaceOpacity = 0.88f)
    ForgeElementTarget.HUD_MULTI_BTN -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#0A1424", "#FACC15", "#FDE047", surfaceOpacity = 0.88f)
    ForgeElementTarget.HUD_WARNING_BANNER -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#160912", "#EF4444", "#F59E0B", surfaceOpacity = 0.92f)
    ForgeElementTarget.CURRENCY_FLUX_ICON -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#0284C7", "#38BDF8", "#00F5D4", surfaceOpacity = 1.00f, rimLightDepth = 0.85f, detailDensity = 0.75f)
    ForgeElementTarget.CURRENCY_SHARD_ICON -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#9333EA", "#E879F9", "#00F5D4", surfaceOpacity = 1.00f, rimLightDepth = 0.88f, detailDensity = 0.80f)
    else -> VisualElementRecipe(k, "#071022", "#38BDF8", "#00F5D4", surfaceOpacity = 0.86f, rimLightDepth = 0.70f, detailDensity = 0.70f)
   }
  }

  fun fromJson(obj: JSONObject): VisualElementRecipe {
   val key = obj.optString("targetKey", ForgeElementTarget.SAFE_ZONE_WALL.key)
   val fallbackTarget = ForgeElementTarget.fromKey(key) ?: ForgeElementTarget.SAFE_ZONE_WALL
   val def = defaultFor(fallbackTarget)
   return VisualElementRecipe(
    targetKey = fallbackTarget.key,
    primaryHex = normalizeHexString(obj.optString("primaryHex", def.primaryHex), def.primaryHex),
    trimHex = normalizeHexString(obj.optString("trimHex", def.trimHex), def.trimHex),
    glowHex = normalizeHexString(obj.optString("glowHex", def.glowHex), def.glowHex),
    geometryStyle = obj.optInt("geometryStyle", def.geometryStyle).coerceIn(0, 3),
    pixelScale = obj.optDouble("pixelScale", def.pixelScale.toDouble()).toFloat().coerceIn(0.50f, 2.00f),
    borderWeight = obj.optDouble("borderWeight", def.borderWeight.toDouble()).toFloat().coerceIn(0.40f, 2.50f),
    glowIntensity = obj.optDouble("glowIntensity", def.glowIntensity.toDouble()).toFloat().coerceIn(0.00f, 2.50f),
    surfaceOpacity = obj.optDouble("surfaceOpacity", def.surfaceOpacity.toDouble()).toFloat().coerceIn(0.15f, 1.00f),
    rimLightDepth = obj.optDouble("rimLightDepth", def.rimLightDepth.toDouble()).toFloat().coerceIn(0.00f, 1.50f),
    detailDensity = obj.optDouble("detailDensity", def.detailDensity.toDouble()).toFloat().coerceIn(0.00f, 1.50f),
    shaderTurbulence = obj.optDouble("shaderTurbulence", def.shaderTurbulence.toDouble()).toFloat().coerceIn(0.00f, 2.00f),
    promptUsed = obj.optString("promptUsed", def.promptUsed).ifBlank { def.promptUsed }.take(120),
   )
  }

  fun synthesizeFromPrompt(target: ForgeElementTarget, rawPrompt: String, variationSalt: Int = 0): VisualElementRecipe {
   val cleaned = rawPrompt.trim()
   val def = defaultFor(target)
   if (cleaned.isEmpty()) return def
   val lower = cleaned.lowercase(Locale.US)
   val hash = abs((lower + "#$variationSalt#${target.key}").hashCode())
   fun hasAny(vararg words: String): Boolean = words.any { lower.contains(it) }
   val isBrightRiftOrIcon = target in setOf(
    ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_PLASMA, ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_REPULSOR, ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_GRAVITY,
    ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_PHASE_PAIR, ForgeElementTarget.FLUX_CORE_ORB, ForgeElementTarget.PROJECTILE_PRIMARY_BOLT,
    ForgeElementTarget.CURRENCY_FLUX_ICON, ForgeElementTarget.CURRENCY_SHARD_ICON,
   )
   val (primary, trim, glow) = when {
    hasAny("gold", "sovereign", "imperial", "royal", "gilded", "amber", "solar", "sun") ->
     if (isBrightRiftOrIcon) Triple("#F59E0B", "#FACC15", "#FEF08A") else Triple("#120D05", "#FACC15", "#F59E0B")
    hasAny("crimson", "red", "blood", "magma", "lava", "volcanic", "molten", "hazard", "alert") ->
     if (isBrightRiftOrIcon) Triple("#EF4444", "#F97316", "#FFE4E6") else Triple("#14060A", "#EF4444", "#FB7185")
    hasAny("violet", "amethyst", "purple", "magenta", "phase", "void", "quantum", "singularity") ->
     if (isBrightRiftOrIcon) Triple("#A855F7", "#EC4899", "#F5D0FE") else Triple("#0B0618", "#A855F7", "#E879F9")
    hasAny("emerald", "green", "bio", "venom", "acid", "jade", "sonar") ->
     if (isBrightRiftOrIcon) Triple("#10B981", "#2DD4BF", "#D1FAE5") else Triple("#041410", "#10B981", "#00F5D4")
    hasAny("ice", "cryo", "glacier", "frost", "arctic", "diamond", "cobalt", "sapphire") ->
     if (isBrightRiftOrIcon) Triple("#0284C7", "#7DD3FC", "#F0F9FF") else Triple("#051122", "#7DD3FC", "#E0F2FE")
    hasAny("titanium", "gunmetal", "steel", "iron", "chrome", "basalt", "rock", "crater", "slate") ->
     if (isBrightRiftOrIcon) Triple("#475569", "#94A3B8", "#38BDF8") else Triple("#0B121E", "#64748B", "#38BDF8")
    hasAny("rose", "pink", "coral", "neon") ->
     if (isBrightRiftOrIcon) Triple("#EC4899", "#38BDF8", "#FCE7F3") else Triple("#140716", "#EC4899", "#00F5D4")
    hasAny("obsidian", "pitch", "black", "stealth", "ghost", "dark") ->
     if (isBrightRiftOrIcon) Triple("#0E7490", "#38BDF8", "#00F5D4") else Triple("#030710", "#1E3A5F", "#00F5D4")
    hasAny("cyan", "teal", "hard-light", "hardlight", "laser", "turquoise", "electric") ->
     if (isBrightRiftOrIcon) Triple("#00F5D4", "#38BDF8", "#E0F2FE") else Triple("#040914", "#38BDF8", "#00F5D4")
    else -> {
     val palettes = if (isBrightRiftOrIcon) arrayOf(
      Triple("#00F5D4", "#38BDF8", "#E0F2FE"), Triple("#A855F7", "#38BDF8", "#F5D0FE"),
      Triple("#F59E0B", "#FACC15", "#FEF08A"), Triple("#EF4444", "#D946EF", "#FFE4E6"),
     ) else arrayOf(
      Triple("#040914", "#38BDF8", "#00F5D4"), Triple("#090D1C", "#A855F7", "#00F5D4"),
      Triple("#0F0C06", "#F59E0B", "#38BDF8"), Triple("#051314", "#10B981", "#38BDF8"),
     )
     palettes[hash % palettes.size]
    }
   }
   val style = when {
    hasAny("solar", "wing", "array", "kite", "trident", "crystal", "geode") -> 1
    hasAny("crater", "boulder", "round", "octagon", "bastion", "sphere", "dome") -> 2
    hasAny("hollow", "minimal", "razor", "thin", "diamond", "frame", "lattice") -> 3
    variationSalt > 0 -> hash % 4
    else -> def.geometryStyle
   }
   val scale = when {
    hasAny("giant", "massive", "huge", "large") -> 1.25f
    hasAny("compact", "small", "tiny", "micro") -> 0.84f
    else -> def.pixelScale
   }
   val border = when {
    hasAny("thick", "heavy", "bold", "fortress", "armored", "bastion") -> 1.45f
    hasAny("thin", "razor", "hairline", "minimal", "sleek", "subtle") -> 0.68f
    else -> def.borderWeight
   }
   val glowAmt = when {
    hasAny("blazing", "intense", "radiant", "overcharged", "supernova", "neon", "bright") -> 1.65f
    hasAny("matte", "muted", "stealth", "low-glare", "minimal", "pure pitch") -> 0.42f
    else -> def.glowIntensity
   }
   val opacity = when {
    hasAny("ghost", "translucent", "transparent", "glass", "holo", "lightweight") -> 0.52f
    hasAny("solid", "opaque", "armored", "heavy", "obsidian") -> 0.96f
    else -> def.surfaceOpacity
   }
   val rimDepth = when {
    hasAny("3d", "bevel", "faceted", "craggy", "deep", "sculpted", "sunlit") -> 1.15f
    hasAny("flat", "clean", "minimal") -> 0.45f
    else -> def.rimLightDepth
   }
   val density = when {
    hasAny("ornate", "detailed", "intricate", "complex", "cratered", "lit", "windows", "conduits") -> 1.20f
    hasAny("clean", "minimal", "smooth", "pure", "simple") -> 0.38f
    else -> def.detailDensity
   }
   val turbulence = when {
    hasAny("storm", "tempest", "swirl", "chaotic", "turbulent", "arc", "lightning", "unstable", "vortex") -> 1.45f
    hasAny("calm", "still", "smooth", "minimal", "pure", "laminar") -> 0.28f
    variationSalt > 0 -> 0.45f + ((hash % 110) / 100f)
    else -> def.shaderTurbulence
   }
   return VisualElementRecipe(
    targetKey = target.key, primaryHex = primary, trimHex = trim, glowHex = glow, geometryStyle = style,
    pixelScale = scale.coerceIn(0.50f, 2.00f), borderWeight = border.coerceIn(0.40f, 2.50f),
    glowIntensity = glowAmt.coerceIn(0.00f, 2.50f), surfaceOpacity = opacity.coerceIn(0.15f, 1.00f),
    rimLightDepth = rimDepth.coerceIn(0.00f, 1.50f), detailDensity = density.coerceIn(0.00f, 1.50f),
    shaderTurbulence = turbulence.coerceIn(0.00f, 2.00f),
    promptUsed = cleaned.take(120),
   )
  }
 }
}

data class SyndicateCrestRecipe(
 val shieldShape: Int = 0,
 val emblemGlyph: Int = 0,
 val primaryHex: String = "#0B1528",
 val trimHex: String = "#FACC15",
 val glowHex: String = "#00F5D4",
 val promptUsed: String = "Sovereign Gold & Cyan Aegis",
) {
 val primaryColorInt: Int get() = VisualElementRecipe.parseHexColorSafe(primaryHex, 0xFF0B1528.toInt())
 val trimColorInt: Int get() = VisualElementRecipe.parseHexColorSafe(trimHex, 0xFFFACC15.toInt())
 val glowColorInt: Int get() = VisualElementRecipe.parseHexColorSafe(glowHex, 0xFF00F5D4.toInt())

 val shieldShapeLabel: String
  get() = when (shieldShape.coerceIn(0, 3)) {
   1 -> "Chevron Kite"; 2 -> "Octagon Bastion"; 3 -> "Diamond Sovereign"; else -> "Hexagon Aegis"
  }

 val emblemGlyphLabel: String
  get() = when (emblemGlyph.coerceIn(0, 5)) {
   1 -> "Twin Blades"; 2 -> "Crown Spire"; 3 -> "Vortex Eye"; 4 -> "Winged Falcon"; 5 -> "Tactician Visor"; else -> "Rift Singularity"
  }

 fun toJson(): JSONObject = JSONObject().apply {
  put("shieldShape", shieldShape.coerceIn(0, 3))
  put("emblemGlyph", emblemGlyph.coerceIn(0, 5))
  put("primaryHex", VisualElementRecipe.normalizeHexString(primaryHex, "#0B1528"))
  put("trimHex", VisualElementRecipe.normalizeHexString(trimHex, "#FACC15"))
  put("glowHex", VisualElementRecipe.normalizeHexString(glowHex, "#00F5D4"))
  put("promptUsed", promptUsed.take(120))
 }

 companion object {
  fun fromJson(obj: JSONObject?): SyndicateCrestRecipe {
   if (obj == null) return SyndicateCrestRecipe()
   return SyndicateCrestRecipe(
    shieldShape = obj.optInt("shieldShape", 0).coerceIn(0, 3),
    emblemGlyph = obj.optInt("emblemGlyph", 0).coerceIn(0, 5),
    primaryHex = VisualElementRecipe.normalizeHexString(obj.optString("primaryHex", "#0B1528"), "#0B1528"),
    trimHex = VisualElementRecipe.normalizeHexString(obj.optString("trimHex", "#FACC15"), "#FACC15"),
    glowHex = VisualElementRecipe.normalizeHexString(obj.optString("glowHex", "#00F5D4"), "#00F5D4"),
    promptUsed = obj.optString("promptUsed", "Sovereign Gold & Cyan Aegis").ifBlank { "Sovereign Gold & Cyan Aegis" }.take(120),
   )
  }

  fun synthesizeFromPrompt(rawPrompt: String, variationSalt: Int = 0): SyndicateCrestRecipe {
   val cleaned = rawPrompt.trim()
   if (cleaned.isEmpty()) return SyndicateCrestRecipe()
   val lower = cleaned.lowercase(Locale.US)
   val hash = abs((lower + "#$variationSalt").hashCode())
   fun hasAny(vararg w: String): Boolean = w.any { lower.contains(it) }
   val shape = when {
    hasAny("kite", "chevron", "shield", "knight", "herald") -> 1
    hasAny("octagon", "bastion", "fortress", "heavy", "iron") -> 2
    hasAny("diamond", "prism", "rhombus", "crystal") -> 3
    hasAny("hex", "aegis", "hive") -> 0
    else -> hash % 4
   }
   val glyph = when {
    hasAny("blade", "sword", "dagger", "sabre", "duel", "fang") -> 1
    hasAny("crown", "king", "sovereign", "royal", "empire", "monarch") -> 2
    hasAny("vortex", "eye", "rift", "singularity", "black hole", "abyss") -> 3
    hasAny("wing", "falcon", "hawk", "eagle", "valkyrie", "phoenix", "bird") -> 4
    hasAny("skull", "visor", "phantom", "reaper", "ghost", "helm") -> 5
    hasAny("star", "nova", "astral", "sun") -> 0
    else -> (hash / 5) % 6
   }
   val (primary, trim, glow) = when {
    hasAny("crimson", "blood", "red", "war", "wrath") -> Triple("#1A070C", "#EF4444", "#F59E0B")
    hasAny("violet", "amethyst", "void", "purple", "eclipse") -> Triple("#0F0722", "#E879F9", "#00F5D4")
    hasAny("emerald", "venom", "jade", "green", "viper") -> Triple("#051914", "#10B981", "#00F5D4")
    hasAny("ice", "frost", "glacier", "cyan", "arctic") -> Triple("#061528", "#38BDF8", "#E0F2FE")
    hasAny("obsidian", "black", "shadow", "stealth") -> Triple("#040812", "#94A3B8", "#00F5D4")
    else -> Triple("#0B1528", "#FACC15", "#00F5D4")
   }
   return SyndicateCrestRecipe(shape, glyph, primary, trim, glow, cleaned.take(120))
  }
 }
}

object RiftVisualForgeState {
 const val SHOW_DEV_FORGE: Boolean = true
 private const val MAX_UNDO_PER_TARGET = 24

 var visualRevision by mutableIntStateOf(0)
 var pointLightEnabled by mutableStateOf(true)
 var pointLightTestOrbWorldPos by mutableStateOf<Offset?>(null)
 var dynamicLightIntensity by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)
 var projectileLightRadius by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)
 var ambientSpaceDarkness by mutableFloatStateOf(0.0f)
 var activeSyndicateCrestRecipe by mutableStateOf(SyndicateCrestRecipe())
 val activeRecipes = mutableStateMapOf<String, VisualElementRecipe>()

 private data class TargetUndoSnapshot(
  val recipe: VisualElementRecipe,
  val calibrationValues: Map<String, Float>,
  val hudOffset: Offset?,
 )

 private val undoStacks = mutableMapOf<String, ArrayDeque<TargetUndoSnapshot>>()

 init {
  for (target in ForgeElementTarget.entries) {
   activeRecipes[target.key] = VisualElementRecipe.defaultFor(target)
  }
 }

 fun getRecipe(target: ForgeElementTarget): VisualElementRecipe =
  activeRecipes[target.key] ?: VisualElementRecipe.defaultFor(target).also { activeRecipes[target.key] = it }

 fun getRecipeByKey(targetKey: String): VisualElementRecipe =
  getRecipe(ForgeElementTarget.fromKey(targetKey) ?: ForgeElementTarget.SAFE_ZONE_WALL)

 fun updateRecipe(target: ForgeElementTarget, recipe: VisualElementRecipe, recordUndo: Boolean = true, context: Context? = null) {
  if (recordUndo) pushUndoSnapshotForTarget(target)
  activeRecipes[target.key] = recipe.copy(targetKey = target.key)
  RiftSpriteBaker.invalidateVisualTarget(target)
  if (context != null) RiftCalibrationState.savePersistedLayout(context)
  visualRevision++
 }

 fun reforgeTargetFromPrompt(target: ForgeElementTarget, prompt: String, variationSalt: Int = 0, recordUndo: Boolean = true, context: Context? = null): VisualElementRecipe {
  val synthesized = VisualElementRecipe.synthesizeFromPrompt(target, prompt, variationSalt)
  updateRecipe(target, synthesized, recordUndo = recordUndo, context = context)
  return synthesized
 }

 fun updateSyndicateCrest(recipe: SyndicateCrestRecipe, context: Context? = null) {
  activeSyndicateCrestRecipe = recipe
  if (context != null) RiftCalibrationState.savePersistedLayout(context)
  visualRevision++
 }

 fun reforgeSyndicateCrestFromPrompt(prompt: String, variationSalt: Int = 0, context: Context? = null): SyndicateCrestRecipe {
  val forged = SyndicateCrestRecipe.synthesizeFromPrompt(prompt, variationSalt)
  activeSyndicateCrestRecipe = forged
  if (context != null) RiftCalibrationState.savePersistedLayout(context)
  visualRevision++
  return forged
 }

 fun getHudOffsetForTarget(target: ForgeElementTarget): Offset? = when (target) {
  ForgeElementTarget.HUD_TOP_BAR -> RiftCalibrationState.topBarOffset
  ForgeElementTarget.HUD_NEXUS_BUTTON -> RiftCalibrationState.nexusBtnOffset
  ForgeElementTarget.HUD_MINIMAP_CONSOLE -> RiftCalibrationState.bottomConsoleOffset
  ForgeElementTarget.HUD_BUFF_STRIP -> RiftCalibrationState.buffBarOffset
  ForgeElementTarget.HUD_KILL_FEED -> RiftCalibrationState.killLogOffset
  ForgeElementTarget.HUD_LEFT_STICK -> RiftCalibrationState.leftStickOffset
  ForgeElementTarget.HUD_FIRE_STICK -> RiftCalibrationState.fireStickOffset
  ForgeElementTarget.HUD_SECONDARY_BTN -> RiftCalibrationState.bombBtnOffset
  ForgeElementTarget.HUD_SPECIAL_BUFF_BTN -> RiftCalibrationState.burstBtnOffset
  ForgeElementTarget.HUD_REPEL_BTN -> RiftCalibrationState.repelBtnOffset
  ForgeElementTarget.HUD_BRAKE_BTN -> RiftCalibrationState.brakeBtnOffset
  ForgeElementTarget.HUD_MULTI_BTN -> RiftCalibrationState.multiBtnOffset
  ForgeElementTarget.HUD_SPECTATOR_BOX -> RiftCalibrationState.spectatorBoxOffset
  ForgeElementTarget.HUD_WARNING_BANNER -> RiftCalibrationState.idleWarningBannerOffset
  else -> null
 }

 fun setHudOffsetForTarget(target: ForgeElementTarget, offset: Offset, recordUndo: Boolean = false) {
  if (recordUndo) pushUndoSnapshotForTarget(target)
  when (target) {
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_TOP_BAR -> RiftCalibrationState.topBarOffset = offset
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_NEXUS_BUTTON -> RiftCalibrationState.nexusBtnOffset = offset
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_MINIMAP_CONSOLE -> RiftCalibrationState.bottomConsoleOffset = offset
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_BUFF_STRIP -> RiftCalibrationState.buffBarOffset = offset
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_KILL_FEED -> RiftCalibrationState.killLogOffset = offset
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_LEFT_STICK -> RiftCalibrationState.leftStickOffset = offset
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_FIRE_STICK -> RiftCalibrationState.fireStickOffset = offset
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_SECONDARY_BTN -> RiftCalibrationState.bombBtnOffset = offset
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_SPECIAL_BUFF_BTN -> RiftCalibrationState.burstBtnOffset = offset
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_REPEL_BTN -> RiftCalibrationState.repelBtnOffset = offset
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_BRAKE_BTN -> RiftCalibrationState.brakeBtnOffset = offset
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_MULTI_BTN -> RiftCalibrationState.multiBtnOffset = offset
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_SPECTATOR_BOX -> RiftCalibrationState.spectatorBoxOffset = offset
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_WARNING_BANNER -> RiftCalibrationState.idleWarningBannerOffset = offset
   else -> Unit
  }
  RiftCalibrationState.calibrationRevision++
  visualRevision++
 }

 fun getCalibrationDescriptorsForTarget(target: ForgeElementTarget): List<CalibrationParamDescriptor> {
  val boundKeys: List<String> = when (target) {
   ForgeElementTarget.SAFE_ZONE_WALL -> listOf("safeZoneScale", "safeZoneReentryLockoutTime", "safeZoneRepelForce", "wallElasticity")
   ForgeElementTarget.SAFE_ZONE_PAD -> listOf("safeZoneScale", "safeZoneRechargeMult", "safeZoneIdleLimitSec", "exitPhaseShieldSec")
   ForgeElementTarget.PLACED_STASIS_BARRIER -> listOf("stasisBarrierDuration", "stasisBarrierLength", "wallElasticity")
   ForgeElementTarget.OBSTACLE_ORBITAL_STATION, ForgeElementTarget.OBSTACLE_ASTEROID_STATION,
   ForgeElementTarget.OBSTACLE_SPACE_ASTEROID, ForgeElementTarget.OBSTACLE_FLOATING_DEBRIS,
   ForgeElementTarget.ARENA_PERIMETER_RING -> listOf("wallElasticity")
   ForgeElementTarget.BACKGROUND_NEBULA -> listOf("publicMatchCycleLimitSec", "hitStopDurationSec")
   ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_PLASMA -> listOf("anomalyScale", "riftLifespanSec", "riftPhysicalRadius", "plasmaRiftDamagePct")
   ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_REPULSOR -> listOf("anomalyScale", "riftLifespanSec", "riftPhysicalRadius", "repulsorFieldRadius", "repulsorBaseForce")
   ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_GRAVITY -> listOf("anomalyScale", "riftLifespanSec", "riftPhysicalRadius", "gravityPullRadius", "gravityPullForce", "gravityStopImmunitySec")
   ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_PHASE_PAIR -> listOf("anomalyScale", "riftLifespanSec", "riftPhysicalRadius", "phaseRiftCooldownSec")
   ForgeElementTarget.SUPPLY_CRATE -> listOf("crateScale", "buffCapFfa", "buffRespawnFrequency", "buffBaseRespawnDelay", "cratePickupBounty", "fullChargeCrateBounty")
   ForgeElementTarget.PROJECTILE_PRIMARY_BOLT -> listOf("projectileScale", "aimTelegraphScale", "crateMultiShotAmmo")
   ForgeElementTarget.PROJECTILE_PROXIMITY_MINE -> listOf("projectileScale", "maxMinesPerShip", "proxFuseRadius")
   ForgeElementTarget.ECLIPSE_STASIS_BUBBLE -> listOf("interdictorBubbleRadius", "interdictorBubbleDuration", "interdictorBubbleCooldown")
   ForgeElementTarget.FLUX_CORE_ORB -> listOf("fluxCoreBountyPerSec", "fluxCoreEjectSpeed")
   ForgeElementTarget.STASIS_BRIG_JAIL -> listOf("stasisBrigReactorMaxHp")
   ForgeElementTarget.SHIP_AURA_LABELS -> listOf("shipScale", "labelDistanceOffset", "hvtBountyThreshold", "bountyKillBonusPct")
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_TOP_BAR -> listOf("topBarScale", "skirmishKillTargetPerRound")
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_NEXUS_BUTTON -> listOf("topBarScale")
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_MINIMAP_CONSOLE -> listOf("bottomConsoleScale")
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_BUFF_STRIP -> listOf("buffBarScale", "overchargeSurgePctPerStack")
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_KILL_FEED -> listOf("killLogScale", "bountyKillBonusPct")
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_LEFT_STICK -> listOf("leftStickScale", "gamepadDeadzoneLeft", "afterburnerThrustMult", "afterburnerDrainPerSec")
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_FIRE_STICK -> listOf("combatArcScale", "aimTelegraphScale", "gamepadDeadzoneRight")
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_SECONDARY_BTN -> listOf("combatArcScale", "cloakDrainPerSec", "empPulseRadius", "empFluxDrainPct", "empFreezeSec", "phaseDashImpulse")
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_SPECIAL_BUFF_BTN -> listOf("combatArcScale", "seekerDamage", "seekerSpeed", "novaBoltDamage", "shatterPelletDamage", "hyperSurgeSpeedMult")
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_REPEL_BTN -> listOf("combatArcScale", "repelCost", "repelRadius", "repelPushForce")
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_BRAKE_BTN -> listOf("combatArcScale", "retroBrakeDamping")
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_MULTI_BTN -> listOf("combatArcScale", "crateMultiShotAmmo")
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_SPECTATOR_BOX -> listOf("respawnDelaySec")
   ForgeElementTarget.HUD_WARNING_BANNER -> listOf("idleWarningBannerScale", "playfieldIdleLimitSec", "playfieldIdleDrainPctPerSec")
   ForgeElementTarget.CURRENCY_FLUX_ICON, ForgeElementTarget.CURRENCY_SHARD_ICON -> listOf("bottomConsoleScale", "topBarScale")
  }
  val byKey = RiftCalibrationState.buildAllParameterDescriptors().associateBy { it.key }
  val lighting = if (target == ForgeElementTarget.BACKGROUND_NEBULA) buildDynamicLightingDescriptors() else emptyList()
  return lighting + boundKeys.mapNotNull { byKey[it] }
 }

 fun buildDynamicLightingDescriptors(): List<CalibrationParamDescriptor> = listOf(
  CalibrationParamDescriptor(
   "forge_dynamicLightIntensity", 0, 0, "Dynamic Point-Light Intensity", "x",
   "Scales real-time radial light cast by plasma bolts, Rifts, and test orbs.",
   0.0f, 2.5f, 0.05f, 2, { dynamicLightIntensity },
   { dynamicLightIntensity = it.coerceIn(0.0f, 2.5f); visualRevision++ },
  ),
  CalibrationParamDescriptor(
   "forge_projectileLightRadius", 0, 0, "Projectile Light Radius", "x",
   "Scales illumination radius around flying bolts, bombs, and Flux Core.",
   0.3f, 2.5f, 0.05f, 2, { projectileLightRadius },
   { projectileLightRadius = it.coerceIn(0.3f, 2.5f); visualRevision++ },
  ),
  CalibrationParamDescriptor(
   "forge_ambientSpaceDarkness", 0, 0, "Ambient Void Contrast", "%",
   "Deepens ambient space darkness so dynamic point lights pop with higher contrast.",
   0.0f, 0.85f, 0.05f, 2, { ambientSpaceDarkness },
   { ambientSpaceDarkness = it.coerceIn(0.0f, 0.85f); visualRevision++ },
  ),
 )

 fun getCombatSandboxDescriptors(shipIdFilter: Int = 0): List<CalibrationParamDescriptor> {
  val all = RiftCalibrationState.buildAllParameterDescriptors()
  return if (shipIdFilter in 1..10) {
   all.filter { it.shipIdFilter == shipIdFilter || (it.tabIndex == 1 && it.shipIdFilter == 0) }
  } else {
   buildDynamicLightingDescriptors() + all.filter { it.shipIdFilter == 0 && it.tabIndex in setOf(1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7) }
  }
 }

 fun pushUndoSnapshotForTarget(target: ForgeElementTarget) {
  val boundDescriptors = getCalibrationDescriptorsForTarget(target).filter { !it.key.startsWith("forge_") }
  val calSnapshot = LinkedHashMap<String, Float>()
  for (desc in boundDescriptors) calSnapshot[desc.key] = desc.getter()
  val snap = TargetUndoSnapshot(getRecipe(target), calSnapshot, getHudOffsetForTarget(target))
  val deque = undoStacks.getOrPut(target.key) { ArrayDeque() }
  if (deque.lastOrNull() == snap) return
  if (deque.size >= MAX_UNDO_PER_TARGET) deque.removeFirst()
  deque.addLast(snap)
  visualRevision++
 }

 fun canUndoTarget(target: ForgeElementTarget): Boolean = undoStacks[target.key]?.isNotEmpty() == true

 fun undoTarget(target: ForgeElementTarget, engine: RiftGameEngine? = null, context: Context? = null): Boolean {
  val deque = undoStacks[target.key] ?: return false
  val snap = deque.removeLastOrNull() ?: return false
  activeRecipes[target.key] = snap.recipe
  val byKey = RiftCalibrationState.buildAllParameterDescriptors().associateBy { it.key }
  for ((k, v) in snap.calibrationValues) byKey[k]?.setter?.invoke(v)
  if (snap.hudOffset != null) setHudOffsetForTarget(target, snap.hudOffset, recordUndo = false)
  RiftSpriteBaker.invalidateVisualTarget(target)
  RiftCalibrationState.applyCalibrationChangesLive(engine, context)
  visualRevision++
  return true
 }

 fun resetTargetToDefault(target: ForgeElementTarget, engine: RiftGameEngine? = null, context: Context? = null) {
  RiftCalibrationState.ensureBaselineCaptured()
  pushUndoSnapshotForTarget(target)
  activeRecipes[target.key] = VisualElementRecipe.defaultFor(target)
  if (target == ForgeElementTarget.BACKGROUND_NEBULA) {
   dynamicLightIntensity = 1.0f
   projectileLightRadius = 1.0f
   ambientSpaceDarkness = 0.0f
   pointLightEnabled = true
  }
  val boundDescriptors = getCalibrationDescriptorsForTarget(target).filter { !it.key.startsWith("forge_") }
  for (desc in boundDescriptors) {
   RiftCalibrationState.DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]?.let { defVal -> desc.setter(defVal) }
  }
  if (getHudOffsetForTarget(target) != null) setHudOffsetForTarget(target, Offset.Zero, recordUndo = false)
  RiftSpriteBaker.invalidateVisualTarget(target)
  RiftCalibrationState.applyCalibrationChangesLive(engine, context)
  visualRevision++
 }

 fun resetAllVisualTargetsToDefault() {
  val hadCustomRecipes = activeRecipes.values.any { !it.isFactoryDefault }
  for (target in ForgeElementTarget.entries) activeRecipes[target.key] = VisualElementRecipe.defaultFor(target)
  pointLightEnabled = true
  pointLightTestOrbWorldPos = null
  dynamicLightIntensity = 1.0f
  projectileLightRadius = 1.0f
  ambientSpaceDarkness = 0.0f
  activeSyndicateCrestRecipe = SyndicateCrestRecipe()
  undoStacks.clear()
  if (hadCustomRecipes) {
   RiftSpriteBaker.invalidateAllVisualTargets()
  }
  visualRevision++
 }

 fun toJsonObject(): JSONObject {
  val recipesObj = JSONObject()
  for (target in ForgeElementTarget.entries) {
   val rec = getRecipe(target)
   if (!rec.isFactoryDefault) recipesObj.put(target.key, rec.toJson())
  }
  return JSONObject().apply {
   put("pointLightEnabled", pointLightEnabled)
   put("dynamicLightIntensity", ((dynamicLightIntensity * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
   put("projectileLightRadius", ((projectileLightRadius * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
   put("ambientSpaceDarkness", ((ambientSpaceDarkness * 100f).roundToInt() / 100.0))
   put("recipes", recipesObj)
  }
 }

 fun loadFromJsonObject(obj: JSONObject?) {
  val hadCustomBefore = activeRecipes.values.any { !it.isFactoryDefault }
  var loadedCustomNow = false
  for (target in ForgeElementTarget.entries) activeRecipes[target.key] = VisualElementRecipe.defaultFor(target)
  if (obj != null) {
   pointLightEnabled = obj.optBoolean("pointLightEnabled", true)
   dynamicLightIntensity = obj.optDouble("dynamicLightIntensity", 1.0).toFloat().coerceIn(0.0f, 2.5f)
   projectileLightRadius = obj.optDouble("projectileLightRadius", 1.0).toFloat().coerceIn(0.3f, 2.5f)
   ambientSpaceDarkness = obj.optDouble("ambientSpaceDarkness", 0.0).toFloat().coerceIn(0.0f, 0.85f)
   val recipesObj = obj.optJSONObject("recipes")
   if (recipesObj != null) {
    val keys = recipesObj.keys()
    while (keys.hasNext()) {
     val k = keys.next()
     val target = ForgeElementTarget.fromKey(k) ?: continue
     val recJson = recipesObj.optJSONObject(k) ?: continue
     val loadedRec = VisualElementRecipe.fromJson(recJson).copy(targetKey = target.key)
     activeRecipes[target.key] = loadedRec
     if (!loadedRec.isFactoryDefault) loadedCustomNow = true
    }
   }
  }
  if (hadCustomBefore || loadedCustomNow) {
   RiftSpriteBaker.invalidateAllVisualTargets()
  }
  visualRevision++
 }
}

object RiftProgressionCatalog {

  val CONDUIT_RANK_TIERS: List<ConduitRankTier> =
    listOf(
      ConduitRankTier(0, 149, "DRIFT INITIATE", 100, 0xFF38BDF8),
      ConduitRankTier(150, 349, "VANGUARD", 150, 0xFF00F5D4),
      ConduitRankTier(350, 649, "INTERCEPTOR", 225, 0xFF34D399),
      ConduitRankTier(650, 999, "PHANTOM", 300, 0xFFC084FC),

    )

  fun getConduitTierForResonance(liveResonance: Int): ConduitRankTier {
    val clean = liveResonance.coerceAtLeast(0)
    return CONDUIT_RANK_TIERS.firstOrNull { clean in it.minResonance..it.maxResonance }
      ?: CONDUIT_RANK_TIERS.last()
  }

  fun computeStartingBountyForResonance(liveResonance: Int): Int =
    getConduitTierForResonance(liveResonance).startingBounty

  fun getConduitProgressFraction(liveResonance: Int): Float {
    val clean = liveResonance.coerceAtLeast(0)
    val tier = getConduitTierForResonance(clean)
    if (tier.maxResonance == Int.MAX_VALUE) return 1f
    val span = (tier.maxResonance - tier.minResonance + 1).coerceAtLeast(1)
    return ((clean - tier.minResonance).toFloat() / span.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
  }

  fun getNextConduitTierThreshold(liveResonance: Int): Pair<Int, String> {
    val clean = liveResonance.coerceAtLeast(0)
    val nextTier = CONDUIT_RANK_TIERS.firstOrNull { it.minResonance > clean }

  /**
   * Deterministically generates the 3 Daily Conduit Directives for [utcDay] (100% on-device).
   * Slot rewards: Slot 0 = 40❖ + 10 RES, Slot 1 = 50❖ + 15 RES, Slot 2 = 60❖ + 20 RES (+100❖ & +25 RES 3/3 Sweep = 250❖/day).
   */
  fun generateDailyDirectivesForDay(
    utcDay: Long,
    slotRerollCounts: IntArray = intArrayOf(0, 0, 0),
  ): List<DailyConduitDirective> {
    val shardRewards = longArrayOf(40L, 50L, 60L)
    val resRewards = intArrayOf(10, 15, 20)
    val usedMetrics = mutableSetOf<DailyDirectiveMetric>()
    val result = ArrayList<DailyConduitDirective>(3)

    for (slot in 0..2) {
      val rerollSalt = slotRerollCounts.getOrElse(slot) { 0 }.coerceAtLeast(0)
      val rawHash = abs((utcDay * 1_103_515_245L + slot * 97_531L + rerollSalt * 31_337L).toInt())
      var chosen = DIRECTIVE_TEMPLATES[rawHash % DIRECTIVE_TEMPLATES.size]
      var probe = 1
      while (chosen.metric in usedMetrics && probe < DIRECTIVE_TEMPLATES.size) {
        chosen = DIRECTIVE_TEMPLATES[(rawHash + probe) % DIRECTIVE_TEMPLATES.size]
        probe++
      }
      usedMetrics.add(chosen.metric)
      result.add(
        DailyConduitDirective(
          slotIndex = slot,
          directiveId = "${chosen.id}_d${utcDay}_r$rerollSalt",
          title = chosen.title,
          subtitle = chosen.subtitle,
          metric = chosen.metric,
          targetValue = chosen.target,
          progressValue = 0,
          shardReward = shardRewards[slot],
          resonanceReward = resRewards[slot],
          claimed = false,
        )
      )
    }
    return result
  }

    val base = 30L
    val milestoneBonus =

  fun calculateTotalMilestoneShardsUpTo(level: Int): Long {
    val top = level.coerceIn(1, 100)
    if (top < 2) return 0L
    var sum = 0L
    for (lv in 2..top) {
      sum += getShardRewardForLevel(lv)
    }
    return sum

    val endLv = currentLevel.coerceIn(1, 100)
    if (startLv > endLv) return 0L
    var sum = 0L
    for (lv in startLv..endLv) {

    }
    return sum

    return when (category.trim().uppercase(Locale.US)) {
      "KILL_FINISHER" -> killFinishers
      "HULL_TRIM" -> hullTrims
      "WARP_SIGNATURE" -> warpSignatures
      "HVT_HALO" -> hvtHalos
      else -> emptyList()
    }
  }

  fun getCosmeticItem(category: String, id: Int): CosmeticCatalogItem? {
    return getItemsForCategory(category).firstOrNull { it.id == id }
  }

  fun getFrameSlotGate(slotId: String): FrameSlotGateInfo {
    val norm = CustomShipLoadoutSlot.normalizeSlotId(slotId)
    return frameSlotGates.firstOrNull { it.slotId == norm } ?: frameSlotGates.first()
  }

enum class BuffAimMode {
  AIM_DIRECTIONAL,
  TAP_INSTANT,
}

enum class CustomBuffEffect(val label: String) {
  NONE("Pure Plasma Damage"),
  PULL("Gravity Vortex Pull"),
  PUSH("Shockwave Repel Knockback"),
  EMP("Flux-Drain EMP Lockout"),
  SLOW("Cryo Velocity Snare"),
  BARRIER("45s Tethered Hard-Light Barrier"),
  SPEED_BOOST("Hyper-Thruster Surge"),
  CLONE("Holographic Decoy Clone"),
}

data class SpecialBuffRegistryEntry(
  val id: String,
  val buffTypeIndex: Int,
  val officialName: String,
  val shortLabel: String,
  var chargesPerPickup: Int,
  val aimMode: BuffAimMode,
  val strokeColorHex: String,
  val fillColorArgb: Int,
  val summary: String,
  val isCustomForged: Boolean = false,
  var projectileSpeed: Float = 640f,
  var flightDuration: Float = 2.5f,
  var damage: Float = 480f,
  var blastRadius: Float = 200f,
  val specialEffect: CustomBuffEffect = CustomBuffEffect.NONE,
  val wallBounces: Int = 2,
  val promptUsed: String = "",
) {
  val strokeColorInt: Int
    get() =
      try {
        Color.parseColor(strokeColorHex)
      } catch (_: Exception) {
        0xFF00F5D4.toInt()
      }

  fun toJsonObject(): JSONObject =
    JSONObject().apply {
      put("id", id)
      put("buffTypeIndex", buffTypeIndex)
      put("officialName", officialName)
      put("shortLabel", shortLabel)
      put("chargesPerPickup", chargesPerPickup)
      put("aimMode", aimMode.name)
      put("strokeColorHex", strokeColorHex)
      put("fillColorArgb", fillColorArgb)
      put("summary", summary)
      put("isCustomForged", isCustomForged)
      put("projectileSpeed", projectileSpeed.toDouble())
      put("flightDuration", flightDuration.toDouble())
      put("damage", damage.toDouble())
      put("blastRadius", blastRadius.toDouble())
      put("specialEffect", specialEffect.name)
      put("wallBounces", wallBounces)
      put("promptUsed", promptUsed)
    }

  companion object {
    fun fillColorFromStroke(hex: String): Int {
      return try {
        val c = Color.parseColor(hex)
        Color.argb(165, (Color.red(c) * 0.35f).toInt(), (Color.green(c) * 0.35f).toInt(), (Color.blue(c) * 0.35f).toInt())
      } catch (_: Exception) {
        Color.argb(165, 16, 48, 78)
      }
    }

    fun fromJsonObject(obj: JSONObject): SpecialBuffRegistryEntry {
      val strokeHex = obj.optString("strokeColorHex", "#C084FC")
      val aimName = obj.optString("aimMode", BuffAimMode.AIM_DIRECTIONAL.name)
      val effName = obj.optString("specialEffect", CustomBuffEffect.PULL.name)
      val isCustom = obj.optBoolean("isCustomForged", true)
      return SpecialBuffRegistryEntry(
        id = obj.optString("id", "FORGED_BUFF_${System.currentTimeMillis()}"),
        buffTypeIndex = obj.optInt("buffTypeIndex", 16).coerceAtLeast(if (isCustom) 16 else 0),
        officialName = obj.optString("officialName", "GRAVITY WELL").take(20),
        shortLabel = obj.optString("shortLabel", "GRAVITY").take(8),
        chargesPerPickup = obj.optInt("chargesPerPickup", 2).coerceIn(1, 8),
        aimMode = BuffAimMode.entries.firstOrNull { it.name == aimName } ?: BuffAimMode.AIM_DIRECTIONAL,
        strokeColorHex = strokeHex,
        fillColorArgb = obj.optInt("fillColorArgb", fillColorFromStroke(strokeHex)),
        summary = obj.optString("summary", "Custom forged special buff."),
        isCustomForged = obj.optBoolean("isCustomForged", true),
        projectileSpeed = obj.optDouble("projectileSpeed", 420.0).toFloat().coerceIn(120f, 1600f),
        flightDuration = obj.optDouble("flightDuration", 3.0).toFloat().coerceIn(0.5f, 12.0f),
        damage = obj.optDouble("damage", 420.0).toFloat().coerceIn(0f, 2500f),
        blastRadius = obj.optDouble("blastRadius", 220.0).toFloat().coerceIn(40f, 650f),
        specialEffect = CustomBuffEffect.entries.firstOrNull { it.name == effName } ?: CustomBuffEffect.PULL,
        wallBounces = obj.optInt("wallBounces", 2).coerceIn(0, 6),
        promptUsed = obj.optString("promptUsed", ""),
      )
    }

    fun synthesizeFromPrompt(rawPrompt: String, nextBuffTypeIndex: Int): SpecialBuffRegistryEntry {
      val clean = rawPrompt.trim().ifEmpty { "Gravity Well slow violet orb that pulls nearby enemies inward for 3 seconds, 2 charges" }
      val lower = clean.lowercase(Locale.US)
      val hash = abs(clean.hashCode() + nextBuffTypeIndex * 4999)

      val effect =
        when {
          lower.contains("pull") || lower.contains("vortex") || lower.contains("gravity") || lower.contains("black hole") ->
            CustomBuffEffect.PULL
          lower.contains("push") || lower.contains("knock") || lower.contains("repel") || lower.contains("shockwave") ->
            CustomBuffEffect.PUSH
          lower.contains("emp") || lower.contains("drain") || lower.contains("ion") || lower.contains("disable") ->
            CustomBuffEffect.EMP
          lower.contains("slow") || lower.contains("cryo") || lower.contains("frost") || lower.contains("snare") || lower.contains("ice") ->
            CustomBuffEffect.SLOW
          lower.contains("wall") || lower.contains("barrier") || lower.contains("bulkhead") || lower.contains("shield") ->
            CustomBuffEffect.BARRIER
          lower.contains("speed") || lower.contains("boost") || lower.contains("dash") || lower.contains("surge") || lower.contains("turbo") ->
            CustomBuffEffect.SPEED_BOOST
          lower.contains("clone") || lower.contains("decoy") || lower.contains("phantom") || lower.contains("holo") ->
            CustomBuffEffect.CLONE
          else -> CustomBuffEffect.NONE
        }

      val aim =
        if (effect in setOf(CustomBuffEffect.SPEED_BOOST, CustomBuffEffect.CLONE) && lower.contains("instant")) {
          BuffAimMode.TAP_INSTANT
        } else {
          BuffAimMode.AIM_DIRECTIONAL
        }

      val strokeHex =
        when {
          lower.contains("violet") || lower.contains("purple") || effect == CustomBuffEffect.PULL -> "#C084FC"
          lower.contains("cyan") || lower.contains("frost") || lower.contains("ice") || effect == CustomBuffEffect.EMP -> "#22D3EE"
          lower.contains("emerald") || lower.contains("green") || effect == CustomBuffEffect.CLONE -> "#34D399"
          lower.contains("crimson") || lower.contains("red") || lower.contains("rose") -> "#FB7185"
          lower.contains("amber") || lower.contains("solar") || lower.contains("gold") || effect == CustomBuffEffect.PUSH -> "#FACC15"
          else -> "#FB923C"
        }

      val calledMatch = Regex("(?i)called\\s+([a-z0-9][a-z0-9 \\-]{2,18}?)(?:\\s+that|\\s+which|,|$)").find(clean)
      val officialName =
        (calledMatch?.groupValues?.getOrNull(1)?.trim()?.uppercase(Locale.US)
          ?: when (effect) {
            CustomBuffEffect.PULL -> "GRAVITY WELL"
            CustomBuffEffect.PUSH -> "SOLAR PULSE"
            CustomBuffEffect.EMP -> "ION LANCE"
            CustomBuffEffect.SLOW -> "CRYO WEB"
            CustomBuffEffect.BARRIER -> "AEGIS WALL"
            CustomBuffEffect.SPEED_BOOST -> "HYPER DRIVE"
            CustomBuffEffect.CLONE -> "MIRAGE CLONE"
            CustomBuffEffect.NONE -> "PLASMA ORB"
          }).take(20)

      val shortLabel = officialName.split(" ").firstOrNull()?.take(8)?.ifEmpty { "FORGED" } ?: "FORGED"

      val chargesMatch = Regex("(\\d+)\\s*charge").find(lower)
      val charges = (chargesMatch?.groupValues?.getOrNull(1)?.toIntOrNull() ?: (2 + (hash % 2))).coerceIn(1, 8)

      val secMatch = Regex("(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\\s*(?:second|sec|s\\b)").find(lower)
      val duration = (secMatch?.groupValues?.getOrNull(1)?.toFloatOrNull() ?: 3.0f).coerceIn(0.8f, 10.0f)

      val dmgMatch = Regex("(\\d{2,4})\\s*(?:damage|dmg|flux)").find(lower)
      val dmg = (dmgMatch?.groupValues?.getOrNull(1)?.toFloatOrNull() ?: if (effect == CustomBuffEffect.BARRIER) 0f else 440f).coerceIn(0f, 2000f)

      val speed =
        when {
          lower.contains("fast") || lower.contains("lance") -> 920f
          lower.contains("slow") -> 340f
          else -> 580f
        }
      val radius =
        when {
          lower.contains("wide") || lower.contains("large") -> 300f
          else -> 230f
        }
      val bounces = if (lower.contains("bounce")) 3 else 2
      val idSlug =
        "FORGED_" +
          officialName.replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9]"), "_").trim('_').ifEmpty { "BUFF" } +
          "_$nextBuffTypeIndex"
      val summary =
        "${effect.label} • ${charges}x Charges • ${String.format(Locale.US, "%.1fs", duration)} • ${dmg.toInt()} Flux DMG (${radius.toInt()}px)."

      return SpecialBuffRegistryEntry(
        id = idSlug,
        buffTypeIndex = nextBuffTypeIndex.coerceAtLeast(11),
        officialName = officialName,
        shortLabel = shortLabel,
        chargesPerPickup = charges,
        aimMode = aim,
        strokeColorHex = strokeHex,
        fillColorArgb = fillColorFromStroke(strokeHex),
        summary = summary,
        isCustomForged = true,
        projectileSpeed = speed,
        flightDuration = duration,
        damage = dmg,
        blastRadius = radius,
        specialEffect = effect,
        wallBounces = bounces,
        promptUsed = clean.take(160),
      )
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Ship Specification for all 10 Playable Hulls in RIFT (9 Signature Hulls + Ship #10 Modular Rift Frame).
 */
data class ShipSpec(
  val id: Int,
  val name: String,
  val role: String,
  val tacticalLore: String,
  val silhouetteDesc: String,
  val weaponSummary: String,
  val primaryTitle: String,
  val secondaryTitle: String,
  val primaryShortLabel: String,
  val secondaryShortLabel: String,
  var maxFlux: Float,
  var rechargeRate: Float,
  var topSpeed: Float,
  var afterburnerSpeed: Float,
  var thrust: Float,
  var turnRate: Float,
  var primaryCost: Float,
  var primaryCooldown: Float,
  var primaryDamage: Float,
  var primarySpeed: Float,
  val primaryStreams: Int,
  val primarySpreadRad: Float,
  val primaryBounces: Int,
  val isParallelTwin: Boolean = false,
  val hasBomb: Boolean,
  val bombType: String,
  var bombCost: Float,
  var bombCooldown: Float,
  var bombDamage: Float,
  val bombBounces: Int,
  var bombRecoil: Float,
  val supportsNativeMultifire: Boolean,
  val initialRepels: Int,
  val accentColorHex: Int,
  val speedPts: Int = 10,
  val thrustPts: Int = 10,
  val turnPts: Int = 10,
  val maxFluxPts: Int = 10,
  val rechargePts: Int = 10,
  val primaryPts: Int = 15,
  val secondaryPts: Int = 15,
  val isCustomModularFrame: Boolean = false,
  val activeCustomSlotId: String = "Frame A",
) {
  val totalHullStatPoints: Int
    get() = speedPts + thrustPts + turnPts + maxFluxPts + rechargePts

  val totalAllocatedPoints: Int
    get() = totalHullStatPoints + primaryPts + secondaryPts
}

/**
 * Procedural Hull Visual Recipe generated by the Hangar Hull Forge (Ship #10).
 */
data class CustomHullVisualRecipe(
  val hullName: String = "RIFT FRAME",
  val silhouette: String = "DELTA_INTERCEPTOR",
  val wingSweep: Float = 1.0f,
  val chassisPlates: Int = 2,
  val primaryHex: String = "#1D4ED8",
  val trimHex: String = "#38BDF8",
  val coreGlowHex: String = "#00F5D4",
  val engineStyle: String = "TWIN_PLASMA",
  val promptUsed: String = "Default cobalt-cyan modular Rift Frame interceptor",
) {
  fun toJsonString(): String {
    return JSONObject()
      .apply {
        put("hullName", hullName)
        put("silhouette", silhouette)
        put("wingSweep", wingSweep.toDouble())
        put("chassisPlates", chassisPlates)
        put("primaryHex", primaryHex)
        put("trimHex", trimHex)
        put("coreGlowHex", coreGlowHex)
        put("engineStyle", engineStyle)
        put("promptUsed", promptUsed)
      }
      .toString()
  }

  companion object {
    fun ensureMinLuminanceHex(hex: String, minLum: Float): String {
      return try {
        val c = Color.parseColor(hex)
        val r = Color.red(c) / 255f
        val g = Color.green(c) / 255f
        val b = Color.blue(c) / 255f
        val lum = 0.2126f * r + 0.7152f * g + 0.0722f * b
        if (lum >= minLum) {
          hex
        } else {
          val boost = (minLum - lum).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
          val nr = ((r + boost * (1f - r)) * 255f).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255)
          val ng = ((g + boost * (1f - g)) * 255f).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255)
          val nb = ((b + boost * (1f - b)) * 255f).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255)
          String.format(Locale.US, "#%02X%02X%02X", nr, ng, nb)
        }
      } catch (_: Exception) {
        "#38BDF8"
      }
    }

    fun fromJsonString(raw: String?): CustomHullVisualRecipe {
      if (raw.isNullOrBlank()) return CustomHullVisualRecipe()
      return try {
        val obj = JSONObject(raw)
        CustomHullVisualRecipe(
          hullName = obj.optString("hullName", "RIFT FRAME").take(20),
          silhouette = obj.optString("silhouette", "DELTA_INTERCEPTOR"),
          wingSweep = obj.optDouble("wingSweep", 1.0).toFloat().coerceIn(0.65f, 1.35f),
          chassisPlates = obj.optInt("chassisPlates", 2).coerceIn(1, 4),
          primaryHex = obj.optString("primaryHex", "#1D4ED8"),
          trimHex = obj.optString("trimHex", "#38BDF8"),
          coreGlowHex = obj.optString("coreGlowHex", "#00F5D4"),
          engineStyle = obj.optString("engineStyle", "TWIN_PLASMA"),
          promptUsed = obj.optString("promptUsed", "Custom modular hull"),
        )
      } catch (_: Exception) {
        CustomHullVisualRecipe()
      }
    }

    fun synthesizeFromPrompt(rawPrompt: String, variationSalt: Int = 0): CustomHullVisualRecipe {
      val clean = rawPrompt.trim().ifEmpty { "Sleek obsidian stealth scythe with crimson plasma core" }
      val lower = clean.lowercase(Locale.US)
      val hash = abs(clean.hashCode() + variationSalt * 3571)

      val silhouette =
        when {
          lower.contains("scythe") || lower.contains("crescent") || lower.contains("blade") || lower.contains("talon") ->
            "CRESCENT_SCYTHE"
          lower.contains("heavy") || lower.contains("tank") || lower.contains("dreadnought") || lower.contains("fortress") || lower.contains("bastion") || lower.contains("goliath") ->
            "BASTION_DREADNOUGHT"
          lower.contains("manta") || lower.contains("ray") || lower.contains("bio") || lower.contains("organic") || lower.contains("alien") ->
            "MANTA_STINGRAY"
          lower.contains("twin") || lower.contains("fork") || lower.contains("prong") || lower.contains("rail") || lower.contains("sniper") ->
            "TWIN_BOOM_STRIKER"
          lower.contains("predator") || lower.contains("raptor") || lower.contains("fang") || lower.contains("claw") || lower.contains("swept") ->
            "FORWARD_SWEPT_PREDATOR"
          else -> {
            val all =
              listOf(
                "DELTA_INTERCEPTOR",
                "FORWARD_SWEPT_PREDATOR",
                "TWIN_BOOM_STRIKER",
                "CRESCENT_SCYTHE",
                "BASTION_DREADNOUGHT",
                "MANTA_STINGRAY",
              )
            all[hash % all.size]
          }
        }

      val (pri, trim, glow) =
        when {
          lower.contains("crimson") || lower.contains("red") || lower.contains("blood") || lower.contains("inferno") || lower.contains("lava") ->
            Triple("#7F1D1D", "#F87171", "#FF1744")
          lower.contains("gold") || lower.contains("solar") || lower.contains("amber") || lower.contains("sun") || lower.contains("royal") ->
            Triple("#78350F", "#FACC15", "#FFEA00")
          lower.contains("void") || lower.contains("purple") || lower.contains("violet") || lower.contains("nebula") || lower.contains("amethyst") ->
            Triple("#4C1D95", "#C084FC", "#E040FB")
          lower.contains("emerald") || lower.contains("green") || lower.contains("jade") || lower.contains("venom") || lower.contains("acid") ->
            Triple("#064E3B", "#34D399", "#00E676")
          lower.contains("obsidian") || lower.contains("stealth") || lower.contains("shadow") || lower.contains("black") || lower.contains("phantom") ->
            Triple("#0F172A", "#94A3B8", "#38BDF8")
          lower.contains("white") || lower.contains("ivory") || lower.contains("ice") || lower.contains("frost") || lower.contains("arctic") ->
            Triple("#CBD5E1", "#38BDF8", "#00E5FF")
          else -> {
            val palettes =
              listOf(
                Triple("#1E3A8A", "#38BDF8", "#00F5D4"),
                Triple("#581C87", "#E879F9", "#00E5FF"),
                Triple("#881337", "#FB7185", "#FBBF24"),
                Triple("#134E4A", "#2DD4BF", "#A3E635"),
              )
            palettes[hash % palettes.size]
          }
        }

      val engines = listOf("TWIN_PLASMA", "QUAD_NOVA", "HEAVY_THRUSTER", "BIO_ARC")
      val engineStyle = engines[(hash / 7) % engines.size]
      val sweep = (0.72f + (hash % 36) / 100f).coerceIn(0.70f, 1.08f)
      val plates = 1 + (hash % 4)

      val titleWords =
        clean
          .uppercase(Locale.US)
          .replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9 ]"), " ")
          .split(Regex("\\s+"))
          .filter { it.length in 3..9 && it !in setOf("WITH", "AND", "THE", "SHIP", "HULL", "CORE") }
      val generatedTitle =
        if (titleWords.size >= 2) {
          "${titleWords[0]} ${titleWords[1]}".take(18)
        } else if (titleWords.size == 1) {
          "${titleWords[0]} MK-IX".take(18)
        } else {
          "APEX RIFT-IX"
        }

      return CustomHullVisualRecipe(
        hullName = generatedTitle,
        silhouette = silhouette,
        wingSweep = sweep,
        chassisPlates = plates,
        primaryHex = pri,
        trimHex = trim,
        coreGlowHex = glow,
        engineStyle = engineStyle,
        promptUsed = clean,
      )
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Saved Loadout Slot (Frame A, Frame B, Frame C, Frame D, Frame E) for Ship #10 (Rift Frame).
 */
data class CustomShipLoadoutSlot(
  val slotId: String = "Frame A",
  val customName: String = "Rift Frame",
  val speedPts: Int = 25,
  val thrustPts: Int = 8,
  val turnPts: Int = 18,
  val maxFluxPts: Int = 0,
  val rechargePts: Int = 14,
  val primaryArchetype: String = "SNIPER_RAIL",
  val secondaryType: String = "PHASE_DASH",
  val visualRecipe: CustomHullVisualRecipe = CustomHullVisualRecipe(),
  val aiGenerationsCount: Int = 0,
) {
  val primaryPts: Int
    get() = primaryPointCost()

  val secondaryPts: Int
    get() = secondaryPointCost()

  fun primaryPointCost(): Int = getPrimaryPointCost(primaryArchetype)
  fun secondaryPointCost(): Int = getSecondaryPointCost(secondaryType)

  fun hullStatPoints(): Int = speedPts + thrustPts + turnPts + maxFluxPts + rechargePts
  fun totalAllocatedPoints(): Int = hullStatPoints() + primaryPointCost() + secondaryPointCost()

  fun toJsonString(): String {
    return JSONObject()
      .apply {
        put("slotId", slotId)
        put("customName", customName)
        put("speedPts", speedPts)
        put("thrustPts", thrustPts)
        put("turnPts", turnPts)
        put("maxFluxPts", maxFluxPts)
        put("rechargePts", rechargePts)
        put("primaryArchetype", primaryArchetype)
        put("secondaryType", secondaryType)
        put("visualRecipe", JSONObject(visualRecipe.toJsonString()))
        put("aiGenerationsCount", aiGenerationsCount)
      }
      .toString()

    fun getAllAvailableSecondaryOptions(): List<SecondaryAbilityOption> {
      val customOptions =
        RiftCodex.getCustomForgedBuffs().map { entry ->
          SecondaryAbilityOption(
            id = entry.id,
            title = "${entry.officialName} (Forged Crate)",
            shortLabel = entry.shortLabel,
            pointCost = 22,
            fluxAndCdLabel = "420 Flux • 1.40s CD",
            summary = entry.summary,
          )
        }
      return SECONDARY_OPTIONS + customOptions
    }

    fun getPrimaryPointCost(archetype: String): Int =
      PRIMARY_OPTIONS.firstOrNull { it.id == archetype }?.pointCost ?: 0

    fun getSecondaryPointCost(secType: String): Int {
      val norm = normalizeLegacySecondaryCode(secType)
      SECONDARY_OPTIONS.firstOrNull { it.id == norm }?.let { return it.pointCost }
      if (RiftCodex.getBuffRegistryEntry(norm)?.isCustomForged == true) return 22
      return 0
    }

    private fun normalizeLegacySecondaryCode(rawCode: String): String =
      when {
        rawCode == "BURST" -> "NOVA_RING"
        rawCode.equals("SH" + "OTGUN", ignoreCase = true) -> "SHATTER_CONE"
        rawCode.equals("MI" + "SSILE", ignoreCase = true) -> "SEEKER_TORPEDO"
        rawCode.equals("DISC", ignoreCase = true) -> "CHAKRAM"
        else -> rawCode
      }

    fun normalizeSlotId(slotId: String): String =
      when (slotId.trim().uppercase(Locale.US)) {
        "FRAME B", "9B", "B" -> "Frame B"
        "FRAME C", "9C", "C" -> "Frame C"
        "FRAME D", "9D", "D" -> "Frame D"
        "FRAME E", "9E", "E" -> "Frame E"
        else -> "Frame A"
      }

    fun fromJsonString(raw: String?, fallbackSlotId: String = "Frame A"): CustomShipLoadoutSlot {
      val cleanFallback = normalizeSlotId(fallbackSlotId)
      if (raw.isNullOrBlank()) return defaultSlot(cleanFallback)
      return try {
        val obj = JSONObject(raw)
        val recipeObj = obj.optJSONObject("visualRecipe")
        val rawPri = obj.optString("primaryArchetype", "SNIPER_RAIL")
        val validPri = if (PRIMARY_OPTIONS.any { it.id == rawPri }) rawPri else "SNIPER_RAIL"
        val rawSec = normalizeLegacySecondaryCode(obj.optString("secondaryType", "PHASE_DASH"))
        val validSec =
          if (
            SECONDARY_OPTIONS.any { it.id == rawSec } ||
              RiftCodex.getBuffRegistryEntry(rawSec)?.isCustomForged == true ||
              rawSec.startsWith("FORGED_") ||
              rawSec.startsWith("CUSTOM_")
          ) {
            rawSec
          } else {
            "NONE"
          }
        val cleanSlot = normalizeSlotId(obj.optString("slotId", cleanFallback))

        val sp = obj.optInt("speedPts", 25).coerceIn(0, 30)
        val th = obj.optInt("thrustPts", 8).coerceIn(0, 30)
        val tu = obj.optInt("turnPts", 18).coerceIn(0, 30)
        val mf = obj.optInt("maxFluxPts", 0).coerceIn(0, 30)
        val rc = obj.optInt("rechargePts", 14).coerceIn(0, 30)
        val aiCount = obj.optInt("aiGenerationsCount", 0).coerceAtLeast(0)

        val isUntouchedLegacyA =
          cleanSlot == "Frame A" &&
            aiCount == 0 &&
            sp == 4 &&
            th == 4 &&
            tu == 4 &&
            mf == 4 &&
            rc == 4 &&
            validPri == "LIGHT_PULSE" &&
            validSec == "NONE"
        val isUntouchedLegacyB =
          cleanSlot == "Frame B" &&
            aiCount == 0 &&
            sp == 2 &&
            th == 2 &&
            tu == 2 &&
            mf == 2 &&
            rc == 2 &&
            validPri == "TWIN_SCATTER" &&
            validSec == "NONE"
        val isUntouchedLegacyC =
          cleanSlot == "Frame C" &&
            aiCount == 0 &&
            sp == 5 &&
            th == 0 &&
            tu == 0 &&
            mf == 0 &&
            rc == 0 &&
            validPri == "LIGHT_PULSE" &&
            validSec == "PHASE_DASH"
        if (isUntouchedLegacyA || isUntouchedLegacyB || isUntouchedLegacyC) {
          return defaultSlot(cleanSlot)
        }

        val rawCustomName = obj.optString("customName", "Rift Frame")
        val cleanName =
          rawCustomName
            .replace(Regex("(?i)^RIFT FRAME\\s*9[ABCDE]$"), "Rift Frame")
            .replace("9A", "Frame A")
            .replace("9B", "Frame B")
            .replace("9C", "Frame C")
            .replace("9D", "Frame D")
            .replace("9E", "Frame E")
            .take(18)
            .ifBlank { "Rift Frame" }

        CustomShipLoadoutSlot(
          slotId = cleanSlot,
          customName = cleanName,
          speedPts = sp,
          thrustPts = th,
          turnPts = tu,
          maxFluxPts = mf,
          rechargePts = rc,
          primaryArchetype = validPri,
          secondaryType = validSec,
          visualRecipe =
            if (recipeObj != null) {
              CustomHullVisualRecipe.fromJsonString(recipeObj.toString())
            } else {
              defaultSlot(cleanSlot).visualRecipe
            },
          aiGenerationsCount = aiCount,
        )
      } catch (_: Exception) {
        defaultSlot(cleanFallback)
      }
    }
  }
}

  val category: String,

object RiftCodex {
  const val BASE_TOP_SPEED = 380f
  const val SPEED_PER_PT = 8f

  const val BASE_THRUST = 600f
  const val THRUST_PER_PT = 15f

  const val BASE_TURN_RATE = 3.2f
  const val TURN_PER_PT = 0.10f

  const val BASE_MAX_FLUX = 2200f
  const val MAX_FLUX_PER_PT = 80f

  const val BASE_RECHARGE = 240f
  const val RECHARGE_PER_PT = 8f

  val primaryWeaponOptions: List<PrimaryWeaponOption>
    get() = CustomShipLoadoutSlot.PRIMARY_OPTIONS

  val secondaryAbilityOptions: List<SecondaryAbilityOption>
    get() = CustomShipLoadoutSlot.getAllAvailableSecondaryOptions()

  fun getRiftFramePointBudget(pilotLevel: Int, devOverride: Boolean = false): Int =
    com.example.engine.getRiftFramePointBudget(pilotLevel, devOverride)

  fun computeTopSpeed(pts: Int): Float = BASE_TOP_SPEED + pts.coerceIn(0, 30) * SPEED_PER_PT
  fun computeThrust(pts: Int): Float = BASE_THRUST + pts.coerceIn(0, 30) * THRUST_PER_PT
  fun computeTurnRate(pts: Int): Float = BASE_TURN_RATE + pts.coerceIn(0, 30) * TURN_PER_PT
  fun computeMaxFlux(pts: Int): Float = BASE_MAX_FLUX + pts.coerceIn(0, 30) * MAX_FLUX_PER_PT
  fun computeRecharge(pts: Int): Float = BASE_RECHARGE + pts.coerceIn(0, 30) * RECHARGE_PER_PT

  @Volatile
  var activeCustomShipSlot: CustomShipLoadoutSlot = CustomShipLoadoutSlot.defaultSlot("Frame A")

  val customShip9Spec: ShipSpec
    get() = buildShipSpecFromCustomSlot(activeCustomShipSlot)

  fun updateActiveCustomShipSlot(slot: CustomShipLoadoutSlot) {
    activeCustomShipSlot = slot
    RiftSpriteBaker.updateCustomShip9Sprites(slot.visualRecipe)

  val BUFF_REGISTRY: MutableMap<String, SpecialBuffRegistryEntry> = createCoreBuffRegistry()

  fun normalizeSpecialBuffId(raw: String): String {
    val clean = raw.trim().uppercase(Locale.US)
    return when (clean) {
      "BURST", "NOVA", "NOVA_RING" -> "NOVA_RING"
      "SHOTGUN", "SHATTER", "SHATTER_CONE" -> "SHATTER_CONE"
      "MISSILE", "SEEKER", "SEEKER_TORPEDO", "THOR" -> "SEEKER_TORPEDO"
      "DECOY", "PHANTOM", "HOLO_PHANTOM" -> "HOLO_PHANTOM"
      "BRICK", "BARRIER", "STASIS_BARRIER" -> "STASIS_BARRIER"
      "ROCKET", "SURGE", "HYPER_SURGE", "PHASE_BLINK" -> "HYPER_SURGE"
      "SWARM", "DRONES", "SWARM_DRONES" -> "SWARM_DRONES"
      "TRACTOR", "TRACTOR_BEAM", "WEB" -> "TRACTOR_BEAM"
      "PROX_MISSILE", "PROX_SEEKER", "PROX_LOCK", "INFINITE_MISSILE" -> "PROX_SEEKER"
      "LANCE", "LANCE_BEAM", "CONTINUOUS_LANCE" -> "LANCE_BEAM"
      "CHAKRAM", "DISC", "SAW_DISC", "PIZZA_DISC" -> "CHAKRAM"
      else -> clean
    }
  }

  fun getBuffRegistryEntry(idOrAlias: String): SpecialBuffRegistryEntry? {
    val norm = normalizeSpecialBuffId(idOrAlias)
    return BUFF_REGISTRY[norm] ?: BUFF_REGISTRY[idOrAlias]
  }

  fun getBuffRegistryByIndex(index: Int): SpecialBuffRegistryEntry? {
    return BUFF_REGISTRY.values.firstOrNull { it.buffTypeIndex == index }
  }

  fun getCustomForgedBuffs(): List<SpecialBuffRegistryEntry> {
    return BUFF_REGISTRY.values.filter { it.isCustomForged }.sortedBy { it.buffTypeIndex }
  }

  fun nextCustomBuffTypeIndex(): Int {
    val maxExisting = BUFF_REGISTRY.values.maxOfOrNull { it.buffTypeIndex } ?: 15
    return max(16, maxExisting + 1)
  }

  fun registerCustomBuff(entry: SpecialBuffRegistryEntry) {
    val safeEntry =
      if (entry.isCustomForged && entry.buffTypeIndex <= 15) {
        entry.copy(buffTypeIndex = nextCustomBuffTypeIndex())
      } else {
        entry
      }
    BUFF_REGISTRY[safeEntry.id] = safeEntry
    RiftSpriteBaker.invalidateCustomBuffIcon(safeEntry.buffTypeIndex)
  }

  fun removeCustomBuff(id: String) {
    val removed = BUFF_REGISTRY.remove(id)
    if (removed != null) {
      RiftSpriteBaker.invalidateCustomBuffIcon(removed.buffTypeIndex)
    }
  }

  fun resetBuffRegistryToDefaults(preserveCustomForged: Boolean = true) {
    val preserved = if (preserveCustomForged) getCustomForgedBuffs() else emptyList()
    BUFF_REGISTRY.clear()
    BUFF_REGISTRY.putAll(createCoreBuffRegistry())
    for (custom in preserved) {
      BUFF_REGISTRY[custom.id] = custom
    }
  }

  fun buildShipSpecFromCustomSlot(slot: CustomShipLoadoutSlot): ShipSpec {
    val spPts = slot.speedPts.coerceIn(0, 30)
    val thPts = slot.thrustPts.coerceIn(0, 30)
    val tuPts = slot.turnPts.coerceIn(0, 30)
    val mfPts = slot.maxFluxPts.coerceIn(0, 30)
    val rcPts = slot.rechargePts.coerceIn(0, 30)

    val topSpd = computeTopSpeed(spPts)
    val thrustVal = computeThrust(thPts)
    val turnVal = computeTurnRate(tuPts)
    val maxFlx = computeMaxFlux(mfPts)
    val rechVal = computeRecharge(rcPts)

    val priPts = slot.primaryPointCost()
    val secPts = slot.secondaryPointCost()

    val (pTitle, pShort, pCost, pCd, pDmg, pSpeed, pStreams, pSpread, pBounce, isParallel) =
      when (slot.primaryArchetype) {
        "ION_NEEDLER" ->
          PrimaryTuple("Needler", "NEEDLER", 18f, 0.13f, 82f, 950f, 2, 0.04f, 0, false)
        "TWIN_SCATTER" ->
          PrimaryTuple("Twin Scatter Cannons", "SCATTER", 20f, 0.14f, 88f, 900f, 2, 0.065f, 0, false)
        "ANGLED_PULSE" ->
          PrimaryTuple("Ricochet Twin-Pulse", "RICOCHET", 20f, 0.15f, 92f, 960f, 2, 0.055f, 1, false)
        "QUAD_PULSE" ->
          PrimaryTuple("Quad-Converging Flak", "QUAD", 24f, 0.15f, 68f, 940f, 4, 0.045f, 0, false)
        "HEAVY_PLASMA" ->
          PrimaryTuple("Heavy Twin Plasma", "PLASMA", 38f, 0.21f, 150f, 880f, 2, 0.05f, 0, false)
        "TRI_PRISM" ->
          PrimaryTuple("Tri-Prism Splitter", "PRISM", 24f, 0.15f, 80f, 960f, 3, 0.05f, 0, false)
        "SNIPER_RAIL" ->
          PrimaryTuple("1-Bounce Rail-Laser", "RAILGUN", 26f, 0.18f, 225f, 1280f, 1, 0f, 1, false)
        "PARALLEL_AUTOCANNON" ->
          PrimaryTuple("Parallel Autocannon", "AUTOCANNON", 22f, 0.13f, 128f, 1000f, 2, 0.025f, 0, true)
        else ->
          PrimaryTuple("Light Pulse Repeater", "PULSE", 16f, 0.12f, 115f, 980f, 1, 0f, 0, false)
      }

    val supportsNativeMulti = slot.secondaryType == "NATIVE_MULTI"
    val extraPrimaryBounces = if (slot.secondaryType == "NATIVE_RICOCHET") 1 else 0
    val extraRepel = if (slot.secondaryType == "MINE") 1 else 0
    val hasSecBomb = slot.secondaryType !in setOf("NONE", "NATIVE_MULTI", "NATIVE_RICOCHET")

    val (sTitle, sShort, bCost, bCd, bDmg, bBounces, bRecoil) =
      when (slot.secondaryType) {
        "NATIVE_MULTI" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Native 4-Bolt Multi-Toggle", "TWIN MULTI", 0f, 0f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "NATIVE_RICOCHET" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Ricochet Rounds (+1 Bounce)", "RICOCHET", 0f, 0f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "PHASE_DASH" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Phase Dash + +35% Overcharge", "PHASE DASH", 320f, 0.65f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "MINE" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Magnetic Proximity Mines (300 Flux • Max 6)", "PROX MINE", 300f, 0.80f, 1040f, 0, 0f)
        "BOUNCE" ->
          SecondaryTuple("3-Bounce Bank Torpedo", "TORPEDO", 420f, 0.90f, 980f, 3, 220f)
        "PROX" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Proximity Flak Warhead", "PROX FLAK", 450f, 0.95f, 820f, 1, 210f)
        "CLUSTER" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Cluster Shrapnel Bomb", "CLUSTER", 520f, 1.05f, 920f, 0, 250f)
        "NOVA_RING" ->
          SecondaryTuple("360° 16-Bolt Nova Ring", "NOVA RING", 480f, 1.15f, 145f, 1, 0f)
        "SHATTER_CONE" ->
          SecondaryTuple("7-Pellet Shatter Cone", "SHATTER", 380f, 0.85f, 195f, 0, 260f)
        "SEEKER_TORPEDO" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Homing Seeker Torpedo", "SEEKER", 460f, 1.05f, 880f, 0, 190f)
        "CHAKRAM" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Chakram Ricochet Saw-Disc (4 Bounces)", "CHAKRAM", 400f, 0.90f, 560f, 4, 140f)
        "HOLO_PHANTOM" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Holo Phantom Clone + Cloak", "PHANTOM", 400f, 3.5f, 420f, 0, 0f)
        "STASIS_BARRIER" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Stasis Hard-Light Barrier", "BARRIER", 360f, 4.0f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "HYPER_SURGE" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Hyper Surge Thruster Boost", "SURGE", 320f, 3.8f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "SWARM_DRONES" ->
          SecondaryTuple("5-Drone Hunter Swarm", "SWARM", 440f, 1.8f, 210f, 0, 0f)
        "TRACTOR_BEAM" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Toggleable Tractor Beam (112/s)", "TRACTOR", 0f, 0.35f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "PROX_SEEKER" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Proximity Patrol Missile (Max 2)", "PROX LOCK", 500f, 2.4f, 840f, 99, 170f)
        "LANCE_BEAM" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Toggleable Plasma Lance (145/s)", "LANCE", 0f, 0.35f, 280f, 0, 0f)
        "REPEL_PULSE" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Repel Shockwave Generator", "REPEL", 340f, 2.2f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "CLOAK_EMP" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Stealth Cloak + 0-Flux Decloak EMP", "CLOAK", 0f, 4.5f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "SIEGE" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Heavy Siege Bomb (Air-Burst)", "SIEGE BOMB", 650f, 1.20f, 1350f, 1, 360f)
        "INTERDICTOR_DOME" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Stasis (320 Flux • 6.0s)", "STASIS", 320f, 8.5f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        else -> {
          val customForged = getBuffRegistryEntry(slot.secondaryType)?.takeIf { it.isCustomForged }
          if (customForged != null) {
            SecondaryTuple(
              "${customForged.officialName} (Forged)",
              customForged.shortLabel,
              420f,
              1.40f,
              customForged.damage,
              customForged.wallBounces,
              140f,
            )
          } else {
            SecondaryTuple("Pure Hull Focus (No Secondary)", "NONE", 0f, 0f, 0f, 0, 0f)
          }
        }
      }

    val cleanHullTitle = slot.customName.trim().ifEmpty { "Rift Frame" }
    return ShipSpec(
      id = 10,
      name = cleanHullTitle,
      role = "Modular Custom Hull (${slot.totalAllocatedPoints()}/100 Pts)",
      tacticalLore = "Pilot-engineered modular Rift Frame combining custom 100-Point stat allocation, curated weapon hardpoints, and procedural 3D chassis geometry.",
      silhouetteDesc = "${slot.visualRecipe.silhouette.replace('_', ' ')} • Prompt: \"${slot.visualRecipe.promptUsed.take(64)}\"",
      weaponSummary = "PRI: $pShort (${pCost.toInt()} Flux) • SEC: $sShort" + (if (bCost > 0f) " (${bCost.toInt()} Flux)" else ""),
      primaryTitle = pTitle,
      secondaryTitle = sTitle,
      primaryShortLabel = pShort,
      secondaryShortLabel = sShort,
      maxFlux = maxFlx,
      rechargeRate = rechVal,
      topSpeed = topSpd,
      afterburnerSpeed = topSpd * 1.32f,
      thrust = thrustVal,
      turnRate = turnVal,
      primaryCost = pCost,
      primaryCooldown = pCd,
      primaryDamage = pDmg,
      primarySpeed = pSpeed,
      primaryStreams = pStreams,
      primarySpreadRad = pSpread,
      primaryBounces = pBounce + extraPrimaryBounces,
      isParallelTwin = isParallel,
      hasBomb = hasSecBomb,
      bombType = if (hasSecBomb) slot.secondaryType else "NONE",
      bombCost = bCost,
      bombCooldown = bCd,
      bombDamage = bDmg,
      bombBounces = bBounces,
      bombRecoil = bRecoil,
      supportsNativeMultifire = supportsNativeMulti,
      initialRepels = 2 + extraRepel,
      accentColorHex = 0xFF38BDF8.toInt(),
      speedPts = spPts,
      thrustPts = thPts,
      turnPts = tuPts,
      maxFluxPts = mfPts,
      rechargePts = rcPts,
      primaryPts = priPts,
      secondaryPts = secPts,
      isCustomModularFrame = true,
      activeCustomSlotId = slot.slotId,
    )
  }

  var SHIPS: List<ShipSpec> = createDefaultSignatureShips()
    private set

  fun resetShipsToDefaults() {
    val fresh = createDefaultSignatureShips()
    if (SHIPS.size == fresh.size) {
      for (i in fresh.indices) {
        val dst = SHIPS[i]
        val src = fresh[i]
        dst.maxFlux = src.maxFlux
        dst.rechargeRate = src.rechargeRate
        dst.topSpeed = src.topSpeed
        dst.afterburnerSpeed = src.afterburnerSpeed
        dst.thrust = src.thrust
        dst.turnRate = src.turnRate
        dst.primaryCost = src.primaryCost
        dst.primaryCooldown = src.primaryCooldown
        dst.primaryDamage = src.primaryDamage
        dst.primarySpeed = src.primarySpeed
        dst.bombCost = src.bombCost
        dst.bombCooldown = src.bombCooldown
        dst.bombDamage = src.bombDamage
        dst.bombRecoil = src.bombRecoil
      }
    } else {
      SHIPS = fresh
    }
  }

  fun getAllTenShips(): List<ShipSpec> = SHIPS + buildShipSpecFromCustomSlot(activeCustomShipSlot)

  fun getAllNineShips(): List<ShipSpec> = getAllTenShips()

  fun getShipById(id: Int): ShipSpec {
    if (id == 10) return buildShipSpecFromCustomSlot(activeCustomShipSlot)
    return SHIPS.find { it.id == id } ?: SHIPS.first()
  }
