fun attemptAutoSignIn(
  context: Context,
  credentialManager: CredentialManager,
  onAuthSuccess: () -> Unit,
  onUnauthenticated: () -> Unit,
  scope: CoroutineScope,
) {
  if (Firebase.auth.currentUser != null) {
    onAuthSuccess()
    return
  }
  if (!NetworkConnectivityMonitor.isCurrentlyOnline(context)) {
    onUnauthenticated()
    return
  }
  val clientId =
    try {
      context.getString(R.string.default_web_client_id)
    } catch (e: Exception) {
      onUnauthenticated()
      return
    }

  val googleIdOption =
    GetGoogleIdOption.Builder()
      .setFilterByAuthorizedAccounts(true)
      .setServerClientId(clientId)
      .setAutoSelectEnabled(true)
      .build()

  val request = GetCredentialRequest.Builder().addCredentialOption(googleIdOption).build()

  scope.launch {
    try {
      val result = credentialManager.getCredential(context, request)
      val credential = result.credential
      if (credential is CustomCredential && credential.type == TYPE_GOOGLE_ID_TOKEN_CREDENTIAL) {
        val googleIdToken = GoogleIdTokenCredential.createFrom(credential.data).idToken
        val authCredential = GoogleAuthProvider.getCredential(googleIdToken, null)
        Firebase.auth.signInWithCredential(authCredential).await()
        onAuthSuccess()
      } else {
        onUnauthenticated()
      }
    } catch (e: Exception) {
      onUnauthenticated()
    }
  }
}

fun onGoogleSignInClicked(
  context: Context,
  credentialManager: CredentialManager,
  onAuthSuccess: () -> Unit,
  onAuthError: (String) -> Unit,
  scope: CoroutineScope,
  onAuthCancelled: () -> Unit = {},
) {
  if (!NetworkConnectivityMonitor.isCurrentlyOnline(context)) {
    if (Firebase.auth.currentUser != null) {
      onAuthSuccess()
    } else {
      onAuthError(
        "Device is currently offline. Tap Play as Drifter below for instant offline play, or connect to the internet to sign in with Google."
      )
    }
    return
  }
  val clientId =
    try {
      context.getString(R.string.default_web_client_id)
    } catch (e: Exception) {
      onAuthError("Google Sign-In configuration missing: default_web_client_id not found")
      return
    }

  val signInOption = GetSignInWithGoogleOption.Builder(serverClientId = clientId).build()
  val request = GetCredentialRequest.Builder().addCredentialOption(signInOption).build()

  scope.launch {
    try {
      val result = credentialManager.getCredential(context, request)
      val credential = result.credential
      if (credential is CustomCredential && credential.type == TYPE_GOOGLE_ID_TOKEN_CREDENTIAL) {
        val googleIdToken = GoogleIdTokenCredential.createFrom(credential.data).idToken
        val authCredential = GoogleAuthProvider.getCredential(googleIdToken, null)
        Firebase.auth.signInWithCredential(authCredential).await()
        onAuthSuccess()
      } else {
        onAuthError("Unexpected credential type")
      }
    } catch (e: GetCredentialCancellationException) {
      Log.w("Auth", "Google Sign-In cancelled or dismissed: ${e.message}", e)
      onAuthCancelled()
    } catch (e: Exception) {
      Log.e("Auth", "Google Sign-In failed", e)
      onAuthError(e.localizedMessage ?: "Sign in failed")
    }
  }
}

fun signOut(
  credentialManager: CredentialManager,
  scope: CoroutineScope,
  onSignOutComplete: () -> Unit = {},
) {
  scope.launch {
    withContext(NonCancellable) {
      try {
        credentialManager.clearCredentialState(ClearCredentialStateRequest())
      } catch (e: Exception) {
        Log.w("Auth", "Failed to clear credential state: ${e.message}")
      } finally {
        Firebase.auth.signOut()
        onSignOutComplete()
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
fun AuthScreen(
  onAuthSuccess: () -> Unit,
  onPlayAsGuest: () -> Unit = {},
  onOpenChangelog: () -> Unit = {},
) {
  val context = LocalContext.current
  val coroutineScope = rememberCoroutineScope()
  val credentialManager = remember { CredentialManager.create(context) }
  var isLoading by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
  var errorMessage by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
  val scrollState = rememberScrollState()
  val isOnline by
    remember(context) { NetworkConnectivityMonitor.observeOnlineState(context) }
      .collectAsState(initial = NetworkConnectivityMonitor.isCurrentlyOnline(context))

  LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
    if (Firebase.auth.currentUser != null) {
      onAuthSuccess()
    }
  }

  Box(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(Color(0xFF02050B)),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
    // RIFT Title Artwork atmospheric backdrop + translucent #02050B vignette
    Image(
      painter = painterResource(id = R.drawable.rift_title_loading),
      contentDescription = "RIFT Title Artwork",
      contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
      alpha = 0.36f,
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
    )
    Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
      val w = size.width
      val h = size.height
      drawRect(
        brush =
          Brush.radialGradient(
            colors = listOf(Color(0x9E08162E), Color(0xC9040A16), Color(0xE802050B)),
            center = Offset(w * 0.34f, h * 0.50f),
            radius = maxOf(w, h) * 0.80f,
          )
      )
      val starCount = 46
      for (i in 0 until starCount) {
        val hx = ((i * 73856093) xor 0x5A17) and 0xFFFF
        val hy = ((i * 19349663) xor 0x2F91) and 0xFFFF
        val sx = (hx / 65535f) * w
        val sy = (hy / 65535f) * h
        val starCol =
          when {
            i % 7 == 0 -> Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.42f)
            i % 5 == 0 -> Color(0xFFFACC15).copy(alpha = 0.36f)
            else -> Color(0xFFCBD5E1).copy(alpha = 0.28f)
          }
        val r = if (i % 6 == 0) 1.6.dp.toPx() else 1.0.dp.toPx()
        drawCircle(color = starCol, radius = r, center = Offset(sx, sy))
      }
    }

    BoxWithConstraints(
      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxSize()
          .windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.safeDrawing)
          .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
      contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
      val viewportMaxHeight = maxHeight
      val aspect = if (viewportMaxHeight.value > 0f) maxWidth.value / viewportMaxHeight.value else 1.6f
      val isWideLandscape = maxWidth >= 560.dp && aspect >= 1.15f
      val isUltraCompactHeight = viewportMaxHeight < 410.dp
      val cardMaxWidth = if (maxWidth >= 1000.dp) 980.dp else 940.dp

      Surface(
        modifier =
          Modifier.widthIn(max = cardMaxWidth)
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .then(
              if (isWideLandscape && !isUltraCompactHeight) {
                Modifier.heightIn(max = (maxHeight * 0.94f).coerceAtMost(540.dp))
              } else {
                Modifier.heightIn(max = maxHeight * 0.96f)
              }
            )
            .border(
              1.2.dp,
              Brush.linearGradient(
                listOf(Color(0xFF00F5D4), Color(0xFF38BDF8), Color(0xFFFACC15))
              ),
              RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
            ),
        color = Color(0xEE060D1A),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
        tonalElevation = 10.dp,
      ) {
        Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
          // Sci-Fi Command Tablet chamfer/corner registration brackets
          Canvas(modifier = Modifier.matchParentSize()) {
            val stroke = 1.8.dp.toPx()
            val inset = 5.dp.toPx()
            val arm = 20.dp.toPx()
            val cyan = Color(0xFF00F5D4)
            val gold = Color(0xFFFACC15)
            drawLine(cyan, Offset(inset, inset), Offset(inset + arm, inset), stroke)
            drawLine(cyan, Offset(inset, inset), Offset(inset, inset + arm), stroke)
            drawLine(gold, Offset(size.width - inset - arm, inset), Offset(size.width - inset, inset), stroke)
            drawLine(gold, Offset(size.width - inset, inset), Offset(size.width - inset, inset + arm), stroke)
            drawLine(gold, Offset(inset, size.height - inset - arm), Offset(inset, size.height - inset), stroke)
            drawLine(gold, Offset(inset, size.height - inset), Offset(inset + arm, size.height - inset), stroke)
            drawLine(
              cyan,
              Offset(size.width - inset - arm, size.height - inset),
              Offset(size.width - inset, size.height - inset),
              stroke,
            )
            drawLine(
              cyan,
              Offset(size.width - inset, size.height - inset - arm),
              Offset(size.width - inset, size.height - inset),
              stroke,
            )
          }

          val bodyModifier =
            if (!isWideLandscape || isUltraCompactHeight) {
              Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .verticalScroll(scrollState)
                .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 12.dp)
            } else {
              Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = 18.dp, vertical = 12.dp)
            }

          Column(
            modifier = bodyModifier,
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
          ) {
            // TOP TABLET HEADER STRIP
            Row(
              modifier =
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                  .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                  .background(Color(0xFF081326))
                  .border(1.dp, Color(0x3D38BDF8), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                  .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            ) {
              Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
              ) {
                NexusMergedBrandEmblem(modifier = Modifier.size(28.dp))
                Row(
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                ) {
                  Text(
                    text = stringResource(R.string.auth_title),
                    color = Color.White,
                    fontSize = 16.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    letterSpacing = 2.0.sp,
                    maxLines = 1,
                  )
                  Text(
                    text = "// THRESHOLD DYNAMICS STUDIO, LLC",
                    color = Color(0xFFFACC15),
                    fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                  )
                }
              }

              Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))

              Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
              ) {
                val netColor = if (isOnline) Color(0xFF10B981) else Color(0xFFF59E0B)
                val netBg = if (isOnline) Color(0x2610B981) else Color(0x2EF59E0B)
                Row(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .background(netBg)
                      .border(1.dp, netColor, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 5.dp)
                      .testTag("auth_network_status_badge"),
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
                ) {
                  Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size(7.dp)) {
                    drawCircle(color = netColor)
                  }
                  Text(
                    text = if (isOnline) "ONLINE" else "OFFLINE",
                    color = netColor,
                    fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    maxLines = 1,
                  )
                }

                Button(
                  onClick = onOpenChangelog,
                  colors =
                    ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                      containerColor = Color(0xFF0B1C32),
                      contentColor = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
                    ),
                  border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color(0xFF38BDF8)),
                  shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                  contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 11.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
                      .heightIn(min = 36.dp)
                      .testTag("auth_changelog_button"),
                ) {
                  Icon(
                    imageVector = RiftAuthIcons.Terminal,
                    contentDescription = "Patch Log",
                    tint = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
                    modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp),
                  )
                  Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                  Text(
                    text = "[ BUILD #$CURRENT_RIFT_BUILD_VERSION PATCH LOG ]",
                    fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    maxLines = 1,
                  )
                }
              }
            }

            // 2-COLUMN SCI-FI COMMAND TABLET DECK (Left: Live Safe-Harbor Showcase | Right: Briefing & Auth)
            if (isWideLandscape) {
              val showcaseMaxH = (viewportMaxHeight * 0.66f).coerceIn(185.dp, 310.dp)
              Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              ) {
                AuthSafeHarborRadarShowcase(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.weight(0.46f)
                      .heightIn(min = 180.dp, max = showcaseMaxH)
                      .fillMaxWidth()
                )
                AuthCommandBriefingColumn(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.weight(0.54f)
                      .then(if (isUltraCompactHeight) Modifier else Modifier.verticalScroll(scrollState)),
                  isOnline = isOnline,
                  isLoading = isLoading,
                  errorMessage = errorMessage,
                  onSignInGoogle = {
                    errorMessage = null
                    isLoading = true
                    onGoogleSignInClicked(
                      context = context,
                      credentialManager = credentialManager,
                      onAuthSuccess = {
                        isLoading = false
                        onAuthSuccess()
                      },
                      onAuthError = { msg ->
                        isLoading = false
                        errorMessage = msg
                      },
                      scope = coroutineScope,
                      onAuthCancelled = { isLoading = false },
                    )
                  },
                  onEnterDrifter = onPlayAsGuest,
                )
              }
            } else {
              val portraitShowcaseH = (viewportMaxHeight * 0.28f).coerceIn(160.dp, 225.dp)
              AuthSafeHarborRadarShowcase(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(portraitShowcaseH)
              )
              AuthCommandBriefingColumn(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                isOnline = isOnline,
                isLoading = isLoading,
                errorMessage = errorMessage,
                onSignInGoogle = {
                  errorMessage = null
                  isLoading = true
                  onGoogleSignInClicked(
                    context = context,
                    credentialManager = credentialManager,
                    onAuthSuccess = {
                      isLoading = false
                      onAuthSuccess()
                    },
                    onAuthError = { msg ->
                      isLoading = false
                      errorMessage = msg
                    },
                    scope = coroutineScope,
                    onAuthCancelled = { isLoading = false },
                  )
                },
                onEnterDrifter = onPlayAsGuest,
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Left Column (`weight(0.46f)`): Live Gameplay-Honest Circular Safe-Harbor Radar Showcase.
 * Renders a round rippling cyan/gold digitized aperture framing the real `5x` `Nexus Station`
 * sprite (`RiftSpriteBaker.safeZoneStationBitmap` + `drawSafeZoneStationHoloRing`) and
 * 3 real `128x128` ship sprites (`getShipSprite`) banking along orbital patrol arcs with thruster trails.
 */
@Composable
private fun AuthSafeHarborRadarShowcase(modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
  val headless = remember { isHeadlessGlEnvironment() }
  val visualRev = RiftVisualForgeState.visualRevision
  val customVer = RiftSpriteBaker.customShip9Version

  val orbitPhaseRad =
    if (headless) {
      0.85f
    } else {
      val transition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "auth_safe_harbor_showcase")
      val p by
        transition.animateFloat(
          initialValue = 0f,
          targetValue = (2.0 * PI).toFloat(),
          animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(9600, easing = LinearEasing), RepeatMode.Restart),
          label = "auth_orbit_rad",
        )
      p
    }

  val stationBmp = remember(visualRev) { RiftSpriteBaker.safeZoneStationBitmap }
  val patrolShip1 = remember(customVer, visualRev) { RiftSpriteBaker.getShipSprite(1, isAllied = true, isHitFlashing = false) }
  val patrolShip2 = remember(customVer, visualRev) { RiftSpriteBaker.getShipSprite(5, isAllied = true, isHitFlashing = false) }
  val patrolShip3 = remember(customVer, visualRev) { RiftSpriteBaker.getShipSprite(9, isAllied = false, isHitFlashing = false) }
  val shipMatrix = remember { Matrix() }
  val stationRect = remember { RectF() }

  Box(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
        .background(Color(0xFF040A16))
        .border(1.dp, Color(0x3838BDF8), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
        .padding(6.dp),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
    Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxHeight().aspectRatio(1f, matchHeightConstraintsFirst = true)) {
      val w = size.width
      val h = size.height
      if (w <= 8f || h <= 8f) return@Canvas
      val cx = w * 0.5f
      val cy = h * 0.5f
      val center = Offset(cx, cy)
      val apertureR = (min(w, h) * 0.41f).coerceAtLeast(36f)
      val timeSec = (orbitPhaseRad / (2f * PI.toFloat())) * 9.6f

      // 1. Deep Safe-Harbor abyssal space inside the circular Overwatch aperture
      drawCircle(
        brush =
          Brush.radialGradient(
            colors = listOf(Color(0xFF0A1D3B), Color(0xFF050E20), Color(0xFF020611)),
            center = center,
            radius = apertureR,
          ),
        radius = apertureR,
        center = center,
      )

      // Subtle tactical polar radar rings & crosshairs
      val gridColor = Color(0xFF38BDF8).copy(alpha = 0.14f)
      drawCircle(gridColor, radius = apertureR * 0.42f, center = center, style = Stroke(width = 1.dp.toPx()))
      drawCircle(gridColor, radius = apertureR * 0.72f, center = center, style = Stroke(width = 1.dp.toPx()))
      drawLine(gridColor, Offset(cx - apertureR * 0.92f, cy), Offset(cx + apertureR * 0.92f, cy), strokeWidth = 0.9.dp.toPx())
      drawLine(gridColor, Offset(cx, cy - apertureR * 0.92f), Offset(cx, cy + apertureR * 0.92f), strokeWidth = 0.9.dp.toPx())

      // 8 Radial Cyan/Gold Safe-Zone Stabilizer Beams bracing the Safe Harbor perimeter
      val safeShieldR = apertureR * 0.86f
      for (b in 0 until 8) {
        val bAng = (b * PI * 0.25).toFloat() + sin(orbitPhaseRad) * 0.02f
        val innerPt = Offset(cx + cos(bAng) * (apertureR * 0.22f), cy + sin(bAng) * (apertureR * 0.22f))
        val outerPt = Offset(cx + cos(bAng) * safeShieldR, cy + sin(bAng) * safeShieldR)
        drawLine(
          brush =
            Brush.linearGradient(
              listOf(Color(0x99FACC15), Color(0xAA00F5D4), Color(0x2238BDF8)),
              start = innerPt,
              end = outerPt,
            ),
          start = innerPt,
          end = outerPt,
          strokeWidth = 1.6.dp.toPx(),
          cap = StrokeCap.Round,
        )
      }
      drawCircle(
        color = Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.55f),
        radius = safeShieldR,
        center = center,
        style = Stroke(width = 1.6.dp.toPx()),
      )

      // 2. Real 5x Nexus Station Sprite + Revolving Ops Holo-Ring + 3 Real 128x128 Patrol Ships
      val stationR = apertureR * 0.34f
      val patrolSpecs =
        arrayOf(
          Triple(patrolShip1, apertureR * 0.58f, orbitPhaseRad),
          Triple(patrolShip2, apertureR * 0.73f, -orbitPhaseRad * 1.0f + 2.15f),
          Triple(patrolShip3, apertureR * 0.66f, orbitPhaseRad * 1.0f + 4.20f),
        )

      // Draw curved cyan/gold thruster wakes first (under hulls)
      patrolSpecs.forEachIndexed { idx, (_, orbitR, angRad) ->
        val dirSign = if (idx == 1) -1f else 1f
        val trailColor = if (idx == 2) Color(0xFFFACC15) else Color(0xFF00F5D4)
        val segments = 8
        for (s in 0 until segments) {
          val a0 = angRad - dirSign * (s * 0.065f)
          val a1 = angRad - dirSign * ((s + 1) * 0.065f)
          val frac = 1f - (s / segments.toFloat())
          drawLine(
            color = trailColor.copy(alpha = 0.58f * frac),
            start = Offset(cx + cos(a0) * orbitR, cy + sin(a0) * orbitR),
            end = Offset(cx + cos(a1) * orbitR, cy + sin(a1) * orbitR),
            strokeWidth = (3.4f * frac).dp.toPx(),
            cap = StrokeCap.Round,
          )
        }
      }

      drawIntoCanvas { composeCanvas ->
        val nc = composeCanvas.nativeCanvas
        // Center 5x Nexus Station
        nc.save()
        nc.translate(cx, cy)
        nc.rotate((orbitPhaseRad * 180f / PI.toFloat()) * 0.25f)
        stationRect.set(-stationR, -stationR, stationR, stationR)
        nc.drawBitmap(stationBmp, null, stationRect, null)
        nc.restore()

        // Shrunk 3D-tilted revolving cyan/gold Ops Holo-Ring
        RiftSpriteBaker.drawSafeZoneStationHoloRing(
          c = nc,
          cx = cx,
          cy = cy,
          stationRadius = stationR,
          timeSec = timeSec,
          isLockedOut = false,
          alphaScale = 1f,
        )

        // 3 Real 128x128 Ship Sprites banking along orbital patrol arcs
        val shipRenderSize = (apertureR * 0.22f).coerceAtLeast(18f)
        patrolSpecs.forEachIndexed { idx, (bmp, orbitR, angRad) ->
          val dirSign = if (idx == 1) -1f else 1f
          val sx = cx + cos(angRad) * orbitR
          val sy = cy + sin(angRad) * orbitR
          // Tangent heading (+ slight inward bank toward station)
          val headingRad = angRad + dirSign * (PI.toFloat() * 0.5f) - dirSign * 0.12f
          val halfBmp = bmp.width * 0.5f
          val drawScale = shipRenderSize / bmp.width.toFloat()
          shipMatrix.reset()
          shipMatrix.postTranslate(-halfBmp, -halfBmp)
          shipMatrix.postScale(drawScale, drawScale)
          shipMatrix.postRotate(headingRad * 180f / PI.toFloat())
          shipMatrix.postTranslate(sx, sy)
          nc.drawBitmap(bmp, shipMatrix, null)
        }
      }

      // 3. Mask #060D1A tablet glass outside aperture & draw Round Rippling Polar Digitization Rings
      val outerMask =
        Path().apply {
          fillType = PathFillType.EvenOdd
          addRect(Rect(0f, 0f, w, h))
          addOval(Rect(cx - apertureR, cy - apertureR, cx + apertureR, cy + apertureR))
        }
      drawPath(outerMask, color = Color(0xFF060D1A))

      val numBands = 6
      val numSegs = 40
      val segSweepDeg = 360f / numSegs.toFloat()
      val segGapDeg = 1.5f
      val borderSw = 0.9.dp.toPx()

      for (band in 0 until numBands) {
        val outerFrac = 1.20f - band * 0.038f
        val innerFrac = outerFrac - 0.032f
        val rMid = apertureR * ((outerFrac + innerFrac) * 0.5f)
        val bandThickness = (apertureR * (outerFrac - innerFrac)).coerceAtLeast(1.4f)
        val arcRect = Rect(cx - rMid, cy - rMid, cx + rMid, cy + rMid)
        val keepThreshold = 1.0f - band * 0.16f

        for (seg in 0 until numSegs) {
          val hash = ((band * 73856093) xor (seg * 19349663)) and 0xFF
          val normHash = hash / 255f
          val segAng = ((seg + 0.5f) / numSegs.toFloat()) * (2f * PI.toFloat())
          val inwardWave = 0.5f + 0.5f * sin(band * 0.95f - orbitPhaseRad * 3.0f + sin(segAng * 3f) * 0.5f)
          if (normHash > keepThreshold + inwardWave * 0.12f) continue

          val startDeg = seg * segSweepDeg + segGapDeg * 0.5f
          val sweepDeg = (segSweepDeg - segGapDeg).coerceAtLeast(1.2f)
          val cyanLit = (0.5f + 0.5f * cos(segAng - orbitPhaseRad)).pow(2.0f)
          val goldLit = (0.5f + 0.5f * cos(segAng + orbitPhaseRad * 0.7f - 1.8f)).pow(2.4f)
          val litAlpha = ((0.18f + 0.52f * cyanLit + 0.38f * goldLit) * inwardWave).coerceIn(0.08f, 0.82f)
          val cellColor = if (goldLit > cyanLit * 1.06f) Color(0xFFFACC15) else Color(0xFF00F5D4)

          drawArc(
            color = cellColor.copy(alpha = litAlpha * (1f - band * 0.10f).coerceAtLeast(0.25f)),
            startAngle = startDeg,
            sweepAngle = sweepDeg,
            useCenter = false,
            topLeft = arcRect.topLeft,
            size = arcRect.size,
            style = Stroke(width = if (band >= 4) borderSw * 1.2f else borderSw, cap = StrokeCap.Butt),
          )
        }
      }

      rotate(degrees = (orbitPhaseRad * 180f / PI.toFloat())) {
        drawCircle(
          brush =
            Brush.sweepGradient(
              0.00f to Color(0xFF00F5D4),
              0.25f to Color(0xFF38BDF8).copy(alpha = 0.48f),
              0.50f to Color(0xFFFACC15),
              0.75f to Color(0xFF1E293B).copy(alpha = 0.50f),
              1.00f to Color(0xFF00F5D4),
              center = center,
            ),
          radius = apertureR,
          center = center,
          style = Stroke(width = 1.7.dp.toPx()),
        )
      }
    }

    // Compact live telemetry label pinned at bottom of showcase
    Box(
      modifier =
        Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
          .padding(bottom = 4.dp)
          .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
          .background(Color(0xE6060D1A))
          .border(0.9.dp, Color(0x8800F5D4), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
          .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 2.5.dp)
    ) {
      Text(
        text = "RIFT STATION • LIVE SAFE HARBOR",
        color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
        fontSize = 8.8.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        maxLines = 1,
      )
    }
  }
}

        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
      )
    }
  }

private val CodexMono = FontFamily.Monospace

private fun cleanCodexCopy(raw: String): String =
  raw
    .replace("\u26A1", "Flux")
    .replace("\u2696\uFE0F", "")
    .replace("\u2696", "")
    .replace("\uFE0F", "")

@Composable
private fun VectorCodexEmblem(accent: Color, sizeDp: Dp = 16.dp) {
  val hexPath = remember { Path() }
  Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size(sizeDp)) {
    val cx = size.width * 0.5f
    val cy = size.height * 0.5f
    val r = size.minDimension * 0.44f
    hexPath.reset()
    hexPath.moveTo(cx, cy - r)
    hexPath.lineTo(cx + r * 0.86f, cy - r * 0.5f)
    hexPath.lineTo(cx + r * 0.86f, cy + r * 0.5f)
    hexPath.lineTo(cx, cy + r)
    hexPath.lineTo(cx - r * 0.86f, cy + r * 0.5f)
    hexPath.lineTo(cx - r * 0.86f, cy - r * 0.5f)
    hexPath.close()
    drawPath(hexPath, accent.copy(alpha = 0.18f))
    drawPath(hexPath, accent, style = Stroke(width = 1.3.dp.toPx()))
    drawLine(
      color = Color.White,
      start = Offset(cx - r * 0.42f, cy),
      end = Offset(cx + r * 0.42f, cy),
      strokeWidth = 1.2.dp.toPx(),
      cap = StrokeCap.Round,
    )
  }
}

@Composable
private fun VectorSwirlDeckGlyph(accent: Color, sizeDp: Dp = 11.dp) {
  Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size(sizeDp)) {
    val cx = size.width * 0.5f
    val cy = size.height * 0.5f
    val r = size.minDimension * 0.42f
    drawArc(
      color = accent,
      startAngle = 20f,
      sweepAngle = 140f,
      useCenter = false,
      topLeft = Offset(cx - r, cy - r),
      size = Size(r * 2f, r * 2f),
      style = Stroke(width = 1.4.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
    )
    drawArc(
      color = Color.White,
      startAngle = 200f,
      sweepAngle = 140f,
      useCenter = false,
      topLeft = Offset(cx - r * 0.72f, cy - r * 0.72f),
      size = Size(r * 1.44f, r * 1.44f),
      style = Stroke(width = 1.2.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
    )
  }
}

@Composable
private fun VectorHullChevronGlyph(accent: Color, sizeDp: Dp = 11.dp) {
  val hullPath = remember { Path() }
  Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size(sizeDp)) {
    val w = size.width
    val h = size.height
    hullPath.reset()
    hullPath.moveTo(w * 0.88f, h * 0.50f)
    hullPath.lineTo(w * 0.16f, h * 0.16f)
    hullPath.lineTo(w * 0.34f, h * 0.50f)
    hullPath.lineTo(w * 0.16f, h * 0.84f)
    hullPath.close()
    drawPath(hullPath, accent.copy(alpha = 0.28f))
    drawPath(hullPath, accent, style = Stroke(width = 1.2.dp.toPx()))
  }
}

            }
          }
        }

      1 -> {

          modifier =
            Modifier.weight(1f)

        ) {

              CodexHighlightCard(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                title = "45S RIFT CYCLES",
                body =
                  "Playfield Rifts relocate every 45s outside the Safe Zone and never spawn inside Stasis Breach Jails or Rift Control rings.",
                bgColor = Color(0xFF1B102E),
                borderColor = Color(0xFFA855F7),
                bodyColor = Color(0xFFE9D5FF),
                isCompactPhone = isCompactPhone,

              CodexHighlightCard(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                title = "MAX GRAVITY & UNSTABLE RIFT",
                body =
                  "0.92x swept weapon absorption swells Gravity Rifts up to 440px; at >= 260px they drag & implode Asteroids/Stations (950/s crush + 360° Nova). Any 2 overlapping Rifts (incl. Phase Rifts) fuse into a calm 10.0s Unstable Rift that insta-kills outside Safe Zone (-25 RES).",
                bgColor = Color(0xFF0A2229),

              CodexHighlightCard(

                borderColor = Color(0xFFEF4444),

          item(key = "safe_zone_ds9_and_sector_obstacles") {

          items(RiftCodex.RIFT_ANOMALIES_CODEX, key = { it.id }) { rift ->

              )
              Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Row(
                  modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                ) {
                  Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                  ) {
                    Text(
                      text = cleanCodexCopy(rift.title),
                      color = accentColor,
                      fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 12.2.sp else 13.8.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                      fontFamily = CodexSans,
                    )
                    Box(
                      modifier =
                        Modifier.background(Color(0x22FFFFFF), RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                          .padding(horizontal = 5.dp, vertical = 2.dp)

                      Text(
                        text = cleanCodexCopy(rift.classification),
                        color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
                        fontSize = 9.0.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontFamily = CodexMono,
                      )
                    }
                  }
                  Box(
                    modifier =
                      Modifier.background(accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.16f), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                        .border(1.dp, accentColor, RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                        .padding(horizontal = 7.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                  ) {
                    Text(
                      text = cleanCodexCopy(rift.specBadge),
                      color = accentColor,
                      fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.5.sp else 10.2.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                      fontFamily = CodexMono,
                    )
                  }
                }
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(3.dp))
                Text(
                  text = cleanCodexCopy(rift.effectSummary),
                  color = Color.White,
                  fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 10.2.sp else 11.4.sp,
                  lineHeight = if (isCompactPhone) 13.5.sp else 15.sp,
                )
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
                Text(
                  text = "TACTICAL: ${cleanCodexCopy(rift.tacticalNote)}",
                  color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
                  fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.8.sp else 10.5.sp,
                  lineHeight = if (isCompactPhone) 12.8.sp else 14.sp,
                )
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      else -> {
        LazyColumn(
          modifier =
            Modifier.weight(1f)
              .fillMaxWidth()
              .background(Color(0xFF081426), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
              .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF1B3454), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
              .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 8.dp)
              .testTag("codex_ships_matrix_list"),
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 8.dp),
        ) {
          item(key = "hull_matrix_header") {
            Row(
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 5.dp else 8.dp),
            ) {
              CodexHighlightCard(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                title = "ALL 10 HULLS OPEN AT 0 RESONANCE",
                body =
                  "Viper (#1) through Eclipse (#9) and modular Rift Frame (#10) are immediately playable from 0 Resonance.",
                bgColor = Color(0xFF082032),
                borderColor = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
                bodyColor = Color(0xFFE0F2FE),
                isCompactPhone = isCompactPhone,
              )
              CodexHighlightCard(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                title = "STRICT 100-POINT COMPETITIVE PARITY",
                body =
                  "Every signature hull and Rift Frame bay (Frame A–E) distributes an identical 100-Point stat & ordnance budget.",
                bgColor = Color(0xFF1E1035),
                borderColor = Color(0xFFC084FC),
                bodyColor = Color(0xFFF3E8FF),
                isCompactPhone = isCompactPhone,
              )
              CodexHighlightCard(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                title = "HELM TWIN-STICK REMAPPER",
                body =
                  "Customize hardware gamepad binds, camera FOV, and HUD layout anytime inside HELM SYSTEMS.",
                bgColor = Color(0xFF092318),
                borderColor = Color(0xFF34D399),
                bodyColor = Color(0xFFD1FAE5),
                isCompactPhone = isCompactPhone,
              )
            }
          }

          items(shipPairs, key = { pair -> pair.first().id }) { pair ->
            Row(
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 8.dp),
            ) {
              pair.forEach { ship ->
                CodexHullReferenceCard(
                  ship = ship,
                  spriteVersion = spriteVersion,
                  isCompactPhone = isCompactPhone,
                  modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                )
              }
              if (pair.size == 1) {
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Dedicated Safe-Zone `Nexus Station` & Sector Obstacles reference card inside the Playfield Rifts tab.
 * Renders the live `RiftSpriteBaker.safeZoneStationBitmap` (`5x` ship-scale `180px` Nexus Station)
 * + revolving Ops Holo-Ring alongside exact Safe Harbor, `2,400` Flux Crystal Asteroid, and `10`-Hit Station Nova rules.
 */
@Composable
private fun SafeZoneAndSectorObstaclesCard(
  isCompactPhone: Boolean,
  visualRev: Int,
) {
  val headless = remember { isHeadlessGlEnvironment() }
  val spinPhase =
    if (headless) {
      0.6f
    } else {
      val transition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "codex_nexus_station_spin")
      val p by
        transition.animateFloat(
          initialValue = 0f,
          targetValue = 1f,
          animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(9000, easing = LinearEasing), RepeatMode.Restart),
          label = "nexus_station_spin_frac",
        )
      p
    }
  val stationBmp = remember(visualRev) { RiftSpriteBaker.safeZoneStationBitmap }
  val stationRect = remember { RectF() }
  val previewSizeDp = if (isCompactPhone) 62 else 74

  Row(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
        .background(Color(0xFF0B1C34), RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
        .border(
          1.2.dp,
          Brush.horizontalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF00F5D4), Color(0xFFFACC15), Color(0xFF38BDF8))),
          RoundedCornerShape(9.dp),
        )
        .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 10.dp)
        .testTag("codex_safe_zone_ds9_card"),
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 10.dp else 12.dp),
  ) {
    Box(
      modifier =
        Modifier.size(previewSizeDp.dp)
          .clip(RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
          .background(Color(0xFF030814))
          .border(1.4.dp, Color(0xFF00F5D4), RoundedCornerShape(9.dp)),
      contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
      Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(3.dp)) {
        val cx = size.width * 0.5f
        val cy = size.height * 0.5f
        val shieldR = size.minDimension * 0.47f
        val stationR = size.minDimension * 0.38f
        val timeSec = spinPhase * 9.0f

        for (b in 0 until 8) {
          val ang = (b * PI * 0.25).toFloat()
          drawLine(
            color = Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.42f),
            start = Offset(cx + cos(ang) * (stationR * 0.45f), cy + sin(ang) * (stationR * 0.45f)),
            end = Offset(cx + cos(ang) * shieldR, cy + sin(ang) * shieldR),
            strokeWidth = 1.1.dp.toPx(),
          )
        }
        drawCircle(
          color = Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.55f),
          radius = shieldR,
          center = Offset(cx, cy),
          style = Stroke(width = 1.2.dp.toPx()),
        )
        drawIntoCanvas { composeCanvas ->
          val nc = composeCanvas.nativeCanvas
          nc.save()
          nc.translate(cx, cy)
          nc.rotate(spinPhase * 360f)
          stationRect.set(-stationR, -stationR, stationR, stationR)
          nc.drawBitmap(stationBmp, null, stationRect, null)
          nc.restore()
          RiftSpriteBaker.drawSafeZoneStationHoloRing(
            c = nc,
            cx = cx,
            cy = cy,
            stationRadius = stationR,
            timeSec = timeSec,
            isLockedOut = false,
            alphaScale = 1f,
          )
        }
      }
    }

    Column(
      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp),
    ) {
      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      ) {
        Row(
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
          modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "NEXUS STATION SAFE HARBOR & SECTOR OBSTACLES",
            color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
            fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 11.8.sp else 13.5.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
            fontFamily = CodexSans,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          )
          Box(
            modifier =
              Modifier.background(Color(0x26FACC15), RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                .padding(horizontal = 5.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
          ) {
            Text(
              text = "STAR FORGE LIVE",
              color = Color(0xFFFACC15),
              fontSize = 8.8.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = CodexMono,
            )
          }
        }
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.background(Color(0x2200F5D4), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
              .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF00F5D4), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
              .padding(horizontal = 7.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "5X SHIP (180px) • 15S STAY",
            color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
            fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.2.sp else 10.0.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = CodexMono,
          )
        }
      }

      Text(
        text =
          "SAFE HARBOR (SECTOR CONVERGENCE & FLUX CORE ONLY): Anchored by a 5x ship-scale (180px radius) Nexus Station with a revolving cyan/gold Ops Holo-Ring & radial stabilizer beams (editable in STAR FORGE). Weapons are locked inside; exceeding the 15s max stay or firing in combat triggers a 15s Safe-Zone lockout (ejects Flux Core at 1,650 px/s).",
        color = Color.White,
        fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 10.0.sp else 11.2.sp,
        lineHeight = if (isCompactPhone) 13.2.sp else 14.8.sp,
      )
      Text(
        text =
          "OBSTACLES & STATION NOVAS: Crystal Asteroids have 2,400 Flux integrity, drop a guaranteed Supply Crate on shatter, and respawn in 20.0s. Orbital & Asteroid Stations charge a 10-segment ring and unleash a 16-bolt 360° Defense Nova every 10 hits (or when imploded by a >= 260px Gravity Rift).",
        color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
        fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.8.sp else 10.5.sp,
        lineHeight = if (isCompactPhone) 12.8.sp else 14.0.sp,
      )
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun CodexSupplyBuffCard(
  entry: PowerUpCodexEntry,
  isCompactPhone: Boolean,
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
  val buffType = entry.buffTypeIndex
  val accentColor =
    when (buffType) {
      0 -> Color(0xFFF59E0B)
      1 -> Color(0xFFFB7185)
      2 -> Color(0xFFEF4444)
      3 -> Color(0xFF38BDF8)
      4 -> Color(0xFF22D3EE)
      5 -> Color(0xFFA855F7)
      6 -> Color(0xFF10B981)
      7 -> Color(0xFF60A5FA)
      8 -> Color(0xFFFACC15)
      9 -> Color(0xFFC084FC)
      11 -> Color(0xFF00F5D4)
      12 -> Color(0xFF34D399)
      13 -> Color(0xFFFACC15)
      14 -> Color(0xFFA855F7)
      15 -> Color(0xFFF59E0B)
      -10 -> Color(0xFF38BDF8)
      -11 -> Color(0xFFF59E0B)
      -12 -> Color(0xFF10B981)
      else -> Color(0xFF38BDF8)
    }

  Row(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .background(Color(0xFF0E1F38), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
        .border(1.dp, accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.50f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
        .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 7.dp else 9.dp),
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 10.dp),
  ) {
    BuffIconPreview(
      buffType = buffType,
      sizeDp = if (isCompactPhone) 42 else 48,
      accentColor = accentColor,
    )
    Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      ) {
        Text(
          text = cleanCodexCopy(entry.title),
          color = accentColor,
          fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 10.8.sp else 11.8.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = CodexSans,
          maxLines = 1,
          overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).padding(end = 4.dp),
        )
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.background(Color(0x26FFD700), RoundedCornerShape(5.dp))
              .border(1.dp, Color(0xFFFFD700), RoundedCornerShape(5.dp))
              .padding(horizontal = 5.dp, vertical = 1.5.dp)
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "${entry.dropRatePercent}%",
            color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
            fontSize = 9.0.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = CodexMono,
          )
        }
      }
      Text(
        text = cleanCodexCopy(entry.effectSummary),
        color = Color.White,
        fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.8.sp else 10.6.sp,
        lineHeight = if (isCompactPhone) 12.4.sp else 13.6.sp,
        maxLines = 3,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
      )
      Text(
        text = "TACTICAL: ${cleanCodexCopy(entry.tacticalNote)}",
        color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
        fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.4.sp else 10.0.sp,
        lineHeight = if (isCompactPhone) 11.8.sp else 13.0.sp,
        maxLines = 2,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
      )
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun CodexHullReferenceCard(
  ship: ShipSpec,
  spriteVersion: Int,
  isCompactPhone: Boolean,
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
  val isModularFrame = ship.id == 10
  val accentColor = if (isModularFrame) Color(0xFFEC4899) else Color(ship.accentColorHex)
  val shipBmp =
    remember(ship.id, spriteVersion) {
      RiftSpriteBaker.getShipSprite(ship.id, isAllied = true, isHitFlashing = false).asImageBitmap()
    }
  val displayName =
    if (isModularFrame) "RIFT FRAME (MODULAR)"
    else ship.name.replace(Regex("^[0-9]+-"), "").uppercase(Locale.US)

  val secondaryDisplay =
    when {
      ship.id == 9 -> "Stasis (320 Flux • 6.0s • 275px • 8.5s CD)"
      ship.id == 6 -> "Cloak (36 Flux/s • 4.5s CD) + 0-Flux Decloak EMP"
      ship.id == 1 -> "Phase Dash (320 Flux • +35% Rail Overcharge)"
      ship.supportsNativeMultifire && !ship.hasBomb -> "Native Split Multi-Shot Toggle (0 Extra Flux)"
      else -> cleanCodexCopy(ship.secondaryTitle)
    }

  Column(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .background(Color(0xFF0E1F38), RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
        .border(1.dp, accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.55f), RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
        .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 7.dp else 9.dp)
        .testTag("codex_hull_card_${ship.id}"),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
  ) {
    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
    ) {
      Row(
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
      ) {
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.size(if (isCompactPhone) 40.dp else 46.dp)
              .background(Color(0xFF040914), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .border(1.dp, accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.65f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)),
          contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
          Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            drawCircle(
              brush = Brush.radialGradient(listOf(accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.35f), Color.Transparent)),
              radius = size.minDimension * 0.48f,
            )
          }
          Image(
            bitmap = shipBmp,
            contentDescription = displayName,
            filterQuality = FilterQuality.High,
            modifier = Modifier.size(if (isCompactPhone) 34.dp else 38.dp),
          )
        }
        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
          Text(
            text = "#${ship.id} $displayName",
            color = Color.White,
            fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 11.4.sp else 12.8.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = CodexSans,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          )
          Text(
            text = ship.role.uppercase(Locale.US),
            color = accentColor,
            fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.6.sp else 10.4.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = CodexSans,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          )
        }
      }
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.background(Color(0xFF06281E), RoundedCornerShape(5.dp))
            .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF10B981), RoundedCornerShape(5.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "0 RES • 100 PTS",
          color = Color(0xFF34D399),
          fontSize = 8.6.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = CodexMono,
        )
      }
    }

    Row(
      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
          .background(Color(0xFF060E1C), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
          .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
      HullStatChip("SPD", ship.speedPts, Color(0xFF38BDF8))
      HullStatChip("THR", ship.thrustPts, Color(0xFFF59E0B))
      HullStatChip("TRN", ship.turnPts, Color(0xFFEC4899))
      HullStatChip("FLX", ship.maxFluxPts, Color(0xFF00F5D4))
      HullStatChip("RCH", ship.rechargePts, Color(0xFF10B981))
    }

    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
      Text(
        text =
          "PRI (${ship.primaryPts}P): ${cleanCodexCopy(ship.primaryTitle)} • ${ship.primaryDamage.toInt()} DMG • ${ship.primaryCost.toInt()} Flux",
        color = Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
        fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.6.sp else 10.2.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = CodexMono,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
      )
      Text(
        text = "SEC (${ship.secondaryPts}P): $secondaryDisplay",
        color = Color(0xFFFBBF24),
        fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.6.sp else 10.2.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = CodexMono,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
      )
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun HullStatChip(label: String, pts: Int, accent: Color) {
  Row(
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp),
  ) {
    Text(
      text = label,
      color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
      fontSize = 8.4.sp,
      fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
      fontFamily = CodexMono,
    )
    Box(
      modifier =
        Modifier.size(width = 18.dp, height = 4.dp)
          .clip(RoundedCornerShape(2.dp))
          .background(Color(0xFF1E293B))
    ) {
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxHeight()
            .fillMaxWidth((0.12f + (pts.coerceIn(0, 30) / 30f) * 0.88f).coerceIn(0f, 1f))
            .background(accent, RoundedCornerShape(2.dp))
      )
    }
    Text(
      text = "$pts",
      color = Color.White,
      fontSize = 8.8.sp,
      fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
      fontFamily = CodexMono,
    )
  }
}

@Composable
private fun CodexTabPill(
  label: String,
  glyphMode: Int,
  selected: Boolean,
  accentColor: Color,
  testTag: String,
  onClick: () -> Unit,
) {
  Box(
    modifier =
      Modifier.height(29.dp)
        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
        .background(
          if (selected) {
            Brush.verticalGradient(
              listOf(accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.34f), accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.16f))
            )
          } else {
            Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF0A1424), Color(0xFF060C16)))
          }
        )
        .border(1.dp, if (selected) accentColor else Color(0xFF1E293B), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
        .clickable(onClick = onClick)
        .padding(horizontal = 9.dp)
        .testTag(testTag),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
    Row(
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
    ) {
      when (glyphMode) {
        0 -> FluxEmblem(sizeDp = 10.dp)
        1 -> VectorSwirlDeckGlyph(accent = accentColor, sizeDp = 10.dp)
        else -> VectorHullChevronGlyph(accent = accentColor, sizeDp = 10.dp)
      }
      Text(
        text = label,
        color = if (selected) Color.White else Color(0xFF94A3B8),
        fontSize = 9.8.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
        fontFamily = CodexMono,
        maxLines = 1,
      )
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun CodexHighlightCard(
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
  title: String,
  body: String,
  bgColor: Color,
  borderColor: Color,
  bodyColor: Color,
  isCompactPhone: Boolean,
) {
  Box(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .background(bgColor, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
        .border(1.dp, borderColor, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
        .padding(
          horizontal = if (isCompactPhone) 7.dp else 10.dp,
          vertical = if (isCompactPhone) 5.dp else 7.dp,
        )
  ) {
    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
      Text(
        text = title,
        color = borderColor,
        fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.8.sp else 10.8.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = CodexMono,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
      )
      Text(
        text = body,
        color = bodyColor,
        fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.5.sp else 10.2.sp,
        lineHeight = if (isCompactPhone) 12.2.sp else 13.6.sp,
        maxLines = if (isCompactPhone) 4 else 5,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
      )
    }
  }
}

@Composable
fun RiftAnomalyIconPreview(riftId: String, sizeDp: Int, accentColor: Color) {
  val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "codex_rift_preview_$riftId")
  val spinAngle by
    infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
      initialValue = 0f,
      targetValue = (2.0 * PI).toFloat(),
      animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(3600, easing = LinearEasing), RepeatMode.Restart),
      label = "rift_spin_angle",
    )
  val pulsePhase by
    infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
      initialValue = 0f,
      targetValue = 1f,
      animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(1600, easing = LinearEasing), RepeatMode.Restart),
      label = "rift_pulse_phase",
    )
  val linkPath = remember { Path() }

  Box(
    modifier =
      Modifier.size(sizeDp.dp)
        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
        .background(Color(0xFF030712))
        .border(1.5.dp, accentColor, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
    Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(3.dp)) {
      val w = size.width
      val h = size.height
      val minDim = size.minDimension
      val cx = w * 0.5f
      val cy = h * 0.5f
      if (riftId == "phase_rift" || riftId == "phase_rift_pair") {
        val ax = w * 0.33f
        val ay = h * 0.35f
        val bx = w * 0.68f
        val by = h * 0.66f
        val midX = (ax + bx) * 0.5f + sin(spinAngle * 2f) * (minDim * 0.06f)
        val midY = (ay + by) * 0.5f - sin(spinAngle * 2f) * (minDim * 0.06f)
        linkPath.reset()
        linkPath.moveTo(ax, ay)
        linkPath.quadraticTo(midX, midY, bx, by)
        drawPath(
          linkPath,
          Brush.linearGradient(
            listOf(Color(0x662DD4BF), Color(0x6638BDF8)),
            Offset(ax, ay),
            Offset(bx, by),
          ),
          style = Stroke(width = 4.0.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
        )
        drawPath(
          linkPath,
          Brush.linearGradient(
            listOf(Color(0xFF2DD4BF), Color(0xFF38BDF8)),
            Offset(ax, ay),
            Offset(bx, by),
          ),
          style = Stroke(width = 1.6.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
        )
      }

      drawIntoCanvas { composeCanvas ->
        val nc = composeCanvas.nativeCanvas
        when (riftId) {
          "plasma_rift" ->
            RiftSpriteBaker.draw3dPlayfieldRift(
              nc,
              cx,
              cy,
              minDim * 0.38f,
              spinAngle,
              android.graphics.Color.rgb(239, 68, 68),
              android.graphics.Color.rgb(217, 70, 239),
              android.graphics.Color.rgb(255, 228, 230),
              darkVoidCenter = false,
              inwardSpiral = false,
              pulsePhaseOverride = pulsePhase,
            )
          "repulsor_rift" ->
            RiftSpriteBaker.draw3dPlayfieldRift(
              nc,
              cx,
              cy,
              minDim * 0.38f,
              -spinAngle * 1.15f,
              android.graphics.Color.rgb(56, 189, 248),
              android.graphics.Color.rgb(186, 230, 253),
              android.graphics.Color.rgb(255, 255, 255),
              darkVoidCenter = false,
              inwardSpiral = false,
              pulsePhaseOverride = pulsePhase,
            )
          "gravity_rift" -> {
            val gravR = minDim * 0.38f
            RiftSpriteBaker.draw3dPlayfieldRift(
              nc,
              cx,
              cy,
              gravR,
              spinAngle * 1.35f,
              android.graphics.Color.rgb(168, 85, 247),
              android.graphics.Color.rgb(99, 102, 241),
              android.graphics.Color.rgb(233, 213, 255),
              darkVoidCenter = true,
              inwardSpiral = true,
              pulsePhaseOverride = pulsePhase,
            )
            for (cIdx in 0 until 3) {
              val ang = -spinAngle * 1.4f + cIdx * (2f * PI.toFloat() / 3f)
              val dist = gravR * (0.48f + 0.24f * (1f - pulsePhase))
              val px = cx + kotlin.math.cos(ang) * dist
              val py = cy + kotlin.math.sin(ang) * dist
              RiftSpriteBaker.drawReactiveFilamentStrand(
                canvas = nc,
                x0 = cx + kotlin.math.cos(ang - 0.35f) * (gravR * 0.84f),
                y0 = cy + kotlin.math.sin(ang - 0.35f) * (gravR * 0.84f),
                ctrlX = cx + kotlin.math.cos(ang - 0.16f) * (gravR * 0.66f),
                ctrlY = cy + kotlin.math.sin(ang - 0.16f) * (gravR * 0.66f),
                x1 = px,
                y1 = py,
                thickness = (gravR * 0.055f).coerceAtLeast(1.1f),
                outerColor = android.graphics.Color.rgb(168, 85, 247),
                midColor = android.graphics.Color.rgb(0, 245, 212),
                coreColor = android.graphics.Color.rgb(250, 204, 21),
                alphaFrac = 0.82f,
              )
              RiftSpriteBaker.drawPrecipitateCrystalCluster(
                canvas = nc,
                cx = px,
                cy = py,
                radius = (gravR * 0.085f).coerceAtLeast(1.6f),
                angleRad = ang * 1.8f,
                primaryColor = android.graphics.Color.rgb(0, 245, 212),
                coreColor = android.graphics.Color.WHITE,
                alphaFrac = 0.88f,
                facetSeed = cIdx,
              )
            }
          }
          "unstable_rift" ->
            RiftSpriteBaker.drawUnstableMergedRiftOnCanvas(
              nc,
              cx,
              cy,
              minDim * 0.39f,
              spinAngle * 0.45f,
              pulsePhase,
            )
          else -> {
            val nodeR = minDim * 0.22f
            RiftSpriteBaker.draw3dPlayfieldRift(
              nc,
              w * 0.33f,
              h * 0.35f,
              nodeR,
              spinAngle,
              android.graphics.Color.rgb(45, 212, 191),
              android.graphics.Color.rgb(56, 189, 248),
              android.graphics.Color.rgb(240, 253, 250),
              darkVoidCenter = true,
              inwardSpiral = false,
              pulsePhaseOverride = pulsePhase,
            )
            RiftSpriteBaker.draw3dPlayfieldRift(
              nc,
              w * 0.68f,
              h * 0.66f,
              nodeR,
              -spinAngle,
              android.graphics.Color.rgb(56, 189, 248),
              android.graphics.Color.rgb(168, 85, 247),
              android.graphics.Color.rgb(240, 253, 250),
              darkVoidCenter = true,
              inwardSpiral = false,
              pulsePhaseOverride = pulsePhase,
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
