          center = center,
          style = Stroke(width = (18f - i * 3f).dp.toPx() * recipe.borderWeight),
        )
      }
    } else {
      drawCircle(
        brush =
          Brush.radialGradient(
            listOf(
              Color.White.copy(alpha = if (mode < 0.5f) 0.65f else 0.18f),
              tCol.copy(alpha = 0.52f * recipe.surfaceOpacity),
              pCol.copy(alpha = 0.72f * recipe.surfaceOpacity),
              Color.Transparent,
            ),
            center = center,
            radius = (radiusPx * 1.12f).coerceAtLeast(10f),
          ),
        radius = (radiusPx * 1.12f).coerceAtLeast(10f),
        center = center,
      )
      for (arm in 0 until 4) {
        drawArc(
          color = gCol.copy(alpha = 0.68f),
          startAngle = arm * 90f + timeSec * 42f * recipe.shaderTurbulence.coerceAtLeast(0.25f),
          sweepAngle = 58f,
          useCenter = false,
          topLeft = Offset(center.x - radiusPx * 0.88f, center.y - radiusPx * 0.88f),
          size = Size(radiusPx * 1.76f, radiusPx * 1.76f),
          style = Stroke(width = 2.2.dp.toPx() * recipe.borderWeight, cap = StrokeCap.Round),
        )
      }
    }
  }
  if (mode < 1.5f && radiusPx > 10f) {
    drawIntoCanvas { c ->
      val nc = c.nativeCanvas
      RiftSpriteBaker.drawLocalizedIngressPlumes(
        canvas = nc,
        cx = center.x,
        cy = center.y,
        outerRimR = radiusPx * 0.98f,
        innerReachR = radiusPx * 0.54f,
        plumeCount = 6,
        phaseRad = -timeSec * (0.55f + 0.35f * recipe.shaderTurbulence.coerceIn(0.1f, 2.0f)),
        outerColor = recipe.primaryColorInt,
        midColor = recipe.glowColorInt,
        coreColor = android.graphics.Color.WHITE,
        fadeAlpha = (recipe.surfaceOpacity * 0.84f).coerceIn(0.18f, 0.95f),
        swirlBias = 0.20f,
      )
      RiftSpriteBaker.drawRefractiveMeniscusRim(
        canvas = nc,
        cx = center.x,
        cy = center.y,
        rimRadius = radiusPx * 0.99f,
        throatRadius = if (mode < 0.5f) radiusPx * 0.28f else 0f,
        lightAngleRad = -2.28f + 0.07f * sin(timeSec * 0.8f),
        rimTintColor = recipe.glowColorInt,
        secondaryTintColor = recipe.trimColorInt,
        fadeAlpha = recipe.surfaceOpacity.coerceIn(0.25f, 1f),
        strokeScale = recipe.borderWeight.coerceIn(0.6f, 1.9f),
      )
    }
  }
}

private fun DrawScope.drawIsolatedTargetSpecimen(
  target: ForgeElementTarget,
  recipe: VisualElementRecipe,
  engine: RiftGameEngine,
  cx: Float,
  cy: Float,
  baseSpan: Float,
  timeSec: Float,
  vortexAgslShader: RuntimeShader?,
) {
  val span = (baseSpan * recipe.pixelScale).coerceAtLeast(18f)
  val spin = timeSec * (0.9f + 0.8f * recipe.shaderTurbulence)
  when (target) {
    ForgeElementTarget.SAFE_ZONE_PAD -> {
      drawCircle(Color(0xFF030917), span * 1.04f, Offset(cx, cy))
      drawCircle(
        Color(recipe.glowColorInt).copy(alpha = 0.28f),
        span * 1.04f,
        Offset(cx, cy),
        style = Stroke(2.0.dp.toPx() * recipe.borderWeight),
      )
      val stationR = span * 0.88f
      drawIntoCanvas { c ->
        val nc = c.nativeCanvas
        val bmp = RiftSpriteBaker.safeZoneStationBitmap
        nc.save()
        nc.translate(cx, cy)
        nc.rotate((timeSec * 12f) % 360f)
        nc.drawBitmap(
          bmp,
          null,
          android.graphics.RectF(-stationR, -stationR, stationR, stationR),
          null,
        )
        nc.restore()
        RiftSpriteBaker.drawSafeZoneStationHoloRing(
          c = nc,
          cx = cx,
          cy = cy,
          stationRadius = stationR,
          timeSec = timeSec,
          isLockedOut = false,
          alphaScale = recipe.surfaceOpacity,
        )
      }
    }
    ForgeElementTarget.SAFE_ZONE_WALL -> {
      drawShaderOrFallbackVortex(vortexAgslShader, 0f, Offset(cx, cy), span, timeSec, recipe)
      drawCircle(Color(recipe.trimColorInt), span, Offset(cx, cy), style = Stroke(2.6.dp.toPx() * recipe.borderWeight))
    }
    ForgeElementTarget.ARENA_PERIMETER_RING -> {
      drawShaderOrFallbackVortex(vortexAgslShader, 2f, Offset(cx, cy + span * 1.45f), span * 1.65f, timeSec, recipe)
    }
    ForgeElementTarget.ECLIPSE_STASIS_BUBBLE -> {
      drawShaderOrFallbackVortex(vortexAgslShader, 1f, Offset(cx, cy), span, timeSec, recipe)
    }
    ForgeElementTarget.OBSTACLE_ORBITAL_STATION,
    ForgeElementTarget.OBSTACLE_ASTEROID_STATION,
    ForgeElementTarget.OBSTACLE_SPACE_ASTEROID,
    ForgeElementTarget.OBSTACLE_FLOATING_DEBRIS -> {
      val type =
        when (target) {
          ForgeElementTarget.OBSTACLE_ORBITAL_STATION -> SpaceObstacleType.ORBITAL_STATION
          ForgeElementTarget.OBSTACLE_ASTEROID_STATION -> SpaceObstacleType.ASTEROID_STATION
          ForgeElementTarget.OBSTACLE_SPACE_ASTEROID -> SpaceObstacleType.CRYSTAL_ASTEROID
          else -> SpaceObstacleType.FLOATING_DEBRIS
        }
      drawIntoCanvas { c ->
        val bmp = RiftSpriteBaker.getSpaceObstacleBitmap(type, 0)
        c.nativeCanvas.drawBitmap(bmp, null, android.graphics.RectF(cx - span, cy - span, cx + span, cy + span), null)
      }
    }
    ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_PLASMA,
    ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_REPULSOR,
    ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_GRAVITY,
    ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_PHASE_PAIR -> {
      drawIntoCanvas { c ->
        val nc = c.nativeCanvas
        when (target) {
          ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_PLASMA -> RiftSpriteBaker.draw3dPlayfieldRift(nc, AnomalyType.PLASMA_RIFT, cx, cy, span, spin)
          ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_REPULSOR -> RiftSpriteBaker.draw3dPlayfieldRift(nc, AnomalyType.REPULSOR_RIFT, cx, cy, span, spin)
          ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_GRAVITY -> RiftSpriteBaker.draw3dPlayfieldRift(nc, AnomalyType.GRAVITY_RIFT, cx, cy, span, spin)
          else -> {
            RiftSpriteBaker.draw3dPlayfieldRift(nc, AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_A, cx - span * 0.55f, cy, span * 0.62f, spin)
            RiftSpriteBaker.draw3dPlayfieldRift(nc, AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_B, cx + span * 0.55f, cy, span * 0.62f, -spin)
          }
        }
      }
    }
    ForgeElementTarget.CURRENCY_FLUX_ICON -> {
      drawIntoCanvas { c -> RiftSpriteBaker.drawFluxPrismIcon(c.nativeCanvas, cx, cy, span * 0.72f, alpha = 255) }
    }
    ForgeElementTarget.CURRENCY_SHARD_ICON -> {
      drawIntoCanvas { c ->
        val bmp = RiftSpriteBaker.riftShardIconBitmap
        val r = span * 0.78f
        c.nativeCanvas.drawBitmap(bmp, null, android.graphics.RectF(cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r), null)
      }
    }
    ForgeElementTarget.PLACED_STASIS_BARRIER -> {
      drawLine(Color(recipe.glowColorInt).copy(alpha = 0.38f), Offset(cx - span, cy), Offset(cx + span, cy), 14.dp.toPx() * recipe.borderWeight, StrokeCap.Round)
      drawLine(Color(recipe.trimColorInt), Offset(cx - span, cy), Offset(cx + span, cy), 4.dp.toPx() * recipe.borderWeight, StrokeCap.Round)
      drawCircle(Color.White, 5.dp.toPx(), Offset(cx - span, cy))
      drawCircle(Color.White, 5.dp.toPx(), Offset(cx + span, cy))
    }
    ForgeElementTarget.SHIP_AURA_LABELS -> {
      drawIntoCanvas { c ->
        RiftSpriteBaker.drawMetallicShipOnCanvas(c.nativeCanvas, cx, cy, span * 0.58f, engine.localPlayer.spec, isAllied = true)
      }
      drawArc(
        Color(recipe.glowColorInt),
        -90f,
        285f,
        false,
        Offset(cx - span * 0.85f, cy - span * 0.85f),
        Size(span * 1.70f, span * 1.70f),
        style = Stroke(width = 3.dp.toPx() * recipe.borderWeight, cap = StrokeCap.Round),
      )
    }
    ForgeElementTarget.SUPPLY_CRATE -> {
      drawCircle(
        Color(recipe.glowColorInt).copy(alpha = (0.24f * recipe.glowIntensity).coerceIn(0.06f, 0.55f)),
        span * 1.02f,
        Offset(cx, cy),
      )
      drawIntoCanvas { c ->
        val nc = c.nativeCanvas
        val podBmp = RiftSpriteBaker.supplyPodFrameBitmap
        val podR = span * 0.88f
        val iconR = span * 0.60f
        nc.save()
        nc.translate(cx, cy)
        nc.rotate((timeSec * 36f) % 360f)
        nc.drawBitmap(podBmp, null, android.graphics.RectF(-podR, -podR, podR, podR), null)
        nc.restore()
        val buffBmp = RiftSpriteBaker.getBuffIconBitmap(0)
        nc.drawBitmap(buffBmp, null, android.graphics.RectF(cx - iconR, cy - iconR, cx + iconR, cy + iconR), null)
      }
    }
    ForgeElementTarget.FLUX_CORE_ORB -> {
      val corePulse = 0.5f + 0.5f * sin(timeSec * 3.0f)
      drawFluxCoreOrbSpecimen(
        center = Offset(cx, cy),
        radiusPx = (span * (0.74f + 0.06f * corePulse)).coerceAtLeast(16f),
        timeSec = timeSec,
        recipe = recipe,
      )
    }
    else -> {
      val fill = Color(recipe.primaryColorInt).copy(alpha = recipe.surfaceOpacity.coerceIn(0.2f, 0.98f))
      val trim = Color(recipe.trimColorInt)
      val glow = Color(recipe.glowColorInt)
      val isRound =
        target in
          setOf(
            ForgeElementTarget.STASIS_BRIG_JAIL,
            ForgeElementTarget.PROJECTILE_PROXIMITY_MINE,
            ForgeElementTarget.HUD_NEXUS_BUTTON,
            ForgeElementTarget.HUD_MINIMAP_CONSOLE,
            ForgeElementTarget.HUD_LEFT_STICK,
            ForgeElementTarget.HUD_FIRE_STICK,
            ForgeElementTarget.HUD_SECONDARY_BTN,
            ForgeElementTarget.HUD_SPECIAL_BUFF_BTN,
            ForgeElementTarget.HUD_REPEL_BTN,
            ForgeElementTarget.HUD_BRAKE_BTN,
            ForgeElementTarget.HUD_MULTI_BTN,
          )
      if (isRound) {
        drawCircle(glow.copy(alpha = (0.28f * recipe.glowIntensity).coerceIn(0f, 0.85f)), span * 1.18f, Offset(cx, cy))
        drawCircle(fill, span * 0.86f, Offset(cx, cy))
        drawCircle(trim, span * 0.86f, Offset(cx, cy), style = Stroke(2.4.dp.toPx() * recipe.borderWeight))
        drawCircle(glow, span * 0.24f, Offset(cx, cy))
      } else {
        val wRect = span * 1.75f
        val hRect = span * 0.68f
        drawRoundRect(glow.copy(alpha = (0.24f * recipe.glowIntensity).coerceIn(0f, 0.8f)), Offset(cx - wRect * 0.54f, cy - hRect * 0.62f), Size(wRect * 1.08f, hRect * 1.24f), CornerRadius(14.dp.toPx(), 14.dp.toPx()))
        drawRoundRect(fill, Offset(cx - wRect * 0.5f, cy - hRect * 0.5f), Size(wRect, hRect), CornerRadius(12.dp.toPx(), 12.dp.toPx()))
        drawRoundRect(trim, Offset(cx - wRect * 0.5f, cy - hRect * 0.5f), Size(wRect, hRect), CornerRadius(12.dp.toPx(), 12.dp.toPx()), style = Stroke(2.2.dp.toPx() * recipe.borderWeight))
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun BoundCalibrationDescriptorSlider(
  desc: CalibrationParamDescriptor,
  engine: RiftGameEngine,
  context: Context,
) {
  var localVal by remember(desc.key, RiftCalibrationState.calibrationRevision) { mutableFloatStateOf(desc.getter()) }
  val fmtVal =
    if (desc.decimals <= 0) "${localVal.roundToInt()} ${desc.unit}".trim()
    else String.format(Locale.US, "%.${desc.decimals}f %s", localVal, desc.unit).trim()
  CompactForgeSliderRow(
    title = desc.title,
    value = localVal.coerceIn(desc.min, desc.max),
    range = desc.min..desc.max,
    valueText = fmtVal,
    accent = Color(0xFFFACC15),
    onChange = { raw ->
      localVal = raw
      desc.setter(raw)
      RiftCalibrationState.applyCalibrationChangesLive(engine, null)
    },
    onFinished = { RiftCalibrationState.applyCalibrationChangesLive(engine, context) },
  )
}

@Composable
private fun ForgeTextInputBox(
  value: String,
  onValueChange: (String) -> Unit,
  placeholder: String,
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
  Box(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .height(34.dp)
        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
        .background(Color(0xFF040914))
        .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF284B73), RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
        .padding(horizontal = 9.dp),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.CenterStart,
  ) {
    if (value.isEmpty()) {
      Text(placeholder, color = Color(0xFF64748B), fontSize = 9.sp, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
    }
    BasicTextField(
      value = value,
      onValueChange = onValueChange,
      singleLine = true,
      cursorBrush = SolidColor(Color(0xFF00F5D4)),
      textStyle = TextStyle(color = Color.White, fontSize = 10.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium, fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif),
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
    )
  }
}

@Composable
private fun ForgeSwatchPickerRow(
  label: String,
  selectedHex: String,
  onSelectHex: (String) -> Unit,
) {
  Row(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
  ) {
    Text(
      "$label:",
      color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
      fontSize = 7.8.sp,
      fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
      fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
      modifier = Modifier.width(42.dp),
    )
    FORGE_COLOR_SWATCHES.forEach { hex ->
      val isSel = selectedHex.equals(hex, ignoreCase = true)
      val colInt = VisualElementRecipe.parseHexColorSafe(hex, 0xFF38BDF8.toInt())
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.size(18.dp)
            .clip(CircleShape)
            .background(Color(colInt))
            .border(if (isSel) 2.dp else 1.dp, if (isSel) Color.White else Color(0x88475569), CircleShape)
            .clickable { onSelectHex(hex) },
      )
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun CompactForgeSliderRow(
  title: String,
  value: Float,
  range: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Float>,
  valueText: String,
  accent: Color,
  onChange: (Float) -> Unit,
  onFinished: () -> Unit = {},
) {
  Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(1.dp)) {
    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
      Text(title, color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1), fontSize = 8.4.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
      Text(valueText, color = accent, fontSize = 8.4.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace)
    }
    Slider(
      value = value.coerceIn(range.start, range.endInclusive),
      onValueChange = onChange,
      onValueChangeFinished = onFinished,
      valueRange = range,
      colors = SliderDefaults.colors(thumbColor = accent, activeTrackColor = accent, inactiveTrackColor = Color(0xFF132642)),
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(20.dp),
    )
  }
}

private fun DrawScope.drawFluxCoreOrbSpecimen(
  center: Offset,
  radiusPx: Float,
  timeSec: Float,
  recipe: VisualElementRecipe,
) {
  val r = radiusPx.coerceAtLeast(12f)
  val pulsePhase = timeSec * 3.0f
  val pulse = 0.5f + 0.5f * sin(pulsePhase)
  val glowMult = recipe.glowIntensity.coerceIn(0.2f, 1.8f)
  val borderMult = recipe.borderWeight.coerceIn(0.5f, 2.2f)
  val auraCol = if (recipe.isFactoryDefault) Color(0xFFFACC15) else Color(recipe.glowColorInt)
  val trimCol = if (recipe.isFactoryDefault) Color(0xFFFACC15) else Color(recipe.trimColorInt)
  val haloAlpha = (((75f + 50f * pulse) * glowMult) / 255f).coerceIn(0f, 0.92f)

  // 1. Pulsing outer containment aura / halo
  drawCircle(
    color = auraCol.copy(alpha = haloAlpha),
    radius = r * 1.56f,
    center = center,
  )

  // 2. Outer cyan capture ring & inner golden/trim containment collar
  drawCircle(
    color = Color(0xFF22D3EE),
    radius = r * 1.04f,
    center = center,
    style = Stroke(width = (r * 0.105f * borderMult).coerceAtLeast(1.6f)),
  )
  drawCircle(
    color = trimCol,
    radius = r * 0.91f,
    center = center,
    style = Stroke(width = (r * 0.078f * borderMult).coerceAtLeast(1.3f)),
  )

  // 3. Canonical 3D Swirling Plasma Toroid / Tri-Arc Vortex Coil Flux icon centered inside
  drawIntoCanvas { c ->
    val nc = c.nativeCanvas
    nc.save()
    nc.translate(center.x, center.y)
    nc.rotate((pulsePhase * 22f) % 360f)
    RiftSpriteBaker.drawFluxPrismIcon(
      c = nc,
      cx = 0f,
      cy = 0f,
      r = r * 0.80f,
      alpha = 255,
    )
    nc.restore()
    RiftSpriteBaker.drawRefractiveMeniscusRim(
      canvas = nc,
      cx = center.x,
      cy = center.y,
      rimRadius = r * 1.02f,
      throatRadius = 0f,
      lightAngleRad = -2.28f,
      rimTintColor = recipe.glowColorInt,
      secondaryTintColor = recipe.trimColorInt,
      fadeAlpha = 0.88f,
      strokeScale = borderMult,
    )
  }
}

private val DYSON_SPECTRUM_STOPS =
  listOf(
    Color(0xFFFFD700), // Solar Gold
    Color(0xFF00F5D4), // Electric Cyan
    Color(0xFFEC4899), // Hyper Magenta
    Color(0xFFA855F7), // Astral Violet
    Color(0xFF38BDF8), // Ion Sapphire
    Color(0xFFFB923C), // Stellar Amber
  )

private fun sampleDysonStellarSpectrum(phase: Float): Color {
  val wrapped = ((phase % 1f) + 1f) % 1f
  val scaled = wrapped * DYSON_SPECTRUM_STOPS.size
  val idx0 = scaled.toInt() % DYSON_SPECTRUM_STOPS.size
  val idx1 = (idx0 + 1) % DYSON_SPECTRUM_STOPS.size
  val frac = (scaled - scaled.toInt()).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
  return lerp(DYSON_SPECTRUM_STOPS[idx0], DYSON_SPECTRUM_STOPS[idx1], frac)
}

private fun DrawScope.drawTiltedMetallicDysonRingHemisphere(
  center: Offset,
  rx: Float,
  ry: Float,
  tiltRad: Float,
  spinPhaseRad: Float,
  thicknessPx: Float,
  frontHemisphere: Boolean,
  energyHue: Color,
) {
  val cosTilt = cos(tiltRad)
  val sinTilt = sin(tiltRad)
  val startA = if (frontHemisphere) 0f else PI.toFloat()
  val endA = if (frontHemisphere) PI.toFloat() else (PI.toFloat() * 2f)
  val steps = 36
  val path = Path()
  for (i in 0..steps) {
    val t = startA + (endA - startA) * (i.toFloat() / steps.toFloat())
    val lx = cos(t) * rx
    val ly = sin(t) * ry
    val sx = center.x + lx * cosTilt - ly * sinTilt
    val sy = center.y + lx * sinTilt + ly * cosTilt
    if (i == 0) path.moveTo(sx, sy) else path.lineTo(sx, sy)
  }

  val gradSpanX = cos(tiltRad + spinPhaseRad * 0.35f) * rx
  val gradSpanY = sin(tiltRad + spinPhaseRad * 0.35f) * rx
  val metallic5StopBrush =
    Brush.linearGradient(
      colorStops =
        arrayOf(
          0.00f to Color(0xFF0B1324),
          0.24f to Color(0xFF475569),
          0.50f to Color(0xFFF8FAFC),
          0.76f to Color(0xFF94A3B8),
          1.00f to Color(0xFF1E293B),
        ),
      start = Offset(center.x - gradSpanX, center.y - gradSpanY),
      end = Offset(center.x + gradSpanX, center.y + gradSpanY),
    )
  val depthAlpha = if (frontHemisphere) 0.96f else 0.64f

  // Outer energy conduit aura along the Dyson ring
  drawPath(
    path = path,
    color = energyHue.copy(alpha = if (frontHemisphere) 0.30f else 0.16f),
    style = Stroke(width = thicknessPx * 1.95f, cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round),
  )
  // Dark gunmetal chassis shadow
  drawPath(
    path = path,
    color = Color(0xFF050A14).copy(alpha = depthAlpha),
    style = Stroke(width = thicknessPx * 1.24f, cap = StrokeCap.Butt, join = StrokeJoin.Round),
  )
  // 5-stop metallic Dyson megastructure band
  drawPath(
    path = path,
    brush = metallic5StopBrush,
    alpha = depthAlpha,
    style = Stroke(width = thicknessPx, cap = StrokeCap.Butt, join = StrokeJoin.Round),
  )
  // Specular highlight filament down the ring spine
  drawPath(
    path = path,
    color = lerp(Color.White, energyHue, 0.35f).copy(alpha = if (frontHemisphere) 0.82f else 0.38f),
    style = Stroke(width = (thicknessPx * 0.22f).coerceAtLeast(1.1f), cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round),
  )

  // Collector nodes orbiting along the tilted Dyson ring
  val nodeCount = 10
  for (n in 0 until nodeCount) {
    val orbAngle = ((spinPhaseRad + n * (PI.toFloat() * 2f / nodeCount)) % (PI.toFloat() * 2f) + PI.toFloat() * 2f) % (PI.toFloat() * 2f)
    val inHemisphere = if (frontHemisphere) (orbAngle <= PI.toFloat()) else (orbAngle > PI.toFloat())
    if (!inHemisphere) continue
    val lx = cos(orbAngle) * rx
    val ly = sin(orbAngle) * ry
    val nx = center.x + lx * cosTilt - ly * sinTilt
    val ny = center.y + lx * sinTilt + ly * cosTilt
    val nodeR = (thicknessPx * 0.56f).coerceAtLeast(2.2f)
    val nodeHue = sampleDysonStellarSpectrum((orbAngle / (PI.toFloat() * 2f)) + spinPhaseRad * 0.08f)
    drawCircle(
      color = nodeHue.copy(alpha = if (frontHemisphere) 0.45f else 0.22f),
      radius = nodeR * 2.0f,
      center = Offset(nx, ny),
    )
    drawCircle(
      color = Color(0xFFE2E8F0).copy(alpha = depthAlpha),
      radius = nodeR,
      center = Offset(nx, ny),
    )
    drawCircle(
      color = nodeHue.copy(alpha = depthAlpha),
      radius = nodeR * 0.58f,
      center = Offset(nx, ny),
    )
  }
}

private fun buildStarForgeHoloGlyphPath(
  ch: Char,
  left: Float,
  top: Float,
  w: Float,
  h: Float,
): Path {
  val r = left + w
  val b = top + h
  val mx = left + w * 0.5f
  val my = top + h * 0.5f
  val bev = w * 0.20f
  return Path().apply {
    when (ch) {
      'S' -> {
        moveTo(r, top + h * 0.18f)
        lineTo(r - bev, top)
        lineTo(left + bev, top)
        lineTo(left, top + h * 0.18f)
        lineTo(left, my - h * 0.06f)
        lineTo(left + bev, my)
        lineTo(r - bev, my)
        lineTo(r, my + h * 0.08f)
        lineTo(r, b - h * 0.18f)
        lineTo(r - bev, b)
        lineTo(left + bev, b)
        lineTo(left, b - h * 0.18f)
      }
      'T' -> {
        moveTo(left, top)
        lineTo(r, top)
        moveTo(mx, top)
        lineTo(mx, b)
      }
      'A' -> {
        moveTo(left, b)
        lineTo(left + w * 0.16f, top + h * 0.22f)
        lineTo(mx, top)
        lineTo(r - w * 0.16f, top + h * 0.22f)
        lineTo(r, b)
        moveTo(left + w * 0.14f, my + h * 0.10f)
        lineTo(r - w * 0.14f, my + h * 0.10f)
      }
      'R' -> {
        moveTo(left, b)
        lineTo(left, top)
        lineTo(r - bev, top)
        lineTo(r, top + h * 0.16f)
        lineTo(r, my - h * 0.06f)
        lineTo(r - bev, my)
        lineTo(left, my)
        moveTo(mx + w * 0.04f, my)
        lineTo(r, b)
      }
      'F' -> {
        moveTo(left, b)
        lineTo(left, top)
        lineTo(r, top)
        moveTo(left, my)
        lineTo(r - w * 0.18f, my)
      }
      'O' -> {
        moveTo(left + bev, top)
        lineTo(r - bev, top)
        lineTo(r, top + h * 0.20f)
        lineTo(r, b - h * 0.20f)
        lineTo(r - bev, b)
        lineTo(left + bev, b)
        lineTo(left, b - h * 0.20f)
        lineTo(left, top + h * 0.20f)
        close()
      }
      'G' -> {
        moveTo(r, top + h * 0.20f)
        lineTo(r - bev, top)
        lineTo(left + bev, top)
        lineTo(left, top + h * 0.20f)
        lineTo(left, b - h * 0.20f)
        lineTo(left + bev, b)
        lineTo(r - bev, b)
        lineTo(r, b - h * 0.18f)
        lineTo(r, my + h * 0.04f)
        lineTo(mx + w * 0.02f, my + h * 0.04f)
      }
      'E' -> {
        moveTo(r, top)
        lineTo(left, top)
        lineTo(left, b)
        lineTo(r, b)
        moveTo(left, my)
        lineTo(r - w * 0.18f, my)
      }
    }
  }
}

private fun DrawScope.drawShiftingMulticoloredDysonSunWithHoloLetters(
  center: Offset,
  dysonRadiusPx: Float,
  timeSec: Float,
  isSelected: Boolean,
): Rect {
  val r = dysonRadiusPx.coerceAtLeast(18f)
  val basePhase = timeSec * 0.15f
  val hueCore = sampleDysonStellarSpectrum(basePhase)
  val hueMid = sampleDysonStellarSpectrum(basePhase + 0.31f)
  val hueOuter = sampleDysonStellarSpectrum(basePhase + 0.63f)

  // 1. Deep outer shifting multicolored stellar corona halo
  val coronaR = r * 1.56f
  drawCircle(
    brush =
      Brush.radialGradient(
        colorStops =
          arrayOf(
            0.00f to hueCore.copy(alpha = 0.44f),
            0.38f to hueMid.copy(alpha = 0.28f),
            0.72f to hueOuter.copy(alpha = 0.14f),
            1.00f to Color.Transparent,
          ),
        center = center,
        radius = coronaR,
      ),
    radius = coronaR,
    center = center,
  )

  // 2. Back-hemisphere of 3 counter-rotating 5-stop metallic Dyson rings (3D occluded behind sun)
  val ringThickness = (r * 0.082f).coerceIn(2.6f, 16f)
  val tiltA = (-24f + sin(timeSec * 0.42f) * 6f) * (PI.toFloat() / 180f)
  val tiltB = (31f + cos(timeSec * 0.36f) * 7f) * (PI.toFloat() / 180f)
  val tiltC = (-63f + sin(timeSec * 0.29f + 1.2f) * 5f) * (PI.toFloat() / 180f)
  drawTiltedMetallicDysonRingHemisphere(
    center = center,
    rx = r * 1.04f,
    ry = r * 0.40f,
    tiltRad = tiltC,
    spinPhaseRad = -timeSec * 0.85f,
    thicknessPx = ringThickness * 0.84f,
    frontHemisphere = false,
    energyHue = hueOuter,
  )
  drawTiltedMetallicDysonRingHemisphere(
    center = center,
    rx = r * 0.99f,
    ry = r * 0.46f,
    tiltRad = tiltB,
    spinPhaseRad = timeSec * 1.12f,
    thicknessPx = ringThickness * 0.92f,
    frontHemisphere = false,
    energyHue = hueMid,
  )
  drawTiltedMetallicDysonRingHemisphere(
    center = center,
    rx = r * 0.94f,
    ry = r * 0.36f,
    tiltRad = tiltA,
    spinPhaseRad = -timeSec * 1.38f,
    thicknessPx = ringThickness,
    frontHemisphere = false,
    energyHue = hueCore,
  )

  // 3. Animated solar prominences / magnetic plasma loops around the Dyson Sun sphere
  val sunCoreR = r * 0.72f
  val flareCount = 12
  for (fIdx in 0 until flareCount) {
    val baseAng = fIdx * (PI.toFloat() * 2f / flareCount) + timeSec * 0.34f
    val pulse = 0.5f + 0.5f * sin(timeSec * 2.8f + fIdx * 1.37f)
    val flarePeakR = sunCoreR * (1.07f + 0.16f * pulse)
    val span = 0.16f + 0.05f * pulse
    val p0 = Offset(center.x + cos(baseAng - span) * (sunCoreR * 0.94f), center.y + sin(baseAng - span) * (sunCoreR * 0.94f))
    val ctrl = Offset(center.x + cos(baseAng) * flarePeakR, center.y + sin(baseAng) * flarePeakR)
    val p1 = Offset(center.x + cos(baseAng + span) * (sunCoreR * 0.94f), center.y + sin(baseAng + span) * (sunCoreR * 0.94f))
    val flarePath = Path().apply {
      moveTo(p0.x, p0.y)
      quadraticTo(ctrl.x, ctrl.y, p1.x, p1.y)
    }
    val flareHue = sampleDysonStellarSpectrum(basePhase + fIdx * (1f / flareCount))
    drawPath(
      path = flarePath,
      color = flareHue.copy(alpha = 0.56f),
      style = Stroke(width = (r * 0.032f).coerceAtLeast(1.4f), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
    )
  }

  // 4. Shifting Multicolored Dyson Sun Photosphere & Convective Plasma Core
  drawCircle(
    brush =
      Brush.radialGradient(
        colorStops =
          arrayOf(
            0.00f to Color.White,
            0.22f to lerp(Color.White, hueCore, 0.55f),
            0.52f to hueCore,
            0.78f to hueMid,
            0.94f to hueOuter,
            1.00f to hueOuter.copy(alpha = 0.15f),
          ),
        center = Offset(center.x - sunCoreR * 0.14f, center.y - sunCoreR * 0.14f),
        radius = sunCoreR * 1.06f,
      ),
    radius = sunCoreR,
    center = center,
  )

  // Swirling multicolored convective plasma bands across the solar surface
  for (band in 0 until 8) {
    val startDeg = (timeSec * (44f + band * 5f) + band * 45f) % 360f
    val bandR = sunCoreR * (0.34f + (band % 4) * 0.15f)
    val bandHue = sampleDysonStellarSpectrum(basePhase + 0.18f + band * 0.11f)
    drawArc(
      color = lerp(Color.White, bandHue, 0.62f).copy(alpha = 0.44f),
      startAngle = startDeg,
      sweepAngle = 68f + 22f * sin(timeSec * 1.9f + band),
      useCenter = false,
      topLeft = Offset(center.x - bandR, center.y - bandR),
      size = Size(bandR * 2f, bandR * 2f),
      style = Stroke(width = (r * 0.028f).coerceAtLeast(1.2f), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
    )
  }

  // Brilliant solar limb rim
  drawCircle(
    color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.72f),
    radius = sunCoreR * 0.985f,
    center = center,
    style = Stroke(width = (r * 0.018f).coerceAtLeast(1.1f)),
  )

  // 5. Front-hemisphere of 3 counter-rotating 5-stop metallic Dyson rings (3D passing in front of sun)
  drawTiltedMetallicDysonRingHemisphere(
    center = center,
    rx = r * 1.04f,
    ry = r * 0.40f,
    tiltRad = tiltC,
    spinPhaseRad = -timeSec * 0.85f,
    thicknessPx = ringThickness * 0.84f,
    frontHemisphere = true,
    energyHue = hueOuter,
  )
  drawTiltedMetallicDysonRingHemisphere(
    center = center,
    rx = r * 0.99f,
    ry = r * 0.46f,
    tiltRad = tiltB,
    spinPhaseRad = timeSec * 1.12f,
    thicknessPx = ringThickness * 0.92f,
    frontHemisphere = true,
    energyHue = hueMid,
  )
  drawTiltedMetallicDysonRingHemisphere(
    center = center,
    rx = r * 0.94f,
    ry = r * 0.36f,
    tiltRad = tiltA,
    spinPhaseRad = -timeSec * 1.38f,
    thicknessPx = ringThickness,
    frontHemisphere = true,
    energyHue = hueCore,
  )

  if (isSelected) {
    val selR = r * 1.12f
    drawCircle(
      color = Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.78f),
      radius = selR,
      center = center,
      style = Stroke(width = (r * 0.024f).coerceAtLeast(1.8f)),
    )
  }

  // 6. Upward-Emitted Volumetric Holographic Projection Rays & Graphic Letters Spelling "STAR FORGE"
  val titleChars = "STAR FORGE"
  val glyphH = (r * 0.255f).coerceIn(11f, 52f)
  val glyphW = glyphH * 0.64f
  val glyphGap = glyphW * 0.30f
  val spaceW = glyphW * 0.62f
  var totalBannerW = 0f
  titleChars.forEachIndexed { idx, c ->
    totalBannerW += if (c == ' ') spaceW else glyphW
    if (idx < titleChars.lastIndex) totalBannerW += glyphGap
  }

  val hoverLift = sin(timeSec * 2.1f) * (r * 0.026f)
  val bannerCy = center.y - r * 0.94f + hoverLift
  val bannerTop = bannerCy - glyphH * 0.5f
  val bannerLeft = center.x - totalBannerW * 0.5f

  // Upward emitter cone rays fanning from the Dyson Sun's northern crown up into "STAR FORGE"
  val rayCount = 7
  for (rayIdx in 0 until rayCount) {
    val frac = rayIdx.toFloat() / (rayCount - 1).toFloat()
    val emitterX = center.x + (frac - 0.5f) * (sunCoreR * 0.86f)
    val emitterY = center.y - sunCoreR * 0.46f
    val targetX = bannerLeft + frac * totalBannerW
    val targetY = bannerTop + glyphH * 1.05f
    val rayHue = sampleDysonStellarSpectrum(basePhase + frac * 0.45f)
    drawLine(
      brush =
        Brush.linearGradient(
          listOf(
            rayHue.copy(alpha = 0.42f),
            Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.24f),
            Color.Transparent,
          ),
          start = Offset(emitterX, emitterY),
          end = Offset(targetX, bannerTop - glyphH * 0.25f),
        ),
      start = Offset(emitterX, emitterY),
      end = Offset(targetX, targetY),
      strokeWidth = (r * 0.036f).coerceAtLeast(1.6f),
      cap = StrokeCap.Round,
    )
  }

  // Upward-rising holographic plasma motes streaming from the Dyson Sun through the letters
  for (mIdx in 0 until 10) {
    val prog = ((timeSec * 0.58f + mIdx * 0.103f) % 1f)
    val mx = bannerLeft + ((mIdx * 0.108f + sin(timeSec * 1.3f + mIdx) * 0.04f).coerceIn(0.03f, 0.97f)) * totalBannerW
    val my = (center.y - sunCoreR * 0.40f) - prog * (r * 0.78f)
    val moteAlpha = sin(prog * PI.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f) * 0.78f
    val moteCol = sampleDysonStellarSpectrum(basePhase + mIdx * 0.09f)
    drawCircle(
      color = moteCol.copy(alpha = moteAlpha),
      radius = (r * 0.019f).coerceAtLeast(1.3f),
      center = Offset(mx, my),
    )
  }

  // Translucent holographic projection pedestal plate behind "STAR FORGE"
  val padX = glyphW * 0.48f
  val padY = glyphH * 0.34f
  val bannerRect =
    Rect(
      left = bannerLeft - padX,
      top = bannerTop - padY,
      right = bannerLeft + totalBannerW + padX,
      bottom = bannerTop + glyphH + padY,
    )
  drawRoundRect(
    color = Color(0x99040B18),
    topLeft = Offset(bannerRect.left, bannerRect.top),
    size = Size(bannerRect.width, bannerRect.height),
    cornerRadius = CornerRadius(glyphH * 0.28f, glyphH * 0.28f),
  )
  drawRoundRect(
    brush =
      Brush.linearGradient(
        listOf(
          hueCore.copy(alpha = 0.85f),
          Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.88f),
          hueMid.copy(alpha = 0.85f),
        ),
        start = Offset(bannerRect.left, bannerRect.top),
        end = Offset(bannerRect.right, bannerRect.bottom),
      ),
    topLeft = Offset(bannerRect.left, bannerRect.top),
    size = Size(bannerRect.width, bannerRect.height),
    cornerRadius = CornerRadius(glyphH * 0.28f, glyphH * 0.28f),
    style = Stroke(width = (glyphH * 0.065f).coerceAtLeast(1.1f)),
  )

  // Custom 3D holographic vector graphic letters "STAR FORGE"
  var cursorX = bannerLeft
  val coreStroke = (glyphH * 0.135f).coerceIn(1.4f, 6.2f)
  val scanSweepY = bannerTop + ((1f - ((timeSec * 0.85f) % 1f)) * glyphH)
  titleChars.forEachIndexed { idx, ch ->
    if (ch == ' ') {
      cursorX += spaceW + glyphGap
    } else {
      val letterWaveY = sin(timeSec * 3.4f - idx * 0.48f) * (glyphH * 0.065f)
      val letterTop = bannerTop + letterWaveY
      val letterHue = sampleDysonStellarSpectrum(basePhase + idx * 0.075f)
      val shadowPath =
        buildStarForgeHoloGlyphPath(
          ch = ch,
          left = cursorX + coreStroke * 0.55f,
          top = letterTop + coreStroke * 0.62f,
          w = glyphW,
          h = glyphH,
        )
      val mainPath =
        buildStarForgeHoloGlyphPath(
          ch = ch,
          left = cursorX,
          top = letterTop,
          w = glyphW,
          h = glyphH,
        )

      // Pass 1: 3D holographic extrusion shadow
      drawPath(
        path = shadowPath,
        color = Color(0xCC09152B),
        style = Stroke(width = coreStroke * 1.55f, cap = StrokeCap.Square, join = StrokeJoin.Bevel),
      )
      // Pass 2: Shifting multicolored holographic outer bloom
      drawPath(
        path = mainPath,
        color = letterHue.copy(alpha = 0.52f),
        style = Stroke(width = coreStroke * 2.15f, cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round),
      )
      // Pass 3: Vibrant cyan/stellar holographic body stroke
      drawPath(
        path = mainPath,
        color = lerp(letterHue, Color(0xFF00F5D4), 0.42f),
        style = Stroke(width = coreStroke, cap = StrokeCap.Square, join = StrokeJoin.Bevel),
      )
      // Pass 4: Crisp white-hot inner hologram filament
      drawPath(
        path = mainPath,
        color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.92f),
        style = Stroke(width = (coreStroke * 0.38f).coerceAtLeast(0.9f), cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round),
      )

      cursorX += glyphW + glyphGap
    }
  }

  // Upward-sweeping holographic scanline across the "STAR FORGE" letters
  drawLine(
    brush =
      Brush.horizontalGradient(
        listOf(
          Color.Transparent,
          Color(0x9900F5D4),
          Color(0xCCFFFFFF),
          hueCore.copy(alpha = 0.72f),
          Color.Transparent,
        ),
        startX = bannerRect.left,
        endX = bannerRect.right,
      ),
    start = Offset(bannerRect.left + padX * 0.35f, scanSweepY),
    end = Offset(bannerRect.right - padX * 0.35f, scanSweepY),
    strokeWidth = (glyphH * 0.055f).coerceAtLeast(1.0f),
    cap = StrokeCap.Round,
  )

  return bannerRect
}

internal fun isHeadlessGlEnvironment(): Boolean {
  val fp = Build.FINGERPRINT ?: ""
  val model = Build.MODEL ?: ""
  if (fp.contains("robolectric", ignoreCase = true) ||
    model.contains("robolectric", ignoreCase = true)
  ) {
    return true
  }
  return runCatching {
    Class.forName("org.robolectric.Robolectric")
    true
  }.getOrDefault(false)
}

private const val CAMERA_FOV_Y_DEG = 46.0f
private const val BASE_CAMERA_Z = 3.16f

private const val STATION_CENTER_X = 0.00f
private const val STATION_CENTER_Y = 0.05f
private const val STATION_CENTER_Z = 0.08f
private const val SANCTUARY_SHIELD_RADIUS = 0.92f
private const val SANCTUARY_PITCH_X_RAD = 0.46f
private const val SANCTUARY_ROLL_Z_RAD = -0.14f

internal data class CameraBasis3D(
  val camX: Float,
  val camY: Float,
  val camZ: Float,
  val fwdX: Float,
  val fwdY: Float,
  val fwdZ: Float,
  val rightX: Float,
  val rightY: Float,
  val rightZ: Float,
  val upX: Float,
  val upY: Float,
  val upZ: Float,
  val tanHalfFovY: Float,
  val aspect: Float,
)

/**
 * Orthonormal 3D frame for the tilted Safe-Zone Sanctuary disc & `NEXUS` Orbital Citadel:
 * - `(ux, uy, uz)` & `(vx, vy, vz)` span the tilted Safe-Zone plane (`R = 0.92f`).
 * - `(nx, ny, nz)` is the outward/upward citadel spire axis perpendicular to the Safe-Zone plane.
 */
private data class SanctuaryFrame3D(
  val ux: Float,
  val uy: Float,
  val uz: Float,
  val vx: Float,
  val vy: Float,
  val vz: Float,
  val nx: Float,
  val ny: Float,
  val nz: Float,
)

private fun buildSanctuaryFrame3D(
  pitchX: Float = SANCTUARY_PITCH_X_RAD,
  rollZ: Float = SANCTUARY_ROLL_Z_RAD,
): SanctuaryFrame3D {
  val cp = cos(pitchX)
  val sp = sin(pitchX)
  val cr = cos(rollZ)
  val sr = sin(rollZ)

  // Start with disc in (X, Y) and spire along +Z, pitch back by Rx(-pitchX) so top recedes into -Z,
  // then bank by Rz(rollZ):
  // u0 = (1, 0, 0) -> Rx(-pitchX) = (1, 0, 0) -> Rz(rollZ) = (cr, sr, 0)
  // v0 = (0, 1, 0) -> Rx(-pitchX) = (0, cp, -sp) -> Rz(rollZ) = (-sr*cp, cr*cp, -sp)
  // n0 = (0, 0, 1) -> Rx(-pitchX) = (0, sp, cp) -> Rz(rollZ) = (-sr*sp, cr*sp, cp)
  return SanctuaryFrame3D(
    ux = cr,
    uy = sr,
    uz = 0f,
    vx = -sr * cp,
    vy = cr * cp,
    vz = -sp,
    nx = -sr * sp,
    ny = cr * sp,
    nz = cp,
  )
}

private val DEFAULT_SANCTUARY_FRAME = buildSanctuaryFrame3D()

private fun buildCameraBasis3D(
  viewportW: Float,
  viewportH: Float,
  timeSec: Float,
  lookYawRad: Float,
  lookPitchRad: Float,
  diveTearIdx: Int,
  diveProgress: Float,
  isSplashMode: Boolean,
): CameraBasis3D {
  val safeW = max(1f, viewportW)
  val safeH = max(1f, viewportH)
  val aspect = safeW / safeH
  val tanHalfFovY = tan((CAMERA_FOV_Y_DEG * 0.5f) * (PI.toFloat() / 180f))
  val aspectPullback = if (isSplashMode) 1.04f else max(1.0f, 1.55f / aspect.coerceAtLeast(0.55f))
  val baseZ = BASE_CAMERA_Z * aspectPullback

  val orbitX = if (isSplashMode) sin(timeSec * 0.22f) * 0.032f else 0f
  val orbitY = if (isSplashMode) cos(timeSec * 0.18f) * 0.022f else 0f
  val orbitZ = if (isSplashMode) sin(timeSec * 0.15f) * 0.024f else 0f

  var camX = orbitX + sin(lookYawRad) * 0.44f
  var camY = orbitY + sin(lookPitchRad) * 0.34f
  var camZ = baseZ + orbitZ

  var lookX = -sin(lookYawRad) * 0.42f
  var lookY = STATION_CENTER_Y - sin(lookPitchRad) * 0.32f
  var lookZ = STATION_CENTER_Z

  if (!isSplashMode && diveTearIdx in NEXUS_3D_RIFT_TEARS.indices && diveProgress > 0.001f) {
    val target = NEXUS_3D_RIFT_TEARS[diveTearIdx]
    val ease = diveProgress * diveProgress * (3f - 2f * diveProgress)
    val diveTargetX = if (diveTearIdx == 0) STATION_CENTER_X else target.worldX * 0.34f
    val diveTargetY = if (diveTearIdx == 0) STATION_CENTER_Y else target.worldY * 0.34f
    camX += (diveTargetX - camX) * (ease * 0.74f)
    camY += (diveTargetY - camY) * (ease * 0.74f)
    camZ += (0.86f - camZ) * (ease * 0.80f)
    lookX += (diveTargetX - lookX) * ease
    lookY += (diveTargetY - lookY) * ease
    lookZ += (STATION_CENTER_Z - lookZ) * ease
  }

  var fx = lookX - camX
  var fy = lookY - camY
  var fz = lookZ - camZ
  val fLen = sqrt(max(1e-6f, fx * fx + fy * fy + fz * fz))
  fx /= fLen
  fy /= fLen
  fz /= fLen

  var rx = -fz
  var ry = 0f
  var rz = fx
  val rLen = sqrt(max(1e-6f, rx * rx + ry * ry + rz * rz))
  rx /= rLen
  ry /= rLen
  rz /= rLen

  val ux = ry * fz - rz * fy
  val uy = rz * fx - rx * fz
  val uz = rx * fy - ry * fx

  return CameraBasis3D(
    camX = camX,
    camY = camY,
    camZ = camZ,
    fwdX = fx,
    fwdY = fy,
    fwdZ = fz,
    rightX = rx,
    rightY = ry,
    rightZ = rz,
    upX = ux,
    upY = uy,
    upZ = uz,
    tanHalfFovY = tanHalfFovY,
    aspect = aspect,
  )
}

internal fun projectTearsWithBasis(
  basis: CameraBasis3D,
  viewportW: Float,
  viewportH: Float,
  @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") timeSec: Float,
): List<ProjectedRiftTearScreenState> {
  val safeW = max(1f, viewportW)
  val safeH = max(1f, viewportH)
  return NEXUS_3D_RIFT_TEARS.map { spec ->
    val wx = spec.worldX
    val wy = spec.worldY
    val wz = spec.worldZ

    val dx = wx - basis.camX
    val dy = wy - basis.camY
    val dz = wz - basis.camZ

    val vx = dx * basis.rightX + dy * basis.rightY + dz * basis.rightZ
    val vy = dx * basis.upX + dy * basis.upY + dz * basis.upZ
    val vz = dx * basis.fwdX + dy * basis.fwdY + dz * basis.fwdZ

    if (vz <= 0.12f) {
      ProjectedRiftTearScreenState(
        index = spec.index,
        node = spec.node,
        screenCenterX = safeW * 0.5f,
        screenCenterY = safeH * 0.5f,
        projectedWidthPx = 0f,
        projectedHeightPx = 0f,
        depthScale = 0f,
        visible = false,
      )
    } else {
      val ndcX = vx / (vz * basis.aspect * basis.tanHalfFovY)
      val ndcY = vy / (vz * basis.tanHalfFovY)
      val pxPerWorld = (safeH * 0.5f) / (vz * basis.tanHalfFovY)
      val projW = 2f * spec.halfWidthWorld * pxPerWorld
      val projH = 2f * spec.halfHeightWorld * pxPerWorld
      val cx = (0.5f + 0.5f * ndcX) * safeW
      val cy = (0.5f - 0.5f * ndcY) * safeH
      val visible =
        cx + projW * 0.5f > 0f &&
          cx - projW * 0.5f < safeW &&
          cy + projH * 0.5f > 0f &&
          cy - projH * 0.5f < safeH
      ProjectedRiftTearScreenState(
        index = spec.index,
        node = spec.node,
        screenCenterX = cx,
        screenCenterY = cy,
        projectedWidthPx = projW,
        projectedHeightPx = projH,
        depthScale = (BASE_CAMERA_Z / vz).coerceIn(0.55f, 2.2f),
        visible = visible,
      )
    }
  }
}

fun computeStaticProjectedTearStates(
  viewportW: Float,
  viewportH: Float,
): List<ProjectedRiftTearScreenState> {
  val basis =
    buildCameraBasis3D(
      viewportW = viewportW,
      viewportH = viewportH,
      timeSec = 0f,
      lookYawRad = 0f,
      lookPitchRad = 0f,
      diveTearIdx = -1,
      diveProgress = 0f,
      isSplashMode = false,
    )
  return projectTearsWithBasis(basis, viewportW, viewportH, 0f)
}

/**
 * Procedural 3D Mesh Builder (`11` floats per vertex: `pos(3) + normal(3) + color(3) + emissive(1) + radialT(1)`)
 * for the Multi-Ring 3D `NEXUS` Orbital Citadel, Counter-Rotating Docking Rings, 3D Containment Shield Ring,
 * 8 Golden-Cyan 3D Stabilizer Beams, and 8 Outward-Bracing Emitter Chevrons.
 */
private class StationMeshBuilder(initialFloats: Int = 24576) {
  private var data = FloatArray(initialFloats)
  var floatCount: Int = 0
    private set

  val vertexCount: Int
    get() = floatCount / FLOATS_PER_VERTEX

  private fun ensureCapacity(extraFloats: Int) {
    if (floatCount + extraFloats <= data.size) return
    var next = data.size * 2
    while (next < floatCount + extraFloats) next *= 2
    data = data.copyOf(next)
  }

  private fun pushVertex(
    px: Float, py: Float, pz: Float,
    nx: Float, ny: Float, nz: Float,
    r: Float, g: Float, b: Float,
    emissive: Float,
    radialT: Float,
  ) {
    ensureCapacity(FLOATS_PER_VERTEX)
    var i = floatCount
    data[i++] = px; data[i++] = py; data[i++] = pz
    data[i++] = nx; data[i++] = ny; data[i++] = nz
    data[i++] = r; data[i++] = g; data[i++] = b
    data[i++] = emissive
    data[i++] = radialT
    floatCount = i
  }

  fun addTri(
    ax: Float, ay: Float, az: Float,
    bx: Float, by: Float, bz: Float,
    cx: Float, cy: Float, cz: Float,
    r: Float, g: Float, b: Float,
    emissive: Float = 0f,
    radialT: Float = -1f,
  ) {
    val ux = bx - ax; val uy = by - ay; val uz = bz - az
    val vx = cx - ax; val vy = cy - ay; val vz = cz - az
    var nx = uy * vz - uz * vy
    var ny = uz * vx - ux * vz
    var nz = ux * vy - uy * vx
    val nLen = sqrt(max(1e-8f, nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz))
    nx /= nLen; ny /= nLen; nz /= nLen
    pushVertex(ax, ay, az, nx, ny, nz, r, g, b, emissive, radialT)
    pushVertex(bx, by, bz, nx, ny, nz, r, g, b, emissive, radialT)
    pushVertex(cx, cy, cz, nx, ny, nz, r, g, b, emissive, radialT)
  }

  fun addTriGradRadial(
    ax: Float, ay: Float, az: Float, ta: Float, ra: Float, ga: Float, ba: Float,
    bx: Float, by: Float, bz: Float, tb: Float, rb: Float, gb: Float, bb: Float,
    cx: Float, cy: Float, cz: Float, tc: Float, rc: Float, gc: Float, bc: Float,
    emissive: Float,
  ) {
    val ux = bx - ax; val uy = by - ay; val uz = bz - az
    val vx = cx - ax; val vy = cy - ay; val vz = cz - az
    var nx = uy * vz - uz * vy
    var ny = uz * vx - ux * vz
    var nz = ux * vy - uy * vx
    val nLen = sqrt(max(1e-8f, nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz))
    nx /= nLen; ny /= nLen; nz /= nLen
    pushVertex(ax, ay, az, nx, ny, nz, ra, ga, ba, emissive, ta)
    pushVertex(bx, by, bz, nx, ny, nz, rb, gb, bb, emissive, tb)
    pushVertex(cx, cy, cz, nx, ny, nz, rc, gc, bc, emissive, tc)
  }

  fun addQuad(
    x0: Float, y0: Float, z0: Float,
    x1: Float, y1: Float, z1: Float,
    x2: Float, y2: Float, z2: Float,
    x3: Float, y3: Float, z3: Float,
    r: Float, g: Float, b: Float,
    emissive: Float = 0f,
    radialT: Float = -1f,
  ) {
    addTri(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2, r, g, b, emissive, radialT)
    addTri(x0, y0, z0, x2, y2, z2, x3, y3, z3, r, g, b, emissive, radialT)
  }

  /**
   * Builds a tapered polygonal frustum around the local `Z` spire axis (`z0 -> z1`, radii `r0 -> r1`).
   */
  fun addSpireFrustumZ(
    sides: Int,
    z0: Float,
    z1: Float,
    r0: Float,
    r1: Float,
    r: Float,
    g: Float,
    b: Float,
    emissive: Float = 0f,
    capBottom: Boolean = false,
    capTop: Boolean = false,
    angleOffset: Float = 0f,
  ) {
    val step = (PI.toFloat() * 2f) / sides.toFloat()
    for (i in 0 until sides) {
      val a0 = angleOffset + i * step
      val a1 = angleOffset + (i + 1) * step
      val c0 = cos(a0); val s0 = sin(a0)
      val c1 = cos(a1); val s1 = sin(a1)
      if (r0 > 1e-4f && r1 > 1e-4f) {
        addQuad(
          c0 * r0, s0 * r0, z0,
          c1 * r0, s1 * r0, z0,
          c1 * r1, s1 * r1, z1,
          c0 * r1, s0 * r1, z1,
          r, g, b, emissive,
        )
      } else if (r1 <= 1e-4f) {
        addTri(
          c0 * r0, s0 * r0, z0,
          c1 * r0, s1 * r0, z0,
          0f, 0f, z1,
          r, g, b, emissive,
        )
      } else {
        addTri(
          0f, 0f, z0,
          c1 * r1, s1 * r1, z1,
          c0 * r1, s0 * r1, z1,
          r, g, b, emissive,
        )
      }
      if (capTop && r1 > 1e-4f) {
        addTri(0f, 0f, z1, c0 * r1, s0 * r1, z1, c1 * r1, s1 * r1, z1, r * 1.12f, g * 1.12f, b * 1.12f, emissive)
      }
      if (capBottom && r0 > 1e-4f) {
        addTri(0f, 0f, z0, c1 * r0, s1 * r0, z0, c0 * r0, s0 * r0, z0, r * 0.82f, g * 0.82f, b * 0.82f, emissive)
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Builds a beveled 4-sided diamond/chamfered 3D ring lying in the local `(X, Y)` disc plane.
   */
  fun addBeveledRingXY(
    segments: Int,
    majorR: Float,
    halfRadialW: Float,
    halfHeightZ: Float,
    hullR: Float, hullG: Float, hullB: Float,
    innerTrimR: Float, innerTrimG: Float, innerTrimB: Float,
    innerEmissive: Float,
    outerTrimR: Float, outerTrimG: Float, outerTrimB: Float,
    outerEmissive: Float,
  ) {
    val step = (PI.toFloat() * 2f) / segments.toFloat()
    val rIn = majorR - halfRadialW
    val rMid = majorR
    val rOut = majorR + halfRadialW
    for (i in 0 until segments) {
      val a0 = i * step
      val a1 = (i + 1) * step
      val c0 = cos(a0); val s0 = sin(a0)
      val c1 = cos(a1); val s1 = sin(a1)

      // Top-inner slope (brushed titanium)
      addQuad(
        c0 * rIn, s0 * rIn, 0f,
        c1 * rIn, s1 * rIn, 0f,
        c1 * rMid, s1 * rMid, halfHeightZ,
        c0 * rMid, s0 * rMid, halfHeightZ,
        innerTrimR, innerTrimG, innerTrimB, innerEmissive,
      )
      // Top-outer slope (armored hull)
      addQuad(
        c0 * rMid, s0 * rMid, halfHeightZ,
        c1 * rMid, s1 * rMid, halfHeightZ,
        c1 * rOut, s1 * rOut, 0f,
        c0 * rOut, s0 * rOut, 0f,
        hullR, hullG, hullB, 0f,
      )
      // Bottom-outer slope
      addQuad(
        c0 * rOut, s0 * rOut, 0f,
        c1 * rOut, s1 * rOut, 0f,
        c1 * rMid, s1 * rMid, -halfHeightZ,
        c0 * rMid, s0 * rMid, -halfHeightZ,
        outerTrimR, outerTrimG, outerTrimB, outerEmissive,
      )
      // Bottom-inner slope
      addQuad(
        c0 * rMid, s0 * rMid, -halfHeightZ,
        c1 * rMid, s1 * rMid, -halfHeightZ,
        c1 * rIn, s1 * rIn, 0f,
        c0 * rIn, s0 * rIn, 0f,
        hullR * 0.82f, hullG * 0.82f, hullB * 0.86f, 0f,
      )
    }
  }

  fun addOrientedBoxXY(
    angleRad: Float,
    rStart: Float,
    rEnd: Float,
    halfTangentialW: Float,
    zBottom: Float,
    zTop: Float,
    r: Float, g: Float, b: Float,
    emissive: Float = 0f,
  ) {
    val ca = cos(angleRad); val sa = sin(angleRad)
    val px = -sa * halfTangentialW; val py = ca * halfTangentialW

    val x0L = ca * rStart + px; val y0L = sa * rStart + py
    val x0R = ca * rStart - px; val y0R = sa * rStart - py
    val x1L = ca * rEnd + px; val y1L = sa * rEnd + py
    val x1R = ca * rEnd - px; val y1R = sa * rEnd - py

    // Top (+Z)
    addQuad(x0R, y0R, zTop, x1R, y1R, zTop, x1L, y1L, zTop, x0L, y0L, zTop, r, g, b, emissive)
    // Bottom (-Z)
    addQuad(x0L, y0L, zBottom, x1L, y1L, zBottom, x1R, y1R, zBottom, x0R, y0R, zBottom, r * 0.78f, g * 0.78f, b * 0.82f, emissive)
    // Outer end (rEnd)
    addQuad(x1R, y1R, zBottom, x1L, y1L, zBottom, x1L, y1L, zTop, x1R, y1R, zTop, r * 1.08f, g * 1.08f, b * 1.08f, emissive)
    // Inner end (rStart)
    addQuad(x0L, y0L, zBottom, x0R, y0R, zBottom, x0R, y0R, zTop, x0L, y0L, zTop, r * 0.88f, g * 0.88f, b * 0.88f, emissive)
    // Left flank
    addQuad(x0L, y0L, zBottom, x0L, y0L, zTop, x1L, y1L, zTop, x1L, y1L, zBottom, r * 0.92f, g * 0.92f, b * 0.95f, emissive)
    // Right flank
    addQuad(x1R, y1R, zBottom, x1R, y1R, zTop, x0R, y0R, zTop, x0R, y0R, zBottom, r * 0.92f, g * 0.92f, b * 0.95f, emissive)
  }

  fun toFloatBuffer(): FloatBuffer {
    val buf = ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(floatCount * 4).order(ByteOrder.nativeOrder()).asFloatBuffer()
    buf.put(data, 0, floatCount)
    buf.position(0)
    return buf
  }

  companion object {
    const val FLOATS_PER_VERTEX = 11
    const val STRIDE_BYTES = FLOATS_PER_VERTEX * 4

    /**
     * Builds the central dark-titanium octagonal `NEXUS` Command Citadel Spire with twinkling
     * cyan/gold micro-windows, central reactor heart, and 4 armored docking pylons.
     */
    fun buildCentralSpireMesh(): StationMeshBuilder {
      val m = StationMeshBuilder(12288)
      // Dark brushed titanium-obsidian palette (#0D1729 / #1C2E4A / #2A4365)
      val darkHullR = 0.052f; val darkHullG = 0.092f; val darkHullB = 0.165f
      val midHullR = 0.110f; val midHullG = 0.180f; val midHullB = 0.292f
      val litBevelR = 0.175f; val litBevelG = 0.275f; val litBevelB = 0.420f

      // Lower deep-space reactor keel (-0.34 -> -0.05)
      m.addSpireFrustumZ(8, -0.34f, -0.22f, 0.0f, 0.055f, darkHullR, darkHullG, darkHullB)
      m.addSpireFrustumZ(8, -0.22f, -0.09f, 0.055f, 0.115f, midHullR, midHullG, midHullB, capTop = true)
      // Glowing lower keel cyan thruster/stabilizer band
      m.addSpireFrustumZ(8, -0.105f, -0.088f, 0.117f, 0.119f, 0.0f, 0.96f, 0.83f, emissive = 1.35f)

      // Central Reactor Heart & Octagonal Command Citadel (-0.09 -> +0.16)
      m.addSpireFrustumZ(8, -0.09f, -0.02f, 0.138f, 0.156f, darkHullR, darkHullG, darkHullB, capBottom = true)
      // Glowing Solar-Gold & Cyan Reactor Core Band around z = -0.01..+0.03
      m.addSpireFrustumZ(12, -0.018f, 0.026f, 0.148f, 0.148f, 0.05f, 0.95f, 0.88f, emissive = 1.65f)
      m.addSpireFrustumZ(8, 0.026f, 0.125f, 0.156f, 0.122f, midHullR, midHullG, midHullB, capTop = true)
      m.addSpireFrustumZ(8, 0.125f, 0.225f, 0.102f, 0.072f, litBevelR, litBevelG, litBevelB, capTop = true)
      // Upper Command Bridge & Tall Sensor Mast (+0.225 -> +0.40)
      m.addSpireFrustumZ(8, 0.225f, 0.305f, 0.052f, 0.028f, midHullR, midHullG, midHullB)
      m.addSpireFrustumZ(6, 0.305f, 0.405f, 0.018f, 0.002f, litBevelR, litBevelG, litBevelB)
      // Apex Beacon Tip (HDR Solar-Gold / Cyan)
      m.addSpireFrustumZ(8, 0.385f, 0.415f, 0.014f, 0.0f, 0.98f, 0.82f, 0.15f, emissive = 1.85f)

      // Twinkling Cyan & Solar-Gold Micro-Windows across the 8 Citadel Faces
      val octStep = (PI.toFloat() * 2f) / 8f
      for (face in 0 until 8) {
        val midAng = (face + 0.5f) * octStep
        for (tier in 0 until 3) {
          val zBot = 0.042f + tier * 0.025f
          val zTop = zBot + 0.012f
          val tierFrac = (zBot - 0.026f) / (0.125f - 0.026f)
          val faceR = (0.156f + (0.122f - 0.156f) * tierFrac) * cos(octStep * 0.5f) + 0.003f
          val isGold = (face + tier) % 3 == 0
          val wr = if (isGold) 0.98f else 0.00f
          val wg = if (isGold) 0.80f else 0.96f
          val wb = if (isGold) 0.12f else 0.85f
          m.addOrientedBoxXY(
            angleRad = midAng,
            rStart = faceR - 0.002f,
            rEnd = faceR + 0.003f,
            halfTangentialW = 0.018f,
            zBottom = zBot,
            zTop = zTop,
            r = wr, g = wg, b = wb,
            emissive = 1.42f,
          )
        }
      }

      // 8 Radial Collar Anchor Buttresses around z = -0.015..+0.025 (from r = 0.135 -> 0.185)
      for (k in 0 until 8) {
        val ang = k * (PI.toFloat() * 0.25f)
        m.addOrientedBoxXY(
          angleRad = ang,
          rStart = 0.130f,
          rEnd = 0.186f,
          halfTangentialW = if (k % 2 == 0) 0.022f else 0.015f,
          zBottom = -0.018f,
          zTop = 0.026f,
          r = midHullR, g = midHullG, b = midHullB,
        )
        m.addOrientedBoxXY(
          angleRad = ang,
          rStart = 0.168f,
          rEnd = 0.192f,
          halfTangentialW = 0.010f,
          zBottom = 0.026f,
          zTop = 0.035f,
          r = 0.98f, g = 0.80f, b = 0.10f,
          emissive = 1.35f,
        )
      }
      return m
    }

    /**
     * Builds the Outer Sovereign Docking Ring (`R = 0.44f`) with 8 armored docking clamps.
     */
    fun buildOuterDockingRingMesh(): StationMeshBuilder {
      val m = StationMeshBuilder(8192)
      m.addBeveledRingXY(
        segments = 44,
        majorR = 0.44f,
        halfRadialW = 0.032f,
        halfHeightZ = 0.019f,
        hullR = 0.115f, hullG = 0.190f, hullB = 0.305f,
        innerTrimR = 0.05f, innerTrimG = 0.82f, innerTrimB = 0.96f,
        innerEmissive = 1.22f,
        outerTrimR = 0.075f, outerTrimG = 0.130f, outerTrimB = 0.220f,
        outerEmissive = 0f,
      )
      for (k in 0 until 8) {
        val ang = k * (PI.toFloat() * 0.25f)
        m.addOrientedBoxXY(
          angleRad = ang,
          rStart = 0.395f,
          rEnd = 0.485f,
          halfTangentialW = 0.020f,
          zBottom = -0.024f,
          zTop = 0.024f,
          r = 0.165f, g = 0.260f, b = 0.395f,
        )
        // Solar-gold docking beacon light on each clamp
        m.addOrientedBoxXY(
          angleRad = ang,
          rStart = 0.402f,
          rEnd = 0.422f,
          halfTangentialW = 0.009f,
          zBottom = 0.024f,
          zTop = 0.031f,
          r = 0.98f, g = 0.80f, b = 0.10f,
          emissive = 1.45f,
        )
      }
      return m
    }

    /**
     * Builds the Inner Counter-Rotating Gyro Ring (`R = 0.28f`).
     */
    fun buildInnerGyroRingMesh(): StationMeshBuilder {
      val m = StationMeshBuilder(6144)
      m.addBeveledRingXY(
        segments = 36,
        majorR = 0.28f,
        halfRadialW = 0.022f,
        halfHeightZ = 0.014f,
        hullR = 0.140f, hullG = 0.225f, hullB = 0.355f,
        innerTrimR = 0.98f, innerTrimG = 0.80f, innerTrimB = 0.12f,
        innerEmissive = 1.28f,
        outerTrimR = 0.00f, outerTrimG = 0.96f, outerTrimB = 0.83f,
        outerEmissive = 1.15f,
      )
      for (k in 0 until 4) {
        val ang = k * (PI.toFloat() * 0.5f) + 0.39f
        m.addOrientedBoxXY(
          angleRad = ang,
          rStart = 0.248f,
          rEnd = 0.312f,
          halfTangentialW = 0.015f,
          zBottom = -0.018f,
          zTop = 0.018f,
          r = 0.20f, g = 0.31f, b = 0.46f,
        )
      }
      return m
    }

    /**
     * Builds the **3D Containment Shield Ring (`R = 0.92f`) + 8 Golden-Cyan 3D Stabilizer Beams +
     * 8 Outward-Bracing 3D Emitter Chevrons** visibly pushing outward to hold back storm collapse.
     */
    fun buildContainmentAssemblyMesh(): StationMeshBuilder {
      val m = StationMeshBuilder(16384)
      val shieldR = SANCTUARY_SHIELD_RADIUS

      // 1. Crisp 3D Containment Shield Torus Ring at R = 0.92f
      m.addBeveledRingXY(
        segments = 64,
        majorR = shieldR,
        halfRadialW = 0.018f,
        halfHeightZ = 0.012f,
        hullR = 0.08f, hullG = 0.28f, hullB = 0.44f,
        innerTrimR = 0.00f, innerTrimG = 0.96f, innerTrimB = 0.85f,
        innerEmissive = 1.52f,
        outerTrimR = 0.22f, outerTrimG = 0.74f, outerTrimB = 0.98f,
        outerEmissive = 1.38f,
      )

      // 2. 8 Golden-Cyan 3D Stabilizer Beams (r = 0.175f -> 0.905f) + 8 Outward-Bracing Emitter Chevrons
      val beamSteps = 6
      val rStart = 0.175f
      val rEnd = shieldR - 0.015f
      for (k in 0 until 8) {
        val ang = k * (PI.toFloat() * 0.25f)
        val ca = cos(ang)
        val sa = sin(ang)
        val px = -sa
        val py = ca

        // Segmented 3D diamond-cross-section energy beam from Solar-Gold collar emitter to Bioluminescent Cyan shield rim
        for (s in 0 until beamSteps) {
          val t0 = s.toFloat() / beamSteps.toFloat()
          val t1 = (s + 1).toFloat() / beamSteps.toFloat()
          val rad0 = rStart + (rEnd - rStart) * t0
          val rad1 = rStart + (rEnd - rStart) * t1
          val w0 = 0.0105f * (1f - 0.22f * t0)
          val w1 = 0.0105f * (1f - 0.22f * t1)
          val h0 = 0.0085f * (1f - 0.20f * t0)
          val h1 = 0.0085f * (1f - 0.20f * t1)

          // Smooth gradient from Solar-Gold (#FACC15) near station collar -> Cyan (#00F5D4) into containment rim
          val goldMix0 = (1f - t0 * 1.45f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
          val goldMix1 = (1f - t1 * 1.45f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
          val rCol0 = 0.00f * (1f - goldMix0) + 0.98f * goldMix0
          val gCol0 = 0.96f * (1f - goldMix0) + 0.82f * goldMix0
          val bCol0 = 0.84f * (1f - goldMix0) + 0.12f * goldMix0
          val rCol1 = 0.00f * (1f - goldMix1) + 0.98f * goldMix1
          val gCol1 = 0.96f * (1f - goldMix1) + 0.82f * goldMix1
          val bCol1 = 0.84f * (1f - goldMix1) + 0.12f * goldMix1

          val top0x = ca * rad0; val top0y = sa * rad0; val top0z = h0
          val top1x = ca * rad1; val top1y = sa * rad1; val top1z = h1
          val bot0x = ca * rad0; val bot0y = sa * rad0; val bot0z = -h0
          val bot1x = ca * rad1; val bot1y = sa * rad1; val bot1z = -h1
          val lft0x = ca * rad0 + px * w0; val lft0y = sa * rad0 + py * w0
          val lft1x = ca * rad1 + px * w1; val lft1y = sa * rad1 + py * w1
          val rgt0x = ca * rad0 - px * w0; val rgt0y = sa * rad0 - py * w0
          val rgt1x = ca * rad1 - px * w1; val rgt1y = sa * rad1 - py * w1

          val beamEmissive = 1.48f
          // Top-left facet
          m.addTriGradRadial(top0x, top0y, top0z, t0, rCol0, gCol0, bCol0, lft0x, lft0y, 0f, t0, rCol0, gCol0, bCol0, lft1x, lft1y, 0f, t1, rCol1, gCol1, bCol1, beamEmissive)
          m.addTriGradRadial(top0x, top0y, top0z, t0, rCol0, gCol0, bCol0, lft1x, lft1y, 0f, t1, rCol1, gCol1, bCol1, top1x, top1y, top1z, t1, rCol1, gCol1, bCol1, beamEmissive)
          // Top-right facet
          m.addTriGradRadial(rgt0x, rgt0y, 0f, t0, rCol0, gCol0, bCol0, top0x, top0y, top0z, t0, rCol0, gCol0, bCol0, top1x, top1y, top1z, t1, rCol1, gCol1, bCol1, beamEmissive)
          m.addTriGradRadial(rgt0x, rgt0y, 0f, t0, rCol0, gCol0, bCol0, top1x, top1y, top1z, t1, rCol1, gCol1, bCol1, rgt1x, rgt1y, 0f, t1, rCol1, gCol1, bCol1, beamEmissive)
          // Bottom-left facet
          m.addTriGradRadial(lft0x, lft0y, 0f, t0, rCol0, gCol0, bCol0, bot0x, bot0y, bot0z, t0, rCol0, gCol0, bCol0, bot1x, bot1y, bot1z, t1, rCol1, gCol1, bCol1, beamEmissive)
          m.addTriGradRadial(lft0x, lft0y, 0f, t0, rCol0, gCol0, bCol0, bot1x, bot1y, bot1z, t1, rCol1, gCol1, bCol1, lft1x, lft1y, 0f, t1, rCol1, gCol1, bCol1, beamEmissive)
          // Bottom-right facet
          m.addTriGradRadial(bot0x, bot0y, bot0z, t0, rCol0, gCol0, bCol0, rgt0x, rgt0y, 0f, t0, rCol0, gCol0, bCol0, rgt1x, rgt1y, 0f, t1, rCol1, gCol1, bCol1, beamEmissive)
          m.addTriGradRadial(bot0x, bot0y, bot0z, t0, rCol0, gCol0, bCol0, rgt1x, rgt1y, 0f, t1, rCol1, gCol1, bCol1, bot1x, bot1y, bot1z, t1, rCol1, gCol1, bCol1, beamEmissive)
        }

        // Armored Pylon Node Socket on the Containment Ring (r = 0.89f..0.95f)
        m.addOrientedBoxXY(
          angleRad = ang,
          rStart = shieldR - 0.030f,
          rEnd = shieldR + 0.026f,
          halfTangentialW = 0.026f,
          zBottom = -0.018f,
          zTop = 0.018f,
          r = 0.125f, g = 0.215f, b = 0.345f,
        )

        // 3D Outward-Bracing V-Shaped Emitter Chevron (r = 0.935f -> 1.035f) visibly bracing back the outer storm!
        val chevBaseR = shieldR + 0.015f
        val chevTipR = shieldR + 0.108f
        val chevWingSpan = 0.068f
        val tipX = ca * chevTipR
        val tipY = sa * chevTipR
        val wingLx = ca * chevBaseR + px * chevWingSpan
        val wingLy = sa * chevBaseR + py * chevWingSpan
        val wingRx = ca * chevBaseR - px * chevWingSpan
        val wingRy = sa * chevBaseR - py * chevWingSpan
        val throatX = ca * (chevBaseR + 0.028f)
        val throatY = sa * (chevBaseR + 0.028f)

        // Top armored solar-gold & cyan chevron wings
        m.addTri(throatX, throatY, 0.016f, wingLx, wingLy, 0.004f, tipX, tipY, 0.0f, 0.98f, 0.82f, 0.14f, emissive = 1.46f, radialT = 1.0f)
        m.addTri(throatX, throatY, 0.016f, tipX, tipY, 0.0f, wingRx, wingRy, 0.004f, 0.00f, 0.96f, 0.85f, emissive = 1.52f, radialT = 1.0f)
        // Bottom chevron wings
        m.addTri(throatX, throatY, -0.016f, tipX, tipY, 0.0f, wingLx, wingLy, -0.004f, 0.00f, 0.82f, 0.92f, emissive = 1.32f, radialT = 1.0f)
        m.addTri(throatX, throatY, -0.016f, wingRx, wingRy, -0.004f, tipX, tipY, 0.0f, 0.98f, 0.78f, 0.12f, emissive = 1.32f, radialT = 1.0f)
      }
      return m
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Live 3D Playfield Ship Entity undocking, patrolling in 3D inside `shieldR`, and docking back at the
 * central 3D `NEXUS` Orbital Station.
 */
private class HubTrafficShip(
  var shipId: Int = 1,
  var routeType: Int = 0, // 0 = UNDOCK_TO_PATROL, 1 = SANCTUARY_ORBIT_PATROL, 2 = PATROL_TO_DOCK
  var progress: Float = 0f,
  var durationSec: Float = 6.5f,
  var p0x: Float = 0f, var p0y: Float = 0f, var p0z: Float = 0f,
  var p1x: Float = 0f, var p1y: Float = 0f, var p1z: Float = 0f,
  var p2x: Float = 0f, var p2y: Float = 0f, var p2z: Float = 0f,
  var p3x: Float = 0f, var p3y: Float = 0f, var p3z: Float = 0f,
  var curX: Float = 0f, var curY: Float = 0f, var curZ: Float = 0f,
  var dirX: Float = 1f, var dirY: Float = 0f, var dirZ: Float = 0f,
  var bankRad: Float = 0f,
  var orbitAnchorAngle: Float = 0f,
  val trailHistoryX: FloatArray = FloatArray(TRAIL_POINTS),
  val trailHistoryY: FloatArray = FloatArray(TRAIL_POINTS),
  val trailHistoryZ: FloatArray = FloatArray(TRAIL_POINTS),
  var trailInitialized: Boolean = false,
) {
  companion object {
    const val TRAIL_POINTS = 10
  }
}

/**
 * Hardware-accelerated OpenGL ES 3.0 (`#version 300 es`) `Abyssal-Garden` 3D Safe-Zone Sanctuary Renderer:
 * - Choreographer hardware VSYNC pacing (`eglSwapInterval(1)` + EMA `dt` smoothing).
 * - Zero tie-dye magenta/rainbow swirls:
 *   - Inside `r < shieldR`: Calm volumetric `#020814` -> `#041428` abyssal space-ocean clarity with angled
 *     light shafts, gentle cyan/sapphire caustic shimmer (`0.10..0.22`), crisp `1.0x` starlight, and drifting
 *     cyan/gold depth motes.
 *   - At `r == shieldR`: Braced `#00F5D4` / `#38BDF8` 3D Containment Shield Ring (`R = 0.92f`) with 8
 *     golden-cyan 3D stabilizer beams & 8 outward-bracing emitter chevrons radiating outward ripples.
 *   - Outside `r > shieldR`: Dark encroaching abyssal storm clouds (`#050914`, `#0B192E`, `#1E3A5F` / `#0284C7`
 *     ridges + fine ice-cyan veins) pressing inward and physically held back from collapsing in.
 * - High-contrast 3D Multi-Ring `NEXUS` Orbital Citadel + live `128x128` Playfield ships patrolling in 3D under
 *   hardware `GL_DEPTH_TEST`, finished with half-res `>1.05` HDR bloom & haze-free ACES Filmic Tonemap.
 */
class NexusSpaceGlView(context: Context) :
  TextureView(context), TextureView.SurfaceTextureListener {

  @Volatile var isSplashMode: Boolean = false
  @Volatile var dimFactor: Float = 1.0f
  @Volatile var focusedTearIndex: Int = -1
  @Volatile private var activeDiveTearIdx: Int = -1
  @Volatile private var activeDiveProgress: Float = 0f

  @Volatile private var targetLookYawRad: Float = 0f
  @Volatile private var targetLookPitchRad: Float = 0f
  @Volatile private var currentLookYawRad: Float = 0f
  @Volatile private var currentLookPitchRad: Float = 0f
  @Volatile private var springBackActive: Boolean = true
  @Volatile private var latestTimeSec: Float = 0f

  @Volatile private var onlinePilotShipIds: IntArray = intArrayOf(1)
  @Volatile private var holoOnlinePilots: Int = 1
  @Volatile private var holoUnreadComms: Int = 0
  @Volatile private var projectionDirty: Boolean = true

  private var renderThread: GlSpaceRenderThread? = null

  init {
    isOpaque = false
    if (!isHeadlessGlEnvironment()) {
      surfaceTextureListener = this
    }
  }

  fun consumeProjectionDirty(): Boolean {
    if (projectionDirty) {
      projectionDirty = false
      return true
    }
    return false
  }

  fun updateStationHologramTelemetry(onlinePilots: Int, unreadComms: Int) {
    holoOnlinePilots = onlinePilots.coerceAtLeast(1)
    holoUnreadComms = unreadComms.coerceAtLeast(0)
  }

  fun updateOnlinePilotShips(shipIds: IntArray) {
    onlinePilotShipIds =
      if (shipIds.isEmpty()) {
        intArrayOf(1)
      } else {
        IntArray(shipIds.size) { i -> shipIds[i].coerceIn(1, 10) }
      }
  }

  fun addCameraLookDelta(dxPx: Float, dyPx: Float) {
    val w = max(1f, width.toFloat())
    val h = max(1f, height.toFloat())
    springBackActive = false
    targetLookYawRad = (targetLookYawRad - (dxPx / w) * 0.42f).coerceIn(-0.22f, 0.22f)
    targetLookPitchRad = (targetLookPitchRad + (dyPx / h) * 0.30f).coerceIn(-0.15f, 0.15f)
    projectionDirty = true
  }

  fun releaseCameraLookSpring() {
    springBackActive = true
    projectionDirty = true
  }

  fun triggerTearDive(tearIndex: Int) {
    activeDiveTearIdx = tearIndex
    activeDiveProgress = 0.01f
    projectionDirty = true
  }

  fun triggerDiveIntoTear(tearIndex: Int) = triggerTearDive(tearIndex)

  fun clearTearDive() {
    activeDiveTearIdx = -1
    activeDiveProgress = 0f
    projectionDirty = true
  }

  fun resetCameraDive() = clearTearDive()

  fun computeProjectedTearStates(
    viewportW: Float = width.toFloat(),
    viewportH: Float = height.toFloat(),
  ): List<ProjectedRiftTearScreenState> {
    val basis =
      buildCameraBasis3D(
        viewportW = viewportW,
        viewportH = viewportH,
        timeSec = latestTimeSec,
        lookYawRad = currentLookYawRad,
        lookPitchRad = currentLookPitchRad,
        diveTearIdx = activeDiveTearIdx,
        diveProgress = activeDiveProgress,
        isSplashMode = isSplashMode,
      )
    return projectTearsWithBasis(basis, viewportW, viewportH, latestTimeSec)
  }

  override fun onSurfaceTextureAvailable(surface: SurfaceTexture, width: Int, height: Int) {
    if (isHeadlessGlEnvironment()) return
    projectionDirty = true
    stopRenderThread()
    renderThread =
      GlSpaceRenderThread(surface, max(1, width), max(1, height)).also { it.start() }
  }

  override fun onSurfaceTextureSizeChanged(surface: SurfaceTexture, width: Int, height: Int) {
    projectionDirty = true
    renderThread?.updateViewportSize(max(1, width), max(1, height))
  }

  override fun onSurfaceTextureDestroyed(surface: SurfaceTexture): Boolean {
    stopRenderThread()
    return true
  }

  override fun onSurfaceTextureUpdated(surface: SurfaceTexture) = Unit

  override fun onAttachedToWindow() {
    super.onAttachedToWindow()
    if (!isHeadlessGlEnvironment() && isAvailable && renderThread == null) {
      surfaceTexture?.let { st ->
        onSurfaceTextureAvailable(st, max(1, width), max(1, height))
      }
    }
  }

  override fun onDetachedFromWindow() {
    stopRenderThread()
    super.onDetachedFromWindow()
  }

  private fun stopRenderThread() {
    val thread = renderThread ?: return
    renderThread = null
    thread.requestStop()
    runCatching { thread.join(350L) }
  }

  private inner class GlSpaceRenderThread(
    private val surfaceTexture: SurfaceTexture,
    initialWidth: Int,
    initialHeight: Int,
  ) : Thread("NexusSpaceGlES30Thread") {

    private val running = AtomicBoolean(true)
    @Volatile private var viewportW: Int = initialWidth
    @Volatile private var viewportH: Int = initialHeight

    private var eglDisplay: EGLDisplay = EGL14.EGL_NO_DISPLAY
    private var eglContext: EGLContext = EGL14.EGL_NO_CONTEXT
    private var eglSurface: EGLSurface = EGL14.EGL_NO_SURFACE

    private var emptyVao = 0
    private var progScene = 0
    private var progSceneUpsample = 0
    private var progStation = 0
    private var progShipHull = 0
    private var progShipTrail = 0
    private var progBright = 0
    private var progBlur = 0
    private var progComposite = 0

    private var fboPlasma = 0
    private var texPlasma = 0
    private var plasmaW = 0
    private var plasmaH = 0
    private var fboScene = 0
    private var texScene = 0
    private var rboSceneDepth = 0
    private var fboBloomA = 0
    private var texBloomA = 0
    private var fboBloomB = 0
    private var texBloomB = 0
    private var allocatedW = 0
    private var allocatedH = 0

    // 4 Static 3D Station & Containment Mesh Groups
    private var vaoSpire = 0
    private var vboSpire = 0
    private var countSpire = 0

    private var vaoOuterRing = 0
    private var vboOuterRing = 0
    private var countOuterRing = 0

    private var vaoInnerRing = 0
    private var vboInnerRing = 0
    private var countInnerRing = 0

    private var vaoContainment = 0
    private var vboContainment = 0
    private var countContainment = 0

    private var texShipAtlas = 0
    private var bakedCustomShipVersion = -1
    private var vaoShipHull = 0
    private var vboShipHull = 0
    private var vaoShipTrail = 0
    private var vboShipTrail = 0
    private val shipHullScratch = FloatArray(32 * 6 * 7)
    private val shipHullBuffer: FloatBuffer =
      ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(shipHullScratch.size * 4).order(ByteOrder.nativeOrder()).asFloatBuffer()
    private val shipTrailScratch = FloatArray(32 * (HubTrafficShip.TRAIL_POINTS + 2) * 6 * 7)
    private val shipTrailBuffer: FloatBuffer =
      ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(shipTrailScratch.size * 4).order(ByteOrder.nativeOrder()).asFloatBuffer()

    private val trafficRng = Random(0x68AB54L)
    private val trafficShips = ArrayList<HubTrafficShip>(28)

    private val vsyncLock = Object()
    @Volatile private var pendingVsyncFrameNs: Long = 0L
    @Volatile private var hasPendingVsync: Boolean = false
    private val mainHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private val vsyncCallback =
      object : Choreographer.FrameCallback {
        override fun doFrame(frameTimeNanos: Long) {
          if (!running.get()) return
          synchronized(vsyncLock) {
            pendingVsyncFrameNs = frameTimeNanos
            hasPendingVsync = true
            vsyncLock.notifyAll()
          }
          Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(this)
        }
      }

    fun updateViewportSize(w: Int, h: Int) {
      viewportW = w
      viewportH = h
      projectionDirty = true
    }

    fun requestStop() {
      running.set(false)
      synchronized(vsyncLock) {
        hasPendingVsync = true
        vsyncLock.notifyAll()
      }
      mainHandler.post {
        runCatching { Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(vsyncCallback) }
      }
    }

    override fun run() {
      if (!initEglAndGl()) {
        releaseAllGlResources()
        return
      }

      mainHandler.post {
        if (running.get()) {
          runCatching { Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(vsyncCallback) }
        }
      }

      var startNs = 0L
      var prevFrameNs = 0L
      var smoothedDtSec = 1f / 60f
      var wasCameraMoving = false

      try {
        while (running.get()) {
          var vsyncNs: Long
          synchronized(vsyncLock) {
            if (!hasPendingVsync && running.get()) {
              runCatching { vsyncLock.wait(32L) }
            }
            hasPendingVsync = false
            vsyncNs = pendingVsyncFrameNs
          }
          if (!running.get()) break

          val frameNs = if (vsyncNs > 0L) vsyncNs else System.nanoTime()
          if (startNs == 0L) startNs = frameNs
          val rawDt =
            if (prevFrameNs == 0L) (1f / 60f)
            else ((frameNs - prevFrameNs) * 1e-9f).coerceIn(0.002f, 0.05f)
          prevFrameNs = frameNs
          smoothedDtSec += (rawDt - smoothedDtSec) * 0.22f
          val dtSec = smoothedDtSec.coerceIn(0.004f, 0.034f)
          val elapsedSec = ((frameNs - startNs) * 1e-9f).coerceAtLeast(0f)
          latestTimeSec = elapsedSec

          if (springBackActive) {
            targetLookYawRad += (0f - targetLookYawRad) * min(1f, dtSec * 4.5f)
            targetLookPitchRad += (0f - targetLookPitchRad) * min(1f, dtSec * 4.5f)
          }
          val smooth = min(1f, dtSec * 9.5f)
          currentLookYawRad += (targetLookYawRad - currentLookYawRad) * smooth
          currentLookPitchRad += (targetLookPitchRad - currentLookPitchRad) * smooth

          if (activeDiveTearIdx >= 0 && activeDiveProgress > 0f) {
            activeDiveProgress = (activeDiveProgress + dtSec * 2.8f).coerceAtMost(1f)
          }

          val cameraActiveNow =
            abs(currentLookYawRad) > 1e-4f ||
              abs(currentLookPitchRad) > 1e-4f ||
              abs(targetLookYawRad) > 1e-4f ||
              abs(targetLookPitchRad) > 1e-4f ||
              activeDiveProgress > 0f
          if (cameraActiveNow) {
            projectionDirty = true
            wasCameraMoving = true
          } else if (wasCameraMoving) {
            currentLookYawRad = 0f
            currentLookPitchRad = 0f
            targetLookYawRad = 0f
            targetLookPitchRad = 0f
            projectionDirty = true
            wasCameraMoving = false
          }

          val w = max(1, viewportW)
          val h = max(1, viewportH)
          runCatching {
            if (w != allocatedW || h != allocatedH) {
              allocateFramebuffers(w, h)
              projectionDirty = true
            }
            ensureShipAtlasUpToDate()
            stepTrafficSimulation(dtSec)

            drawFrame(w, h, elapsedSec)
            EGL14.eglSwapBuffers(eglDisplay, eglSurface)
          }.onFailure { err ->
            Log.e("NexusSpaceGlView", "Frame render error", err)
          }
        }
      } finally {
        mainHandler.post {
          runCatching { Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(vsyncCallback) }
        }
        releaseAllGlResources()
      }
    }

    private fun initEglAndGl(): Boolean {
      return runCatching {
        eglDisplay = EGL14.eglGetDisplay(EGL14.EGL_DEFAULT_DISPLAY)
        if (eglDisplay == EGL14.EGL_NO_DISPLAY) return false
        val vers = IntArray(2)
        if (!EGL14.eglInitialize(eglDisplay, vers, 0, vers, 1)) return false

        val configAttribs =
          intArrayOf(
            EGL14.EGL_RENDERABLE_TYPE, 0x0040, // EGL_OPENGL_ES3_BIT_KHR
            EGL14.EGL_RED_SIZE, 8,
            EGL14.EGL_GREEN_SIZE, 8,
            EGL14.EGL_BLUE_SIZE, 8,
            EGL14.EGL_ALPHA_SIZE, 8,
            EGL14.EGL_DEPTH_SIZE, 0,
            EGL14.EGL_STENCIL_SIZE, 0,
            EGL14.EGL_NONE,
          )
        val configs = arrayOfNulls<EGLConfig>(1)
        val numConfigs = IntArray(1)
        if (!EGL14.eglChooseConfig(eglDisplay, configAttribs, 0, configs, 0, 1, numConfigs, 0) ||
          numConfigs[0] <= 0
        ) {
          return false
        }
        val chosenConfig = configs[0] ?: return false

        val ctxAttribs = intArrayOf(EGL14.EGL_CONTEXT_CLIENT_VERSION, 3, EGL14.EGL_NONE)
        eglContext = EGL14.eglCreateContext(eglDisplay, chosenConfig, EGL14.EGL_NO_CONTEXT, ctxAttribs, 0)
        if (eglContext == EGL14.EGL_NO_CONTEXT) return false

        val surfAttribs = intArrayOf(EGL14.EGL_NONE)
        eglSurface = EGL14.eglCreateWindowSurface(eglDisplay, chosenConfig, surfaceTexture, surfAttribs, 0)
        if (eglSurface == EGL14.EGL_NO_SURFACE) return false

        if (!EGL14.eglMakeCurrent(eglDisplay, eglSurface, eglSurface, eglContext)) return false
        EGL14.eglSwapInterval(eglDisplay, 1)

        val vaos = IntArray(1)
        GLES30.glGenVertexArrays(1, vaos, 0)
        emptyVao = vaos[0]

        progScene = linkProgram("progScene", FULLSCREEN_TRI_VERT_GLSL, ABYSSAL_SANCTUARY_SCENE_FRAG_GLSL)
        progSceneUpsample = linkProgram("progSceneUpsample", FULLSCREEN_TRI_VERT_GLSL, ABYSSAL_SCENE_UPSAMPLE_FRAG_GLSL)
        progStation = linkProgram("progStation", STATION_VERT_GLSL, STATION_FRAG_GLSL)
        progShipHull = linkProgram("progShipHull", SHIP_HULL_VERT_GLSL, SHIP_HULL_FRAG_GLSL)
        progShipTrail = linkProgram("progShipTrail", SHIP_TRAIL_VERT_GLSL, SHIP_TRAIL_FRAG_GLSL)
        progBright = linkProgram("progBright", FULLSCREEN_TRI_VERT_GLSL, BLOOM_BRIGHT_EXTRACT_FRAG_GLSL)
        progBlur = linkProgram("progBlur", FULLSCREEN_TRI_VERT_GLSL, BLOOM_GAUSSIAN_BLUR_FRAG_GLSL)
        progComposite = linkProgram("progComposite", FULLSCREEN_TRI_VERT_GLSL, FINAL_ACES_COMPOSITE_FRAG_GLSL)

        if (progScene == 0 || progSceneUpsample == 0 || progStation == 0 || progBright == 0 || progBlur == 0 || progComposite == 0) {
          Log.e(
            "NexusSpaceGlView",
            "Core GL program link failed: scene=$progScene upsample=$progSceneUpsample station=$progStation bright=$progBright blur=$progBlur comp=$progComposite",
          )
          return false
        }

        initStaticStationMeshes()
        initDynamicShipBuffers()
        true
      }.onFailure { err ->
        Log.e("NexusSpaceGlView", "initEglAndGl failed", err)
      }.getOrDefault(false)
    }

    private fun uploadStaticStationMesh(mesh: StationMeshBuilder): IntArray {
      val vaoArr = IntArray(1)
      val vboArr = IntArray(1)
      GLES30.glGenVertexArrays(1, vaoArr, 0)
      GLES30.glGenBuffers(1, vboArr, 0)
      val vao = vaoArr[0]
      val vbo = vboArr[0]
      val buf = mesh.toFloatBuffer()
      val stride = StationMeshBuilder.STRIDE_BYTES

      GLES30.glBindVertexArray(vao)
      GLES30.glBindBuffer(GLES30.GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, vbo)
      GLES30.glBufferData(GLES30.GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, mesh.floatCount * 4, buf, GLES30.GL_STATIC_DRAW)

      // aPos (vec3)
      GLES30.glEnableVertexAttribArray(0)
      GLES30.glVertexAttribPointer(0, 3, GLES30.GL_FLOAT, false, stride, 0)
      // aNormal (vec3)
      GLES30.glEnableVertexAttribArray(1)
      GLES30.glVertexAttribPointer(1, 3, GLES30.GL_FLOAT, false, stride, 3 * 4)
      // aColor (vec3)
      GLES30.glEnableVertexAttribArray(2)
      GLES30.glVertexAttribPointer(2, 3, GLES30.GL_FLOAT, false, stride, 6 * 4)
      // aEmissiveRadial (vec2: emissive, radialT)
      GLES30.glEnableVertexAttribArray(3)
      GLES30.glVertexAttribPointer(3, 2, GLES30.GL_FLOAT, false, stride, 9 * 4)

      GLES30.glBindVertexArray(0)
      GLES30.glBindBuffer(GLES30.GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0)
      return intArrayOf(vao, vbo, mesh.vertexCount)
    }

    private fun initStaticStationMeshes() {
      val spireTriple = uploadStaticStationMesh(StationMeshBuilder.buildCentralSpireMesh())
      vaoSpire = spireTriple[0]; vboSpire = spireTriple[1]; countSpire = spireTriple[2]
