    center.y + panOffsetY + (wy - engine.arenaCenterY) * radarScale,
   )

   // Outer obsidian-glass bezel (eliminates bezel/tip clipping)
   drawCircle(Color(0xE8030812), outerBezelRadius, center)
   drawCircle(Color(0x4438BDF8), outerBezelRadius, center, style = Stroke(width = 1.0.dp.toPx()))

   // Inner 1:1 circular playfield scope
   drawCircle(if (isExpanded) Color(0xF5040B16) else Color(0xCC040B16), playfieldRadius, center)
   innerClipPath.reset()
   innerClipPath.addOval(Rect(center.x - playfieldRadius, center.y - playfieldRadius, center.x + playfieldRadius, center.y + playfieldRadius))

   val nowMs = System.currentTimeMillis()
   val pulsePhase = ((nowMs % 1200L) / 1200f)
   val goldPulse = 0.5f + 0.5f * sin(((nowMs % 640L) / 640f) * 6.28318f)
   val p = engine.localPlayer

   clipPath(innerClipPath) {
    val arenaCenterOnRadar = Offset(center.x + panOffsetX, center.y + panOffsetY)
    drawCircle(Color(0x2238BDF8), playfieldRadius * 0.55f, arenaCenterOnRadar, style = Stroke(width = 1.0f))
    drawLine(Color(0x1838BDF8), Offset(arenaCenterOnRadar.x - playfieldRadius, arenaCenterOnRadar.y), Offset(arenaCenterOnRadar.x + playfieldRadius, arenaCenterOnRadar.y), 1f)
    drawLine(Color(0x1838BDF8), Offset(arenaCenterOnRadar.x, arenaCenterOnRadar.y - playfieldRadius), Offset(arenaCenterOnRadar.x, arenaCenterOnRadar.y + playfieldRadius), 1f)

    if (engine.hasActiveSafeZone()) {
     val szCenter = Offset(
      center.x + panOffsetX + (4000f - engine.arenaCenterX) * radarScale,
      center.y + panOffsetY + (4000f - engine.arenaCenterY) * radarScale,
     )
     val szRadius = ((engine.safeZone.width() * 0.5f) * RiftCalibrationState.safeZoneScale * radarScale).coerceAtLeast(3.2f)
     drawCircle(Color(0x2600F5D4), szRadius, szCenter)
     drawCircle(Color(0xAA00F5D4), szRadius, szCenter, style = Stroke(width = 1.2f))
    }

    for (wall in engine.walls) {
     val wx = wall.x + wall.w * 0.5f
     val wy = wall.y + wall.h * 0.5f
     val wPt = Offset(
      center.x + panOffsetX + (wx - engine.arenaCenterX) * radarScale,
      center.y + panOffsetY + (wy - engine.arenaCenterY) * radarScale,
     )
     val halfSpan = max(wall.w, wall.h) * 0.5f * radarScale
     drawCircle(Color(0x66475569), halfSpan.coerceIn(1.2f, 4.5f), wPt)
    }

    for (g in engine.greens) drawCircle(Color(0xFF10B981).copy(alpha = 0.55f), 1.1f, worldToRadar(g.x, g.y))

    if (engine.isStasisBreachRulesActive()) {
     drawCircle(Color(0xFF38BDF8), 4.2f, worldToRadar(engine.westBrigReactorX, engine.westBrigReactorY), style = Stroke(1.3f))
     drawCircle(Color(0xFFF43F5E), 4.2f, worldToRadar(engine.eastBrigReactorX, engine.eastBrigReactorY), style = Stroke(1.3f))
    } else if (engine.isRiftControlRulesActive()) {
     val aCol = when (engine.riftAlphaLockedBy) { 0 -> Color(0xFF00F5D4); 1 -> Color(0xFFF43F5E); else -> Color(0xFF38BDF8) }
     val oCol = when (engine.riftOmegaLockedBy) { 0 -> Color(0xFF00F5D4); 1 -> Color(0xFFF43F5E); else -> Color(0xFF38BDF8) }
     drawCircle(aCol, 4.6f, worldToRadar(engine.riftAlphaX, engine.riftAlphaY), style = Stroke(1.5f))
     drawCircle(oCol, 4.6f, worldToRadar(engine.riftOmegaX, engine.riftOmegaY), style = Stroke(1.5f))
    }

    for (anom in engine.anomalies) {
     val aColor = when (anom.type) {
      AnomalyType.PLASMA_RIFT -> Color(0xFFEF4444)
      AnomalyType.REPULSOR_RIFT -> Color.White
      AnomalyType.GRAVITY_RIFT -> Color(0xFFA855F7)
      AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_A -> Color(0xFF2DD4BF)
      AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_B -> Color(0xFF38BDF8)
     }
     drawCircle(aColor.copy(alpha = 0.82f), 2.6f, worldToRadar(anom.x, anom.y))
    }

    for (bw in engine.brickWalls) {
     val aPt = worldToRadar(if (bw.w >= bw.h) bw.x else bw.x + bw.w * 0.5f, if (bw.w >= bw.h) bw.y + bw.h * 0.5f else bw.y)
     val bPt = worldToRadar(if (bw.w >= bw.h) bw.x + bw.w else bw.x + bw.w * 0.5f, if (bw.w >= bw.h) bw.y + bw.h * 0.5f else bw.y + bw.h)
     drawLine(Color(0xFF00F5D4), aPt, bPt, strokeWidth = 2.2f)
    }

    for (dc in engine.decoys) {
     val isFriendlyDecoy = dc.ownerId == p.id || (p.armadaName.isNotEmpty() && dc.armadaName == p.armadaName) || (p.syndicateTag != "GUEST" && dc.syndicateTag == p.syndicateTag)
     drawCircle(if (isFriendlyDecoy) Color(0xFF38BDF8) else Color(0xFFEF4444), 2.2f, worldToRadar(dc.x, dc.y))
    }

    if (engine.isFluxCoreRulesActive() && engine.fluxCoreCarrierEntityId.isEmpty()) {
     val orbPt = worldToRadar(engine.fluxCoreOrb.x, engine.fluxCoreOrb.y)
     val orbHaloR = 4.4f + 4.8f * goldPulse
     drawCircle(Color(0xFFFACC15).copy(alpha = (0.85f - 0.50f * goldPulse).coerceIn(0.25f, 0.90f)), orbHaloR, orbPt, style = Stroke(1.5f))
     drawCircle(Color(0xFFFFD700), 4.4f, orbPt)
     drawCircle(Color.White, 4.4f, orbPt, style = Stroke(1.1f))
    }

    val radarShips = if (engine.hasJoinedMatch) engine.ships else listOf(p)
    for (s in radarShips) {
     if (s.respawnTimer > 0f) continue
     val isFriendly = engine.areAllied(p, s)
     val isBallCarrier = engine.hasJoinedMatch && engine.isFluxCoreRulesActive() &&
      (s.id == engine.fluxCoreCarrierEntityId || (engine.fluxCoreOrb.carrierShipId != -1 && s.shipId == engine.fluxCoreOrb.carrierShipId))
     if (s.isCloaked && !isFriendly && !s.isLocalPlayer && !isBallCarrier) continue

     val pt = worldToRadar(s.x, s.y)
     val sx = pt.x; val sy = pt.y
     if (isBallCarrier) {
      // 2x pulsing Gold Flux Core carrier beacon
      val carrierHaloR = 6.2f + 5.8f * goldPulse
      drawCircle(Color(0xFFFACC15).copy(alpha = (0.92f - 0.52f * goldPulse).coerceIn(0.30f, 0.95f)), carrierHaloR, pt, style = Stroke(1.8f))
      drawCircle(lerp(Color(0xFFFFD700), Color(0xFFFACC15), goldPulse), 6.2f, pt)
      drawCircle(Color.White, 6.2f, pt, style = Stroke(1.25f))
      continue
     }

     if (!engine.isFluxCoreRulesActive() && s.bounty >= RiftGameEngine.HVT_BOUNTY_THRESHOLD) {
      val pingR = 3.2f + pulsePhase * 6.5f
      drawCircle(Color(0xFFFFD700).copy(alpha = (1f - pulsePhase).coerceIn(0.20f, 0.90f)), pingR, pt, style = Stroke(1.3f))
     }

     if (s.isLocalPlayer) {
      val r = 4.2f; val a = s.angle
      trianglePath.reset()
      trianglePath.moveTo(sx + cos(a) * r, sy + sin(a) * r)
      trianglePath.lineTo(sx + cos(a + 2.4f) * r * 0.85f, sy + sin(a + 2.4f) * r * 0.85f)
      trianglePath.lineTo(sx + cos(a - 2.4f) * r * 0.85f, sy + sin(a - 2.4f) * r * 0.85f)
      trianglePath.close()
      drawPath(trianglePath, if (s.isCloaked) Color(0xFFD8B4FE) else Color.White)
     } else {
      val isSpectatedTarget = engine.isActivelySpectatingTeammates() && s.id == engine.spectatingTargetShipId
      val dotFill = when { isSpectatedTarget -> Color(0xFF00F5D4); isFriendly -> Color(0xFF3B82F6); else -> Color(0xFFEF4444) }
      val dotRadius = when { isSpectatedTarget -> 4.0f; s.isHuman -> 3.0f; else -> 2.2f }
      drawCircle(dotFill, dotRadius, pt)
      if (s.isHuman || isSpectatedTarget) drawCircle(Color.White, dotRadius, pt, style = Stroke(if (isSpectatedTarget) 1.3f else 1.0f))
     }
    }
   }

   drawCircle(Color(0x6638BDF8), playfieldRadius, center, style = Stroke(width = 1.1.dp.toPx()))

   // 3D AGSL Swirling Plasma Flux Ring wrapping the Circular Minimap
   val fluxPct = (p.flux / p.maxFlux.coerceAtLeast(1f)).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
   val critFlash = if (fluxPct < 0.20f || p.isIdleDraining) 0.38f + 0.62f * (0.5f + 0.5f * sin((nowMs % 320L) / 320f * 6.28318f)) else 1.0f
   val ringPrimary = when {
    p.isIdleDraining || fluxPct < 0.20f -> Color(0xFFEF4444).copy(alpha = critFlash)
    fluxPct >= 0.70f -> Color(0xFF00F5D4)
    fluxPct >= 0.35f -> Color(0xFF38BDF8)
    else -> Color(0xFFF59E0B)
   }
   val ringSecondary = when {
    p.isIdleDraining || fluxPct < 0.20f -> Color(0xFFF97316).copy(alpha = critFlash)
    fluxPct >= 0.70f -> Color(0xFF38BDF8)
    fluxPct >= 0.35f -> Color(0xFF10B981)
    else -> Color(0xFFEF4444)
   }

   val trackStrokeW = 5.0.dp.toPx()
   val arcStrokeW = 4.6.dp.toPx()
   val arcTopLeft = Offset(center.x - fluxRingRadius, center.y - fluxRingRadius)
   val arcSize = Size(fluxRingRadius * 2f, fluxRingRadius * 2f)
   drawCircle(Color(0xBF071120), fluxRingRadius, center, style = Stroke(width = trackStrokeW))
   for (tick in 0 until 12) {
    val tickRad = Math.toRadians(-90.0 + tick * 30.0)
    val rIn = fluxRingRadius - trackStrokeW * 0.48f; val rOut = fluxRingRadius + trackStrokeW * 0.48f
    drawLine(Color(0x5538BDF8), Offset(center.x + rIn * cos(tickRad).toFloat(), center.y + rIn * sin(tickRad).toFloat()), Offset(center.x + rOut * cos(tickRad).toFloat(), center.y + rOut * sin(tickRad).toFloat()), 0.9.dp.toPx())
   }

   if (fluxPct > 0.005f) {
    val sweepDeg = 360f * fluxPct
    drawArc(ringPrimary.copy(alpha = 0.24f), -90f, sweepDeg, false, arcTopLeft, arcSize, style = Stroke(width = arcStrokeW * 1.75f, cap = StrokeCap.Round))
    var drewAgslRing = false
    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33 && fluxAgslShader != null) {
     val timeSec = ((nowMs % 60000L) / 1000f)
     drewAgslRing = runCatching {
      fluxAgslShader.setFloatUniform("uRes", w, h)
      fluxAgslShader.setFloatUniform("uTime", timeSec)
      fluxAgslShader.setFloatUniform("uSweepFrac", fluxPct.coerceIn(0f, 1f))
      fluxAgslShader.setFloatUniform("uRIn", fluxRingRadius - arcStrokeW * 0.56f)
      fluxAgslShader.setFloatUniform("uROut", fluxRingRadius + arcStrokeW * 0.56f)
      fluxAgslShader.setFloatUniform("uColA", ringSecondary.red, ringSecondary.green, ringSecondary.blue)
      fluxAgslShader.setFloatUniform("uColB", ringPrimary.red, ringPrimary.green, ringPrimary.blue)
      drawRect(brush = ShaderBrush(fluxAgslShader), topLeft = Offset.Zero, size = Size(w, h), alpha = critFlash)
      true
     }.getOrDefault(false)
    }
    if (!drewAgslRing) {
     drawArc(ringSecondary, -90f, sweepDeg, false, arcTopLeft, arcSize, style = Stroke(width = arcStrokeW, cap = StrokeCap.Round))
     drawArc(ringPrimary, -90f, sweepDeg, false, arcTopLeft, arcSize, style = Stroke(width = arcStrokeW * 0.58f, cap = StrokeCap.Round))
    }

    val tipRad = Math.toRadians(-90.0 + sweepDeg.toDouble())
    val tipCenter = Offset(center.x + fluxRingRadius * cos(tipRad).toFloat(), center.y + fluxRingRadius * sin(tipRad).toFloat())
    val tipSpinDeg = ((nowMs % 1800L) / 1800f) * 360f
    val tipPulse = 0.90f + 0.14f * sin((nowMs % 900L) / 900f * 6.283185f)
    val symR = 4.8.dp.toPx() * tipPulse
    drawCircle(ringPrimary.copy(alpha = 0.34f), symR * 1.32f, tipCenter)
    drawCircle(Color(0xF0050E1D), symR * 0.96f, tipCenter)
    drawCircle(ringSecondary.copy(alpha = 0.72f), symR * 0.94f, tipCenter, style = Stroke(0.85.dp.toPx()))
    val outerArcR = symR * 0.82f
    val innerArcR = symR * 0.56f
    for (i in 0 until 3) {
     val baseDeg = tipSpinDeg + i * 120f
     drawArc(
      color = ringSecondary,
      startAngle = baseDeg,
      sweepAngle = 82f,
      useCenter = false,
      topLeft = Offset(tipCenter.x - outerArcR, tipCenter.y - outerArcR),
      size = Size(outerArcR * 2f, outerArcR * 2f),
      style = Stroke(width = 1.25.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
     )
     drawArc(
      color = ringPrimary,
      startAngle = baseDeg + 8f,
      sweepAngle = 68f,
      useCenter = false,
      topLeft = Offset(tipCenter.x - outerArcR, tipCenter.y - outerArcR),
      size = Size(outerArcR * 2f, outerArcR * 2f),
      style = Stroke(width = 0.85.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
     )
     drawArc(
      color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.88f),
      startAngle = -tipSpinDeg * 0.85f + i * 120f + 22f,
      sweepAngle = 54f,
      useCenter = false,
      topLeft = Offset(tipCenter.x - innerArcR, tipCenter.y - innerArcR),
      size = Size(innerArcR * 2f, innerArcR * 2f),
      style = Stroke(width = 0.75.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
     )
    }
    drawCircle(ringPrimary, 1.85.dp.toPx(), tipCenter)
    drawCircle(Color.White, 1.15.dp.toPx(), tipCenter)
   }
  }

  val playerFluxPct = (engine.localPlayer.flux / engine.localPlayer.maxFlux.coerceAtLeast(1f)).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
  val badgeColor = when {
   engine.localPlayer.isIdleDraining || playerFluxPct < 0.20f -> Color(0xFFEF4444)
   playerFluxPct >= 0.70f -> Color(0xFF00F5D4)
   playerFluxPct >= 0.35f -> Color(0xFF38BDF8)
   else -> Color(0xFFF59E0B)
  }
  Box(
   modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomCenter).padding(bottom = 1.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
    .background(Color(0xF2040B16)).border(1.dp, badgeColor.copy(alpha = 0.88f), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
    .padding(horizontal = 5.dp, vertical = 1.dp),
   contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
   Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.5.dp)) {
    FluxEmblem(sizeDp = 9.5.dp)
    Text("${engine.localPlayer.flux.roundToInt()}", color = badgeColor, fontSize = 7.0.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, style = CompactCircleTextStyle, maxLines = 1)
   }
  }
 }
}

@Composable
private fun UnifiedThreeRingCockpitButton(
 title: String,
 sub: String,
 strokeColor: Color,
 fillColor: Color,
 subColor: Color,
 borderWeight: Float = 1.0f,
 sizeDp: Dp = 50.dp,
 modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
 Box(modifier = modifier.size(sizeDp), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
  Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
   val cx = size.width * 0.5f; val cy = size.height * 0.5f; val r = size.minDimension * 0.47f
   drawCircle(Color(0xEB070F1E), r * 1.05f, Offset(cx, cy))
   drawCircle(strokeColor, r, Offset(cx, cy), style = Stroke(width = (2.0f * borderWeight).dp.toPx()))
   for (tick in 0 until 4) {
    val a = tick * (Math.PI.toFloat() * 0.5f)
    drawLine(strokeColor, Offset(cx + cos(a) * (r * 0.88f), cy + sin(a) * (r * 0.88f)), Offset(cx + cos(a) * (r * 1.03f), cy + sin(a) * (r * 1.03f)), 1.3.dp.toPx(), StrokeCap.Round)
   }
   drawCircle(fillColor, r * 0.86f, Offset(cx, cy))
   drawCircle(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.55f), r * 0.82f, Offset(cx, cy), style = Stroke(width = 1.0.dp.toPx()))
   val specR = r * 0.74f
   drawArc(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.45f), 205f, 130f, false, Offset(cx - specR, cy - specR), Size(specR * 2f, specR * 2f), style = Stroke(width = 1.4.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round))
  }
  Text(title, color = Color.White, fontSize = 8.0.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, style = CompactCircleTextStyle, maxLines = 1, modifier = Modifier.offset(y = (-6).dp))
  Box(
   modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomCenter).offset(y = (-2).dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(5.dp))
    .background(Color(0xF0040A16)).border(1.dp, strokeColor, RoundedCornerShape(5.dp)).padding(horizontal = 5.dp, vertical = 1.dp),
   contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) { Text(sub, color = subColor, fontSize = 6.8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, style = CompactCircleTextStyle, maxLines = 1) }
 }
}

@Composable
private fun KillFeedRow(entry: KillFeedEntry, alpha: Float) {
 val cleanKillerTag = entry.killerTag.trim().uppercase(Locale.US).takeIf {
  it.isNotEmpty() && it !in RiftGameEngine.LEGACY_FOUNDRY_TAGS && it !in setOf("GUEST", "FREE", "UNAFFILIATED", "NONE", "SOLO")
 } ?: ""
 val cleanVictimTag = entry.victimTag.trim().uppercase(Locale.US).takeIf {
  it.isNotEmpty() && it !in RiftGameEngine.LEGACY_FOUNDRY_TAGS && it !in setOf("GUEST", "FREE", "UNAFFILIATED", "NONE", "SOLO")
 } ?: ""
 val killerDisplay = if (cleanKillerTag.isNotEmpty()) "[$cleanKillerTag] ${entry.killerName}" else entry.killerName
 val victimDisplay = if (cleanVictimTag.isNotEmpty()) "[$cleanVictimTag] ${entry.victimName}" else entry.victimName
 val isHighBountyShutdown = entry.victimBounty > 1000
 val rowDropShadow = if (isHighBountyShutdown) Shadow(Color(0xFFF59E0B).copy(alpha = alpha), Offset(0f, 1f), 8f) else Shadow(Color(0xF2000000).copy(alpha = alpha), Offset(0f, 1.5f), 3.5f)
 val rowTextStyle = TextStyle(lineHeight = 11.5.sp, shadow = rowDropShadow)
 val killerColor = (when { isHighBountyShutdown -> Color(0xFFFEF08A); entry.killerIsLocal -> Color(0xFF38BDF8); entry.killerIsAllied -> Color(0xFF60A5FA); else -> Color(0xFFF87171) }).copy(alpha = alpha)
 val victimColor = (when { isHighBountyShutdown -> Color(0xFFF59E0B); entry.victimIsLocal -> Color(0xFF38BDF8); entry.victimIsAllied -> Color(0xFF60A5FA); else -> Color(0xFFF87171) }).copy(alpha = alpha)
 val bountyColor = (when { isHighBountyShutdown -> Color(0xFFF59E0B); entry.wasHvt -> Color(0xFFFFD700); else -> Color(0xFFFACC15) }).copy(alpha = alpha)

 Row(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = 1.dp, bottom = 4.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)) {
  Text(killerDisplay, color = killerColor, fontSize = 7.2.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, style = rowTextStyle, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false))
  Text(">>", color = (if (isHighBountyShutdown) Color(0xFFF59E0B) else Color(0xFFCBD5E1)).copy(alpha = 0.85f * alpha), fontSize = 6.8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, style = rowTextStyle)
  Text(victimDisplay, color = victimColor, fontSize = 7.2.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, style = rowTextStyle, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false))
  Text("${entry.victimBounty} RES", color = bountyColor, fontSize = 7.2.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, style = rowTextStyle, maxLines = 1)
 }
}

data class PermanentUpgradeSlot(
 val iconType: Int,
 val label: String,
 val valueText: String,
 val isActive: Boolean,
 val accentColor: Color,
)

@Composable
private fun ActivePowerupsDock(
 player: ShipEntity,
 buffVersion: Int,
 frameTick: Int,
 textScale: Float,
 uiUnlocked: Boolean,
 buffRec: VisualElementRecipe = RiftVisualForgeState.getRecipe(ForgeElementTarget.HUD_BUFF_STRIP),
) {
 val unusedTick = frameTick + buffVersion
 val pctPerStack = RiftCalibrationState.overchargeSurgePctPerStack
 val spdPct = (player.speedOverchargeStacks * pctPerStack * 100f).roundToInt()
 val thrPct = (player.thrustOverchargeStacks * pctPerStack * 100f).roundToInt()
 val turnPct = player.turnOverchargeStacks * 12
 val maxFluxPct = player.maxFluxOverchargeStacks * 10
 val rchPct = (player.rechargeOverchargeStacks * pctPerStack * 100f).roundToInt()
 val dockBg = if (buffRec.isFactoryDefault) Color(0xD9080E18) else Color(buffRec.primaryColorInt).copy(alpha = buffRec.surfaceOpacity.coerceIn(0.25f, 0.98f))
 val dockBorder = if (buffRec.isFactoryDefault) Color(0x4D38BDF8) else Color(buffRec.trimColorInt)

 val activeSpecialReg =
  when {
   player.tractorBeamActive -> RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["TRACTOR_BEAM"]
   player.lanceBeamActive -> RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["LANCE_BEAM"]
   player.specialWeaponCharges > 0 && player.specialWeaponType != "NONE" -> RiftCodex.getBuffRegistryEntry(player.specialWeaponType)
   else -> null
  }
 val slots = buildList {
  if (activeSpecialReg != null) {
   val specVal =
    when {
     player.tractorBeamActive || player.lanceBeamActive -> "ON"
     player.specialWeaponStacks > 1 -> "x${player.specialWeaponStacks}"
     else -> "[${player.specialWeaponCharges}]"
    }
   add(
    PermanentUpgradeSlot(
     iconType = activeSpecialReg.buffTypeIndex.coerceAtLeast(0),
     label = activeSpecialReg.shortLabel.take(5),
     valueText = specVal,
     isActive = true,
     accentColor = Color(activeSpecialReg.strokeColorInt),
    )
   )
  }
  add(PermanentUpgradeSlot(9, "BNC", when { player.hasBouncingBulletsUpgrade -> "ON"; player.spec.primaryBounces > 0 -> "NAT"; else -> "OFF" }, player.hasBouncingBulletsUpgrade || player.spec.primaryBounces > 0, Color(0xFFA855F7)))
  add(PermanentUpgradeSlot(-10, "SPD", "+$spdPct%", player.speedOverchargeStacks > 0, Color(0xFF38BDF8)))
  add(PermanentUpgradeSlot(-11, "THR", "+$thrPct%", player.thrustOverchargeStacks > 0, Color(0xFFF59E0B)))
  add(PermanentUpgradeSlot(-13, "TURN", "+$turnPct%", player.turnOverchargeStacks > 0, Color(0xFFEC4899)))
  add(PermanentUpgradeSlot(-14, "MAX", "+$maxFluxPct%", player.maxFluxOverchargeStacks > 0, Color(0xFF00F5D4)))
  add(PermanentUpgradeSlot(-12, "RCH", "+$rchPct%", player.rechargeOverchargeStacks > 0, Color(0xFF10B981)))
 }

 Row(
  modifier = Modifier.wrapContentSize().clip(RoundedCornerShape(9.dp)).background(dockBg)
   .border((0.85f * buffRec.borderWeight).dp, dockBorder, RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
   .wysiwygUnlockOutline(enabled = uiUnlocked, cornerRadius = 9.dp)
   .padding(horizontal = (6.5f * textScale).dp, vertical = (2.8f * textScale).dp),
  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy((5.5f * textScale).dp),
 ) {
  slots.forEach { slot -> PermanentUpgradeBadge(slot = slot, textScale = textScale) }
 }
}

@Composable
private fun PermanentUpgradeBadge(slot: PermanentUpgradeSlot, textScale: Float) {
 val bmp = remember(slot.iconType) { RiftSpriteBaker.getBuffIconBitmap(slot.iconType).asImageBitmap() }
 val labelColor = if (slot.isActive) slot.accentColor else Color(0xFF64748B)
 Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy((2.5f * textScale).dp)) {
  Box(modifier = Modifier.size((14.0f * textScale).dp), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
   Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
    val strokeWidthPx = (if (slot.isActive) 1.1.dp else 0.7.dp).toPx()
    val radius = (size.minDimension - strokeWidthPx) / 2f
    if (slot.isActive) {
     drawCircle(slot.accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.25f), radius, style = Stroke(strokeWidthPx * 1.4f))
     drawCircle(slot.accentColor, radius, style = Stroke(strokeWidthPx))
    } else drawCircle(Color(0x3D475569), radius, style = Stroke(strokeWidthPx))
   }
   if (slot.iconType == -14) FluxEmblem(sizeDp = (9.5f * textScale).dp)
   else {
    Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size((10.0f * textScale).dp)) {
     drawImage(bmp, IntOffset.Zero, IntSize(size.width.toInt(), size.height.toInt()), alpha = if (slot.isActive) 1.0f else 0.28f)
    }
   }
  }
  Text("${slot.label} ${slot.valueText}", color = labelColor, fontSize = (6.8f * textScale).sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, style = WingTelemetryTextStyle, maxLines = 1)
 }
}

private fun parseHexColorSafe(hex: String, fallback: Color = ConduitNexusTeal): Color {
  val cleaned = hex.trim().removePrefix("#")
  val rgb = cleaned.toLongOrNull(16) ?: return fallback
  return if (cleaned.length == 8) Color(rgb) else Color(0xFF000000L or rgb)
}

@Composable
fun RiftShardsStoreModal(

  onUnlockOrSelectFrameSlot: ((String) -> Pair<Boolean, String>)? = null,

  val context = LocalContext.current
  val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()

      else remember(refreshTick) { localPrefs.getPeakResonance() },

  }
  val nextTierThreshold = remember(effectiveLiveRes) {

  }

  val resolvedSweepClaimed =

                  }

                previewCosmeticId = item.id
                if (onUnlockOrEquipCosmetic != null) {
                  val (_, msg) = onUnlockOrEquipCosmetic("KILL_FINISHER", item)
                  refreshTick++
                  statusBanner = msg
                } else {
                  val unlocked = queryCosmeticUnlocked("KILL_FINISHER", item)
                  if (unlocked) {
                    localPrefs.setEquippedCosmeticId("KILL_FINISHER", item.id)
                    refreshTick++
                    statusBanner = "EQUIPPED KILL FINISHER: ${item.name.uppercase(Locale.US)}"
                  } else if (trySpendShards(item.shardCost)) {
                    localPrefs.setCosmeticUnlocked("KILL_FINISHER", item.id, true)
                    localPrefs.setEquippedCosmeticId("KILL_FINISHER", item.id)
                    refreshTick++
                    statusBanner =
                      "UNLOCKED & EQUIPPED ${item.name.uppercase(Locale.US)} (${spendCostNote(item.shardCost)})"
                  } else {
                    statusBanner =
                      "REQUIRES ${item.freeAtResonance} PEAK RESONANCE (FREE) OR ${item.shardCost} RIFT SHARDS"
                  }
                }
              },
            )
          }

          2 -> {
            ConduitCosmeticListDeck(
              title = "3D HULL TRIMS // CHASSIS BEVEL & REACTOR SEAM FINISHES",
              categoryKey = "HULL_TRIM",
              items = RiftProgressionCatalog.hullTrims,
              previewedId = previewCosmeticId,
              equippedId = queryEquippedCosmetic("HULL_TRIM"),
              isItemUnlocked = { queryCosmeticUnlocked("HULL_TRIM", it) },
              onPreviewItem = { previewCosmeticId = it.id },
              onUnlockOrEquip = { item ->
                previewCosmeticId = item.id
                if (onUnlockOrEquipCosmetic != null) {
                  val (_, msg) = onUnlockOrEquipCosmetic("HULL_TRIM", item)
                  refreshTick++
                  statusBanner = msg
                } else {
                  val unlocked = queryCosmeticUnlocked("HULL_TRIM", item)
                  if (unlocked) {
                    localPrefs.setEquippedCosmeticId("HULL_TRIM", item.id)
                    RiftSpriteBaker.activeHullTrimStyle = item.id.coerceIn(0, 3)
                    refreshTick++
                    statusBanner = "EQUIPPED 3D HULL TRIM: ${item.name.uppercase(Locale.US)}"
                  } else if (trySpendShards(item.shardCost)) {
                    localPrefs.setCosmeticUnlocked("HULL_TRIM", item.id, true)
                    localPrefs.setEquippedCosmeticId("HULL_TRIM", item.id)
                    RiftSpriteBaker.activeHullTrimStyle = item.id.coerceIn(0, 3)
                    refreshTick++
                    statusBanner =
                      "UNLOCKED & EQUIPPED ${item.name.uppercase(Locale.US)} (${spendCostNote(item.shardCost)})"
                  } else {
                    statusBanner =
                      "REQUIRES ${item.freeAtResonance} PEAK RESONANCE (FREE) OR ${item.shardCost} RIFT SHARDS"
                  }
                }
              },
            )
          }

          3 -> {
            ConduitCosmeticListDeck(
              title = "WARP SIGNATURES // SECTOR ARRIVAL APERTURE VFX",
              categoryKey = "WARP_SIGNATURE",
              items = RiftProgressionCatalog.warpSignatures,
              previewedId = previewCosmeticId,
              equippedId = queryEquippedCosmetic("WARP_SIGNATURE"),
              isItemUnlocked = { queryCosmeticUnlocked("WARP_SIGNATURE", it) },
              onPreviewItem = { previewCosmeticId = it.id },
              onUnlockOrEquip = { item ->
                previewCosmeticId = item.id
                if (onUnlockOrEquipCosmetic != null) {
                  val (_, msg) = onUnlockOrEquipCosmetic("WARP_SIGNATURE", item)
                  refreshTick++
                  statusBanner = msg
                } else {
                  val unlocked = queryCosmeticUnlocked("WARP_SIGNATURE", item)
                  if (unlocked) {
                    localPrefs.setEquippedCosmeticId("WARP_SIGNATURE", item.id)
                    refreshTick++
                    statusBanner = "EQUIPPED WARP SIGNATURE: ${item.name.uppercase(Locale.US)}"
                  } else if (trySpendShards(item.shardCost)) {
                    localPrefs.setCosmeticUnlocked("WARP_SIGNATURE", item.id, true)
                    localPrefs.setEquippedCosmeticId("WARP_SIGNATURE", item.id)
                    refreshTick++
                    statusBanner =
                      "UNLOCKED & EQUIPPED ${item.name.uppercase(Locale.US)} (${spendCostNote(item.shardCost)})"
                  } else {
                    statusBanner =
                      "REQUIRES ${item.freeAtResonance} PEAK RESONANCE (FREE) OR ${item.shardCost} RIFT SHARDS"
                  }
                }
              },
            )
          }

          4 -> {
            ConduitCosmeticListDeck(
              title = "RESONANCE HALOS // #1 SECTOR RESONANCE LEADER RINGS",
              categoryKey = "HVT_HALO",
              items = RiftProgressionCatalog.hvtHalos,
              previewedId = previewCosmeticId,
              equippedId = queryEquippedCosmetic("HVT_HALO"),
              isItemUnlocked = { queryCosmeticUnlocked("HVT_HALO", it) },
              onPreviewItem = { previewCosmeticId = it.id },
              onUnlockOrEquip = { item ->
                previewCosmeticId = item.id
                if (onUnlockOrEquipCosmetic != null) {
                  val (_, msg) = onUnlockOrEquipCosmetic("HVT_HALO", item)
                  refreshTick++
                  statusBanner = msg
                } else {
                  val unlocked = queryCosmeticUnlocked("HVT_HALO", item)
                  if (unlocked) {
                    localPrefs.setEquippedCosmeticId("HVT_HALO", item.id)
                    refreshTick++
                    statusBanner = "EQUIPPED RESONANCE HALO: ${item.name.uppercase(Locale.US)}"
                  } else if (trySpendShards(item.shardCost)) {
                    localPrefs.setCosmeticUnlocked("HVT_HALO", item.id, true)
                    localPrefs.setEquippedCosmeticId("HVT_HALO", item.id)
                    refreshTick++
                    statusBanner =
                      "UNLOCKED & EQUIPPED ${item.name.uppercase(Locale.US)} (${spendCostNote(item.shardCost)})"
                  } else {
                    statusBanner =
                      "REQUIRES ${item.freeAtResonance} PEAK RESONANCE (FREE) OR ${item.shardCost} RIFT SHARDS"
                  }
                }
              },
            )
          }

          5 -> {
            ConduitFrameBaysDeck(
              activeSlotId = activeCustomSlotId,
              spentCustomizationPoints = spentCustomizationPoints,
              totalCustomizationPoints = totalCustomizationPoints,
              aiShipDesignTokens = aiShipDesignTokens,
              isTesterInfiniteShards = isTesterInfiniteShards,
              isFrameUnlocked = ::queryFrameUnlocked,
              onPreviewSlot = { slotId ->
                previewShipId = 10
                previewFrameSlotId = slotId
              },
              onUnlockOrSelectSlot = { slotId ->
                previewShipId = 10
                previewFrameSlotId = slotId
                if (onUnlockOrSelectFrameSlot != null) {
                  val (_, msg) = onUnlockOrSelectFrameSlot(slotId)
                  refreshTick++
                  statusBanner = msg
                } else {
                  val gate = RiftProgressionCatalog.getFrameSlotGate(slotId)
                  if (queryFrameUnlocked(slotId)) {
                    localPrefs.setActiveCustomSlotId(slotId)
                    refreshTick++
                    onOpenHangarShip10()
                  } else if (trySpendShards(gate.shardCost)) {
                    localPrefs.setCustomSlotUnlocked(slotId, true)
                    localPrefs.setActiveCustomSlotId(slotId)
                    refreshTick++
                    statusBanner =
                      "UNLOCKED ${slotId.uppercase(Locale.US)} (${spendCostNote(gate.shardCost)})"
                  } else {
                    statusBanner =
                      "REQUIRES ${gate.freeAtResonance} PEAK RESONANCE (FREE) OR ${gate.shardCost} RIFT SHARDS"
                  }
                }
              },
              onRespecPoints = {
                if (onRespecCustomizationPoints()) {
                  refreshTick++
                  statusBanner = "RIFT FRAME RESPEC COMPLETE (${spendCostNote(50L)})"
                } else {
                  statusBanner = "RESPEC REQUIRES >0 ALLOCATED POINTS (50 RIFT SHARDS)"
                }
              },
              onBuyForgeVoucher = {
                if (onPurchaseAiDesignToken()) {
                  refreshTick++
                  statusBanner = "ACQUIRED HULL FORGE SYNTHESIS VOUCHER (${spendCostNote(150L)})"
                } else {
                  statusBanner = "HULL FORGE VOUCHER REQUIRES 150 RIFT SHARDS"
                }
              },
              onOpenHangarShip10 = onOpenHangarShip10,
            )
          }

          else -> {
            ShardVaultTreasuryDeck(
              isCompactPhone = isCompactPhone,
              isTesterInfiniteShards = isTesterInfiniteShards,
              onSelectSkuPack = { pack ->
                scope.launch {
                  val result =
                    RiftBillingManager.launchShardPackPurchaseFlow(
                      activity = context as? Activity,
                      sku = pack,
                      currentUid = localPrefs.getOrCreatePermanentDeviceUid(),
                      callsign = localPrefs.getCallsign(),
                    )
                  when (result) {
                    is ShardPurchaseResult.VerifiedAndCredited -> {
                      onTopUpRiftShards(result.shardsCredited)
                      refreshTick++
                      statusBanner =
                        "VERIFIED PLAY PURCHASE [${result.productId.uppercase(Locale.US)}] // +${result.shardsCredited} SHARDS CREDITED"
                    }
                    is ShardPurchaseResult.TesterModeDormantNotice -> {
                      statusBanner = result.message
                    }
                    is ShardPurchaseResult.BillingUnavailable -> {
                      statusBanner = result.reason
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun ShardVaultTreasuryDeck(
  isCompactPhone: Boolean,
  isTesterInfiniteShards: Boolean,
  onSelectSkuPack: (ShardVaultSkuPack) -> Unit,
) {
  val rows = remember { RiftBillingManager.OFFICIAL_SKU_CATALOG.chunked(2) }
  val studioUpper = RiftBillingManager.STUDIO_LEGAL_NAME.uppercase(Locale.US)

  Column(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().testTag("shard_vault_treasury_deck"),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 5.dp else 7.dp),
  ) {
    // Top Studio / Tester Treasury Status Banner
    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
          .background(ConduitTabletAbyss, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
          .border(
            1.dp,
            if (isTesterInfiniteShards) ConduitNexusTeal else ConduitSolarGold,
            RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
          )
          .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 5.dp)
          .testTag("shard_vault_tester_banner"),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
    ) {
      Row(
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
      ) {
        RiftShardGemIcon(sizeDp = 15.dp)
        Text(
          text =
            if (isTesterInfiniteShards) {
              "BETA TESTER TREASURY ACTIVE // INFINITE 999,999 SHARDS ENABLED"
            } else {
              "OFFICIAL GOOGLE PLAY BILLING TREASURY // $studioUpper"
            },
          color = if (isTesterInfiniteShards) ConduitNexusTeal else ConduitSolarGold,
          fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.8.sp else 10.5.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          maxLines = 1,
          overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        )
      }
      Text(
        text =
          if (isTesterInfiniteShards) {
            "GOOGLE PLAY BILLING ($studioUpper) STANDING BY FOR LAUNCH • ALL UNLOCKS DEPLETE 0 SHARDS"
          } else {
            "CONSUMABLE RIFT SHARD PACKS VERIFIED VIA FIRESTORE PURCHASE TOKEN LEDGER • ZERO PAY-TO-WIN"
          },
        color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
        fontSize = 9.5.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
      )
    }

    // Zero-scroll 2x2 SKU Pack Grid
    Column(
      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 8.dp),
    ) {
      rows.forEach { rowPacks ->
        Row(
          modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 8.dp),
        ) {
          rowPacks.forEach { pack ->
            val accent = parseHexColorSafe(pack.accentHex, ConduitElectricCyan)
            Column(
              modifier =
                Modifier.weight(1f)
                  .fillMaxHeight()
                  .clip(RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
                  .background(
                    Brush.verticalGradient(
                      listOf(
                        accent.copy(alpha = 0.14f),
                        ConduitTabletPanel,
                        ConduitTabletAbyss,
                      )
                    )
                  )
                  .border(1.2.dp, accent.copy(alpha = 0.72f), RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
                  .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 7.dp else 9.dp)
                  .testTag("shard_vault_sku_${pack.productId}"),
              verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            ) {
              Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              ) {
                Row(
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                  modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                ) {
                  RiftShardGemIcon(sizeDp = if (isCompactPhone) 16.dp else 18.dp)
                  Column {
                    Text(
                      text = pack.title,
                      color = Color.White,
                      fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 10.5.sp else 11.5.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                      fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                      maxLines = 1,
                      overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    )
                    Text(
                      text = "SKU // ${pack.productId}",
                      color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                      fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                      fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                      maxLines = 1,
                    )
                  }
                }

                Box(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.background(ConduitTabletAbyss, RoundedCornerShape(5.dp))
                      .border(1.dp, accent, RoundedCornerShape(5.dp))
                      .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                ) {
                  Text(
                    text = pack.badgeLabel,
                    color = accent,
                    fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    maxLines = 1,
                  )
                }
              }

              Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.Bottom,
              ) {
                Column {
                  Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
                  ) {
                    RiftShardGemIcon(sizeDp = 16.dp)
                    Text(
                      text = "${pack.totalShards}",
                      color = ConduitSolarGold,
                      fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 14.sp else 17.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                      fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    )
                  }
                  Text(
                    text =
                      if (pack.bonusShards > 0L) {
                        "${pack.shardAmount} BASE + ${pack.bonusShards} BONUS"
                      } else {
                        "${pack.shardAmount} BASE RIFT SHARDS"
                      },
                    color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                    fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    maxLines = 1,
                  )
                }

                Text(
                  text = pack.displayPriceUsd,
                  color = Color.White,
                  fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 11.5.sp else 13.5.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                )
              }

              Button(
                onClick = { onSelectSkuPack(pack) },
                colors =
                  ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                    containerColor =
                      if (isTesterInfiniteShards) ConduitTabletAbyss else accent,
                    contentColor =
                      if (isTesterInfiniteShards) ConduitNexusTeal else ConduitTabletAbyss,
                  ),
                border =
                  BorderStroke(
                    1.dp,
                    if (isTesterInfiniteShards) ConduitNexusTeal else accent,
                  ),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                modifier =
                  Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(if (isCompactPhone) 27.dp else 30.dp)
                    .testTag("btn_buy_sku_${pack.productId}"),
              ) {
                Text(
                  text =
                    if (isTesterInfiniteShards) {
                      if (isCompactPhone) "INACTIVE — INFINITE TESTER"
                      else "PLAY BILLING INACTIVE — 999,999 TESTER"
                    } else {
                      "PURCHASE ${pack.displayPriceUsd}"
                    },
                  fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.5.sp else 10.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                  maxLines = 1,
                  overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                )
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun ConduitHoloPreviewStage(
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
  holoPhase: Float,
  selectedSubDeck: Int,
  previewShipId: Int,
  previewCosmeticId: Int,
  previewFrameSlotId: String,
  equippedTrimId: Int,
  equippedWarpId: Int,
  equippedHaloId: Int,
  equippedFinisherId: Int,
  liveResonance: Int,
  peakResonance: Int,
  startingBounty: Int,
  publicGameWins: Long,
  onCycleShip: (Int) -> Unit,
) {
  val customVer = RiftSpriteBaker.customShip9Version
  val effectiveTrim =
    if (selectedSubDeck == 2) previewCosmeticId.coerceIn(0, 3) else equippedTrimId.coerceIn(0, 3)
  val shipSpec = remember(previewShipId, customVer) { RiftCodex.getShipById(previewShipId.coerceIn(1, 10)) }
  val shipBitmap =
    remember(previewShipId, effectiveTrim, customVer) {
      RiftSpriteBaker.getShipSprite(
        shipId = previewShipId.coerceIn(1, 10),
        isAllied = true,
        isHitFlashing = false,
        trimStyleOverride = effectiveTrim,
      ).asImageBitmap()
    }

  val stageAccent =
    when (selectedSubDeck) {
      1 -> Color(
        RiftProgressionCatalog.killFinishers
          .firstOrNull { it.id == previewCosmeticId }
          ?.accentColorHex ?: 0xFF00E5FF.toInt()
      )
      2 -> Color(
        RiftProgressionCatalog.hullTrims
          .firstOrNull { it.id == previewCosmeticId }
          ?.accentColorHex ?: 0xFF38BDF8.toInt()
      )
      3 -> Color(
        RiftProgressionCatalog.warpSignatures
          .firstOrNull { it.id == previewCosmeticId }
          ?.accentColorHex ?: 0xFF00F5D4.toInt()
      )
      4 -> Color(
        RiftProgressionCatalog.hvtHalos
          .firstOrNull { it.id == previewCosmeticId }
          ?.accentColorHex ?: 0xFFFFD700.toInt()
      )
      5 -> Color(0xFFEC4899)
      6 -> ConduitSolarGold
      else -> ConduitNexusTeal
    }

  val stageModeLabel =
    when (selectedSubDeck) {
      1 -> {
        val fin = RiftProgressionCatalog.killFinishers.firstOrNull { it.id == previewCosmeticId }?.name ?: "Plasma Supernova"
        "KILL FINISHER // ${fin.uppercase(Locale.US)}"
      }
      2 -> {
        val tr = RiftProgressionCatalog.hullTrims.firstOrNull { it.id == previewCosmeticId }?.name ?: "Factory Alloy"
        "3D HULL TRIM // ${tr.uppercase(Locale.US)}"
      }
      3 -> {
        val wp = RiftProgressionCatalog.warpSignatures.firstOrNull { it.id == previewCosmeticId }?.name ?: "Standard Phase"
        "WARP APERTURE // ${wp.uppercase(Locale.US)}"
      }
      4 -> {
        val hl = RiftProgressionCatalog.hvtHalos.firstOrNull { it.id == previewCosmeticId }?.name ?: "Hunter Amber Ring"
        "LEADER HALO // ${hl.uppercase(Locale.US)}"
      }
      5 -> "RIFT FRAME // ${previewFrameSlotId.uppercase(Locale.US)} (100-PT PARITY)"
      6 -> "SHARD VAULT // ${RiftBillingManager.STUDIO_LEGAL_NAME.uppercase(Locale.US)}"
      else -> "LIVE CONDUIT HOLO-STAGE // 60FPS TELEMETRY"
    }

  Column(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .background(ConduitTabletPanel, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
        .border(1.dp, stageAccent.copy(alpha = 0.60f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
        .padding(9.dp),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
  ) {
    // Stage Top Bar with Hull Switcher
    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
      Text(
        text = stageModeLabel,
        color = stageAccent,
        fontSize = 9.8.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).padding(end = 6.dp),
      )
      Row(
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
      ) {
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(5.dp))
              .background(ConduitTabletAbyss)
              .border(1.dp, ConduitElectricCyan, RoundedCornerShape(5.dp))
              .clickable { onCycleShip(-1) }
              .padding(horizontal = 7.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
              .testTag("conduit_holo_prev_ship")
        ) {
          Text("<", color = ConduitElectricCyan, fontSize = 9.8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace)
        }
        Text(
          text = shipSpec.name.uppercase(Locale.US),
          color = Color.White,
          fontSize = 9.8.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(5.dp))
              .background(ConduitTabletAbyss)
              .border(1.dp, ConduitElectricCyan, RoundedCornerShape(5.dp))
              .clickable { onCycleShip(1) }
              .padding(horizontal = 7.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
              .testTag("conduit_holo_next_ship")
        ) {
          Text(">", color = ConduitElectricCyan, fontSize = 9.8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace)
        }
      }
    }

    // Center Animated 60fps Holo-Stage Canvas + 3D Banking Ship Sprite
    Box(
      modifier =
        Modifier.weight(1f)
          .fillMaxWidth()
          .padding(vertical = 6.dp)
          .clip(RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
          .background(
            Brush.radialGradient(
              colors = listOf(stageAccent.copy(alpha = 0.16f), ConduitTabletAbyss, Color(0xFF030710))
            )
          )
          .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF1E3A5F), RoundedCornerShape(9.dp)),
      contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
      Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        val cx = w * 0.5f
        val cy = h * 0.50f
        val pedY = h * 0.80f

        // Holo scan-cone & pedestal rings
        val conePath =
          Path().apply {
            moveTo(cx - w * 0.30f, pedY)
            lineTo(cx - w * 0.42f, h * 0.12f)
            lineTo(cx + w * 0.42f, h * 0.12f)
            lineTo(cx + w * 0.30f, pedY)
            close()
          }
        drawPath(
          path = conePath,
          brush =
            Brush.verticalGradient(
              colors = listOf(stageAccent.copy(alpha = 0.03f), stageAccent.copy(alpha = 0.22f)),
              startY = h * 0.12f,
              endY = pedY,
            ),
        )
        drawOval(
          color = stageAccent.copy(alpha = 0.25f),
          topLeft = Offset(cx - w * 0.34f, pedY - h * 0.08f),
          size = Size(w * 0.68f, h * 0.16f),
        )
        drawOval(
          color = stageAccent,
          topLeft = Offset(cx - w * 0.34f, pedY - h * 0.08f),
          size = Size(w * 0.68f, h * 0.16f),
          style = Stroke(width = 1.6.dp.toPx()),
        )

        val activeHalo = if (selectedSubDeck == 4) previewCosmeticId else equippedHaloId
        val activeWarp = if (selectedSubDeck == 3) previewCosmeticId else equippedWarpId
        val activeFinisher = if (selectedSubDeck == 1) previewCosmeticId else equippedFinisherId

        // Warp Signature Rift Aperture Rings (emphasized on Warp tab, subtle ambient otherwise)
        if (selectedSubDeck == 3 || activeWarp > 0) {
          val warpAlpha = if (selectedSubDeck == 3) 0.78f else 0.28f
          val warpR = size.minDimension * (0.24f + 0.07f * ((sin(holoPhase * 1.4f) + 1f) * 0.5f))
          drawCircle(
            color = stageAccent.copy(alpha = warpAlpha),
            radius = warpR,
            center = Offset(cx, cy),
            style = Stroke(width = 2.dp.toPx()),
          )
          for (i in 0 until 8) {
            val a = holoPhase * (if (activeWarp % 2 == 0) 1.1f else -1.3f) + (i * PI.toFloat() / 4f)
            drawLine(
              color = stageAccent.copy(alpha = warpAlpha * 0.85f),
              start = Offset(cx + cos(a) * (warpR * 0.68f), cy + sin(a) * (warpR * 0.68f)),
              end = Offset(cx + cos(a) * (warpR * 1.14f), cy + sin(a) * (warpR * 1.14f)),
              strokeWidth = 1.8.dp.toPx(),
            )
          }
        }

        // HVT Crown Halo Nodes around Ship
        val haloR = size.minDimension * 0.31f
        val haloAlpha = if (selectedSubDeck == 4) 0.92f else 0.40f
        drawCircle(
          color = stageAccent.copy(alpha = haloAlpha * 0.55f),
          radius = haloR,
          center = Offset(cx, cy),
          style = Stroke(width = 1.4.dp.toPx()),
        )
        val nodeCount = 4 + (activeHalo.coerceIn(0, 3) * 2)
        for (i in 0 until nodeCount) {
          val ang = holoPhase * 0.9f + (i * 2f * PI.toFloat() / nodeCount)
          val nx = cx + cos(ang) * haloR
          val ny = cy + sin(ang) * haloR
          drawCircle(color = stageAccent.copy(alpha = haloAlpha), radius = 3.2.dp.toPx(), center = Offset(nx, ny))
        }

        // Orbiting 4-point Rift Shard crystals on Sub-Deck 6 (Shard Vault)
        if (selectedSubDeck == 6) {
          val orbitR = size.minDimension * 0.36f
          for (cIdx in 0 until 6) {
            val ca = -holoPhase * 0.8f + (cIdx * 2f * PI.toFloat() / 6f)
            val sx = cx + cos(ca) * orbitR
            val sy = cy + sin(ca) * (orbitR * 0.72f)
            val cr = 5.5.dp.toPx()
            val shardPath =
              Path().apply {
                moveTo(sx, sy - cr)
                lineTo(sx + cr * 0.7f, sy)
                lineTo(sx, sy + cr)
                lineTo(sx - cr * 0.7f, sy)
                close()
              }
            val shardCol = if (cIdx % 2 == 0) ConduitSolarGold else Color(0xFFC084FC)
            drawPath(shardPath, shardCol.copy(alpha = 0.85f))
          }
        }

        // Kill Finisher Shockwave Pulse on Sub-Deck 1
        if (selectedSubDeck == 1) {
          val cyc = (holoPhase * 0.55f) % 1f
          val ringR =
            if (activeFinisher == 1) {
              size.minDimension * (0.42f * (1f - cyc).coerceIn(0.08f, 1f))
            } else {
              size.minDimension * (0.10f + 0.34f * cyc)
            }
          drawCircle(
            color = stageAccent.copy(alpha = (1f - cyc).coerceIn(0.15f, 0.9f)),
            radius = ringR,
            center = Offset(cx, cy),
            style = Stroke(width = 2.6.dp.toPx()),
          )
          for (sIdx in 0 until 10) {
            val sa = (sIdx * 2f * PI.toFloat() / 10f) + holoPhase * 0.4f
            drawCircle(
              color = Color.White.copy(alpha = (1f - cyc) * 0.85f),
              radius = 2.4.dp.toPx(),
              center = Offset(cx + cos(sa) * ringR, cy + sin(sa) * ringR),
            )
          }
        }
      }

      val bobOffsetPx = (sin(holoPhase * 1.25f) * 6f).roundToInt()
      val bankRotation = sin(holoPhase * 0.75f) * 11f
      Image(
        bitmap = shipBitmap,
        contentDescription = shipSpec.name,
        filterQuality = FilterQuality.High,
        modifier =
          Modifier.size(72.dp)
            .offset { IntOffset(0, bobOffsetPx - 4) }
            .graphicsLayer {
              rotationZ = bankRotation
            },
      )
    }

    // Bottom Compact Loadout & Fairness Readout
    Row(
      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
          .background(ConduitTabletAbyss, RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
          .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF1E3A5F), RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
          .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 5.dp),
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
      Column {
        Text(
          text = "STARTING RESONANCE: $startingBounty RES (SCALES 100->500)",
          color = ConduitSolarGold,
          fontSize = 9.5.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
        Text(
          text = "CONVERGENCES WON: $publicGameWins • ALL 10 HULLS OPEN AT 0",
          color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
          fontSize = 9.5.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
      }
      Row(
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
      ) {
        ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = 14.dp)
        Text(
          text = "PEAK $peakResonance",
          color = Color(0xFFC084FC),
          fontSize = 10.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun DailyDirectivesDeck(
  directives: List<DailyConduitDirective>,
  canRerollToday: Boolean,
  sweepBonusClaimed: Boolean,
  liveResonance: Int,
  isCompactPhone: Boolean,
  onClaimDirective: (Int) -> Unit,
  onRerollDirective: (Int) -> Unit,
  onClaimSweep: () -> Unit,
) {
  val completedCount = directives.count { it.isComplete }
  val allClaimedOrDone = directives.size >= 3 && directives.all { it.isComplete }

  Column(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
  ) {
    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
      Row(
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
      ) {
        RiftShardGemIcon(sizeDp = 15.dp)
        Text(
          text = "3 DAILY DIRECTIVES // 250 DAILY OUTPUT",
          color = ConduitSolarGold,
          fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 10.5.sp else 11.5.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
      }
      Text(
        text = if (canRerollToday) "1 FREE REROLL READY" else "DAILY REROLL USED",
        color = if (canRerollToday) ConduitNexusTeal else Color(0xFF94A3B8),
        fontSize = 9.5.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
      )
    }

    LazyColumn(
      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
    ) {
      items(directives, key = { "${it.slotIndex}_${it.directiveId}" }) { dir ->
        Row(
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .background(
                if (dir.claimed) ConduitTabletElevated else ConduitTabletAbyss,
                RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
              )
              .border(
                1.dp,
                when {
                  dir.claimed -> Color(0xFF10B981)
                  dir.isComplete -> ConduitSolarGold
                  else -> ConduitElectricCyan.copy(alpha = 0.45f)
                },
                RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
              )
              .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
              .testTag("daily_directive_card_${dir.slotIndex}"),
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        ) {
          Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).padding(end = 8.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
            Row(
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
            ) {
              Text(
                text = dir.title,
                color = Color.White,
                fontSize = 11.5.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
              Text(
                text = "${dir.progressValue.coerceAtMost(dir.targetValue)} / ${dir.targetValue}",
                color = if (dir.isComplete) Color(0xFF00E676) else ConduitElectricCyan,
                fontSize = 10.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }
            Text(
              text = dir.subtitle,
              color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
              fontSize = 9.8.sp,
              maxLines = 1,
              overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
            )
            Box(
              modifier =
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                  .height(4.dp)
                  .clip(RoundedCornerShape(2.dp))
                  .background(ConduitTabletPanel)
            ) {
              Box(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.fillMaxWidth(dir.progressFraction)
                    .fillMaxHeight()
                    .background(
                      if (dir.isComplete) Color(0xFF00E676) else ConduitNexusTeal,
                      RoundedCornerShape(2.dp),
                    )
              )
            }
          }

          Row(
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
          ) {
            if (!dir.isComplete && !dir.claimed && canRerollToday) {
              Box(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                    .background(ConduitTabletPanel)
                    .border(1.dp, ConduitElectricCyan, RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                    .clickable { onRerollDirective(dir.slotIndex) }
                    .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 5.dp)
                    .testTag("btn_reroll_directive_${dir.slotIndex}")
              ) {
                Text(
                  text = "REROLL",
                  color = ConduitElectricCyan,
                  fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                )
              }
            }

            when {
              dir.claimed -> {
                Box(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.background(ConduitTabletPanel, RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                      .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF00E676), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                      .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 5.dp)
                ) {
                  Text(
                    text = "CLAIMED",
                    color = Color(0xFF00E676),
                    fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                  )
                }
              }

              dir.isComplete -> {
                Button(
                  onClick = { onClaimDirective(dir.slotIndex) },
                  colors =
                    ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                      containerColor = ConduitSolarGold,
                      contentColor = ConduitTabletAbyss,
                    ),
                  shape = RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
                  contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                  modifier = Modifier.height(30.dp).testTag("btn_claim_directive_${dir.slotIndex}"),
                ) {
                  Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
                  ) {
                    RiftShardGemIcon(sizeDp = 13.dp)
                    Text(
                      text = "CLAIM +${dir.shardReward}",
                      fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                      fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    )
                  }
                }
              }

              else -> {
                Row(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.background(ConduitTabletPanel, RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                      .border(1.dp, ConduitSolarGold.copy(alpha = 0.75f), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                      .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 5.dp),
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
                ) {
                  RiftShardGemIcon(sizeDp = 13.dp)
                  Text(
                    text = "+${dir.shardReward}",
                    color = ConduitSolarGold,
                    fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                  )
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // 3/3 Daily Conduit Sweep Bonus Chest (+100 Shards)
      item(key = "daily_sweep_chest") {
        Row(
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .background(
                if (sweepBonusClaimed) ConduitTabletElevated else ConduitTabletAbyss,
                RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
              )
              .border(
                1.2.dp,
                if (sweepBonusClaimed) Color(0xFF10B981) else ConduitSolarGold,
                RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
              )
              .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 7.dp)
              .testTag("daily_sweep_bonus_card"),
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        ) {
          Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).padding(end = 8.dp)) {
            Text(
              text = "DAILY CONDUIT SWEEP BONUS ($completedCount / 3 DIRECTIVES)",
              color = ConduitSolarGold,
              fontSize = 11.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            )
            Text(
              text = "Complete all 3 Daily Directives to unlock the +100 Shard Vault Sweep (250/day total).",
              color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
              fontSize = 9.5.sp,
              maxLines = 1,
              overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
            )
          }

          when {
            sweepBonusClaimed -> {
              Text(
                text = "SWEEP CLAIMED",
                color = Color(0xFF00E676),
                fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }

            allClaimedOrDone -> {
              Button(
                onClick = onClaimSweep,
                colors =
                  ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                    containerColor = Color(0xFF00E676),
                    contentColor = ConduitTabletAbyss,
                  ),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                modifier = Modifier.height(30.dp).testTag("btn_claim_daily_sweep"),
              ) {
                Row(
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
                ) {
                  RiftShardGemIcon(sizeDp = 13.dp)
                  Text(
                    text = "CLAIM +100",
                    fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                  )
                }
              }
            }

            else -> {
              Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
              ) {
                RiftShardGemIcon(sizeDp = 13.dp)
                Text(
                  text = "+100 AT 3/3",
                  color = ConduitSolarGold,
                  fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                )
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Compact 6-Tier Conduit Resonance & Starting Bounty Ladder
      item(key = "conduit_tier_ladder") {
        Column(
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .background(ConduitTabletAbyss, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .border(1.dp, ConduitElectricCyan.copy(alpha = 0.42f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .padding(8.dp),
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
        ) {
          Row(
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
          ) {
            ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = 14.dp)
            Text(
              text = "LIVE RESONANCE RANK TIERS & STARTING RESONANCE SCALING",
              color = ConduitElectricCyan,
              fontSize = 9.8.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            )
          }
          Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
          ) {
            RiftProgressionCatalog.CONDUIT_RANK_TIERS.forEach { tier ->
              val isCurrent = liveResonance in tier.minResonance..tier.maxResonance
              val tc = Color(tier.accentColorHex)
              Column(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.background(
                    if (isCurrent) ConduitTabletElevated else ConduitTabletPanel,
                    RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
                  )
                    .border(1.dp, if (isCurrent) tc else tc.copy(alpha = 0.40f), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                    .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
              ) {
                Text(
                  text = tier.title,
                  color = tc,
                  fontSize = 10.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                )
                Text(
                  text = "${tier.minResonance}+ RES • ${tier.startingBounty} START RES",
                  color = Color.White,
                  fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                )
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun ConduitCosmeticListDeck(
  title: String,
  categoryKey: String,
  items: List<CosmeticCatalogItem>,
  previewedId: Int,
  equippedId: Int,
  isItemUnlocked: (CosmeticCatalogItem) -> Boolean,
  onPreviewItem: (CosmeticCatalogItem) -> Unit,
  onUnlockOrEquip: (CosmeticCatalogItem) -> Unit,
) {
  Column(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
  ) {
    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
      Text(
        text = title,
        color = ConduitNexusTeal,
        fontSize = 11.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
      )
      Text(
        text = "ZERO COMBAT ADVANTAGE",
        color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
        fontSize = 9.5.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
      )
    }

    LazyColumn(
      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
    ) {
      items(items, key = { "${categoryKey}_${it.id}" }) { item ->
        val accent = Color(item.accentColorHex)
        val unlocked = isItemUnlocked(item)
        val isEquipped = equippedId == item.id
        val isPreviewing = previewedId == item.id

        Row(
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .background(
                when {
                  isEquipped || isPreviewing -> ConduitTabletElevated
                  else -> ConduitTabletAbyss
                }
              )
              .border(
                width = if (isEquipped || isPreviewing) 1.4.dp else 1.dp,
                color = if (isEquipped || isPreviewing) accent else accent.copy(alpha = 0.42f),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
              )
              .clickable { onPreviewItem(item) }
              .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 7.dp)
              .testTag("cosmetic_item_${categoryKey}_${item.id}"),
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        ) {
          Row(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).padding(end = 8.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(9.dp),
          ) {
            Box(
              modifier =
                Modifier.size(18.dp)
                  .clip(CircleShape)
                  .background(accent.copy(alpha = 0.25f))
                  .border(1.5.dp, accent, CircleShape)
            )
            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
              Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
              ) {
                Text(
                  text = item.name.uppercase(Locale.US),
                  color = Color.White,
                  fontSize = 11.5.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                )
                if (item.freeAtResonance > 0) {
                  ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = 12.dp)
                }
                Text(
                  text =
                    if (item.freeAtResonance <= 0) "DEFAULT UNLOCK"
                    else "FREE AT ${item.freeAtResonance} PEAK",
                  color = accent,
                  fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                )
              }
              Text(
                text = item.summary,
                color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
              )
            }
          }

          when {
            isEquipped -> {
              Box(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.background(ConduitTabletPanel, RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                    .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF00E676), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                    .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 5.dp)
              ) {
                Text(
                  text = "EQUIPPED",
                  color = Color(0xFF00E676),
                  fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                )
              }
            }

            unlocked -> {
              Button(
                onClick = { onUnlockOrEquip(item) },
                colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = accent, contentColor = ConduitTabletAbyss),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                modifier = Modifier.height(30.dp),
              ) {
                Text(
                  text = "EQUIP",
                  fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                )
              }
            }

            else -> {
              Button(
                onClick = { onUnlockOrEquip(item) },
                colors =
                  ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                    containerColor = ConduitTabletPanel,
                    contentColor = ConduitSolarGold,
                  ),
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, ConduitSolarGold),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                modifier = Modifier.height(30.dp),
              ) {
                Row(
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
                ) {
                  RiftShardGemIcon(sizeDp = 13.dp)
                  Text(
                    text = "UNLOCK ${item.shardCost}",
                    fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                  )
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun ConduitFrameBaysDeck(
  activeSlotId: String,
  spentCustomizationPoints: Int,
  totalCustomizationPoints: Int,
  aiShipDesignTokens: Int,
  isTesterInfiniteShards: Boolean,
  isFrameUnlocked: (String) -> Boolean,
  onPreviewSlot: (String) -> Unit,
  onUnlockOrSelectSlot: (String) -> Unit,
  onRespecPoints: () -> Unit,
  onBuyForgeVoucher: () -> Unit,
  onOpenHangarShip10: () -> Unit,
) {
  val availablePts = (totalCustomizationPoints - spentCustomizationPoints).coerceAtLeast(0)

  Column(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
  ) {
    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
      Text(
        text = "RIFT FRAME BAYS (A–E) // FULL 100-PT PARITY AT 0",
        color = Color(0xFFEC4899),
        fontSize = 11.sp,

sealed interface UiState<out T> {
  data object Loading : UiState<Nothing>
  data class Success<T>(val data: T) : UiState<T>
  data class Error(val message: String) : UiState<Nothing>
}

private fun <T> Flow<T>.retryWithExponentialBackoff(tagLabel: String): Flow<T> =
  this.retryWhen { cause, attempt ->
    if (cause is CancellationException) {
      false
    } else {
      val backoffMs = minOf(8_000L, 900L * (1L shl attempt.coerceAtMost(3L).toInt()))
      Log.w("RiftViewModel", "Retrying $tagLabel stream in ${backoffMs}ms after transient error: ${cause.message}")
      delay(backoffMs)
      true
    }
  }

  fun setActiveSector(sectorId: String) {
    val cleanSector = repository.sanitizeSectorMode(sectorId.ifBlank { "NEXUS_LOBBY" })
    if (_activeSectorId.value != cleanSector) {
      _activeSectorId.value = cleanSector
    }

  val cloudSyncHealth: StateFlow<CloudSyncHealth> = repository.cloudSyncHealth

  private val cloudReadyFlow: StateFlow<Boolean> =
    callbackFlow {
        val auth = Firebase.auth
        fun checkReady(): Boolean {
          val uid = auth.currentUser?.uid?.trim()
          return isGoogleAuthenticated && !uid.isNullOrEmpty() && !uid.startsWith("dev_")
        }
        trySend(checkReady())
        val listener = FirebaseAuth.AuthStateListener { trySend(checkReady()) }
        auth.addAuthStateListener(listener)
        awaitClose { auth.removeAuthStateListener(listener) }
      }
      .distinctUntilChanged()
      .stateIn(
        scope = viewModelScope,
        started = SharingStarted.Eagerly,
        initialValue = isGoogleAuthenticated && Firebase.auth.currentUser != null,
      )

  private fun isCloudSessionReady(): Boolean {
    val uid = Firebase.auth.currentUser?.uid?.trim()
    return isGoogleAuthenticated && !uid.isNullOrEmpty() && !uid.startsWith("dev_")

  val dossierState: StateFlow<UiState<PilotDossier?>> =
